title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Hello, Mister Ward. How are you?"
entries.text: Hello, Mister Ward. How are you?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I... I don't believe we know each o..."
entries.text: I... I don't believe we know each other, do we? Have you just arrived?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Only recently. Declan Ward, Miss, p..."
entries.text: Only recently. Declan Ward, Miss, pleased to meet you.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And I you, Mister Ward. Were you me..."
entries.text: And I you, Mister Ward. Were you meant to be here or did something bring you suddenly - oh blast, that shouldn't matter.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And now I've forgotten to say my na..."
entries.text: And now I've forgotten to say my name - Ivy McLeod.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll let you be, Miss."
entries.text: I'll let you be, Miss.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Take care, Mister Ward."
entries.text: Take care, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Sssh! Not so loudly!"
entries.text: Sssh! Not so loudly!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, but look at me. I don't want th..."
entries.text: Oh, but look at me. I don't want things to be like this. I feel awful doing this to Victoria...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "As long as Miss Deane has... her ev..."
entries.text: As long as Miss Deane has... her evidence, we are not safe. We will be ruined if she decides to share it!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "So, I... All I can do is try and mi..."
entries.text: So, I... All I can do is try and mitigate the damage. Even if that means... Oh, but I don't want to talk about it.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Please, Mister Ward, you can't tell..."
entries.text: Please, Mister Ward, you can't tell anyone. You can't, please. We will be doomed!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I'm sorry - you have me all fluster..."
entries.text: I'm sorry - you have me all flustered. I am host to the second sight, you see. I know things... Or, at least I should. It feels as if, since coming here, I am host to nothing any more.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I should have known you were going..."
entries.text: I should have known you were going to be here - and be late - but it's just more proof that something is wrong...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "She is more calm than I. What will..."
entries.text: She is more calm than I. What will I do without her? I do hope Miss Deane doesn't succeed in driving us apart...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Don't worry, Miss. I won't tell a s..."
entries.text: Don't worry, Miss. I won't tell a soul. I hope Missus Lau is handling the situation well?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, but the only way I can see that..."
entries.text: Oh, but the only way I can see that happening is if we somehow get those awful materials and burn them - there is no other way to be free from that horrible woman's grasp.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Photograph of Deane - Ivy

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "That's Miss Deane, isn't it?"
entries.text: That's Miss Deane, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "In passing. She's trying to make he..."
entries.text: In passing. She's trying to make her name as a spiritualist of some kind.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You know her?"
entries.text: You know her?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Though I don't know if she has a pa..."
entries.text: Though I don't know if she has a particular aptitude of any sort...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this woman?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this woman?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well, good luck to her. May she hav..."
entries.text: Well, good luck to her. May she have the success she deserves.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Sherry - Ivy

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "That's very kind of you, but no tha..."
entries.text: That's very kind of you, but no thank you.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ OFFER ALCOHOL ]"
entries.text: [ OFFER ALCOHOL ]

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ KEEP ALCOHOL ]"
entries.text: [ KEEP ALCOHOL ]

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll hold onto this for now."
entries.text: I'll hold onto this for now.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Séance flyer - Ivy

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "You know, I thought there might be..."
entries.text: You know, I thought there might be more of us attending - with all the spiritualists in London.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But I suppose this seems very far f..."
entries.text: But I suppose this seems very far from home for some. Especially those who've never left the city.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I don't mind - it means there's man..."
entries.text: I don't mind - it means there's many people here that I've never met, and some of them are very interesting. Don't you think?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What is your opinion on the Grand S..."
entries.text: What is your opinion on the Grand Séance?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "A few! But no one's ever tried to t..."
entries.text: A few! But no one's ever tried to tether a ghost before, not that I've seen.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I've still not decided whether I'll..."
entries.text: I've still not decided whether I'll actually go. I should like to see it, but I... I'm worried about it, too.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What is your opinion on the Grand S..."
entries.text: What is your opinion on the Grand Séance?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Marriage talk - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did I hear, Miss, that you're looki..."
entries.text: Did I hear, Miss, that you're looking to find yourself a suitor at this event?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh! I'm sorry, Mister Ward, but tha..."
entries.text: Oh! I'm sorry, Mister Ward, but that's - you're embarrassing me, we hardly know each other. May we talk about something else?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The staff say Deane left - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The staff say Miss Deane left the e..."
entries.text: The staff say Miss Deane left the event early.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Is that so? Maybe she wasn't so int..."
entries.text: Is that so? Maybe she wasn't so interested in this séance as she made out to be...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ghosts - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I could swear there's been some str..."
entries.text: I could swear there's been some strange things happening around this place...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It's getting close to Halloween, an..."
entries.text: It's getting close to Halloween, and with so many of us here, we're not exactly leaving the spirits in peace.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Even if we wanted to - which I do!..."
entries.text: Even if we wanted to - which I do! I've seen some ghastly things. The mirrors especially, they...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He's never there when I turn around..."
entries.text: He's never there when I turn around, of course. But I swear his mouth opens a little wider whenever I spot him, and--

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I-I keep seeing a man behind me, yo..."
entries.text: I-I keep seeing a man behind me, you see.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well, I keep my head bowed at the d..."
entries.text: Well, I keep my head bowed at the dressing room mirrors now. But the other day, I think I felt something wet cross the back of my neck...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The Séance's purpose - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you attended many séances befo..."
entries.text: Have you attended many séances before?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "A few! But no one's ever tried to t..."
entries.text: A few! But no one's ever tried to tether a ghost before, not that I've seen.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I've still not decided whether I'll..."
entries.text: I've still not decided whether I'll actually go. I should like to see it, but I... I'm worried about it, too.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Deane's leaving letter - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It turns out Miss Deane left a lett..."
entries.text: It turns out Miss Deane left a letter excusing herself from the event.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "She did? For what?"
entries.text: She did? For what?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Actually... That's none of my busin..."
entries.text: Actually... That's none of my business, is it? Hm...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Sight - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Would you tell me about this abilit..."
entries.text: Would you tell me about this ability of yours, Miss?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Normally, I would joke that I knew..."
entries.text: Normally, I would joke that I knew you were going to ask that...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It's passed down by blood through S..."
entries.text: It's passed down by blood through Scottish families. It's not uncommon - a fair few people have the ability, at least a little bit.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It just so happens that I'm the onl..."
entries.text: It just so happens that I'm the only one of my family to have it to any measure, and it came in... very strong.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "The Second Sight... it gives a pers..."
entries.text: The Second Sight... it gives a person... foreknowledge. Or just knowledge you couldn't possibly know. I get visions, mostly of things to come.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Or... I used to. Since arriving her..."
entries.text: Or... I used to. Since arriving here, I've been cut off from it. Surely I should have seen warning of that?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But since coming here, it's... clou..."
entries.text: But since coming here, it's... cloudy... and... well, I feel blinded in a way.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But I've put the cart before the ho..."
entries.text: But I've put the cart before the horse. You don't even know what it is that I've lost, yet.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ritual markings - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I came across evidence of a ritual..."
entries.text: I came across evidence of a ritual upstairs.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Hm... I don't know much about ritua..."
entries.text: Hm... I don't know much about rituals... It's not really my focus. I hope you're not going to ask me what it was for.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "That does seem peculiar, though, do..."
entries.text: That does seem peculiar, though, doesn't it?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal saw Deane - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister O'Meara tells me he saw Miss..."
entries.text: Mister O'Meara tells me he saw Miss Deane on Tuesday night, and she looked as if she might have been drinking.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh? ...Well, I suppose it's not as..."
entries.text: Oh? ...Well, I suppose it's not as if people aren't drinking at an event like this. He only saw her?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "He tells me he didn't want to inter..."
entries.text: He tells me he didn't want to intervene and risk offending her.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Ah, that's good of him... Well, I d..."
entries.text: Ah, that's good of him... Well, I didn't see her, I can't speak to it.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Bedroom skeleton key - Ivy

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Why - why do you have that?!"
entries.text: Why - why do you have that?!

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange occurrences - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed any strange happen..."
entries.text: Have you noticed any strange happenings around the manor?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Mm... hm. Truth be told, I woke up..."
entries.text: Mm... hm. Truth be told, I woke up last night to all the windows having been opened.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "That wasn't what woke me, though. W..."
entries.text: That wasn't what woke me, though. What woke me was a knocking on the underside of my bed. There was nothing there, of course, but...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I didn't sleep much after that."
entries.text: I didn't sleep much after that.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Statement, Mister Doyle - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss..."
entries.text: Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone on Tuesday.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He did? Well, Miss Deane - she's be..."
entries.text: He did? Well, Miss Deane - she's been known to find herself an argument, I hear, but -

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, but Mister Doyle has no busines..."
entries.text: Oh, but Mister Doyle has no business talking about it himself! Are we being listened in on?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mysterious figure - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I saw a figure in the window as I w..."
entries.text: I saw a figure in the window as I was walking back to the manor... Have you noticed anything of the sort?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Too shadowed to make out... but sma..."
entries.text: Too shadowed to make out... but small in stature, like a young boy? I've seen him.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Another ghost, I suppose... I wonde..."
entries.text: Another ghost, I suppose... I wonder what happened to him.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Dead End - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I took the trouble of seeing about..."
entries.text: I took the trouble of seeing about where Miss Deane went when she left, and I've found that her trail seems to stop in the middle of the hedge maze.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Stop? I'm sorry, as in, you don't k..."
entries.text: Stop? I'm sorry, as in, you don't know where she is?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It's as if she's vanished. I'd wage..."
entries.text: It's as if she's vanished. I'd wager she never left the grounds at all.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh... Oh, I don't like her, but I'd..."
entries.text: Oh... Oh, I don't like her, but I'd never wish that upon her. Someone ought to see that she's alright.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "If I see anything, I shall tell you..."
entries.text: If I see anything, I shall tell you.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Hermetic Order - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about the Herm..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about the Hermetic Order Of The Golden Dawn?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "A little. I have had a couple of in..."
entries.text: A little. I have had a couple of invitations to join them... but I've no interest in their sort of magic.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Silks - Ivy

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, how kind of you. I'll put it wi..."
entries.text: Oh, how kind of you. I'll put it with my others.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ OFFER SILKS ]"
entries.text: [ OFFER SILKS ]

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ KEEP SILKS ]"
entries.text: [ KEEP SILKS ]

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll hold onto this for now."
entries.text: I'll hold onto this for now.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "You, Sir, have no idea."
entries.text: You, Sir, have no idea.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I hope you have some peace, now."
entries.text: I hope you have some peace, now.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "My sight, my second sight, is not q..."
entries.text: My sight, my second sight, is not quite back to me yet.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But I don't need it to see how luck..."
entries.text: But I don't need it to see how lucky I am.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I know Victoria acted... well, she..."
entries.text: I know Victoria acted... well, she acted... and she made mistakes.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "As did I - in chasing a husband wit..."
entries.text: As did I - in chasing a husband without discussing it with her and what that could mean for... us.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And Darragh, dear sweet Darragh - h..."
entries.text: And Darragh, dear sweet Darragh - he trained me in the sight, you know. How to manage it, how to hide it from others...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And, of course, you, Sir."
entries.text: And, of course, you, Sir.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "For him to be in this place when I..."
entries.text: For him to be in this place when I needed him most... To have acted against Miss Deane and gotten us the key.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "You found the materials and returne..."
entries.text: You found the materials and returned them to us.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "You have given us a chance at a fut..."
entries.text: You have given us a chance at a future together and we will never forget that.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Thank you."
entries.text: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Her haste might have broken my hear..."
entries.text: Her haste might have broken my heart - but it bought my freedom too. Whether we make it through this or not, that is priceless.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I-I'm still coming to terms with it..."
entries.text: I-I'm still coming to terms with it, I think. That someone so dear to me could break my trust.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But... I also know she wasn't entir..."
entries.text: But... I also know she wasn't entirely herself. And her haste bought my freedom too.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I don't know what comes next for us..."
entries.text: I don't know what comes next for us, but that is a priceless gift.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Bridge game - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Were you at the bridge game on Tues..."
entries.text: Were you at the bridge game on Tuesday?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Me? Oh, ah, no. I was taking a nap...."
entries.text: Me? Oh, ah, no. I was taking a nap. I think Victoria was there, though?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal statement, Bridge - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I asked Mister O'Meara if he was at..."
entries.text: I asked Mister O'Meara if he was at the bridge game, and, strangely, he said he was nowhere at all.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, won't you leave him be? What ha..."
entries.text: Oh, won't you leave him be? What harm could he have done? He probably just forgot he was there at all.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Chance - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister O'Meara does seem upset abou..."
entries.text: Mister O'Meara does seem upset about not helping Miss Deane on Tuesday... but I can't help but wonder if he's withholding something.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Withholding-? Why, if it has anythi..."
entries.text: Withholding-? Why, if it has anything to do with Miss Deane, he would tell you, I'm sure. It's the only decent thing to do.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Secret rendevouz - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister O'Meara tells me that he was..."
entries.text: Mister O'Meara tells me that he wasn't at the bridge game, as it happens - that he was in the gardens with you.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, how could-? Hush! Why would you..."
entries.text: Oh, how could-? Hush! Why would you even-?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I... Yes, Mister Ward, if you must..."
entries.text: I... Yes, Mister Ward, if you must know, we went on a walk. And it was only a walk, don't you get a single idea otherwise.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is your chaperone not supposed to a..."
entries.text: Is your chaperone not supposed to accompany you for exactly that sort of thing?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Yes, she is, but I didn't want to -..."
entries.text: Yes, she is, but I didn't want to - Victoria was not - it is none of your business at all!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I went for a walk in the gardens wi..."
entries.text: I went for a walk in the gardens with Mister O'Meara, and we talked, and that is all. That is all! Are you happy, now?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "...Please, do not tell the others...."
entries.text: ...Please, do not tell the others. They will assume the worst of me.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Newspaper clipping - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems like Missus Joyce has an i..."
entries.text: It seems like Missus Joyce has an interest in the goings on in Dublin.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Not only that, but she has circled...."
entries.text: Not only that, but she has circled... here, and here... the name of a Detective Ward.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "How many Wards are there in Dublin,..."
entries.text: How many Wards are there in Dublin, then? How many who come to parties asking questions?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "If we're in danger, I should have k..."
entries.text: If we're in danger, I should have known. Shouldn't I? My head feels so strange...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Drafted telegram - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It appears Missus Joyce sent for he..."
entries.text: It appears Missus Joyce sent for help - that she was worried about Miss Deane.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Have we reason to be worried about..."
entries.text: Have we reason to be worried about Miss Deane? Where is she, then, Detective? That you are still here, and haven't yet found her?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Entertainment schedule - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I caught a glimpse of the entertain..."
entries.text: I caught a glimpse of the entertainment schedule for the week... there's a lot to do.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And I intend to do whatever catches..."
entries.text: And I intend to do whatever catches my fancy. I feel... strange, but lighter than I have for a while.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I'm going to make the most of it!"
entries.text: I'm going to make the most of it!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Any events in particular you're int..."
entries.text: Any events in particular you're interested in?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lan Fen's statement - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Lau mentioned that you've be..."
entries.text: Missus Lau mentioned that you've been having visions less frequently than you usually do.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "She did? Well, she's right. It's th..."
entries.text: She did? Well, she's right. It's the strangest thing.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "For years, I get flashes of - of th..."
entries.text: For years, I get flashes of - of things, of knowledge - every day, and full visions every few, and now - almost nothing.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And it's not as if this place is ve..."
entries.text: And it's not as if this place is very calming. I don't know what it is.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I suppose I will enjoy the peace wh..."
entries.text: I suppose I will enjoy the peace while I have it... If I can. It feels... I don't know. It's strange. I don't know if I like either option.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Talks schedule - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you plan on attending any of the..."
entries.text: Do you plan on attending any of the talks that are going on?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I think I might go to the one Miste..."
entries.text: I think I might go to the one Mister Dupré is hosting.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I'm not really here to sit through..."
entries.text: I'm not really here to sit through talks, but that one does sound really quite interesting.

entries.text: Not any more than the next person, I don't think. And besides, I'm Church of Scotland, and I doubt you need to know anything about that...?

entries.text: Not much... I'm Presbyterian, you see. I've never had to know anything about it.

entries.text: It appears Mister Toussaint has made quite the name for himself.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
