entries.text: Indeed, he has. And for good work, at that. And Victoria likes him. And yet I do not want to speak with him.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "What if I misspeak - contradict mys..."
entries.text: What if I misspeak - contradict myself - and it is taken as proof I am not genuine?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I cannot imagine seeing the things..."
entries.text: I cannot imagine seeing the things I see, and not being believed at all...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Surreptitious meeting - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is it true that you were talking to..."
entries.text: Is it true that you were talking to Mister Hunter on Sunday morning?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "W-well why shouldn't I? Darragh all..."
entries.text: W-well why shouldn't I? Darragh all but helped raise me. It has been... just so nice to see him again.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Of course, people have all sorts of..."
entries.text: Of course, people have all sorts of things to say about it. About what it means for my family.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "All completely untrue, of course! B..."
entries.text: All completely untrue, of course! But, oh, rumours have a mind of their own, don't they?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "How do you know that? Anyway - why..."
entries.text: How do you know that? Anyway - why shouldn't I? Darragh all but helped raise me. It has been... just so nice to see him again.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It just - it has to be kept quiet,..."
entries.text: It just - it has to be kept quiet, because people might have all sorts of things to say about it. About what it means for my family.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "All completely untrue, of course! B..."
entries.text: All completely untrue, of course! But it doesn't really do to invite rumour.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You know, I had the strangest dream..."
entries.text: You know, I had the strangest dream the night I arrived here. Of a long hallway, leading to nothing but more doors.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "You know, I've been reading about i..."
entries.text: You know, I've been reading about it. Hallways represent transitional spaces, because that's what they are, quite literally.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "They can mean moving from one thing..."
entries.text: They can mean moving from one thing onto another... a new stage in life, a new relationship, a new world view...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And locked doors? That's easy. They..."
entries.text: And locked doors? That's easy. They're barriers to overcome. But, really, don't take it too much to heart...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I think everyone gets strange dream..."
entries.text: I think everyone gets strange dreams around here. Right?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It was quite scary! I have never dr..."
entries.text: It was quite scary! I have never dreamt of anything like it before.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I think everyone gets strange dream..."
entries.text: I think everyone gets strange dreams around here. The first night I was here, I had this dream...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I saw somebody walking down these h..."
entries.text: I saw somebody walking down these halls, dripping blood and molten iron. They were looking for something - a way out, maybe?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh! I've had the same. Victoria too..."
entries.text: Oh! I've had the same. Victoria too. I think it's the atmosphere - everywhere looks the same, so of course it'll bubble up in one's dreams.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "The symbols? I don't know so much a..."
entries.text: The symbols? I don't know so much about that - sigils, I think, but that is really outside of my practice.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Memento Mori - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know if there are..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know if there are a lot of deaths in the Quinn family?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Do I? Of course. The whole family i..."
entries.text: Do I? Of course. The whole family is cursed! There's not many of them left at all, I hear... Miss Quinn might be one of the last.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I don't know the specifics of the c..."
entries.text: I don't know the specifics of the curse, but I know it to be true. Bad luck like that doesn't come about naturally. The poor dear...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Drugged Water Jug - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed anything about the..."
entries.text: Have you noticed anything about the drinking water here?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Water always tastes different when..."
entries.text: Water always tastes different when you go somewhere new, doesn't it?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I thought it would be nicer here, b..."
entries.text: I thought it would be nicer here, but it's almost bitter.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Hedonistic Gala - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do events like these usually have p..."
entries.text: Do events like these usually have parties... such as last night's?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "For once I was glad that my sight w..."
entries.text: For once I was glad that my sight was dulled. I saw quite enough as it was.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It was as if everyone took on the p..."
entries.text: It was as if everyone took on the personas of their costumes.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And I was talking with - no, to - t..."
entries.text: And I was talking with - no, to - three ghosts for a while. I only realised that they were not answering me back.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I even saw a giant at one point!"
entries.text: I even saw a giant at one point!

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Hunter mentioned a photograp..."
entries.text: Mister Hunter mentioned a photograph of the two of you, from many years back.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Does he recall it? Really?"
entries.text: Does he recall it? Really?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I must show him - I have it still...."
entries.text: I must show him - I have it still. With me, in fact.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He worked on my parents' land when..."
entries.text: He worked on my parents' land when I was little.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I use it as a bookmark so I never f..."
entries.text: I use it as a bookmark so I never forget him - not that I ever could, of course!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I hadn't realised how much I missed..."
entries.text: I hadn't realised how much I missed him until I saw him again. This time, when I go, I will send letters.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is this you in this photograph with..."
entries.text: Is this you in this photograph with Mister Hunter, Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Where on earth did you find that? S..."
entries.text: Where on earth did you find that? Surely Darragh didn't give it to you?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It is me. I had forgotten about thi..."
entries.text: It is me. I had forgotten about this photograph, but... I remember when it was taken. It was my brother behind the camera.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I thought the world of him then......"
entries.text: I thought the world of him then... And... do you know what? I still do.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He's always been the sentimental so..."
entries.text: He's always been the sentimental sort, and he was insistent that I'd want it one day... but I gave it to Darragh when he left.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I hadn't realised how I missed him..."
entries.text: I hadn't realised how I missed him until I saw him again. This time, when I go, I will send letters.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I thought the world of him then......"
entries.text: I thought the world of him then... And... do you know what? I still do.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this symbol, Mis M..."
entries.text: Do you recognise this symbol, Mis McLeod?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Should I? I don't think it means an..."
entries.text: Should I? I don't think it means anything to me. Magical languages aren't my forté, you know.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Unknown Sigil - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've been seeing this sigil about...."
entries.text: I've been seeing this sigil about. A spiral, intersected with four lines - one on top, three below. Does that mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "That's curious... No, if it means s..."
entries.text: That's curious... No, if it means something, I don't know what it is.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I'm not really one for magical lang..."
entries.text: I'm not really one for magical languages, though. And it's certainly nothing Scottish. Perhaps you could ask someone else?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/freemasons - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about the Freemaso..."
entries.text: What do you know about the Freemasons?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well... nothing at all. I think tha..."
entries.text: Well... nothing at all. I think that's sort of the point, you know. I'm not allowed to know.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm sorry to impose on your persona..."
entries.text: I'm sorry to impose on your personal matters, but I must know - did you meet with Mister O'Meara last Tuesday around nine?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "...Well, Sir, if you can promise yo..."
entries.text: ...Well, Sir, if you can promise your discretion on the matter, then yes, I can tell you that we did indeed meet then.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well - it's not any of your busines..."
entries.text: Well - it's not any of your business - but-

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Since you're being polite... yes, I..."
entries.text: Since you're being polite... yes, I did. I just wanted to talk to him for a moment, without half a dozen people to bear witness.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I just wanted to apologise, Miss Mc..."
entries.text: I just wanted to apologise, Miss McLeod, for walking in on you and Mister O'Meara. It wasn't my intention.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh! No, it's--"
entries.text: Oh! No, it's--

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, it was a stupid idea, really. I..."
entries.text: Oh, it was a stupid idea, really. In all my haste to find a suitor, I should have known better...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "If you'll forgive me for saying so,..."
entries.text: If you'll forgive me for saying so, Miss, you seem a very talented young woman - one with her whole life ahead of her. Why the rush?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I... I have to, Mister Ward. If I d..."
entries.text: I... I have to, Mister Ward. If I don't, then Miss De--

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "...It doesn't matter. What matters..."
entries.text: ...It doesn't matter. What matters is, I must.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Curse - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, the Quinn family have a curse o..."
entries.text: So, the Quinn family have a curse on them? What's it supposed to do?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well, I didn't ask... but I think t..."
entries.text: Well, I didn't ask... but I think there must have been a Quinn, like Corentine, in our circles at least once before, because it's not an unknown quantity.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "From what I've heard, it is suppose..."
entries.text: From what I've heard, it is supposed to drive them to early graves. The means, I don't know... but I've heard of illness, accident, murder...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I've no doubt Miss Quinn has overco..."
entries.text: I've no doubt Miss Quinn has overcome some odds to be here in the first place. Poor darling...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal's Journal - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm sorry to impose on your persona..."
entries.text: I'm sorry to impose on your personal matters, but I must know - did you meet with Mister O'Meara last Tuesday around nine?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "...Well, Sir, if you can promise yo..."
entries.text: ...Well, Sir, if you can promise your discretion on the matter, then yes, I can tell you that we did indeed meet then.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm sorry to impose on your persona..."
entries.text: I'm sorry to impose on your personal matters, but I must know - did you meet with Mister O'Meara last Tuesday around nine?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well - it's not any of your busines..."
entries.text: Well - it's not any of your business - but-

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Since you're being polite... yes, I..."
entries.text: Since you're being polite... yes, I did. I just wanted to talk to him for a moment, without half a dozen people to bear witness.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Deane's Room - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know which room Miss Deane w..."
entries.text: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Of course I do... don't, actually...."
entries.text: Of course I do... don't, actually. I shouldn't have forgotten a thing like that...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "She wasn't in my corridor, I rememb..."
entries.text: She wasn't in my corridor, I remember that much. But still, how could I...?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, how many more ways can I lose m..."
entries.text: Oh, how many more ways can I lose my mind?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Buried Messages - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The dream we're experiencing, it ha..."
entries.text: The dream we're experiencing, it has a message buried inside it!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh? What of? Wait, did you...?"
entries.text: Oh? What of? Wait, did you...?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Images of home, for me. Dublin, my..."
entries.text: Images of home, for me. Dublin, my old pub, my... brother. Eamonn.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I knew it! Victoria and I experienc..."
entries.text: I knew it! Victoria and I experienced similar dreams. In mine, I saw my old mare standing in fields of heather... It must depend on what home means to you, I say, and how you see it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It left me with a longing to attend..."
entries.text: It left me with a longing to attend the séance... But then, the concept of home? The two seem unrelated.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "What if they're not? This dream mus..."
entries.text: What if they're not? This dream must have a source, Mister Ward. Maybe for the source, they're not unrelated at all...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Altered Reality - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I think that we're all sharing a dr..."
entries.text: I think that we're all sharing a dream, Miss McLeod, that is altering our realities. Or our perception of them, at least.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I wonder - could that be to blame f..."
entries.text: I wonder - could that be to blame for my dampened gift? Hmm...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Truly? But what on earth is it chan..."
entries.text: Truly? But what on earth is it changing?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't quite pinpoint it, but I do..."
entries.text: I can't quite pinpoint it, but I don't think it's permanent - yet.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I fear the longer we stay here, the..."
entries.text: I fear the longer we stay here, the harder it will become to tell what's real and what is not.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lucid Dreaming - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about lucid dreami..."
entries.text: Do you know much about lucid dreaming?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh yes. It's quite the wonder. It t..."
entries.text: Oh yes. It's quite the wonder. It takes some training, but some music or other sleep aids can help get you there.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I've never tried using an anchor to..."
entries.text: I've never tried using an anchor to guide the dream, but I gather any concept can be used, as long as there is a physical totem for it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What if you wanted to... explore a..."
entries.text: What if you wanted to... explore a dream?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh gosh. Now that's something! Do y..."
entries.text: Oh gosh. Now that's something! Do you have anything on hand that you'd associate with this dream?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I suppose I have a book, a journal..."
entries.text: I suppose I have a book, a journal really, that set me on this course in the first place. Would that work?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I can't say, Mister Ward, but there..."
entries.text: I can't say, Mister Ward, but there is a certain way to find out, and that is to try!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I prefer unguided, myself - just a..."
entries.text: I prefer unguided, myself - just a cosy space and some free time to explore my mind.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Shared Dreams - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I think many of the guests are expe..."
entries.text: I think many of the guests are experiencing the same dream.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh my. I knew Victoria and I had ex..."
entries.text: Oh my. I knew Victoria and I had experienced similar dreams, but I had no idea the scale of it.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "How would that work? Something bein..."
entries.text: How would that work? Something being cast out for people to pick up in their sleep? Or a larger dream that we're all tuning into?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I've done my fair bit of dream read..."
entries.text: I've done my fair bit of dream reading, but I've not heard of anything like that before.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail material on Livy - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I believe I've found the informatio..."
entries.text: I believe I've found the information Miss Deane had on you.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh! You have? Let me see!"
entries.text: Oh! You have? Let me see!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Mister Ward, you have no idea how r..."
entries.text: Mister Ward, you have no idea how relieved I am!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I have to get Victoria - and maybe..."
entries.text: I have to get Victoria - and maybe - I'll find Darragh, too. He'll be around here somewhere. Just one moment!

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cache of Stolen Documents - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found these documents, but I have..."
entries.text: I found these documents, but I haven't a clue as to their owner. Might you recognise them?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh! Goodness. I-I'm sorry, Mister W..."
entries.text: Oh! Goodness. I-I'm sorry, Mister Ward, I can't imagine who'd leave those lying around like that...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chimney Charm - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this on the grounds. What d..."
entries.text: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it - is it some kind of charm?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Yes, it looks like it. I vaguely re..."
entries.text: Yes, it looks like it. I vaguely recall seeing something of the sort in my childhood... in the stables, perhaps?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But I don't make such things, so I'..."
entries.text: But I don't make such things, so I'm not sure I can be of any use.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Her relationship with Darragh - Ivy

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Yes. Darragh was the groundskeeper..."
entries.text: Yes. Darragh was the groundskeeper on my family estate when I was growing up. I've known him since I was very small.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You knew Mister Hunter before this..."
entries.text: You knew Mister Hunter before this event didn't you?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I was so happy to see him here. I'v..."
entries.text: I was so happy to see him here. I've always considered him a good friend. But we've been trying to be discreet - some people think it's improper.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I think it's silly. I've met plenty..."
entries.text: I think it's silly. I've met plenty of terrible men in far better standing. We're all just people, no matter our station, don't you agree Mister Ward?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And he was a tremendous help when m..."
entries.text: And he was a tremendous help when my Second Sight came in. No one else really knew what to do with me.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It runs in bloodlines, you see - bu..."
entries.text: It runs in bloodlines, you see - but I have it much more fiercely than anyone in my family's living memory.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But I won't risk him his job, so......"
entries.text: But I won't risk him his job, so... Discreet it is.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Wards of Protection - Ivy

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Mister Hunter's always been so good..."
entries.text: Mister Hunter's always been so good to me. We'll wear these for the rest of the event, even just to set his mind at ease.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Those charms look to be crafted wit..."
entries.text: Those charms look to be crafted with a great deal of care, Miss.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Though... What about you, Mister Wa..."
entries.text: Though... What about you, Mister Ward? What if Mister Hunter's right, and something bad is going to happen at the séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll be alright, Miss - don't you w..."
entries.text: I'll be alright, Miss - don't you worry.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I've already asked, but it seems th..."
entries.text: I've already asked, but it seems there's simply no way to have a new ward ready at such short notice...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Witchcraft Components - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of these? Are they..."
entries.text: What do you make of these? Are they items for a ritual of some sort?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Hm... Well, perhaps not a ritual, b..."
entries.text: Hm... Well, perhaps not a ritual, but they could be used to make a charm of some sort.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Traces of drug - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you been having trouble sleepi..."
entries.text: Have you been having trouble sleeping, Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well I... No, but I have been feeli..."
entries.text: Well I... No, but I have been feeling a little out of sorts since we arrived here.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I usually do have trouble sleeping,..."
entries.text: I usually do have trouble sleeping, but here I don't... Yet - I don't feel quite right in myself, either.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Maybe it was the journey here. Or t..."
entries.text: Maybe it was the journey here. Or the ghosts!

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail letter - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You're quite close to Missus Lau?"
entries.text: You're quite close to Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, Victoria's a darling. She's my..."
entries.text: Oh, Victoria's a darling. She's my chaperone, but she's my friend before that.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I - I'm sure I don't know what you..."
entries.text: I - I'm sure I don't know what you mean.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A very dear friend indeed I'd wager..."
entries.text: A very dear friend indeed I'd wager...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/She's being drugged - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss McLeod... I don't know how to..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod... I don't know how to tell you this, but I think your visions might be fading because you are being drugged...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "What! Drugged!? By whom?"
entries.text: What! Drugged!? By whom?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Well, I hesitate to say this, but M..."
entries.text: Well, I hesitate to say this, but Missus Lau would be the person with easiest access to you...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Victoria? Drugging me? Oh, what a r..."
entries.text: Victoria? Drugging me? Oh, what a relief... Now I know you are wrong!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Sir... I appreciate your concerns,..."
entries.text: Sir... I appreciate your concerns, but however you came to that conclusion... I am afraid you are very much mistaken.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I know and trust Victoria implicitl..."
entries.text: I know and trust Victoria implicitly. She would not do anything that was not in my best interests.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/skerritt's cards - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "In tarot, what would a spread of 'T..."
entries.text: In tarot, what would a spread of 'The Hanged Man', the 'Ten of Pentacles', and the 'Death' cards mean to you?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well now! Let me see... The Hanged..."
entries.text: Well now! Let me see... The Hanged Man - he represents spiritual development and, em, patience, I believe.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Death doesn't mean death. Not reall..."
entries.text: Death doesn't mean death. Not really. In an abstract sense, yes, like how a part of you dies as you change and grow. But that's all. It's not a card to be scared of. Or maybe it is, but not in the way that most people would assume.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "The Ten of Pentacles is about famil..."
entries.text: The Ten of Pentacles is about family and sharing, and the security and peace one gets from that.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "As for their meaning together? I mu..."
entries.text: As for their meaning together? I must admit, I don't really know. I work with the cards as a way to focus my own gifts. I honestly couldn't give a clear reading here - not while my sight is dulled.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Perhaps you should speak with one o..."
entries.text: Perhaps you should speak with one of the more accomplished readers?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know how you're going to spe..."
entries.text: Do you know how you're going to spend today?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "You mean, other than the ball later..."
entries.text: You mean, other than the ball later?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I think I'm going to go to Miss Man..."
entries.text: I think I'm going to go to Miss Mantovani's talk at 5pm. I would like to hear what she has to say.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Apart from that, I don't really kno..."
entries.text: Apart from that, I don't really know. Perhaps I'll get some fresh air... unless it gets too cold. As for Sunday...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you think you're going to sp..."
entries.text: How do you think you're going to spend the day?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "...Well, they don't have any servic..."
entries.text: ...Well, they don't have any services that suit me, so I think I'll take a walk in the garden while Victoria is at church.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "After which I hope she'll join me o..."
entries.text: After which I hope she'll join me out there for a walk.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And naturally, we'll want a good lu..."
entries.text: And naturally, we'll want a good lunch at some stage too.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "We shouldn't attempt to raise the d..."
entries.text: We shouldn't attempt to raise the dead on empty stomachs - we'll need our focus for the séance!

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Record - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about music us..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about music used to help a person get to sleep?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I assume you don't mean lullabies?..."
entries.text: I assume you don't mean lullabies? No, that would be a strange question.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I've heard of it, certainly, but I'..."
entries.text: I've heard of it, certainly, but I've never tried it myself. Perhaps Doctor Callaghan might know something about it?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/jacket note - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does Missus Lau know Miss Deane wel..."
entries.text: Does Missus Lau know Miss Deane well? Would she have reason to try to meet with her?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I... I don't see how that is any of..."
entries.text: I... I don't see how that is any of your concern, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "M-me? No, I'd want no part in any s..."
entries.text: M-me? No, I'd want no part in any such meeting, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You wouldn't happen to be meeting u..."
entries.text: You wouldn't happen to be meeting up with Miss Deane this weekend, would you?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/gauge - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen the strange device in..."
entries.text: Have you seen the strange device in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I cannot look at that without getti..."
entries.text: I cannot look at that without getting a headache.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I suspect if my powers were working..."
entries.text: I suspect if my powers were working properly, I would learn a great many terrible things from that device.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And in a way that, if nothing else,..."
entries.text: And in a way that, if nothing else, makes me glad that they are gone.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mourning cameo - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Lau's necklace... am I to un..."
entries.text: Missus Lau's necklace... am I to understand that it's a mourning cameo?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It is, Mister Ward. For her late hu..."
entries.text: It is, Mister Ward. For her late husband.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I never met him, you know. He died..."
entries.text: I never met him, you know. He died of malaria, and I did try to warn Victoria - I had seen it, you understand.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I... we were too late, of course. A..."
entries.text: I... we were too late, of course. And, to listen to Victoria, the world lost a remarkable man because of it.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Their bond... Oh, Mister Ward, it....."
entries.text: Their bond... Oh, Mister Ward, it... Deep gentleness, deep love. Sometimes, I--

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I don't know if I'm doing it right,..."
entries.text: I don't know if I'm doing it right, you see. Being there for her in all this.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But I know I want to try."
entries.text: But I know I want to try.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Varley - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Varley, in your..."
entries.text: Have you met Mister Varley, in your time here?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, yes, almost as soon as we got h..."
entries.text: Oh, yes, almost as soon as we got here.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He's rather stern, isn't he? Though..."
entries.text: He's rather stern, isn't he? Though he was gentlemanly enough.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Besides, I'd be stern too if I had..."
entries.text: Besides, I'd be stern too if I had to sleep in the basement all night.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Mister Hunter says that's where all..."
entries.text: Mister Hunter says that's where all the staff stay - but I think they should get nice rooms like ours, don't you?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How did Missus Lau come to be your..."
entries.text: How did Missus Lau come to be your chaperone?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "That is, in itself, quite the story..."
entries.text: That is, in itself, quite the story... And sometimes I don't know whether it is mine to tell.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I will give you this; I met Victori..."
entries.text: I will give you this; I met Victoria at a party, some springtime do, and once I spoke with her, I felt I could have known her my whole life.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "... And, perhaps despite her better..."
entries.text: ... And, perhaps despite her better judgement, she likes me enough to keep my company.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "She's a darling like that. I am - o..."
entries.text: She's a darling like that. I am - oh, I am immensely fond of her. Seldom do you meet a person like Victoria.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Skerritt

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you made Mister Skerritt's acq..."
entries.text: Have you made Mister Skerritt's acquaintance?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I think I have met almost everyone..."
entries.text: I think I have met almost everyone here. Mister Skerritt introduced himself to me.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "So, yes, I've met him. He talked at..."
entries.text: So, yes, I've met him. He talked at me for a while, though he was rather rude to Victoria and so I stopped listening.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "... Perhaps, don't mention that I s..."
entries.text: ... Perhaps, don't mention that I said that.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Corentine - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Quinn?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, the poet? I have! I've been mea..."
entries.text: Oh, the poet? I have! I've been meaning to find some of her poetry and read it for myself.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I think she's rather charming. Even..."
entries.text: I think she's rather charming. Even if she is poor conversation when she's preoccupied with all that work.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I can't blame her... I think, perha..."
entries.text: I can't blame her... I think, perhaps, there's something after her... Though what exactly it is, I don't know.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It's times like these I truly feel..."
entries.text: It's times like these I truly feel the absence of my second sight.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had reason to talk to the..."
entries.text: Have you had reason to talk to the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "She made a little conversation when..."
entries.text: She made a little conversation when we arrived, asking where we were from.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "...And then she apologised for aski..."
entries.text: ...And then she apologised for asking. I told her I didn't mind. I would be curious about visitors, too, if I never travelled.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well, I did try. But before I'd eve..."
entries.text: Well, I did try. But before I'd even had the chance, she cut me off with the nastiest glare.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Then she said to stop taking up all..."
entries.text: Then she said to stop taking up all of Mister Hunter's time! He wasn't even in the room when she said that.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He's very dear to me, you see, and..."
entries.text: He's very dear to me, you see, and yet we've hardly had a chance to speak since I've arrived...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you happen to have met the stab..."
entries.text: Did you happen to have met the stable master?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I have! Some time ago, in fact. Mis..."
entries.text: I have! Some time ago, in fact. Mister Hunter used to work on my family's estate. It's been lovely to see him again.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He introduced me to the horses. The..."
entries.text: He introduced me to the horses. The manor has, oh, four? All beautiful. And Lottie will certainly poke her head out the stall if you pass by.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He's always very kind with them. Th..."
entries.text: He's always very kind with them. They say that's the sign of a good man, you know - kindness to those without power.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Either way, those horses are living..."
entries.text: Either way, those horses are living the high life.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Seamus

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with the porter?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with the porter?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I believe Victoria did when we arri..."
entries.text: I believe Victoria did when we arrived. As for me... I... I don't recall. I don't believe so.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I've seen him a few times, though,..."
entries.text: I've seen him a few times, though, since then. I get the impression he is not... hm... very invested in the work.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I suppose it is mostly moving bags..."
entries.text: I suppose it is mostly moving bags around, though, so... Who would be?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "The priest is always hounding him a..."
entries.text: The priest is always hounding him about something though - so I suspect there's at least one person on his back...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ivy - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me about yourself, Miss McLeod..."
entries.text: Tell me about yourself, Miss McLeod.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, well! If I'm to be proper - I'm..."
entries.text: Oh, well! If I'm to be proper - I'm Ivy McLeod, first and only daughter of the Laird Robert McLeod.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Not the only child, though. I've tw..."
entries.text: Not the only child, though. I've two brothers. I'd say for my sins, but I love them. But also, for my sins.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And I am, this seeming like the sor..."
entries.text: And I am, this seeming like the sort of place one can only say this, a host to the Second Sight... to a greater degree than any of my forbearers ever seemed to be.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can I ask where you're from, Miss?..."
entries.text: Can I ask where you're from, Miss? I notice there's nothing Irish in your accent.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And if "Laird" or my accent didn't..."
entries.text: And if "Laird" or my accent didn't give it away, I'm Scottish through and through. Though I admit I've been spending more time in London of late.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "There's a great number of mystics t..."
entries.text: There's a great number of mystics there, you see, and people inclined towards such things, and I'm wont to keep company with the sort.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Deane?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "More than once... she's everywhere..."
entries.text: More than once... she's everywhere in London, amongst our sort.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "We've spoken once or twice, but I d..."
entries.text: We've spoken once or twice, but I don't recall much. ...And I'm afraid if I say any more, I may be unkind.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Rather better we live our lives hap..."
entries.text: Rather better we live our lives happily apart with paths uncrossed, then, no? Though, I do wonder...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Most women of her standing would be..."
entries.text: Most women of her standing would be looking for a husband now. I wonder just how it is she manages not to need it...?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Deane?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "More than once... she's everywhere..."
entries.text: More than once... she's everywhere in London, amongst our sort.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "We've spoken once or twice, but I d..."
entries.text: We've spoken once or twice, but I don't recall much. ...And I'm afraid if I say any more, I may be unkind.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Not that kindness ever seems to tro..."
entries.text: Not that kindness ever seems to trouble her. Heaven forbid.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "... But that's another matter, and..."
entries.text: ... But that's another matter, and I shan't trouble you with it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I was wondering - what do you make..."
entries.text: I was wondering - what do you make of Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "My, that's... certainly a question...."
entries.text: My, that's... certainly a question. She's... well. Oh, how do I put this?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "You've read Hansel and Gretel, have..."
entries.text: You've read Hansel and Gretel, haven't you? About the two children lured and nearly eaten by a wicked witch?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh... Mister Ward. Do you remember..."
entries.text: Oh... Mister Ward. Do you remember how it ends?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I fear in my darkest nights, I only..."
entries.text: I fear in my darkest nights, I only find peace when I imagine Miss Deane may one day meet the same fate.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You're saying Miss Deane is a... wi..."
entries.text: You're saying Miss Deane is a... wicked witch, of sorts?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...Gretel pushes the witch into an..."
entries.text: ...Gretel pushes the witch into an oven, and she burns alive, no?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "So yes, we have met. I do not wish..."
entries.text: So yes, we have met. I do not wish for it to happen again.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Cathal - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister O'Meara?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Not by myself, Sir."
entries.text: Not by myself, Sir.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He's a well-to-do man, yes, but I a..."
entries.text: He's a well-to-do man, yes, but I am a Lady.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Though... I suppose he is of the ri..."
entries.text: Though... I suppose he is of the right age. And unspoken for.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I have! He's a gentleman, and makes..."
entries.text: I have! He's a gentleman, and makes for such... interesting conversation.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I hope we'll have the opportunity t..."
entries.text: I hope we'll have the opportunity to take a walk around the grounds, or something of the sort.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "...I should like the chance to talk..."
entries.text: ...I should like the chance to talk with him some more, I mean! Yes, I should.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It wouldn't... it wouldn't be right..."
entries.text: It wouldn't... it wouldn't be right.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ines - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Only in passing. She's... unfamilia..."
entries.text: Only in passing. She's... unfamiliar to me, I suppose, but she seems perfectly pleasant.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "And frankly, I'd be downright disap..."
entries.text: And frankly, I'd be downright disappointed if someone from so far away didn't seem unfamiliar to me!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "What else would all that distance b..."
entries.text: What else would all that distance be for, if everyone was the same the world over?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ettiene - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you happened to meet Mister To..."
entries.text: Have you happened to meet Mister Toussaint?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I have, indeed. It turns out he spe..."
entries.text: I have, indeed. It turns out he speaks perfect English, and I'm so glad - it would embarrass us both to rely on my French.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But I suppose I could have guessed,..."
entries.text: But I suppose I could have guessed, as he publishes in English. Have you read his work?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't say I have."
entries.text: I can't say I have.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Hmm, me neither. Not properly. It i..."
entries.text: Hmm, me neither. Not properly. It is... it is interesting, and worthy... and it is somewhat nerve-wracking to have him in our midst.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Dupré - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to spe..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, I had to! He's from America!"
entries.text: Oh, I had to! He's from America!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He's very pleasant. He said he's no..."
entries.text: He's very pleasant. He said he's not in Ireland for the séance itself, but he thought he'd see it while he was here.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "So we were comparing notes - of a f..."
entries.text: So we were comparing notes - of a fashion - as to how we each understand a séance to work.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus D'Arcy?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, a little. I think she still con..."
entries.text: Oh, a little. I think she still considers me more of a girl than a woman in my own right...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Though she did get word of my... "g..."
entries.text: Though she did get word of my... "gift", because she asked me about it. For a novel, she said.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I don't know... Victoria seems to l..."
entries.text: I don't know... Victoria seems to like her better. And Mister Dupré enjoys her company, I think - though he's nice to everyone.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Coventry - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh yes, a little."
entries.text: Oh yes, a little.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "What an event to attend as your fir..."
entries.text: What an event to attend as your first of the sort...!

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "There’s a noble bearing about him,..."
entries.text: There’s a noble bearing about him, though you wouldn't know by his outfit. I suppose a jeweller’s salary can only go so far.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Hazel - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I have. She introduced herself, and..."
entries.text: I have. She introduced herself, and said she was pleased to meet me, finally - that she'd heard my name before.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "People do talk, I suppose. Anyway,..."
entries.text: People do talk, I suppose. Anyway, she had all sorts of questions about my Second Sight. I answered them as best I could, of course.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It's rare I meet anyone else like m..."
entries.text: It's rare I meet anyone else like me in this sort of gathering - so, of course, people don't usually know how it works...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Sometimes I wish they did. Sometime..."
entries.text: Sometimes I wish they did. Sometimes I wish... I don't know. Don't mind me.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ruairí - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Doctor Callaghan..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He's not at all what I expected! I..."
entries.text: He's not at all what I expected! I was worried he'd apply some scientific rigour to my sight but breezed past it as if it was the most normal thing in the world.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I was so relieved! I told him that..."
entries.text: I was so relieved! I told him that it had waned since coming here and he offered to take my picture with that device of his.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "He said that if the cause was somet..."
entries.text: He said that if the cause was something supernatural it may well show up.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "There was nothing in the image, but..."
entries.text: There was nothing in the image, but I am still certain the problem is magical in nature.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Still, it was a lovely photo to get..."
entries.text: Still, it was a lovely photo to get. After the séance I hope to ask him for one of myself and Victoria, both!

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Carmela - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Spoken? Oh, yes - I'm afraid I rath..."
entries.text: Spoken? Oh, yes - I'm afraid I rather cornered her at tea. I was more excited than I ought to be, perhaps, to talk to her.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "But she was lovely about it; she ga..."
entries.text: But she was lovely about it; she gave me a reading and talked to me for some time after.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "She gave me a lot to think on. I ho..."
entries.text: She gave me a lot to think on. I hope it was not too taxing for her, she seemed quite exhausted by the end of it all.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Blake - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the Marquess?"
entries.text: Have you met the Marquess?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I have. I actually met him a few ye..."
entries.text: I have. I actually met him a few years ago. Would you believe my father hoped I might marry him after his wife passed?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "The Marquess had no interest, but w..."
entries.text: The Marquess had no interest, but was very polite about it. If he remembers me from then, he has not mentioned it.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ivy

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I've not only not met him, I've nev..."
entries.text: I've not only not met him, I've never met anyone of the like before.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well, far be it from me to judge......"
entries.text: Well, far be it from me to judge... Though I think being a little perplexed is fair game.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met with Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Have you met with Mister Ó Finn?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Fiadh  - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Did you know she has a second sight..."
entries.text: Did you know she has a second sight, too? Hers doesn't seem impacted by this place, though.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Maybe because she is from this area..."
entries.text: Maybe because she is from this area? Or maybe her well protects her?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I have, as it happens. I like her -..."
entries.text: I have, as it happens. I like her - talking to her is like talking to an aunt I didn't know I had.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Father Sinnott?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, no... I suppose I could, but I..."
entries.text: Oh, no... I suppose I could, but I don't know what I'd say. And I keep seeing him in the strangest places.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "The other day, I saw him shaking th..."
entries.text: The other day, I saw him shaking the basement hatch out in the stables. It was locked, of course, but still...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Arwa - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Hisham?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Very little. I'm sure - I'm sure sh..."
entries.text: Very little. I'm sure - I'm sure she's perfectly decent, and I would talk to her more, but it makes my head hurt to look at her.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I don't know what that is. I've nev..."
entries.text: I don't know what that is. I've never had anything like it before.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I did try, once, and all I did was..."
entries.text: I did try, once, and all I did was stumble over my words...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Saoirse - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Murphy?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Not about anything much more than t..."
entries.text: Not about anything much more than the weather, really, but she seems nice.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "You know, it's funny, but I feel as..."
entries.text: You know, it's funny, but I feel as though we might have a bit in common.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I couldn't say why - but I should l..."
entries.text: I couldn't say why - but I should like to speak with her more. It's a pity she seems so nervous of me...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Campbell - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Reverend Campbel..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to Reverend Campbell?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, no. I'm from a different church..."
entries.text: Oh, no. I'm from a different church, you see, so I don't know what we'd talk about.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Higgins - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to have seen a man ou..."
entries.text: Do you happen to have seen a man outside the manor, a strong build, not a guest himself? Or staff, for that matter.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "... No?"

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Who would that be?"
entries.text: Who would that be?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Walter Blake - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "If I understand correctly, there's..."
entries.text: If I understand correctly, there's a Master Blake somewhere around the place.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Yes, apparently so. He's a bit youn..."
entries.text: Yes, apparently so. He's a bit young to appear at an event like this, but I know there is some interest in his hand already.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Not surprising, given he's the heir..."
entries.text: Not surprising, given he's the heir to the land, title, and fortune of the Blake family.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/Proud bearing - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "For all that your visions must show..."
entries.text: For all that your visions must show you, you have managed to keep an air of innocence about you.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Thank you, Sir, though I fear my in..."
entries.text: Thank you, Sir, though I fear my innocence is nearing its end.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Not because of this séance, but thr..."
entries.text: Not because of this séance, but through the events surrounding it.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I begin to suspect that it ties in..."
entries.text: I begin to suspect that it ties in with my diminishing visions.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/Bitten nails - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you nervous, Miss? You seem to..."
entries.text: Are you nervous, Miss? You seem to have bitten your nails down.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Oh, um, I was hoping no one would n..."
entries.text: Oh, um, I was hoping no one would notice... Is it that obvious?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/White heather - Ivy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is that a heather you have pinned i..."
entries.text: Is that a heather you have pinned in your hair, Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It is! White Scottish heather. It's..."
entries.text: It is! White Scottish heather. It's supposed to be for good luck.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "When I was a wee girl, learning to..."
entries.text: When I was a wee girl, learning to live with my sight, it was braided into my hair to calm me after a bad vision. I guess it stuck.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Ah... Oh, hold on, I can't think. I..."
entries.text: Ah... Oh, hold on, I can't think. I see... Hm.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I've got you. Is it a vision?"
entries.text: I've got you. Is it a vision?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I... it's not..."
entries.text: I... it's not...

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Nothing. I can't see any... It's li..."
entries.text: Nothing. I can't see any... It's like it wants me to see something, but I can't - whatever it is.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Should I be... concerned?"
entries.text: Should I be... concerned?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Ah - but there is no portent to be..."
entries.text: Ah - but there is no portent to be concerned about, which is... I have no idea, actually.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Well, that, -  but I meant, should..."
entries.text: Well, that, -  but I meant, should I be concerned about you, sweetheart? Are you alright?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "I feel... I don't feel bad. I feel..."
entries.text: I feel... I don't feel bad. I feel strange. Why can't I see like usual?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Oh, Ivy..."
entries.text: Oh, Ivy...

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, ghosts

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "There really are ghosts in the mano..."
entries.text: There really are ghosts in the manor, aren't there?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Have you seen something?"
entries.text: Have you seen something?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I've certainly seen something... I..."
entries.text: I've certainly seen something... I just can't decide what it was. But everyone seems very certain that the house is haunted.

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "Well... it is. I really do think it..."
entries.text: Well... it is. I really do think it is.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I feared as much. Then what can we..."
entries.text: I feared as much. Then what can we do about it?

entries.speaker: Miss McLeod
entries.label: Ivy: "It's not really our place to do any..."
entries.text: It's not really our place to do anything about - but it will be alright, you'll see.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I... might make some extra offering..."
entries.text: I... might make some extra offerings to my ancestors. Just to be sure.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Clothes

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A few nice dresses... nothing unusu..."
entries.text: A few nice dresses... nothing unusual.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Jewellery

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A collection of necklaces and brace..."
entries.text: A collection of necklaces and bracelets. Some of them have precious gems in them.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Best not to disturb these, I think."
entries.text: Best not to disturb these, I think.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Dress pins

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Clothes pins. In case anything need..."
entries.text: Clothes pins. In case anything needs refitting in a hurry, I suppose.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Letter home

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A letter addressed to her mother, h..."
entries.text: A letter addressed to her mother, half written.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "She's downplaying the strangeness o..."
entries.text: She's downplaying the strangeness of the event, but it's hard to say whether that's intentional, or if she's just that used to this sort of thing.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Insomnia remedy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Laudanum, it says, with lavender wa..."
entries.text: Laudanum, it says, with lavender water. An insomnia remedy - but it's unopened.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Tarot

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A deck of tarot, wrapped up and sto..."
entries.text: A deck of tarot, wrapped up and stored in a box with a secure latch.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Perfume

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A small bottle of perfume... though..."
entries.text: A small bottle of perfume... though I think this is Missus Lau's, not Miss McLeod's.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Book on dream imagery

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "'The Encyclopedia of the Symbology..."
entries.text: 'The Encyclopedia of the Symbology of Dreams'. Its spine is broken.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Water jug

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A jug of drinking water. But..."
entries.text: A jug of drinking water. But...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There's something wrong. The water..."
entries.text: There's something wrong. The water is slightly cloudy. Why?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Charm on doorhandle

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It appears to be some sort of charm..."
entries.text: It appears to be some sort of charm, made of stone and wood.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I wonder what it's for?"
entries.text: I wonder what it's for?

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/White heather

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A small vase of dried white heather..."
entries.text: A small vase of dried white heather.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I understand Marquess Blake has a s..."
entries.text: I understand Marquess Blake has a son.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "So I believe, but I cannot say I ha..."
entries.text: So I believe, but I cannot say I have met the boy.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Maybe he is shy. Maybe his father k..."
entries.text: Maybe he is shy. Maybe his father keeps him glued to his chair.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I cannot say."
entries.text: I cannot say.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does the Marquess have a son?"
entries.text: Does the Marquess have a son?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "He does, Sir. Keeps to his room, th..."
entries.text: He does, Sir. Keeps to his room, though, since Marchioness Blake passed away.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Best to leave him be."
entries.text: Best to leave him be.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I understand Marquess Blake has a s..."
entries.text: I understand Marquess Blake has a son.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "In all this week, I might have thou..."
entries.text: In all this week, I might have thought we would see him around somewhere.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Maybe he is shy? Mi caro ragazzo -..."
entries.text: Maybe he is shy? Mi caro ragazzo - my son, Nicolò, he was very shy until he was ten or so.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Campbell

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Am I right in thinking there is a M..."
entries.text: Am I right in thinking there is a Master Blake?

entries.speaker: Reverend Campbell
entries.label: Rev: "Marquess Blake has a son, yes. Thou..."
entries.text: Marquess Blake has a son, yes. Though it is seldom anyone but the Marquess sees him these days, I understand.

entries.speaker: Reverend Campbell
entries.label: Rev: "I have offered to speak with the bo..."
entries.text: I have offered to speak with the boy, of course, but I'm told he refused.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Marquess Blake has a son, as I unde..."
entries.text: Marquess Blake has a son, as I understand.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Do you think? I can't say I've seen..."
entries.text: Do you think? I can't say I've seen him about... I don't think I have, anyway.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Suppose I wouldn't know."
entries.text: Suppose I wouldn't know.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Were you aware Marquess Blake has a..."
entries.text: Were you aware Marquess Blake has a son?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I can't say I gave it much thought,..."
entries.text: I can't say I gave it much thought, but I assumed about as much. Though there have been no introductions, so I assume he is being kept away.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'd say that would be better for hi..."
entries.text: I'd say that would be better for him, but in a place this haunted, I don't think not meeting us all is sparing him much ghostly activity.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "So it's that, or Marquess Blake doe..."
entries.text: So it's that, or Marquess Blake doesn't think us desirable company for his heir. And we are just barely tolerated, so... that might be my ongoing theory.

title: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Am I right in thinking Marquess Bla..."
entries.text: Am I right in thinking Marquess Blake has a son?

entries.label: Darragh: "There's too many to count. Nary a w..."
entries.text: There's too many to count. Nary a week goes by, I tell you...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But the one that really gives me ch..."
entries.text: But the one that really gives me chills is when I was sweeping the ballroom during the off-season, and I turned to find that the chairs...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "...they'd been unpacked and arrange..."
entries.text: ...they'd been unpacked and arranged around me, like I had an audience.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Needless to say, I don't like the b..."
entries.text: Needless to say, I don't like the ballroom all that much.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you have to fix one of the stab..."
entries.text: Did you have to fix one of the stable doors recently?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Hm? Oh, aye. Lottie got spooked and..."
entries.text: Hm? Oh, aye. Lottie got spooked and kicked the latch clean out of the door itself. She was in quite the mood. They all were, really.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "There's no spare stall, either, so..."
entries.text: There's no spare stall, either, so I had to get one and fix it in place - it's too cold to leave them out in the pasture.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "When was this? Did something cause..."
entries.text: When was this? Did something cause her to get spooked?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I did the fixing from Tuesday eveni..."
entries.text: I did the fixing from Tuesday evening into the night, so it would have happened that day. Nothing happened that I can think of to set them off.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Wonderful creatures, horses, but no..."
entries.text: Wonderful creatures, horses, but not always clever. They'll frighten at just about anything. Rabbits, birds, puddles...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Miss Murphy saw me, she was bringin..."
entries.text: Miss Murphy saw me, she was bringing food into the wee house, to the master I assume.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah... It was Tuesday just gone by."
entries.text: Ah... It was Tuesday just gone by.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Can't think what set them off. Wond..."
entries.text: Can't think what set them off. Wonderful creatures, horses, but not always clever. They'll frighten at just about anything. Rabbits, birds, puddles...

entries.text: That's a key for the bathhouse lockers, isn't it? Best put that back where you found it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this?

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Mister Doyle - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss..."
entries.text: Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone on Tuesday evening - a man. Did you hear about it?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "He did, did he? Ach..."
entries.text: He did, did he? Ach...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "No, I didn't hear anything about it..."
entries.text: No, I didn't hear anything about it. Tuesday evening... I was out at the stables. Not a lot to overhear out there.

entries.speaker: Varley
entries.label: ...: "Mister Doyle shouldn't be concernin..."
entries.text: Mister Doyle shouldn't be concerning himself with it, either, if I'm honest. It's a bad look for us staff.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mysterious figure - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I noticed someone in the window as..."
entries.text: I noticed someone in the window as I was heading back to the manor from the gardens... Does someone else live in the house?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "That's not our business, Sir. Yours..."
entries.text: That's not our business, Sir. Yours or mine.

entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about Goibniu?

entries.text: I don't know the... hold on, the name might be familiar. Not many like that, after all.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Was he not supposed to be one of th..."
entries.text: Was he not supposed to be one of the old Irish gods?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Don't know a thing about him myself..."
entries.text: Don't know a thing about him myself, though.

entries.text: If there is, I don't know it. Just that the thing's been there as long as the house, is no longer.

entries.text: There's a saint by that name, isn't there?

entries.text: I don't know anything about a goddess with the name. Or the saint, for that matter.

entries.text: Does the hedge maze happen to have an extra exit...?

entries.text: An extra exit? No, just the one. How come? Did you lose someone in there?

entries.text: In... a manner of speaking. Miss Deane seems to have wandered in there, late on Tuesday, when she's thought to have checked out.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "And now there's no sign of her at a..."
entries.text: And now there's no sign of her at all. Her trail seems to end entirely.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "You mean to tell me something happe..."
entries.text: You mean to tell me something happened to the woman? God Almighty...

entries.text: Those folks? I don't concern myself with them.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Not that I've anything against them..."
entries.text: Not that I've anything against them, mind you. It's just... not my business, and I've got no desire to make it so.

entries.text: She might like this place for that, hah - plenty of them about, these days.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Some time ago, one of the Blakes su..."
entries.text: Some time ago, one of the Blakes supposedly walled up some young lovers after he was slighted. They were never found.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Missing Doors? Percival Blake and t..."
entries.text: Missing Doors? Percival Blake and the missing lovers, right? What else could you have meant?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "They say it is only a rumour, but I..."
entries.text: They say it is only a rumour, but I swear I've heard sobbing late at night over the east side of the building. That poor lass calling out to be with her man.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Anyway, I'll take a look, but maybe..."
entries.text: Anyway, I'll take a look, but maybe one of your magical lot got some inspiration from him?

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sigil - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I came across a sigil recently I ha..."
entries.text: I came across a sigil recently I haven't been able to identify. It's a spiral, with four lines intersecting it. Do you know anything of the sort?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "A spiral, with...? Let me think..."
entries.text: A spiral, with...? Let me think...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Nothing comes to mind. I don't thin..."
entries.text: Nothing comes to mind. I don't think spirals are that common in that sort of thing... Hard to draw where you'd need them.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hedonistic Gala - Darragh
