entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't say I was expecting a party..."
entries.text: I can't say I was expecting a party like that. I had the impression Marquess Blake was rather more... austere.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "He usually is. I don't know what po..."
entries.text: He usually is. I don't know what possessed him to agree to it, let alone see it all arranged.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I never had the impression I knew h..."
entries.text: I never had the impression I knew him all that well, but it seems I know him even less than I thought.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you meet with Miss McLeod this..."
entries.text: Did you meet with Miss McLeod this morning?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "You have a habit of listening in on..."
entries.text: You have a habit of listening in on private conversations, Mister Ward?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Well... No, I didn't mean anything..."
entries.text: Well... No, I didn't mean anything by it. I just saw you and thought it was nice. My apologies - is it a matter of secrecy?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Look, I think of Ivy as all but my..."
entries.text: Look, I think of Ivy as all but my daughter. I helped raise her when she was just a young lass with scary dreams and a Second Sight so strong that no one else knew what to do with her.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But she's a noblewoman, and I'm a s..."
entries.text: But she's a noblewoman, and I'm a servant, and people don't take kindly to others overstepping their station in either direction.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you meet with Miss McLeod this..."
entries.text: Did you meet with Miss McLeod this morning?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "You have a habit of finding out thi..."
entries.text: You have a habit of finding out things people would rather try and keep to themselves, don't you, Mister Ward?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But I suppose there's no good lying..."
entries.text: But I suppose there's no good lying about it. Yes, I spoke to Miss McLeod this morning.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't understand - why would that..."
entries.text: I don't understand - why would that be a matter of secrecy?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah... Look, I think of Ivy as all b..."
entries.text: Ah... Look, I think of Ivy as all but my daughter. I helped raise her when she was just a young lass with scary dreams and a Second Sight so strong that no one else knew what to do with her.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But she's a noblewoman, and I'm a s..."
entries.text: But she's a noblewoman, and I'm a servant, and people don't take kindly to others overstepping their station in either direction.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "So, we keep it to ourselves. All th..."
entries.text: So, we keep it to ourselves. All the better not to embarrass her Laird father, or her, or make myself look disrespectful. Y'see?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah... No, don't worry yourself. Peo..."
entries.text: Ah... No, don't worry yourself. People usually do mean something by it is all, so you've caught me unawares.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy child - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Murphy was telling me about he..."
entries.text: Miss Murphy was telling me about her daughter.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She was? It's seldom Miss Murphy ta..."
entries.text: She was? It's seldom Miss Murphy talks to people about that.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She must have decided you're the tr..."
entries.text: She must have decided you're the trustworthy sort. It's an awful business, but there's not much any of us can do.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I do hope she gets to see her littl..."
entries.text: I do hope she gets to see her little girl again someday...

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Letter to the manager - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I came across a letter Mister Varle..."
entries.text: I came across a letter Mister Varley received from the local Bishop, a reply to an inquiry he had.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Is that so? I don't know what- ...A..."
entries.text: Is that so? I don't know what- ...Ah.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "You're treading delicate ground the..."
entries.text: You're treading delicate ground there, Mister Ward. And I'm not sure it's my place to speak on it.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Old Photo - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss McLeod mentioned she has a pho..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod mentioned she has a photograph of the two of you.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She does, does she? God bless that..."
entries.text: She does, does she? God bless that girl for keeping it all this time. Must have been over a decade since that was taken.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Here - I've been seeing this symbol..."
entries.text: Here - I've been seeing this symbol about the place. Does it mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Can't say I've ever seen one like i..."
entries.text: Can't say I've ever seen one like it. I don't recognise its type, either.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mary Blake - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know of Marquess Blake'..."
entries.text: What do you know of Marquess Blake's late wife?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I didn't know the woman, I'm afraid..."
entries.text: I didn't know the woman, I'm afraid. I was hired on after her death.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Missus Joyce speaks well of her, th..."
entries.text: Missus Joyce speaks well of her, though.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance's purpose - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of this séance? It..."
entries.text: What do you make of this séance? It has... an ambitious goal.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Séances are common enough, and I ha..."
entries.text: Séances are common enough, and I have no real issue with them. But this?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Between you and me, Mister Ward, it..."
entries.text: Between you and me, Mister Ward, it's about the worst idea I've ever heard. I'm not against magic, don't get me wrong, but I'm against this.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "There's nothing good to come of it...."
entries.text: There's nothing good to come of it. I'll have nothing to do with it.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy crib - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know why there's a crib in t..."
entries.text: Do you know why there's a crib in the basement?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Maybe I should keep what I know abo..."
entries.text: Maybe I should keep what I know about this to myself... I don't have permission to be in the basement, after all.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I do. It was given to Miss Murphy b..."
entries.text: I do. It was given to Miss Murphy by her family while there was hope she'd still have the use of it.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I've offered to store it away for h..."
entries.text: I've offered to store it away for her, of course, but she asked me not to.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hand carved rattle - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did I notice Miss Murphy with a rat..."
entries.text: Did I notice Miss Murphy with a rattle in her possession?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah, now... There's not a happy stor..."
entries.text: Ah, now... There's not a happy story to be found there, Mister Ward. I'd leave well enough be.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/hotel finances - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I understand the hotel's in some fi..."
entries.text: I understand the hotel's in some financial difficulty.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Mister Varley's doing his best, but..."
entries.text: Mister Varley's doing his best, but these old houses take a lot of money to even keep upright, let alone turn a profit.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "...Might be best you don't go sprea..."
entries.text: ...Might be best you don't go spreading that around now, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Wouldn't want the guests to be dist..."
entries.text: Wouldn't want the guests to be distracted from the task at hand.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/parcel of money - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found a parcel of Miss Deane's mo..."
entries.text: I found a parcel of Miss Deane's money stashed away in Missus Joyce's belongings.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Why were you-"
entries.text: Why were you-

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah. Well, that makes sense, I suppo..."
entries.text: Ah. Well, that makes sense, I suppose. I'm not sure where she'd have found the money otherwise.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "That doesn't make any sense. Missus..."
entries.text: That doesn't make any sense. Missus Joyce might be too interested in gossip, but she's not stupid... and she's not a thief, at that.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Miss Deane won't mind too much, I'm..."
entries.text: Miss Deane won't mind too much, I'm sure.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ivy meeting Cathal - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems Miss McLeod slipped off to..."
entries.text: It seems Miss McLeod slipped off to meet Mister O'Meara... without her chaperone.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Without her...? But then, why have..."
entries.text: Without her...? But then, why have the chaperone here at all?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "That girl, I swear... She's going a..."
entries.text: That girl, I swear... She's going about this all wrong...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems Miss McLeod intends to sli..."
entries.text: It seems Miss McLeod intends to slip off and meet Mister O'Meara... without her chaperone.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Deane's room - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know which room Mi..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, I did some repair work on the..."
entries.text: Aye, I did some repair work on the chimney after she arrived. It was... Oh... I don't recall, sorry.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hiring telegram - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Hm... Somebody hired you to come he..."
entries.text: Hm... Somebody hired you to come here?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "They're worried about Miss Deane le..."
entries.text: They're worried about Miss Deane leaving so suddenly.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Does all seem to have happened quit..."
entries.text: Does all seem to have happened quite suddenly... Well, in that case, Mister Ward, I'm glad to have you around.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Shadowy Figure - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever seen a large figure -..."
entries.text: Have you ever seen a large figure - much larger than a man - roaming the manor grounds?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "My guess? It's not a ghost. Maybe t..."
entries.text: My guess? It's not a ghost. Maybe the spirit of a giant? Some Guid Folk, perhaps? Or something more - the old Irish gods once walked these parts, though I don't know much about that. Might the library have something of use?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, I've seen it. In the corner of..."
entries.text: Aye, I've seen it. In the corner of the eye. Or, sometimes it's just a feeling of being watched. There's something there, sure enough.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/12 Ticket - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know if there are tickets fo..."
entries.text: Do you know if there are tickets for the luggage room, Mister Hunter?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Oh, aye. Helps the guests remember..."
entries.text: Oh, aye. Helps the guests remember where they put their bags.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "A bit fancy, but it works. I put up..."
entries.text: A bit fancy, but it works. I put up some numbered plaques in the luggage room just last year.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cache of Stolen Documents - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found these lying about the manor..."
entries.text: I found these lying about the manor, but I've no idea what to do with them. Do they look familiar at all to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "...Strange thing to find just lying..."
entries.text: ...Strange thing to find just lying about, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "It all seems to belong to Miss Dean..."
entries.text: It all seems to belong to Miss Deane at a glance. Otherwise, I couldn't tell you.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mysterious Object - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It looks like someone's crammed som..."
entries.text: It looks like someone's crammed something inside the luggage room vent.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Now, who would go and do a thing li..."
entries.text: Now, who would go and do a thing like that?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah, well. When I have time I'll get..."
entries.text: Ah, well. When I have time I'll get a screwdriver from the stables and get that fixed. Thanks.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Miss Deane's Invitation - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I wonder if Miss Deane was personal..."
entries.text: I wonder if Miss Deane was personally invited to this event?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Miss Mantovani was, if I've heard r..."
entries.text: Miss Mantovani was, if I've heard right.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Can't say for sure on Miss Deane. I..."
entries.text: Can't say for sure on Miss Deane. I didn't hear it from the staff or from her and I suspect she'd have made it known.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Not sure anyone would invite that t..."
entries.text: Not sure anyone would invite that trouble on themselves...

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Treasure Map - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I was wondering - does this riddle..."
entries.text: I was wondering - does this riddle look at all familiar to you, Mister Hunter?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Hmm. Autumn? Well, there are those..."
entries.text: Hmm. Autumn? Well, there are those four statues in the gardens. The ones for the seasons.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Not a bad place to start looking, I..."
entries.text: Not a bad place to start looking, I'd say.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I wonder if it's true that Miss Dea..."
entries.text: I wonder if it's true that Miss Deane comes from a powerful bloodline?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, it wouldn't surprise me. I wou..."
entries.text: Aye, it wouldn't surprise me. I wouldn't like it either, mind. Power's always cosying up to the wrong hands.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Coded Papers - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this note covered in dots...."
entries.text: I found this note covered in dots. Do you have any idea what it could mean?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Hah. I'm not sure what it's saying,..."
entries.text: Hah. I'm not sure what it's saying, but the paper whispers like it's got something to hide.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Blackmail material on Livy - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found some documents Miss Deane h..."
entries.text: I found some documents Miss Deane had on Miss McLeod and Missus Lau after using the key you gave me for the catacombs. Do you make anything of that?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I knew that Deane woman was trouble..."
entries.text: I knew that Deane woman was trouble. We should bring this to Ivy and Missus Lau.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are those things you made for..."
entries.text: What are those things you made for the ladies and yourself?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "All I know is charms, as such. Bind..."
entries.text: All I know is charms, as such. Binds, wards, that sort. I can fold them into, well, charms.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The binding on Miss Deane, the char..."
entries.text: The binding on Miss Deane, the charms for the ladies and myself.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "It's simple magic, Mister Ward, but..."
entries.text: It's simple magic, Mister Ward, but old and powerful. It will keep the young ladies safe from harm.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Mine, eh, they need some form of em..."
entries.text: Mine, eh, they need some form of emotional component to them.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I tried to make one for you, but, w..."
entries.text: I tried to make one for you, but, well. Grateful as I am, I don't really know you, Sir.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I don't know Missus Lau, truthfully..."
entries.text: I don't know Missus Lau, truthfully, but my love for Ivy seemed to extend to cover her.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I guess this is what makes magic di..."
entries.text: I guess this is what makes magic different from science. With science you do the same thing twice and you should get the same result.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Magic isn't predictable like that...."
entries.text: Magic isn't predictable like that. It's, ah, what would you call it - alive?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Some of why folk like myself or Fia..."
entries.text: Some of why folk like myself or Fiadh think this séance is dangerous. They're not factoring in the magic of this place and how it feels about it all.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Miss Mantovani, she's maybe thinkin..."
entries.text: Miss Mantovani, she's maybe thinking just too scientifically about it all...

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Catacombs Key - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Miss Deane had this key on her. I h..."
entries.text: Miss Deane had this key on her. I had no idea what door it might work on but now I think maybe it's in those catacombs you mentioned?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Remind me what this is for?"
entries.text: Remind me what this is for?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Miss Deane had this key on her. You..."
entries.text: Miss Deane had this key on her. Your guess is as good as mine as to what it opens. Looks like an old cell door or such.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Relationship with Ivy - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You knew Miss McLeod before this ev..."
entries.text: You knew Miss McLeod before this event?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, Mister Ward, I did. From a pre..."
entries.text: Aye, Mister Ward, I did. From a previous posting. I worked for her family.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Known her since she was a bairn. Sh..."
entries.text: Known her since she was a bairn. She's like a daughter to me. I've always done my best to look after her when others couldn't.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Witchcraft components - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about witchcraft a..."
entries.text: Do you know much about witchcraft and magic, Mister Hunter?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye. Well, I wouldn't call it witch..."
entries.text: Aye. Well, I wouldn't call it witchcraft, but I have my own way of things.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "There's a long tradition in Scotlan..."
entries.text: There's a long tradition in Scotland of knowing how to bring a person good fortune or ward off evil. Things you can make to that effect, and the like.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Chimney Charm - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this on the grounds, what d..."
entries.text: I found this on the grounds, what do you make of it?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Did you, now? Well, it wouldn't do..."
entries.text: Did you, now? Well, it wouldn't do much good just lying about, it'd need to be hidden somewhere close to the person it was intended for.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "At least... I imagine that's how th..."
entries.text: At least... I imagine that's how these things work.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Map of Catacombs - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Would the key I gave you unlock som..."
entries.text: Would the key I gave you unlock something down there, do you think? Worth a look?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I wonder if that key..."
entries.text: I wonder if that key...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "...no, nevermind."
entries.text: ...no, nevermind.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I came across this map. I think it..."
entries.text: I came across this map. I think it might be of an underground complex?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I came across this map. I think it..."
entries.text: I came across this map. I think it might be of the catacombs below the manor?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Catacombs? What?"
entries.text: Catacombs? What?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "A complex? No, that doesn't seem ri..."
entries.text: A complex? No, that doesn't seem right. I'd have known...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I still can't believe there are cat..."
entries.text: I still can't believe there are catacombs here...

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Drugged water jug - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed anything odd about..."
entries.text: Have you noticed anything odd about Miss McLeod's behaviour since she's been here?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She's not been well at all since sh..."
entries.text: She's not been well at all since she arrived... Headaches, her second sight being cloudy... This whole event has people in an odd state, if you ask me.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I've overheard her complaining abou..."
entries.text: I've overheard her complaining about a loss of "sight", but it's not my place to pry.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I'm confident the matter is resolve..."
entries.text: I'm confident the matter is resolved now, Sir. She'll be right in no time.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Fae - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Certainly, I've seen enough to know..."
entries.text: Certainly, I've seen enough to know to leave scraps out for them. I keep a good bottle of brandy in my room to offer up when the horses are unwell. It's worked so far.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about the fae?"
entries.text: What do you know about the fae?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The Guid Folk, we call them back in..."
entries.text: The Guid Folk, we call them back in Scotland. Same idea, even if the specifics change.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Varley Statement - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Varley said he was in a meet..."
entries.text: Mister Varley said he was in a meeting with Missus Joyce when the bridge game was held. Does that sound right to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, it does. Missus Joyce was comp..."
entries.text: Aye, it does. Missus Joyce was complaining about something or other that he said, afterwards.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Wasn't anything of note, mind you,..."
entries.text: Wasn't anything of note, mind you, she just likes to complain now and then.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arwas Vase Drawing- Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, it looks like... That's the on..."
entries.text: Aye, it looks like... That's the one Lady Wilhelmina's holding in the painting in the atrium.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Never seen it in person though."
entries.text: Never seen it in person though.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this vase, at all?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this vase, at all?

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arwas Melody- Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Can't say I recognise the tune, but..."
entries.text: Can't say I recognise the tune, but I'm not really the musical sort.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Maybe if you tried it on an instrum..."
entries.text: Maybe if you tried it on an instrument, it'd come back to you.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've heard this song recently, that..."
entries.text: I've heard this song recently, that I just cannot place. Does it sound familiar to you?

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wilhelmina Blake- Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I've heard the story, but only seco..."
entries.text: I've heard the story, but only secondhand. Off she went one day in the middle of the night, and never told a soul where she was going.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "There's still a collection of her b..."
entries.text: There's still a collection of her belongings down in the basement. I reckon no one knew what to do with them.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know of Wilhelmina Blak..."
entries.text: What do you know of Wilhelmina Blake?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "They say no one ever saw her again...."
entries.text: They say no one ever saw her again. God knows where she went, or what happened to her...

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Saint Brigid's Cross - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Has a member of staff been placing..."
entries.text: Has a member of staff been placing Saint Brigid's crosses about the manor?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, that'd be Missus Joyce. Helps..."
entries.text: Aye, that'd be Missus Joyce. Helps keep her nerves calm in all this chaos, I think.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/blake manor - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about Blake Ma..."
entries.text: What can you tell me about Blake Manor?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Hmmm, what can I tell you? Well, no..."
entries.text: Hmmm, what can I tell you? Well, not much wants to grow here. I'll say that.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I can get a few plants to bloom in..."
entries.text: I can get a few plants to bloom in pots, but in the ground? There's a reason I keep things simple.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Might be the water, but what's in t..."
entries.text: Might be the water, but what's in that well out back is some of the best tasting water I've ever had, so I don't know.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Timetable - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah, we've a delivery all morning, s..."
entries.text: Ah, we've a delivery all morning, so that will have me down in the basement to unload.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Then I might see about getting a mo..."
entries.text: Then I might see about getting a moment or two to rest below decks before the séance goes on.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Thankfully, Mister Varley doesn't n..."
entries.text: Thankfully, Mister Varley doesn't need me for the ball tonight. Then tomorrow...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you think you're going to sp..."
entries.text: How do you think you're going to spend the day?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "You know what they say, no rest for..."
entries.text: You know what they say, no rest for the wicked. I'll be tending to the horses most of the morning and working the garden in the late afternoon.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know how you're going to spe..."
entries.text: Do you know how you're going to spend the weekend?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "...But I have to tend to the garden..."
entries.text: ...But I have to tend to the gardens for a little while at 11am, so I will step out for that.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I'm glad those charms are made. I f..."
entries.text: I'm glad those charms are made. I feel better for the girls. Girls. Ha. Ivy is a woman now, I suppose.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Mister Hunter - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You said you were repairing the sta..."
entries.text: You said you were repairing the stable door on Tuesday evening?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, it would have been Tuesday."
entries.text: Aye, it would have been Tuesday.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Had to do it right when it was brok..."
entries.text: Had to do it right when it was broken. Saved me from making up another stall. I think I missed some meetings for it... The horses have my best interests in mind, hah!

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/ghost at firepit - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever seen a woman's ghost..."
entries.text: Have you ever seen a woman's ghost by the firepit?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, I caught a glimpse of somethin..."
entries.text: Aye, I caught a glimpse of something alright.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Only recent, mind. She's not been t..."
entries.text: Only recent, mind. She's not been there long. That I know.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Miss Mantovani is spending a lot of..."
entries.text: Miss Mantovani is spending a lot of time out there - attuning to the site, or something. Maybe you should talk to her?

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/grimoire - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you make out any of this?"
entries.text: Can you make out any of this?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Hmm, no. I can read some Scots Gael..."
entries.text: Hmm, no. I can read some Scots Gaelic, but only enough to know this isn't it. That's Irish, I'd say. Old Irish at that.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/traces of drugs - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed anything odd about..."
entries.text: Have you noticed anything odd about Miss McLeod's behaviour since she's been here?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She's not been well at all since sh..."
entries.text: She's not been well at all since she arrived... Headaches, her second sight being cloudy... This whole event has people in an odd state, if you ask me.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/cigar burn - hunter

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know what caused the damage..."
entries.text: Do you know what caused the damage to the library armchair?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "You'd need to ask one of the others..."
entries.text: You'd need to ask one of the others about that. I don't much concern myself with what takes place inside. I'm sure Mister Varley would know what happened.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/gauge - darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Well, I'm not a technical-minded ma..."
entries.text: Well, I'm not a technical-minded man, but the parts the Marquess has been getting in are both strange and confusing.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I noticed a strange device in the a..."
entries.text: I noticed a strange device in the atrium. What is that for?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "They seem to be, if you'll forgive..."
entries.text: They seem to be, if you'll forgive me, far more... mystical than your average component.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/washer woman - darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "When was this, Sir?"
entries.text: When was this, Sir?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I could have sworn I saw a woman wa..."
entries.text: I could have sworn I saw a woman washing something in the fountain...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Late on Friday night. When I arrive..."
entries.text: Late on Friday night. When I arrived.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Well... that seems unlikely to me,..."
entries.text: Well... that seems unlikely to me, Sir. The girls are dedicated but not that much...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Late last night. When I arrived."
entries.text: Late last night. When I arrived.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, safe and happy. And should thi..."
entries.text: Aye, safe and happy. And should this séance turn south, well - I've put everything I have into those charms. With some luck, we'll be safe.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss McLeod is safe, now."
entries.text: Miss McLeod is safe, now.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "You know, you'd not tell from looki..."
entries.text: You know, you'd not tell from looking at me now, but when I was a younger man, I cut a fine cloth.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Could dance, too."
entries.text: Could dance, too.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I've never sired.  No children."
entries.text:
I've never sired. 
No children.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The girls would make up any auld ex..."
entries.text: The girls would make up any auld excuse to come by the stables I trained in back home.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Bent spoons, pots that looked recen..."
entries.text: Bent spoons, pots that looked recently bashed in, the odd bit of broken jewellery...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I took it all for granted. I figure..."
entries.text: I took it all for granted. I figured they'd wait - every one of them.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But young 'uns and young love don't..."
entries.text: But young 'uns and young love don't live past spring.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "They all summered and moved on - so..."
entries.text: They all summered and moved on - soon they had husbands, then wee uns of their own.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Just didn't work out that way for m..."
entries.text: Just didn't work out that way for me.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "It was November 2nd, 1884, when I h..."
entries.text: It was November 2nd, 1884, when I heard Missus McLeod's screaming from the big house.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I grabbed something - hoof clippers..."
entries.text: I grabbed something - hoof clippers, I think - and ran. Figured it was a robbery.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Instead, I found her hunched over w..."
entries.text: Instead, I found her hunched over wee Ivy. The child was having a seizure.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Then she sat bolt upright and said..."
entries.text: Then she sat bolt upright and said - and I'll never forget it - she said "Pappy's gonna die tonight".

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Pappy being what she called her mot..."
entries.text: Pappy being what she called her mother's father.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The next day a constable came to th..."
entries.text: The next day a constable came to the house, his hat under his arm - there had been an incident in the Star Theatre the night before.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Some drunk wrongly sounded the alar..."
entries.text: Some drunk wrongly sounded the alarm over a small fire. Fourteen people died in their attempts to escape - including Pappy.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I, ah, well, I happened to be part..."
entries.text: I, ah, well, I happened to be part of a group of fellows that are... more open to the stranger side of life.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "And long, long story short, it was..."
entries.text: And long, long story short, it was agreed that if I could help the girl with her gift - though her mother did not consider it that - then none of her siblings, nor her father needed to know.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "A grand man, Mister McLeod, but God..."
entries.text: A grand man, Mister McLeod, but God-fearing to the extent that his wife worried he would turn out his only daughter.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "And so, I trained her. In secret, o..."
entries.text: And so, I trained her. In secret, of course. From the age of six until I left for here, some three years past.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She is the closest thing I have, or..."
entries.text: She is the closest thing I have, or will have, to a daughter in this world, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "There is nothing - nothing - I woul..."
entries.text: There is nothing - nothing - I wouldn't do or give to keep her safe.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "God willing, someday you'll have ch..."
entries.text: God willing, someday you'll have children and know a love so strong.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Because until then, you cannot unde..."
entries.text: Because until then, you cannot understand how much I appreciate what you have done here.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Varley - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you find working with Mister..."
entries.text: How do you find working with Mister Varley?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Hah! Did he say something? No, he w..."
entries.text: Hah! Did he say something? No, he wouldn't.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "We don't get along, he and I. Don't..."
entries.text: We don't get along, he and I. Don't see eye-to-eye, as my father used to say.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But he's fair enough, and we don't..."
entries.text: But he's fair enough, and we don't see each other much, so there's not much trouble to be had.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Skerritt - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you happen to have met Mister S..."
entries.text: Did you happen to have met Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The older gent with the cane? We sp..."
entries.text: The older gent with the cane? We spoke when I was giving him a lift to the place.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "He took it on himself to explain th..."
entries.text: He took it on himself to explain the workings of the séance to me... I wasn't about to tell him I already understood the thing.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Corentine - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had cause to meet Miss Qui..."
entries.text: Have you had cause to meet Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I believe I saw her on one of the n..."
entries.text: I believe I saw her on one of the nicer afternoons, though she didn't stop to talk.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I think she was talking to the hors..."
entries.text: I think she was talking to the horses. Working something out, it sounded like. Thinking out loud, you know?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I hope she's alright - how a young..."
entries.text: I hope she's alright - how a young woman like her gets scars like that, I don't know.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Caitlin - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How is it to work with Missus Joyce..."
entries.text: How is it to work with Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I can't say I much understand the w..."
entries.text: I can't say I much understand the woman. My way is to leave people to their own. And her, well, she's the opposite.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I wouldn't mind much but she gets s..."
entries.text: I wouldn't mind much but she gets so riled up by whatever gossip she finds.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "And there's not a person who isn't..."
entries.text: And there's not a person who isn't breaking one of the rules in her big holy book of rules.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Seamus - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you speak much with Mister Doyle..."
entries.text: Do you speak much with Mister Doyle?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "He's not really one for talking. I..."
entries.text: He's not really one for talking. I worry about the boy.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I mean, I'm sure a lot of it is jus..."
entries.text: I mean, I'm sure a lot of it is just sour grapes, but there's something about him...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "...and the poor lad has night terro..."
entries.text: ...and the poor lad has night terrors. Always muttering about black angels or something. It's no wonder he always looks so tired.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ivy - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss McLeod?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She's a sweet lass. And a proper yo..."
entries.text: She's a sweet lass. And a proper young lady, now, by all accounts.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah, she's been by. She came to see..."
entries.text: Ah, she's been by. She came to see the horses, and once she saw me, she stayed a while to talk.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I worked on her family's estate som..."
entries.text: I worked on her family's estate some years ago, you see. I almost didn't recognise her, she's grown up so much in the years since!

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinon on Lan Fen - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've met Missus L..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've met Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Miss McLeod's chaperone? I was intr..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod's chaperone? I was introduced.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She seems a sound young lady - good..."
entries.text: She seems a sound young lady - good to see someone in all this with their head firmly on their shoulders for some balance.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "No offence, Sir. I take you to be t..."
entries.text: No offence, Sir. I take you to be the same.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me about yourself, Mister Hunt..."
entries.text: Tell me about yourself, Mister Hunter.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah, I don't know that there's much..."
entries.text: Ah, I don't know that there's much to say... But I can give it a go. I'm Scottish born and raised, and I worked there until just a few years ago.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But a friend of my mother's family..."
entries.text: But a friend of my mother's family - she and her side being Irish - let me know that the manor here was looking for a stable master.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I could've stayed in Scotland and t..."
entries.text: I could've stayed in Scotland and taken some other work, but I prefer a job out in the country. Always have. And so here I find myself.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You say you're the groundsman and s..."
entries.text: You say you're the groundsman and stable master. That seems like a lot of work for one man.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Just as well I have the strength of..."
entries.text: Just as well I have the strength of two, then, right? Hah.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Nah, truth is I do what I can. Ther..."
entries.text: Nah, truth is I do what I can. There's not too much work in either, at least not at this time of year.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "We're often not as busy as we are n..."
entries.text: We're often not as busy as we are now, so the carriage doesn't come out much.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "And once the horses are all cared f..."
entries.text: And once the horses are all cared for... it would be gardening, but all the plants are dying back, now.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Summer, on the other hand - summer'..."
entries.text: Summer, on the other hand - summer's quite another story. I get by, though. Plants, at least, will wait when the horses won't.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Evelyn - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Deane?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye. I have..."
entries.text: Aye. I have...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Oh?"
entries.text: Oh?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Doesn't do well to speak ill of the..."
entries.text: Doesn't do well to speak ill of the guests.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Was she a frequent visitor to the m..."
entries.text: Was she a frequent visitor to the manor?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Can't say for sure but in the three..."
entries.text: Can't say for sure but in the three years I've worked here, it was my first time meeting her.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "And the last, I expect."
entries.text: And the last, I expect.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Cathal - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister O'Meara?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The young Irish fellow? Not really,..."
entries.text: The young Irish fellow? Not really, but I've seen him about. Miss McLeod tells me he's a pleasant sort. I think he seems like he might benefit from some fresh air, getting out of an event like this for once.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But... Miss McLeod mentioned someth..."
entries.text: But... Miss McLeod mentioned something about the young man and angels, though. I wouldn't know where to begin with that.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But I suppose, you can't say there'..."
entries.text: But I suppose, you can't say there's anything strange about angel talk when you're all here to speak with ghosts, can you? Well, not much...

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ines - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I have - she found me out here work..."
entries.text: I have - she found me out here working and had all sorts of questions about the land around here.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Answered them as best I could, of c..."
entries.text: Answered them as best I could, of course. Don't know why, especially, she wanted to know...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "...but she's not going to do any ha..."
entries.text: ...but she's not going to do any harm with it, now, is she?

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ettiene - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Toussaint?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Oh, the Frenchman? I can't say I ha..."
entries.text: Oh, the Frenchman? I can't say I have, though Missus Lau speaks well of him, so I'll take her word for it. Just so long as he doesn't try and call Iv-...

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I mean, Miss McLeod - some sort of..."
entries.text: I mean, Miss McLeod - some sort of fraud. The young lady doesn't deserve that. She's got enough on her shoulders.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Dupré - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Dupré?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The American fellow? I found him lo..."
entries.text: The American fellow? I found him lost in the hedge maze one day, looking for the firepit.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "He had an urn under one arm and a s..."
entries.text: He had an urn under one arm and a spirit board under the other.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I brought him to it and left him be..."
entries.text: I brought him to it and left him be, but I don't think he found what he had hoped for.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I heard some - ack, I probably shou..."
entries.text: I heard some - ack, I probably shouldn't be telling you this - but I heard some manic sobbing not long after.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I'm only telling you, mind, in case..."
entries.text: I'm only telling you, mind, in case you can talk to him as a fellow guest and, I dunno, help him with whatever demon he's carrying about the place.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I'd do it but... That would me out..."
entries.text: I'd do it but... That would me out of work, you understand.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on D'Arcy - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus D'Arcy?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah, I don't believe I have, no."
entries.text: Ah, I don't believe I have, no.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Heard her shouting at somebody our..."
entries.text: Heard her shouting at somebody our by the stables once but she was alone.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Maybe she has borrowed a ghost for..."
entries.text: Maybe she has borrowed a ghost for her stay here, or maybe she has brought her own?

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Coventry - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The soft-spoken gentleman? I have,..."
entries.text: The soft-spoken gentleman? I have, but I don't think it was anything of consequence.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "For all his softness he carried his..."
entries.text: For all his softness he carried his own bags - he's in good shape, I'll give him that.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Hazel - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She would be the American lass, wou..."
entries.text: She would be the American lass, wouldn't she?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah, we spoke, but it wasn't anythin..."
entries.text: Ah, we spoke, but it wasn't anything particular. I think she bemoaned the weather - though she tells me it gets much colder in New York.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I wasn't really listening, to be fr..."
entries.text: I wasn't really listening, to be frank. Doyle had disappeared so I had to lug her large metal trunk to her room by myself.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I'd say that thing weighs more than..."
entries.text: I'd say that thing weighs more than she does.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ruairí - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Doctor Callaghan..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ruairí Callaghan, isn't it? Aye, I'..."
entries.text: Ruairí Callaghan, isn't it? Aye, I've spoken to him a bit. He seems a decent lad - good head on his shoulders, for the most part.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "And a doctor, at that! He's doing w..."
entries.text: And a doctor, at that! He's doing well for himself. His aunt speaks very highly of him - but not when he's within earshot, I've noticed.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Carmela - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Only in that she's discussed her pl..."
entries.text: Only in that she's discussed her plans for the séance and how she'd like the hedge maze set up for it. Our paths haven't crossed much outside of that.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Though I see her wandering the grou..."
entries.text: Though I see her wandering the grounds, always underdressed for the weather - no wonder she is so dosed.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Blake - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you find working for Marques..."
entries.text: How do you find working for Marquess Blake?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Ah, I can't complain. Truth is, I d..."
entries.text: Ah, I can't complain. Truth is, I don't have many dealings with him.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "He doesn't like carriages - not sur..."
entries.text: He doesn't like carriages - not surprising, given what happened to his wife and son - so he tends to stay on the manor grounds.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I get the odd compliment on the gar..."
entries.text: I get the odd compliment on the gardens when he sees me working. That's enough dealings for me.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ó Finn - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Well, I said hello to him as he arr..."
entries.text: Well, I said hello to him as he arrived and nodded in passing on the grounds. We've not had much other reason to cross paths.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But Miss Callaghan likes him, so he..."
entries.text: But Miss Callaghan likes him, so he can't be too bad.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Fiadh - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can I assume you've met Miss Callag..."
entries.text: Can I assume you've met Miss Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I have indeed. Wonderful woman. Got..."
entries.text: I have indeed. Wonderful woman. Got her head on her shoulders and the wits to match.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She's a good sort, Mister Ward. I t..."
entries.text: She's a good sort, Mister Ward. I think, should you need it, and should you let her, she'll do right by you.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Never hurts to have someone with a..."
entries.text: Never hurts to have someone with a good and steady heart on your side.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Father Sinnott?"
entries.text: Have you met Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I've seen him around the grounds no..."
entries.text: I've seen him around the grounds now and then.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I asked, once, if he needed help. H..."
entries.text: I asked, once, if he needed help. He threw question after question at me about the place - namely ruins on the grounds, or secret passages.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "He was very disappointed with my an..."
entries.text: He was very disappointed with my answers.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "God knows what he is looking for bu..."
entries.text: God knows what he is looking for but I tend the grounds, not the library.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Arwa - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Hisham?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, when I brought her in. She was..."
entries.text: Aye, when I brought her in. She was friendly enough.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I've seen her around the grounds -..."
entries.text: I've seen her around the grounds - all over them. Checking doors and the likes.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Less friendly, then. Like I'd caugh..."
entries.text: Less friendly, then. Like I'd caught her in the middle of something.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Saoirse - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you find working with Miss M..."
entries.text: How do you find working with Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She seems a grand lass - though we..."
entries.text: She seems a grand lass - though we don't see each other very often.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "She works downstairs and, well, she..."
entries.text: She works downstairs and, well, she can be skittish around fellas.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Poor girl has a habit of attracting..."
entries.text: Poor girl has a habit of attracting the wrong sorts of people.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Not much I can do there but provide..."
entries.text: Not much I can do there but provide counsel. The odd time she'll listen.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Campbell - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What's your impression of Reverend..."
entries.text: What's your impression of Reverend Campbell?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "He comes by about once a week... Ha..."
entries.text: He comes by about once a week... Has done ever since I've been working here, I think.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "But I can't say I know the man well..."
entries.text: But I can't say I know the man well. Seems a decent sort, though, I suppose.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Higgins - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen a man around these gr..."
entries.text: Have you seen a man around these grounds, tall and wide in the shoulders?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Have I? I thought... I thought this..."
entries.text: Have I? I thought... I thought this place was playing tricks on me.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I suppose I've no idea. But I shoul..."
entries.text: I suppose I've no idea. But I should... Shouldn't I?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Sometimes I hate this blasted place..."
entries.text: Sometimes I hate this blasted place.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Walter Blake - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know of Walter Blake?"
entries.text: What do you know of Walter Blake?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The young master? He's a good lad...."
entries.text: The young master? He's a good lad. I take him for walks 'round the grounds from time to time, but he doesn't talk much.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I'm told he's been quiet since the..."
entries.text: I'm told he's been quiet since the carriage accident that killed his mother and maimed him.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Before my time, all that, but he do..."
entries.text: Before my time, all that, but he does like to go through her maze when I have him out. Misses her something awful, the poor lad.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Outdoor clothes - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I take it you don't have to dress u..."
entries.text: I take it you don't have to dress up like the other staff.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Horses don't care whether you're we..."
entries.text: Horses don't care whether you're wearing a suit, or anything otherwise. And almost everything else is easier to work in.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Besides, if I had to worry about ke..."
entries.text: Besides, if I had to worry about keeping my clothes as pristine as the indoor staff wear their uniforms, I'd never get anything done.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Scent of sugar - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I notice there's a sugary smell abo..."
entries.text: I notice there's a sugary smell about... Do you happen to have sugar cubes in your pockets?

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "I do, and oats, as well. For the ho..."
entries.text: I do, and oats, as well. For the horses, obviously. Us staff do get better fare than that, hah!

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "The horses trust me well enough, bu..."
entries.text: The horses trust me well enough, but it never hurts to have something to treat them with - especially when they're unsure of new people.

title: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Relaxed Regard - Darragh

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your scarf - it's quite the fancy p..."
entries.text: Your scarf - it's quite the fancy piece.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Aye, a gift from a young friend I'd..."
entries.text: Aye, a gift from a young friend I'd not seen in years.

entries.speaker: Mister Hunter
entries.label: Darragh: "Everyone's here to see the dead, bu..."
entries.text: Everyone's here to see the dead, but it's brought the living back to me.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I don't think we've met. Who might..."
entries.text: I don't think we've met. Who might you be?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Hello. What brings you back?"
entries.text: Hello. What brings you back?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "My name's Declan Ward, Miss...?"
entries.text: My name's Declan Ward, Miss...?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I am Missus Victoria Lau. How do yo..."
entries.text: I am Missus Victoria Lau. How do you do?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Lau. A pleasure. Another séa..."
entries.text: Missus Lau. A pleasure. Another séance attendee?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Indirectly only. I am Miss McLeod's..."
entries.text: Indirectly only. I am Miss McLeod's chaperone. The event itself is not to my taste; I am here for her and her alone.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That's all, Missus Lau."
entries.text: That's all, Missus Lau.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Farewell, Mister Ward."
entries.text: Farewell, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Would you - please would you keep y..."
entries.text: Would you - please would you keep your voice down? I am not proud of this. I do not - Oh, God, I don't want to be doing this.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "This whole thing is repulsive. I tr..."
entries.text: This whole thing is repulsive. I tried to find the material Evelyn somehow has. Do you understand? But I couldn't find it.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "There didn't seem much option to me..."
entries.text: There didn't seem much option to me, then. I don't want to think what I might have to do...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have no doubt I am sinning agains..."
entries.text: I have no doubt I am sinning against her, Mister Ward. I have no illusions of that. My hope is that it is the lesser of the evils I must subject her to...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "So you are right, of course. I have..."
entries.text: So you are right, of course. I have seen you asking questions. Your business is other people's business, I gather...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "In cases like this, sometimes I wis..."
entries.text: In cases like this, sometimes I wish it wasn't.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "You think I don't hear myself? How..."
entries.text: You think I don't hear myself? How horrendous this all is? I do not want to be here, Mister Ward, considering these things...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I am doing what I think is best for..."
entries.text: I am doing what I think is best for Ivy. As for Miss Deane... You know I have not yet met with her, don't you? I meant to, but she never showed...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Despite what I think I might have t..."
entries.text: Despite what I think I might have to do, I haven't hurt her. And I won't have to consider her anymore at all, if...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "If... Perhaps you could make good u..."
entries.text: If... Perhaps you could make good use of this? Could you retrieve what Miss Deane has on us?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Then it can all be over. A little m..."
entries.text: Then it can all be over. A little mercy on us, Sir, please. I do not deserve it, but Ivy does. And for all her sins, I do not want to hurt Miss Deane.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Do it for their sake, if not mine...."
entries.text: Do it for their sake, if not mine. I only want to be left in peace, that all this might be between myself and Ivy, and no one else...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "That would mean the world."
entries.text: That would mean the world.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But the more I consider my options,..."
entries.text: But the more I consider my options, I realise that if Ivy knows what I am doing, she, she can't - I can't inflict her with it. I can't.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Perhaps you, with your keen eye and..."
entries.text: Perhaps you, with your keen eye and... wandering spirit, might know where it leads?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I believe she stashed it where she'..."
entries.text: I believe she stashed it where she's made a mark on this map, but... I cannot tell where this is - it does not match anywhere I have found on the grounds.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Ah. The man from this morning. The..."
entries.text: Ah. The man from this morning. The man from room... number 4.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "..."

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Photograph of Deane - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Yes, that's Miss Evelyn Deane."
entries.text: Yes, that's Miss Evelyn Deane.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this woman?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this woman?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "She's a guest here - though, come t..."
entries.text: She's a guest here - though, come to think of it, I don't believe I've seen her in some time.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Séance flyer - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I'll believe it when I see it, Mist..."
entries.text: I'll believe it when I see it, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "... It just so happens that I've al..."
entries.text: ... It just so happens that I've already seen some improbable things.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you think the séance is going to..."
entries.text: Do you think the séance is going to be successful?

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Marriage talk - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I overheard mention that your frien..."
entries.text: I overheard mention that your friend, Miss McLeod, is looking for a suitor.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Yes. Well. She is coming of that ag..."
entries.text: Yes. Well. She is coming of that age, I suppose.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "And for a woman with her gift, find..."
entries.text: And for a woman with her gift, finding a man more open to such things may make the rest of her days easier.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "If she must look, then this is as s..."
entries.text: If she must look, then this is as suitable a place to look as any.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Telegram for Ines - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Ought you not to give this to Miss..."
entries.text: Ought you not to give this to Miss Barbosa?

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/The Staff say Deane left - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The staff say that Miss Deane has l..."
entries.text: The staff say that Miss Deane has left.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "They did? I wonder what for..."
entries.text: They did? I wonder what for...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Hm. I ought to tell Ivy."
entries.text: Hm. I ought to tell Ivy.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Manor contemporary history - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know anything abou..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about this house? It seems to be very old.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I'm afraid I don't, but if you want..."
entries.text: I'm afraid I don't, but if you wanted to learn something about it, you might ask Mister Coventry, or Marquess Blake, if you can find him.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Mister Coventry seems to be some so..."
entries.text: Mister Coventry seems to be some sort of historian, for his part... And I have to assume Marquess Blake would know something about the manor.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I hope that helps you."
entries.text: I hope that helps you.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It does, thank you."
entries.text: It does, thank you.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ghosts - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen any... strange occurr..."
entries.text: Have you seen any... strange occurrences around the manor, Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Doesn't the event alone count as on..."
entries.text: Doesn't the event alone count as one? But, you mean the ghosts, don't you?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't say I was expecting you to..."
entries.text: I can't say I was expecting you to believe in ghosts.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Well... I've seen some strange thin..."
entries.text: Well... I've seen some strange things. Ivy calls them ghosts, and I've no better explanation for them.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "There was a woman upstairs in the a..."
entries.text: There was a woman upstairs in the atrium. I took her for another guest, but when I went up to say hello, she was just... gone...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I... I do believe that many things..."
entries.text: I... I do believe that many things have rational explanations. And maybe Ivy's visions, and the young woman I saw, have a practical explanation.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But for now, Mister Ward, in my own..."
entries.text: But for now, Mister Ward, in my own way, I do confess I believe in Ivy's visions... so while improbable, ghosts no longer seem impossible.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/The Séance's Purpose - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know if anything like this s..."
entries.text: Do you know if anything like this séance has been attempted before?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Inevitably, someone has tried it. I..."
entries.text: Inevitably, someone has tried it. I sometimes wish we were not so preoccupied with what comes next.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But perhaps it is our nature... Whe..."
entries.text: But perhaps it is our nature... When we are dissatisfied in this life, we demand answers from the yet unknown.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I suppose in the hopes that the unk..."
entries.text: I suppose in the hopes that the unknown will reveal something we like better.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Deane's leaving letter - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Deane - Evelyn Deane, that is..."
entries.text: Miss Deane - Evelyn Deane, that is - left a letter excusing herself.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "So that's where she went!"
entries.text: So that's where she went!

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "That's curious... But I really don'..."
entries.text: That's curious... But I really don't know her well enough to judge just how curious...

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Soiled Telegram - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Missus Lau

entries.text: I've never met a member of the family personally before this event, but I have heard mention of something like that.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "They're infamous for terrible luck...."
entries.text: They're infamous for terrible luck. Specifically, terrible luck that leads to an early grave one way or another.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Here and there, and, well - especia..."
entries.text: Here and there, and, well - especially here, among the superstitious, you'll hear tell that they're outright cursed.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "And, you know, considering it all....."
entries.text: And, you know, considering it all... They really might be.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Freemasons - Lan Fen
