entries.text: What do you know of the Freemasons?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Ah... Well, I don't know the name...."
entries.text: Ah... Well, I don't know the name. So, nothing at all?

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Box of pills - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever heard of Quinine powd..."
entries.text: Have you ever heard of Quinine powder, Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau

entries.text: ...What makes you ask?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You know, Missus Lau, I've gone bla..."
entries.text: You know, Missus Lau, I've gone blank as to what reason I had you and that powder in my mind...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I see. Malaria killed my husband, s..."
entries.text: I see. Malaria killed my husband, so yes, I know Quinine.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Thanks to Ivy, I got my hands on so..."
entries.text: Thanks to Ivy, I got my hands on some, but it was too late. It did not save him.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Drugged Water Jug - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Has Miss McLeod had trouble sleepin..."
entries.text: Has Miss McLeod had trouble sleeping since she's arrived?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Not to my knowledge."
entries.text: Not to my knowledge.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Forgive my asking, only she seems a..."
entries.text: Forgive my asking, only she seems a little out of sorts during the day.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Ah, well... She did mention she's n..."
entries.text: Ah, well... She did mention she's not been feeling quite herself.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I think it's the travel, and the st..."
entries.text: I think it's the travel, and the stories about this place... nothing to be concerned about, I'm sure.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Hedonistic Gala - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of the masked ball..."
entries.text: What do you make of the masked ball, Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I am adding it to the list of unusu..."
entries.text: I am adding it to the list of unusual situations Ivy has gotten me into. Does "unusual situation" suffice? No, it doesn't, does it?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I am told the purpose was to attune..."
entries.text: I am told the purpose was to attuned ourselves spiritually...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Do such things actually do anything..."
entries.text: Do such things actually do anything to enhance your spiritual awareness...? I don't know if they do.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But I saw... things... Including an..."
entries.text: But I saw... things... Including an apparition I've seen elsewhere here - a woman who washes.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "So maybe these events do work?"
entries.text: So maybe these events do work?

entries.text: I've been seeing this symbol around... here, I made a copy. Does this mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Nothing at all. It looks like a run..."
entries.text: Nothing at all. It looks like a rune, I suppose, but nothing that I've ever seen... not that I would be an authority.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Unknown Symbol - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've seen a symbol around - a spira..."
entries.text: I've seen a symbol around - a spiral with four lines intersecting it. Does that mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "A spiral with four.... hm."
entries.text: A spiral with four.... hm.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I don't believe I've seen the like,..."
entries.text: I don't believe I've seen the like, no.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Deane's Room - Lan Fen

entries.label: Ward: "Do you know which room Miss Deane w..."
entries.text: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau

entries.text: Why do you think I would know that?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I mean... I have no dealings with h..."
entries.text: I mean... I have no dealings with her. I would have no reason to know...

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Curse - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've heard the Quinn family were cu..."
entries.text: I've heard the Quinn family were cursed some years ago...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Some years ago... and so, I would n..."
entries.text: Some years ago... and so, I would not imagine Corentine Quinn deserves it.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "There are plenty of unlucky stars t..."
entries.text: There are plenty of unlucky stars to be born under, but that is an unusual one.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy meeting Cathal - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I stumbled upon Miss McLeod and Mis..."
entries.text: I stumbled upon Miss McLeod and Mister O'Meara meeting in secret to discuss marriage...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau

entries.text: I... I, ah... Is that so?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "It is, isn't it? I can see it in yo..."
entries.text: It is, isn't it? I can see it in your face.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Oh, Ivy... Not him, don't do that t..."
entries.text: Oh, Ivy... Not him, don't do that to us...

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Blackmail material on Livy - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've managed to gain access to the..."
entries.text: I've managed to gain access to the room in the catacombs, as you requested. I found this stashed away there.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Oh, my goodness. You actually did i..."
entries.text: Oh, my goodness. You actually did it? I...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "...I suppose I'll have to come clea..."
entries.text: ...I suppose I'll have to come clean to her too. I hope she understands why I did what I did.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I'm very grateful Mister Ward. We m..."
entries.text: I'm very grateful Mister Ward. We must tell Ivy right away. Mister Hunter, too, he's been very concerned about Ivy.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found these documents, but I can'..."
entries.text: I found these documents, but I can't for the life of me seem to find the owner. Might you recognise them?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Documents that- But how the...?"
entries.text: Documents that- But how the...?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "...I have the key right-- where did..."
entries.text: ...I have the key right-- where did it go?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "You know, I'm rather sick of games,..."
entries.text: You know, I'm rather sick of games, Mister Ward. I've been toyed with enough for a lifetime.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "We share an inclination for room-se..."
entries.text: We share an inclination for room-searching, do we? Fine.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "You stay out of my business with Ev..."
entries.text: You stay out of my business with Evelyn Deane, and I won't ask why you were sneaking about my room.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Though if your business is Miss Dea..."
entries.text: Though if your business is Miss Deane - because, hah! It is, isn't it? She's in everyone's damn business-

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "You might be interested to know tha..."
entries.text: You might be interested to know that the cufflink you likely saw with this "finding" of yours, belongs to Mister Coventry.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "What do you make of that, Mister Wa..."
entries.text: What do you make of that, Mister Ward? You might want to stick your nose into his affairs and leave mine well enough alone.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Lau-"
entries.text: Missus Lau-

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Map of catacombs - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Remind me what you wanted me to do..."
entries.text: Remind me what you wanted me to do with this?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I think this map shows where Miss D..."
entries.text: I think this map shows where Miss Deane stashed the material she has on myself and Ivy.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But I cannot for the life of me fig..."
entries.text: But I cannot for the life of me figure out where this place actually is - it's not the basement, I know that much.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Witchcraft components - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of these? They loo..."
entries.text: What do you make of these? They look like components for a ritual or charm of some sort, at least to my eye.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "They could be. That sort of thing i..."
entries.text: They could be. That sort of thing is more Miss McLeod's area, to be honest with you. I'm sure you could ask her.

entries.text: Is it fair to say yourself and Miss McLeod are quite close?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Of course, sir. I'm her chaperone,..."
entries.text: Of course, sir. I'm her chaperone, and we spend quite a bit of time together.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Whatever you're implying, Mister Wa..."
entries.text: Whatever you're implying, Mister Ward, I don't appreciate it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...Some might say you're very, very..."
entries.text: ...Some might say you're very, very close, if you catch my meaning?

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Wards of Protection - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "It was very kind of him to make the..."
entries.text: It was very kind of him to make these for us. He's always been so good to Ivy, I'm... a little honoured to be included, I think.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Hunter has you well looked a..."
entries.text: Mister Hunter has you well looked after.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy's relationship with Darragh - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Mmh. Precious little gets past you,..."
entries.text: Mmh. Precious little gets past you, I see, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss McLeod and Mister Hunter know..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod and Mister Hunter know each other quite well, I gather?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "You're not wrong. He was the ground..."
entries.text: You're not wrong. He was the groundskeeper in her family's estate for years. She's known him since she was a child, and she thinks very highly of him.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Some people might think it improper..."
entries.text: Some people might think it improper, keeping a friendship with former staff, which is why they keep it quiet.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But Mister Hunter has been nothing..."
entries.text: But Mister Hunter has been nothing but kind to Miss McLeod. So why shouldn't she keep in touch?

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Chimeny Charm - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found what I think is a charm on..."
entries.text: I found what I think is a charm on the grounds, made of a knotted piece of rope. Would you know anything about something like that?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Hm. Well, it could be a charm, but..."
entries.text: Hm. Well, it could be a charm, but I wouldn't be the person to ask. Ivy might know.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Timetable - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know how you're going to spe..."
entries.text: Do you know how you're going to spend today?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you think you're going to sp..."
entries.text: How do you think you're going to spend the day?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I've convinced Ivy to spend some ti..."
entries.text: I've convinced Ivy to spend some time in the library throughout the day. It's surprisingly expansive, from what I've seen so far.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I will be attending the church serv..."
entries.text: I will be attending the church service at 11am, of course.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "And then, of course, the ball. That..."
entries.text: And then, of course, the ball. That should prove interesting. Then, on Sunday...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "And before the séance, I will be at..."
entries.text: And before the séance, I will be attending the silent dinner at 8pm.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "And, as fair tradeoff, she wishes t..."
entries.text: And, as fair tradeoff, she wishes to visit Lottie - one of the horses.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "After that... Well, you'll think me..."
entries.text: After that... Well, you'll think me quite the bookworm, Mister Ward, but I'll be dragging Ivy to the library again.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Old photograph - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this photograph, M..."
entries.text: Do you recognise this photograph, Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Hm? I can't say I do, I..."
entries.text: Hm? I can't say I do, I...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Oh, goodness. Is that a little Ivy?..."
entries.text: Oh, goodness. Is that a little Ivy? Oh, she's just adorable! What a stern little expression...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "And so the gentleman would be... Mi..."
entries.text: And so the gentleman would be... Mister Hunter. Mm, that's it - it seems obvious now.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Technically, it's improper for a no..."
entries.text: Technically, it's improper for a noblewoman and a servant to be so close, so this is information not best shared...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But I am glad Ivy had Mister Hunter..."
entries.text: But I am glad Ivy had Mister Hunter when she needed him. She was not well understood by her family.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Lucid dreaming - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about lucid dreami..."
entries.text: What do you know about lucid dreaming?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "It's a relatively new concept so I..."
entries.text: It's a relatively new concept so I have only read about it. Supposedly, mastery of lucid dreaming allows you to control your dreams.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "It's an interesting idea, though I..."
entries.text: It's an interesting idea, though I don't necessarily see the appeal.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/gauge - lan fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of the strange dev..."
entries.text: What do you make of the strange device in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Nothing. I am not that interested i..."
entries.text: Nothing. I am not that interested in the event or its showpieces, so I have not given it a second thought.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/washer woman - LF

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "On my arrival here, I thought I saw..."
entries.text: On my arrival here, I thought I saw a woman washing something in the fountain...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have seen her too. Though I saw h..."
entries.text: I have seen her too. Though I saw her on entering the ladies' bathroom.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "She shrieked, and I fell back. When..."
entries.text: She shrieked, and I fell back. When I stood, she was gone - save the shawl she was washing in the tub.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "There was no way she got past me. A..."
entries.text: There was no way she got past me. Another gift from this awful hotel.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Of course, I am thrilled with the o..."
entries.text: Of course, I am thrilled with the outcome.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How are you feeling now that the si..."
entries.text: How are you feeling now that the situation is resolved?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But, I am... less thrilled with my..."
entries.text: But, I am... less thrilled with my behaviour.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I could blame a lot of it on Miss D..."
entries.text: I could blame a lot of it on Miss Deane, or this house, maybe even just the time of year or the event itself...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "...but my training works against me..."
entries.text: ...but my training works against me here. I have to own my anger, frustration, and mistakes from this past week.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have some work to do to regain Iv..."
entries.text: I have some work to do to regain Ivy's trust, but I am happy I have the chance to do that. So, thank you.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have some work to do to regain Iv..."
entries.text: I have some work to do to regain Ivy's trust. It's possible I never will.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But even if I lose her, she will be..."
entries.text: But even if I lose her, she will be free - and that is worth everything. So, thank you.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "You've given me the chance to becom..."
entries.text: You've given me the chance to become the person she deserves, and I may yet fail.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/shared dreams - lan fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I fear many of the guests are exper..."
entries.text: I fear many of the guests are experiencing the same dream.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "...Similar dreams, maybe? We are al..."
entries.text: ...Similar dreams, maybe? We are all in the same place with the same people and same experiences - it is possible for our subconscious to pick up these same signals and try process them while we sleep, which could result...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "No, the same - almost moment to mom..."
entries.text: No, the same - almost moment to moment.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Then I would say you are a liar - i..."
entries.text: Then I would say you are a liar - if we were not in this strange place that seems to defy certain logic.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But since we are in this place, you..."
entries.text: But since we are in this place, you might need to speak to somebody with more of a... magical bent to their studies?

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The dreams, they contains a buried..."
entries.text: The dreams, they contains a buried message!

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "All dreams do, Mister Ward."
entries.text: All dreams do, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "But this one is from an external so..."
entries.text: But this one is from an external source - it is guiding us to the séance.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "...It is natural enough that we're..."
entries.text: ...It is natural enough that we're dreaming of attending the event we're all here for.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "But many guests are not here for it..."
entries.text: But many guests are not here for it, they are here for other reasons - even they are having the same experience.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "That is harder to explain away, I'l..."
entries.text: That is harder to explain away, I'll confess.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "And yet... even I feel the compulsi..."
entries.text: And yet... even I feel the compulsion...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You, yourself, are not really here..."
entries.text: You, yourself, are not really here for the séance. You are here to look after Miss McLeod.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But what does it all mean?"
entries.text: But what does it all mean?

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ivy - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is Miss McLeod a close friend?"
entries.text: Is Miss McLeod a close friend?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Ivy is... she's undoubtedly somethi..."
entries.text: Ivy is... she's undoubtedly something apart from the mundane, but she's sweet, clever, and without artifice.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "She is, very much so. I... am inten..."
entries.text: She is, very much so. I... am intensely glad to have met her.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I think that's why I liked her in t..."
entries.text: I think that's why I liked her in the first place. So, to answer your question, yes. She's very dear to me.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Varley - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the manager?"
entries.text: Have you met the manager?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Mister Varley? Only in passing. Whi..."
entries.text: Mister Varley? Only in passing. Which is, I suspect, the way it is for many people.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "He's been very good to Ivy and I, q..."
entries.text: He's been very good to Ivy and I, quick and thorough to see to any requests.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "He always seems quite concerned, th..."
entries.text: He always seems quite concerned, though. I know running a hotel can be no easy feat - especially through an event like this, but still... I think it may be something else...

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Skerritt - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Has Mister Skerritt introduced hims..."
entries.text: Has Mister Skerritt introduced himself to you?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "He did. Briefly."
entries.text: He did. Briefly.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "He was not very interested in talki..."
entries.text: He was not very interested in talking to me, not with Ivy beside me.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Or, more likely, at all."
entries.text: Or, more likely, at all.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Corentine - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the chance to speak wi..."
entries.text: Have you had the chance to speak with Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau

entries.text: I have. She's a strange sort, but quite affable if her attention holds.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have to wonder what she's working..."
entries.text: I have to wonder what she's working on. She's a poet, as I understand - but her research doesn't look like poetic work...

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Caitlin - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had cause to speak with th..."
entries.text: Have you had cause to speak with the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "She is clearly very eager to learn..."
entries.text: She is clearly very eager to learn everything she can about the guests, and I am very eager for that not to happen.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I asked for the younger girl, the c..."
entries.text: I asked for the younger girl, the cook, to take over the cleaning of my room and Ivy's.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "There's nothing to find there, of c..."
entries.text: There's nothing to find there, of course, but nonetheless, I don't want Missus Joyce trying.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Thankfully, not much. And yet I sti..."
entries.text: Thankfully, not much. And yet I still know more about her than I ever wanted to.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Darragh - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The groundskeeper's a pleasant sort..."
entries.text: The groundskeeper's a pleasant sort, don't you think?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "From what little I know of him, I c..."
entries.text: From what little I know of him, I could say so. I couldn't sense any affectation to it, either.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "He does seem to genuinely care for..."
entries.text: He does seem to genuinely care for Ivy, and she is terribly fond of him, so I like him for that.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I suspect there's nothing he wouldn..."
entries.text: I suspect there's nothing he wouldn't do for her.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Seamus - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the porter?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the porter?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "That poor man needs help. Whatever..."
entries.text: That poor man needs help. Whatever burden is on his shoulders, his attempts to drown it out do not seem to be working.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "He should also stay away from Miss..."
entries.text: He should also stay away from Miss Deane. That woman is nothing but trouble.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Lan Fen - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about yourself..."
entries.text: What can you tell me about yourself, Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "You know, Mister Ward, some people..."
entries.text: You know, Mister Ward, some people tend not to ask me such things. I do appreciate it.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I prefer to study the science of ps..."
entries.text: I prefer to study the science of psychology. That is, the study of the human mind.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I confess, I'm not a spiritualist,..."
entries.text: I confess, I'm not a spiritualist, and I have little interest in it.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "As for myself... I was born and rai..."
entries.text: As for myself... I was born and raised in London, and have lived my entire life there.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "That is not to say I didn't travel..."
entries.text: That is not to say I didn't travel - but I've never found reason to come to Ireland before.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Evelyn - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Deane?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have, unfortunately. We've been d..."
entries.text: I have, unfortunately. We've been dealing with her for a while now.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is it unfortunate?"
entries.text: Is it unfortunate?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I don't know if it was for her, but..."
entries.text: I don't know if it was for her, but it certainly was for me. If only our paths had never crossed.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I can't stand her. The less said ab..."
entries.text: I can't stand her. The less said about it, the better.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Cathal - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have, through Miss McLeod. A char..."
entries.text: I have, through Miss McLeod. A charming rogue, I suppose, but there's something there - a danger.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister O'Meara?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Given his injuries, the methods, an..."
entries.text: Given his injuries, the methods, and the rate at which he acquires them, he's possibly more of a risk to himself than anyone else, but you cannot be sure.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ines - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Now she is an interesting one - she..."
entries.text: Now she is an interesting one - she does not seem the slightest bit interested in the events taking place.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "So why is she here? And what is she..."
entries.text: So why is she here? And what is she hiding?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "One to watch."
entries.text: One to watch.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ettiene - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Toussaint?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have. I had heard of him before,..."
entries.text: I have. I had heard of him before, in passing, and thought he would be much more severe.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "It turns out he makes for very plea..."
entries.text: It turns out he makes for very pleasant conversation... and he was kind enough to recommend me some reading.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I mentioned I was... I hesitate to..."
entries.text: I mentioned I was... I hesitate to call myself a scholar, but I mentioned that I was interested in a field of my own.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "He said he was pleased to see someo..."
entries.text: He said he was pleased to see someone else following such a discipline, different though ours are, and was only happy to aid me.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "It is seldom I meet a man so positi..."
entries.text: It is seldom I meet a man so positively inclined to the whole idea. It's... surprisingly encouraging, somehow.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Dupré - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you by chance been introduced..."
entries.text: Have you by chance been introduced to Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have. I confess, it was Ivy who s..."
entries.text: I have. I confess, it was Ivy who seemed to gain the most from speaking to him, but it was a pleasant experience all the same.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "He seems quite... practical, in a w..."
entries.text: He seems quite... practical, in a way that can be found wanting at events like this.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on D'Arcy - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to spe..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to speak to Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I confess, I haven't read her work,..."
entries.text: I confess, I haven't read her work, and said the same to her - but she didn't seem to mind.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: ""Leave that to the hysterical sort"..."
entries.text: "Leave that to the hysterical sort", she said. Hm! I'm almost convinced to read them now.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "She is an interesting woman... I sh..."
entries.text: She is an interesting woman... I should like to keep contact after this event, though I have no reason to believe she would benefit from that arrangement.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "We will just have to see."
entries.text: We will just have to see.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Coventry - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Just a little. He made introduction..."
entries.text: Just a little. He made introductions. A charming man.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I couldn't help but feel like I was..."
entries.text: I couldn't help but feel like I was missing something, though.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Perhaps he was making moves on Ivy,..."
entries.text: Perhaps he was making moves on Ivy, and I was blind to it. Certainly, he does seem fond of a younger romance.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Hazel - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I have, though she spoke mostly to..."
entries.text: I have, though she spoke mostly to Ivy.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "...I do not like the way she looks..."
entries.text: ...I do not like the way she looks at her.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Mind her, Mister Ward - be wary. Th..."
entries.text: Mind her, Mister Ward - be wary. There is something about Missus Erickson I cannot trust.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ruairí - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you happen to have met Doctor C..."
entries.text: Did you happen to have met Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "We were introduced over drinks just..."
entries.text: We were introduced over drinks just the other night. It's good to see a doctor amidst this gathering.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "And interesting, too, that he is bo..."
entries.text: And interesting, too, that he is both a formally recognised doctor and a magician without the exclusion of one or the other.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "We talked a while. He was more amen..."
entries.text: We talked a while. He was more amenable to talking to me than I might have imagined.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "It's a commonly held belief that th..."
entries.text: It's a commonly held belief that the sciences have no place for women among them - he doesn't seem, at least entirely, to hold that view.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "A result of his training under his..."
entries.text: A result of his training under his aunt, no doubt. Hopefully, soon she will see what a good man he has become.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Carmela - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Ivy told me all about her. I don't..."
entries.text: Ivy told me all about her. I don't know exactly what I was expecting, after that... but she seems like a good, decent woman.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Though perhaps for her reputation,..."
entries.text: Though perhaps for her reputation, I should call her inscrutable. Mystical.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Whichever she would prefer."
entries.text: Whichever she would prefer.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Blake - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with the Marquess,..."
entries.text: Have you spoken with the Marquess, at all?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "No. I played some bridge with him,..."
entries.text: No. I played some bridge with him, but we never spoke beyond a greeting.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "This will sound conspiratorial, Mis..."
entries.text: This will sound conspiratorial, Mister Ward, but it seemed to me that he had no interest in any of the guests who are of a less magical bent.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ó Finn - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I can't say I have, yet. I rather w..."
entries.text: I can't say I have, yet. I rather wonder what I would talk to him about?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I must confess that while I am usua..."
entries.text: I must confess that while I am usually a good read on people, he has me thrown. Maybe that is his intention?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "If I do manage to think of somethin..."
entries.text: If I do manage to think of something, then I'm sure it will be quite the conversation.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Fiadh - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "What a dear. She admonished us for..."
entries.text: What a dear. She admonished us for being here, but in a gentle way.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Then, she took our hands and told u..."
entries.text: Then, she took our hands and told us everything would work out in the end.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I don't know why, but I took great..."
entries.text: I don't know why, but I took great solace from that.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you made the acquaintance of F..."
entries.text: Have you made the acquaintance of Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "I expected more... misgiving, judge..."
entries.text: I expected more... misgiving, judgement, condemnation, even, from him.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "But he was polite and brief when we..."
entries.text: But he was polite and brief when we interacted. I got the impression he did not care about me, but not in a dismissive or derogatory way.

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Arwa - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Hisham?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "She's a historian, she said. And I..."
entries.text: She's a historian, she said. And I don't disbelieve her... but there's something about her...

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Something in her eyes and the way s..."
entries.text: Something in her eyes and the way she moves her hands makes me think there's some other reason for her being here. Some preoccupation.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Something rather more current. What..."
entries.text: Something rather more current. Whatever it may be...

title: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Saoirse - Lan Fen

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Murphy?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "She's neither so talkative nor so i..."
entries.text: She's neither so talkative nor so interested in this event or its guests as Missus Joyce, so I asked for her to look after our rooms.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Poor girl has such a sadness about..."
entries.text: Poor girl has such a sadness about her.

entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Reverend Campbel..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to Reverend Campbell?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "No, I don't believe I have."
entries.text: No, I don't believe I have.

entries.text: I don't suppose you've seen a man around here, not one of the guests or staff? He's got quite the build.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau

entries.text: Oh, I thought he might be a deliveryman. You mean to say he isn't? That's... curious.

entries.text: Were you aware that Marquess Blake has a son?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "Well, I assumed. He's in portraits..."
entries.text: Well, I assumed. He's in portraits around the house, of course, and I think I have seen him watching us go about the gardens - the guests, I mean - from his window.

entries.text: I notice you're wearing a cameo. May I ask who it depicts?

entries.speaker: Missus Lau

entries.text: ...Yes. It's of my late husband.

entries.speaker: Missus Lau
entries.label: Lan Fen: "While I'm no longer expected to dre..."
entries.text: While I'm no longer expected to dress in mourning for him - and he would not have wanted me to continue on so, anyway...

entries.label: Lan Fen: "I... I rather like to keep the came..."
entries.text: I... I rather like to keep the cameo. It keeps him... close.

entries.text: Have you had your dress recently altered, Missus Lau?

entries.text: Father, I was wondering if I might ask something of you.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "...I couldn't tell you without know..."
entries.text: ...I couldn't tell you without knowing what it is you'd ask of me.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The cook, Miss Murphy, has a little..."
entries.text: The cook, Miss Murphy, has a little girl who was taken into custody by a Magdalene Laundry shortly after her birth.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "She is anxious for news of her. I s..."
entries.text: She is anxious for news of her. I said I would ask on her behalf.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "..."

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "...There is so much suffering in th..."
entries.text: ...There is so much suffering in this life, is there not? Why is it that God allows a child to be taken from her mother? Is that bond not God's plan? Is it not sacred?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I would end her suffering, all suff..."
entries.text: I would end her suffering, all suffering,  in my own way.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "What you ask is outside of my power..."
entries.text: What you ask is outside of my power or influence. At least as you would ask it.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "What agents of the divine are we, t..."
entries.text: What agents of the divine are we, that we would do something so vile?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Are we agents of the divine at all?"
entries.text: Are we agents of the divine at all?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "But that is of no use to her, here,..."
entries.text: But that is of no use to her, here, now. No, I'm sorry to say that she will not see that child again by conventional means, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "But we are surrounded by unconventi..."
entries.text: But we are surrounded by unconventional people, are we not? Maybe one of them has a way to see what cannot normally be seen?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Now, go with God and help that poor..."
entries.text: Now, go with God and help that poor girl.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Exorcism - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about exorcism?"
entries.text: Do you know much about exorcism?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I am a man of God. Of course I know..."
entries.text: I am a man of God. Of course I know how to expel the Devil and all his agents.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "But before you ask me to do one - n..."
entries.text: But before you ask me to do one - not that one would suffice for this forsaken place - they require permission and great effort.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I have never put much stock in the..."
entries.text: I have never put much stock in the former, but I have no time for the latter.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I suggest you find somebody well ou..."
entries.text: I suggest you find somebody well outside the reach of the Irish Catholic Church.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "So, assuming you are on some form o..."
entries.text: So, assuming you are on some form of mission from God, you would need to find another accomplice.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Cigar burns - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I do not smoke. It is a weakness of..."
entries.text: I do not smoke. It is a weakness of character, Mister Ward.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hedonistic Gala - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Were you at the ball last night, Fa..."
entries.text: Were you at the ball last night, Father?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I was. I assume you, too, ingested..."
entries.text: I was. I assume you, too, ingested whatever we were given?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I did, but not knowingly."
entries.text: I did, but not knowingly.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "You may save your confessions. You..."
entries.text: You may save your confessions. You saw then? The pretence was dropped - we saw through this Black Iron Prison and saw reality for the hell it really is!

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Would that they understood what we'..."
entries.text: Would that they understood what we've witnessed, then we could all turn our efforts to freeing ourselves!

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Alas, for them, it was all party ga..."
entries.text: Alas, for them, it was all party games, and so they remain lost.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Trying to talk with Sinnott - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I believe Miss Murphy wished to spe..."
entries.text: I believe Miss Murphy wished to speak with you.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Well. Then she should do so. I am r..."
entries.text: Well. Then she should do so. I am ready to receive her.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "But... I do not think she will ever..."
entries.text: But... I do not think she will ever be ready to come.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Badly Written Note - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this note outside your door..."
entries.text: I found this note outside your door, Father - does it mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I am afraid I cannot make out much..."
entries.text: I am afraid I cannot make out much of it. Hopefully, whoever sent it will follow up by... more comprehensible means...

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hauntings - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I gather this manor is haunted. Hav..."
entries.text: I gather this manor is haunted. Have you seen anything to that effect?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "It does seem to be harder for spiri..."
entries.text: It does seem to be harder for spirits to leave here. I suspect something of greater spiritual magnitude keeps them from leaving.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Deane's Room - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know which room Mi..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Miss Deane? I don't think I have me..."
entries.text: Miss Deane? I don't think I have met her. Certainly, I have no idea where she might be staying.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I have spoken with Mister Doyle."
entries.text: I have spoken with Mister Doyle.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Oh?"
entries.text: Oh?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I know you two were working on some..."
entries.text: I know you two were working on something here at the manor, but he has decided to remove himself from the task.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "He asked me to pass this message on..."
entries.text: He asked me to pass this message on to you.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I see... I suspected as much. I......"
entries.text: I see... I suspected as much. I... knew him, you know. I married his parents and baptised him as a baby.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "He was a good boy, a devout boy. I..."
entries.text: He was a good boy, a devout boy. I asked him to help with... some church business, but I did not know what this place would do to him.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "He is changed. Lost. I see that now..."
entries.text: He is changed. Lost. I see that now and accept I did that to him by sending him here. I understand and respect his need to be free.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Hopefully, he will return in time,..."
entries.text: Hopefully, he will return in time, on his own terms.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "And your task?"
entries.text: And your task?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I will try to carry on alone, I sup..."
entries.text: I will try to carry on alone, I suppose. Humanity will not save itself, and Jesus had no company up on his cross.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "We shall see."
entries.text: We shall see.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Shadowy Figure - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I have seen a large, shadowy figure..."
entries.text: I have seen a large, shadowy figure stalking the grounds - what do you make of this, Father?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Aha! I knew it! There is an Aeon he..."
entries.text: Aha! I knew it! There is an Aeon here. How it got here, I do not know, but I shall find it!

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "*Ahem* You'll have to forgive me, c..."
entries.text: *Ahem* You'll have to forgive me, child. I lost the run of myself for a moment. This place has us all on edge, no?

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Martyr - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your task - have you decided what t..."
entries.text: Your task - have you decided what to do now?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Without Mister Doyle, it will be ha..."
entries.text: Without Mister Doyle, it will be hard, but I shall have to carry on alone.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "He may have succumbed to the Demiur..."
entries.text: He may have succumbed to the Demiurge's tricks but that is all the more reason to push on and free us all, no?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "What choice does one really have?"
entries.text: What choice does one really have?

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/aeons - soinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about Aeons?"
entries.text: What can you tell me about Aeons?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Aeons... The closest thing you like..."
entries.text: Aeons... The closest thing you likely know is an angel. On many levels, they are similar. Beings of creation sent by Monad - God - to build the universe.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gnostic bible- Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I have discovered a Gnostic bible,..."
entries.text: I have discovered a Gnostic bible, Father - would you know what that means?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Did you now...? Gnosticism is a......"
entries.text: Did you now...? Gnosticism is a... an old branch of Christianity. It bears many similarities, but its faithful know, believe they know, the true nature of reality.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "And hope that the knowing of that t..."
entries.text: And hope that the knowing of that truth will allow them to find a way to enter the Kingdom of Heaven - the true Kingdom of Heaven.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Death Certificate - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of this?"
entries.text: What do you make of this?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "What else do you expect me to say,..."
entries.text: What else do you expect me to say, other than somebody has recently died?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "My condolences, et cetera, to Miss..."
entries.text: My condolences, et cetera, to Miss Barbosa.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gnostic research - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I finally think I understand Gnosti..."
entries.text: I finally think I understand Gnosticism, Father.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Perhaps the topmost layer, child, b..."
entries.text: Perhaps the topmost layer, child, but I am happy for you.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Next comes believing it, then the c..."
entries.text: Next comes believing it, then the clarity and freedom that it brings.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "In time, you might find a way out."
entries.text: In time, you might find a way out.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Correspondence - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know Mister Doyle? Outside o..."
entries.text: Do you know Mister Doyle? Outside of this event, this place?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "What an odd question. What makes yo..."
entries.text: What an odd question. What makes you ask that, I wonder? Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "*sigh*"
entries.text: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Seamus was part of my flock. He cam..."
entries.text: Seamus was part of my flock. He came here for work and eventually removed himself from the church.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "And so our correspondence slowed, t..."
entries.text: And so our correspondence slowed, then stopped. It is his life, his choice.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/sinnott sequence - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Father, I found these symbols and w..."
entries.text: Father, I found these symbols and was wondering if you knew what they might mean?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "These are... alchemical symbols. Us..."
entries.text: These are... alchemical symbols. Used - in theory - to unlock the fundamental nature of the universe.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/doyle's lockbox - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There is no way to safely discuss t..."
entries.text: There is no way to safely discuss this with him.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/prison - soinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me about the Black Iron Prison..."
entries.text: Tell me about the Black Iron Prison?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "..."

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "All of this - life - is the Prison...."
entries.text: All of this - life - is the Prison. This realm, filled with material trinkets and lurid flesh, built to distract us from the truth, from enlightenment.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Hell is real, Mister Ward, and we a..."
entries.text: Hell is real, Mister Ward, and we are in it.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/aeon killing sigil - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This sigil, Father, what would you..."
entries.text: This sigil, Father, what would you have me do with it?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Carry on as you are. If you find th..."
entries.text: Carry on as you are. If you find the Aeon, release it. Save us all, child.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Coded Papers - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Father, I was wondering if the patt..."
entries.text: Father, I was wondering if the pattern on this paper means anything to you?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "...No. But I would not toy with its..."
entries.text: ...No. But I would not toy with its creator, my son.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "They are hiding something, certainl..."
entries.text: They are hiding something, certainly. I suggest you don't find out what it is.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Perhaps something there can inform..."
entries.text: Perhaps something there can inform my sermon tomorrow morning. That is in the drawing room at 12pm, should you seek some... absolvement.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "With my mass done, I think I shall..."
entries.text: With my mass done, I think I shall rest a while.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Has anything piqued your interest t..."
entries.text: Has anything piqued your interest this Saturday?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have anything planned this S..."
entries.text: Do you have anything planned this Sunday?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "The Marquess' talk on the manor at..."
entries.text: The Marquess' talk on the manor at 11am seems of interest. Otherwise, I intend to check out the rot.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Rot?"
entries.text: Rot?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Others call it history. It is inevi..."
entries.text: Others call it history. It is inevitable in old houses like this. Bewitching.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I shall spend the day perusing the..."
entries.text: I shall spend the day perusing the grounds. Let us see what story this rot tells.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "And there is the silent dinner at 8..."
entries.text: And there is the silent dinner at 8pm. Perhaps a slightly Pagan tradition but a harmless one - I think I shall attend.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Other than that, I will spend the d..."
entries.text: Other than that, I will spend the day blessing the halls before the séance at 9pm.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "As for Sunday..."
entries.text: As for Sunday...

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Then Mister Coventry is talking abo..."
entries.text: Then Mister Coventry is talking about the region's history, and I plan to be there.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "And there is the silent dinner at 8..."
entries.text: And there is the silent dinner at 8pm. Perhaps a slightly Pagan tradition but a harmless one - I think I shall attend.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Other than that, I think I will res..."
entries.text: Other than that, I think I will rest. Certainly, I intend to be asleep by the time the séance begins.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/catacombs - sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What brought you to the catacombs?"
entries.text: What brought you to the catacombs?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "...I suppose you have me over the p..."
entries.text: ...I suppose you have me over the proverbial barrel. You might think this very strange, Mister Ward, but I am searching for something...

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "An entity called an aeon, though yo..."
entries.text: An entity called an aeon, though you might think of it as an angel of sorts. I believe one resides here on the grounds.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I am hoping these catacombs will le..."
entries.text: I am hoping these catacombs will lead me to it.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/enochian - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about Enochian..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about Enochian magic?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Ah, the supposed language of the an..."
entries.text: Ah, the supposed language of the angels. I've not learned it. Never saw the need. I suspect the angels of creation can speak English just fine.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/catacomb map - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this map of the catacombs u..."
entries.text: I found this map of the catacombs underneath the manor...

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Did you, now? ...might I see it?"
entries.text: Did you, now? ...might I see it?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "It seems self contained. Only two e..."
entries.text: It seems self contained. Only two entrances, both that connect to the greater grounds.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Thank you for showing me this, my c..."
entries.text: Thank you for showing me this, my child.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "No hidden ways out of there. I had..."
entries.text: No hidden ways out of there. I had hoped one path, at least, led to a wider complex...

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/fetters - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Well, typically, they are manacles..."
entries.text: Well, typically, they are manacles used to restrain one around the feet.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you tell me anything about fett..."
entries.text: Can you tell me anything about fetters?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "But given where we are, I suspect y..."
entries.text: But given where we are, I suspect you mean it in the more... esoteric sense.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "In which case, it is a term used to..."
entries.text: In which case, it is a term used to describe what anchors a spirit to a place - or person.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "This manor houses many spectres, mo..."
entries.text: This manor houses many spectres, most likely trapped by the events that led to their death.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Perhaps they are fettered to the bu..."
entries.text: Perhaps they are fettered to the building or land. Perhaps something else keeps them trapped here...

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gauge - sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You've noticed the strange device i..."
entries.text: You've noticed the strange device in the atrium, I assume?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Hmmm... I have seen it."
entries.text: Hmmm... I have seen it.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I am told it tracks our readiness f..."
entries.text: I am told it tracks our readiness for the main event...

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "...but I believe it tracks us."
entries.text: ...but I believe it tracks us.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/reflection - Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you okay, Father?"
entries.text: Are you okay, Father?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "My mission is not complete but my p..."
entries.text: My mission is not complete but my part in it is over.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "What happens next is up to you."
entries.text: What happens next is up to you.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "As for me, I have spent much of my..."
entries.text: As for me, I have spent much of my life fighting the Demiurge's illusions.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Whatever comes after this, trick or..."
entries.text: Whatever comes after this, trick or not, I intend to let myself enjoy it while I can.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Doyle's gnostic bible- Sinnott

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Father, would you know what faith M..."
entries.text: Father, would you know what faith Mister Doyle follows?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "..."

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I am not sure what business it is o..."
entries.text: I am not sure what business it is of yours, child, but no - I do not know what faith guides him.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Not anymore."
entries.text: Not anymore.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Character Presents - Sinnott/Opinion on Blake

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about the Marquess..."
entries.text: Do you know much about the Marquess?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I know... some. Before coming here,..."
entries.text: I know... some. Before coming here, I spoke with my protestant counterpart, Reverend Campbell. Due diligence and all that.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "He mentioned the Marquess has chang..."
entries.text: He mentioned the Marquess has changed in the years since his wife's passing. Not an uncommon thing.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Grief can make a man do strange thi..."
entries.text: Grief can make a man do strange things, and the Marquess largely shut himself off from the world. Once an ardent churchgoer, he rarely attends service now. He also closed off all of his wife's charitable donations.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "And, of course, he has invited many..."
entries.text: And, of course, he has invited many heathens to his land to challenge God's order and allow them to speak with the dead. He's fallen a long way from the man Mary married.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Character Presents - Sinnott/Opinion on Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about Mister Coven..."
entries.text: Do you know much about Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "No - he has a knack for speaking, b..."
entries.text: No - he has a knack for speaking, but saying nothing.

title: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Character Presents - Sinnott/Opinion on O Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Do you know Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Know him, no, but we have talked. I..."

entries.text: Have you talked with Missus D'Arcy?

entries.text: Tell me about yourself, Father.

entries.text: What could you want to know other than I am a priest? Do you want a list of hobbies?

entries.text: Are you the local priest?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "..."

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott

entries.text: I am not. If I were, things would be different here.

entries.text: My parish is in Belmullet. A few days' walk north of here.

entries.text: Did you... walk here?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott

entries.text: I did. If it were a good enough way for the Lord to get around, it would do me, too.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "The task at hand requires dedicatio..."
entries.text: The task at hand requires dedication, persistence, sacrifice, and clarity. The walk here helped me hone my mental fortitude.

entries.text: Have you talked with Mister O'Meara?

entries.text: Endlessly. He is obsessed with angels - or what he takes be be angels, at least. He seems to think I have an interest in spending my days discussing this with him. He is wrong.

entries.text: What do you think of Missus Erickson?

entries.text: But I don't care. If she had been a Sufi, then we could have talked faith for there lies much overlap between how they and I see the world.

entries.text: She was not, so we talked archaeology instead. That seemed to break through the fog I've heard others mention.

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "I hope she finds whatever she is lo..."
entries.text: I hope she finds whatever she is looking for here. It might bring her mind some peace.

entries.text: I don't recognise your vestments, Father - do they represent something of note?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott

entries.text: Forgive my prying, Father, but you look as though you've been through the wars...

entries.text: Hmmm? Ah, my scars. Yes, I was a missionary in my youth. Foolish enough to think I could bring enlightenment to the masses through word instead of deed.

entries.label: Ward: "Anywhere exotic?"
entries.text: Anywhere exotic?

entries.speaker: Father Sinnott
entries.label: FatherSinnott: "Many places, Mister Ward, but do no..."
entries.text: Many places, Mister Ward, but do not be so arrogant as to think it's only the darkest parts of the map that need their eyes opened.

entries.label: FatherSinnott: "It is as hard to save a soul here i..."
entries.text: It is as hard to save a soul here in Ireland as anywhere else. Further away from the dark does not mean closer to the light.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "But this event... well, it does giv..."
entries.text: But this event... well, it does give me awful migraines to try and look at the future of it. And that is troublesome to me.

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "And from that, I think you're alrig..."
entries.text: And from that, I think you're alright, Declan!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "An dá shealleadh? I've never heard..."
entries.text: An dá shealleadh? I've never heard of this...

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "It's a blessing and a curse that ha..."
entries.text: It's a blessing and a curse that has allowed the women in my family insight into that which lies within and without.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So you can see things that other pe..."
entries.text: So you can see things that other people can't?

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "Do you jackeens learn nothing in th..."
entries.text: Do you jackeens learn nothing in that city of yours? The two sights, boy. It's something that's been with me since I can remember.

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "It's more of an innate sense of the..."
entries.text: It's more of an innate sense of the pattern, flow and weaving of Imbas about the place. But it does give me a good schniff of people.

title: Cast/Fiadh Callaghan/Character Presents - Fiadh/Opinion on Dupre

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "I have. He's a good man - and one w..."
entries.text: I have. He's a good man - and one who acknowledges the intricate spirals of life, death and rebirth at that... But I fear he carries a shadow on his anam.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Dupré?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "..."

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "His soul, Declan. Lord almighty..."
entries.text: His soul, Declan. Lord almighty...

title: Cast/Fiadh Callaghan/Character Presents - Fiadh/Opinion on Darcy

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "Head in the sand, that one. Does no..."
entries.text: Head in the sand, that one. Does not want to hear of the dangers of this place, only wants things she thinks readers will enjoy.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of Missus D'Arcy?"
entries.text: What do you make of Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "No use gathering material for a boo..."
entries.text: No use gathering material for a book you may not live to write.

title: Cast/Fiadh Callaghan/Character Presents - Fiadh/Opinion on Father sinnot

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "What need do I have of a priest? I'..."
entries.text: What need do I have of a priest? I'm not dying?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Father Sinnott?"
entries.text: Have you met Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "I'll say only this; some people are..."
entries.text: I'll say only this; some people are so caught up in a world that could be, that they're blind to the world they're already in.

title: Cast/Fiadh Callaghan/Character Presents - Fiadh/Opinion on Cathal

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "Not sure I've ever been in the pres..."
entries.text: Not sure I've ever been in the presence of angels before and I'm still not sure I have been...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What impression do you have of Mist..."
entries.text: What impression do you have of Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "In need of a few slaps but there's..."
entries.text: In need of a few slaps but there's a good lad in there somewhere - I have to wonder about his talk of angels, though.

title: Cast/Fiadh Callaghan/Character Presents - Fiadh/Opinion on Hazel

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "God help whoever she's set her sigh..."
entries.text: God help whoever she's set her sights on, I'd say she has a grip like a vice.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "Hazel Erickson? I wouldn't pay her..."
entries.text: Hazel Erickson? I wouldn't pay her any mind, she's a liar and a fake, through and through.

title: Cast/Fiadh Callaghan/Character Presents - Fiadh/Opinion on Ettiene

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "He's a pleasant man. I also think h..."
entries.text: He's a pleasant man. I also think he has as much faith in our fellow guests as I do, though possibly for different reasons to myself.

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "Good to have another sceptical set..."
entries.text: Good to have another sceptical set of eyes on the whole thing, even still. I think I might like to get to know him a bit better after all this is over.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Toussaint..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Toussaint?

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "...if anything remains after, that..."
entries.text: ...if anything remains after, that is.

title: Cast/Fiadh Callaghan/Character Presents - Fiadh/Opinion on Arwa

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "I don't know if its the pull of thi..."
entries.text: I don't know if its the pull of this place, or something buried away inside it, but she is not of her right mind.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of Miss Hisham?"
entries.text: What do you make of Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "There's something wrong with that g..."
entries.text: There's something wrong with that girl.

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "I see a black cloud around her head..."
entries.text: I see a black cloud around her head. Confusing her. A fog of the mind.

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "Whatever it is, she's liable to tur..."
entries.text: Whatever it is, she's liable to turn at any moment. Do not trust her lightly.

title: Cast/Fiadh Callaghan/Character Presents - Fiadh/Opinion on Ruairí

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "Ah, my own flesh and blood! I've ne..."
entries.text: Ah, my own flesh and blood! I've never had children myself, but Ruairí has been beside me like a shadow since he was small.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about Doctor C..."
entries.text: What can you tell me about Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "I've been training him up. Any day..."
entries.text: I've been training him up. Any day now, he'll be ready to take my place.

title: Cast/Fiadh Callaghan/Character Presents - Fiadh/Opinion on Ines

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "Identity is a complex thing. She wa..."
entries.text: Identity is a complex thing. She walks the line where her soul yearns for something her head can't fathom.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: What do you make of Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Miss Callaghan
entries.label: Fiadh: "Ah, she's got her troubles, but she..."
