entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I do not know much about the old be..."
entries.text: I do not know much about the old beliefs, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Was there a goddess Brigid? I would..."
entries.text: Was there a goddess Brigid? I would recognise it as a Saint's name.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Dead end - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems that, on Tuesday night, Mi..."
entries.text: It seems that, on Tuesday night, Miss Deane didn't actually leave - she wandered out into the hedge maze, and seemed to vanish from there.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "How does a woman just vanish, Miste..."
entries.text: How does a woman just vanish, Mister Ward? You must be mistaken.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "So I would appreciate it if you kep..."
entries.text: So I would appreciate it if you kept theories like that to yourself. You are going to cause alarm.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/catacombs - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you tell me much about the cata..."
entries.text: Can you tell me much about the catacombs under the manor.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Loosely. I've only read of them, de..."
entries.text: Loosely. I've only read of them, despite my efforts to find a way in. They always seemed like it might draw more guests in.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I read a Norman Blake used dynamite..."
entries.text: I read a Norman Blake used dynamite to try to open them up in 1834. He died in the blast. I assume he took the entrance out with him, perhaps the entire structure?

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Front door policy - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is the front door usually kept lock..."
entries.text: Is the front door usually kept locked at night?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Doors are locked at ten at night fo..."
entries.text: Doors are locked at ten at night for guests' peace of mind.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Bridge Game _Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm told there was a bridge game th..."
entries.text: I'm told there was a bridge game the other evening. Did I miss out on much?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Yes. One of the events that was run..."
entries.text: Yes. One of the events that was run for the guests. As Marquess Blake was overseeing it himself, I took the opportunity to meet with the housekeeper and coordinate rotas for the following day. I'm afraid I have little else to tell you as a result.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/stall door - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "You would be best to speak with the..."
entries.text: You would be best to speak with the stable master about stable matters.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/entertainment schedule - varley

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Yes. The week's entertainment. Is t..."
entries.text: Yes. The week's entertainment. Is there a particular time or event you are interested in?

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/cigar burn - varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I see there has been some damage to..."
entries.text: I see there has been some damage to one of your armchairs. A cigar burn?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Damage from one of your colleagues..."
entries.text: Damage from one of your colleagues it appears, Sir. Some people do not consider, or perhaps care about, the cost of such repairs.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "No, Mister Ward. Miss Quinn reporte..."
entries.text: No, Mister Ward. Miss Quinn reported it to me on Tuesday night, after the bridge game. Perhaps she saw the culprit herself, I didn't ask.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You saw it happen?"
entries.text: You saw it happen?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Missus Joyce has done her best but..."
entries.text: Missus Joyce has done her best but I'm afraid we might need to employ the skills of an upholsterer once the event is finished.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/talks - varley

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I am afraid I don't have any other..."
entries.text: I am afraid I don't have any other information on these. You would need to talk with the speakers.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Fixed Telegram - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your telegraph machine seems to be..."
entries.text: Your telegraph machine seems to be functional.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Is that so? Mister Hunter must have..."
entries.text: Is that so? Mister Hunter must have slipped in unnoticed and fixed it.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Then you'll have to excuse me, I ha..."
entries.text: Then you'll have to excuse me, I have messages to send ahead of tomorrow. I will be in the telegraph room should you need me.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "You shouldn't be waiting much longe..."
entries.text: You shouldn't be waiting much longer for your room, I assure you. It will be ready by midnight at the latest.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "A missing door? Ah, you mean the ru..."
entries.text: A missing door? Ah, you mean the rumours.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Yes, it's long been said that Perci..."
entries.text: Yes, it's long been said that Percival Blake walled up a scullery girl after she refused his advances.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "But in the one-hundred-plus years s..."
entries.text: But in the one-hundred-plus years since his passing, no hidden rooms or walled up bodies have been found.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Of course... the missing bodies wer..."
entries.text: Of course... the missing bodies were not found anywhere else either, so nothing can be entirely ruled out...

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Percival Blake was documented as a..."
entries.text: Percival Blake was documented as a jealous and bitterly angry man, so it is possible.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Then the same with her fiancé, who..."
entries.text: Then the same with her fiancé, who came looking for her.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Likely, they fled here for a better..."
entries.text: Likely, they fled here for a better life in the, at that time, newly discovered America.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "There's more information on this an..."
entries.text: There's more information on this and other topics in the library.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The door to Room 15, it's... missin..."
entries.text: The door to Room 15, it's... missing?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Certainly it pre-dates the manor be..."
entries.text: Certainly it pre-dates the manor becoming a hotel, so I suspect it was not our Room 15.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Hedonistic Gala - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't say I was expecting the hot..."
entries.text: I can't say I was expecting the hotel to host such a... a party such as that one.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I understand it's not uncommon for..."
entries.text: I understand it's not uncommon for such circles.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "The Marquess was clear that this ha..."
entries.text: The Marquess was clear that this had to be on par with a London event - at all costs.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Would I find you behind reception o..."
entries.text: Would I find you behind reception over the weekend should I need you?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Either here or in the office, for t..."
entries.text: Either here or in the office, for the most part, in which case ring the bell for my attention. There are a few exceptions...

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I will be covering the bar for Mist..."
entries.text: I will be covering the bar for Mister Doyle at 7pm tomorrow evening, so if you need me at that time, that is where you will find me.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "And naturally, I'll be overseeing t..."
entries.text: And naturally, I'll be overseeing the ball tomorrow evening at 9pm, too.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "The silent dinner is at 8pm. While..."
entries.text: The silent dinner is at 8pm. While the staff will not be in attendance, I will be outside to... prepare you.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I will be covering the bar for Mist..."
entries.text: I will be covering the bar for Mister Doyle at 7pm this evening, so if you need me at that time, that is where you will find me.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "And naturally, I will be overseeing..."
entries.text: And naturally, I will be overseeing the ball at 9pm.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Finally, the séance is at 9pm and I..."
entries.text: Finally, the séance is at 9pm and I shall be present.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Then on Sunday..."
entries.text: Then on Sunday...

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Then tomorrow..."
entries.text: Then tomorrow...

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Finally, the séance is at 9pm - tho..."
entries.text: Finally, the séance is at 9pm - though I will be in the office working.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Unknown Sigil - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've seen a sort of rune around. It..."
entries.text: I've seen a sort of rune around. It's a spiral with four lines intersecting it, one at the top, three below. Does that mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I'm sure I don't know what that cou..."
entries.text: I'm sure I don't know what that could be. I don't think... No, I don't know.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Strange Dreams - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've had the strangest dreams since..."
entries.text: I've had the strangest dreams since coming here. Is that something many people report?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I have heard it said."
entries.text: I have heard it said.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It's not something you experience y..."
entries.text: It's not something you experience yourself?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I have worked here for nearly twent..."
entries.text: I have worked here for nearly twenty years, Mister Ward. I don't often sleep off the grounds, so I could not guess what a normal dream would be for me.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "When one spends so much time in a p..."
entries.text: When one spends so much time in a place, to dream of corridors and doors and windows is sadly quite normal.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Letter to Manager - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I understand you've been trying to..."
entries.text: I understand you've been trying to contact the local bishop about the whereabouts of Miss Murphy's child?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "For all the blasted good it's done...."
entries.text: For all the blasted good it's done...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "STOLEN?"
entries.text: STOLEN?

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Hotel Finances - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I understand the hotel is in some f..."
entries.text: I understand the hotel is in some financial trouble.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "It is a difficult task to keep an o..."
entries.text: It is a difficult task to keep an old house like this in good condition, let alone profitable.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I'm hoping that with your discovery..."
entries.text: I'm hoping that with your discovery, that will now be a thing of the past.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Even the business the Grand Séance..."
entries.text: Even the business the Grand Séance has brought in does not make up for the cost of putting it on in the first place.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/parcel of money - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There was a parcel of Miss Deane's..."
entries.text: There was a parcel of Miss Deane's money among Missus Joyce's belongings.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "In ordinary circumstances, such a t..."
entries.text: In ordinary circumstances, such a thing would be a sackable offence on Missus Joyce's part.

entries.speaker: Varley
entries.label: ...: "STOLEN?"
entries.text: STOLEN?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "How did you-? No, rather, why did y..."
entries.text: How did you-? No, rather, why did you-?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "But I think, considering the situat..."
entries.text: But I think, considering the situation, that would be unfair to her.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "You may give me that, Mister Ward,..."
entries.text: You may give me that, Mister Ward, and I will speak with Missus Joyce.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/crib - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is there a particular reason there'..."
entries.text: Is there a particular reason there's a crib in the cook's office?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Yes. But it's not one I feel it wou..."
entries.text: Yes. But it's not one I feel it would be right to discuss with a relative stranger, Mister Ward... if it's all the same to you.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mysterious Symbol - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've been seeing this symbol around..."
entries.text: I've been seeing this symbol around the place. Does it mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "No, I don't think... No. It doesn't..."
entries.text: No, I don't think... No. It doesn't.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mary Blake - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about Mary Bla..."
entries.text: What can you tell me about Mary Blake?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Marchioness Blake was a kind woman..."
entries.text: Marchioness Blake was a kind woman and a dedicated mother. Her death came as a deeply tragic shock to all of us at the manor.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "The Marquess and his son were natur..."
entries.text: The Marquess and his son were naturally never the same. No doubt that is the reason this séance is taking place, now.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Deane's Room - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Which room was Miss Deane assigned..."
entries.text: Which room was Miss Deane assigned when she was staying here?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "She was in room... Hmmm... It seems..."
entries.text: She was in room... Hmmm... It seems I would need to check my records.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "She... had a southern view, I recal..."
entries.text: She... had a southern view, I recall her complaining about the noise as new guests arrived.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Though why that matters now that sh..."
entries.text: Though why that matters now that she is gone is beyond me.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Broken Telegram - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is the telegraph machine hard to re..."
entries.text: Is the telegraph machine hard to repair?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "You will find, Mister Ward, this ho..."
entries.text: You will find, Mister Ward, this house is filled with the brilliant and often eccentric contraptions of our age.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "The Blakes have a long history of i..."
entries.text: The Blakes have a long history of invention, innovation, and, sometimes, aimless tinkering.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Much to my frustration, the working..."
entries.text: Much to my frustration, the workings of this particular device make little sense. It's powered by a battery, of sorts, I believe, but how one makes it work is beyond me.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You mentioned the telegraph machine..."
entries.text: You mentioned the telegraph machine is down?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "It is. Likely, the storm shorted th..."
entries.text: It is. Likely, the storm shorted the battery.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Terrible timing. I tried to wire up..."
entries.text: Terrible timing. I tried to wire up the replacement, but have had no luck.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I'll have the groundsman look in th..."
entries.text: I'll have the groundsman look in the morning.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Shadowy Figure - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Varley, have you ever had re..."
entries.text: Mister Varley, have you ever had reports of, well, ghosts of giants on the lands?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Reports? No. All those things - gho..."
entries.text: Reports? No. All those things - ghouls and giants - have entertaining sections in the library. Maybe there would be something of use to you there?

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/12 Luggage Ticket - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you give out tickets for the lug..."
entries.text: Do you give out tickets for the luggage room, Mister Varley?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "We do, Mister Ward."
entries.text: We do, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Would you know who owns the ticket..."
entries.text: Would you know who owns the ticket for bay 12? I, ah, found a ticket on the floor and was hoping to track down the owner.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Ah, I see. It belongs to Miss Deane..."
entries.text: Ah, I see. It belongs to Miss Deane, but unfortunately, her bags are already gone.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mysterious Object - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Someone seems to have put a strange..."
entries.text: Someone seems to have put a strange object inside the luggage room vent.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "...Did they? Well, I'm sure they ha..."
entries.text: ...Did they? Well, I'm sure they had good reason for it, although I can't imagine what it might be.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Thank you for bringing it to my att..."
entries.text: Thank you for bringing it to my attention. The groundsman will have the tools to deal with this, I'm sure.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Miss Deane's Invitation - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is it true that Miss Deane was spec..."
entries.text: Is it true that Miss Deane was specially invited to the manor?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "If she was, I was not informed. Reg..."
entries.text: If she was, I was not informed. Regardless, we're not liable to discuss that information with guests, Mister Ward.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Treasure Map - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does this mean anything to you, Mis..."
entries.text: Does this mean anything to you, Mister Varley?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "...It's certainly a riddle, Mister..."
entries.text: ...It's certainly a riddle, Mister Ward. Hardly my domain.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I see mention of the garden, howeve..."
entries.text: I see mention of the garden, however. You might ask our groundskeeper.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Chimney Charm - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this on the grounds. What d..."
entries.text: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Ah. My apologies Mister Ward, with..."
entries.text: Ah. My apologies Mister Ward, with all the activities, the cleaning schedule hasn't been as regular as usual.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I couldn't say what it is. It looks..."
entries.text: I couldn't say what it is. It looks like a figurine of some sort made out of sticks and horsehair - perhaps a toy Mister Hunter made for Master Walter?

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Witchcraft components - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of these? They loo..."
entries.text: What do you make of these? They look like they might be components for a ritual or charm of some sort.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I don't know anything about either..."
entries.text: I don't know anything about either of those things, Sir, but it seems like something the, eh, pagans might know about?

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Arwa's Melody - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I would say that you're free to use..."
entries.text: I would say that you're free to use the piano in the drawing room, but it was moved last week - out of tune as it was.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Our finest piano is in storage but..."
entries.text: Our finest piano is in storage but the Marquess refuses to move it upstairs.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Hisham told me about this melo..."
entries.text: Miss Hisham told me about this melody she's heard...

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Lady Wilhelmina - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "...Yes, the centre of one of the od..."
entries.text: ...Yes, the centre of one of the odder occurrences from Blake Manor.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I'm told she had a sudden and drast..."
entries.text: I'm told she had a sudden and drastic change of character. One day, she was content with her life here. The next she was ordering a carriage to Gauford, taking just a small suitcase.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "She never returned or sent for any..."
entries.text: She never returned or sent for any of her belongings. They're all still down in the basement.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It's a spectacular portrait you hav..."
entries.text: It's a spectacular portrait you have of Wilhelmina Blake in the atrium.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance contract - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'd imagine Miss Mantovani is being..."
entries.text: I'd imagine Miss Mantovani is being paid quite handsomely for this event... am I right?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "There are more people claiming to b..."
entries.text: There are more people claiming to be accomplished mediums than you might think...

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "But Mister Blake absolutely insiste..."
entries.text: But Mister Blake absolutely insisted that the Grand Séance be manned by the best of the best.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "And it does so happen that the best..."
entries.text: And it does so happen that the best of the best require paying for their skill.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Saint Brigid's Cross - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There are some beautiful Saint Brig..."
entries.text: There are some beautiful Saint Brigid's crosses about the place.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Yes. Missus Joyce has kindly been p..."
entries.text: Yes. Missus Joyce has kindly been putting them up for us.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Telegram Discs - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Am I right in thinking that these a..."
entries.text: Am I right in thinking that these are components for the telegraph machine?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "You are, but I'd ask you to put the..."
entries.text: You are, but I'd ask you to put them back where you left them, for when I get Mister Hunter to look at it.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Water - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I hope you don't mind, but I helped..."
entries.text: I hope you don't mind, but I helped myself to the water that was by the fire.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Not at all; it is there for the gue..."
entries.text: Not at all; it is there for the guests' convenience.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Letter of complaint - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever received complaints a..."
entries.text: Have you ever received complaints about Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "She occasionally inspires some ire...."
entries.text: She occasionally inspires some ire... But she's a good woman and works hard.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "While I would prefer she keep to he..."
entries.text: While I would prefer she keep to herself more, at present, I have no cause to dismiss her.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/vase drawing - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Hmmm, I believe Miss Hisham was dra..."
entries.text: Hmmm, I believe Miss Hisham was drawing this, or something like it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "It looks similar to the vase Wilhel..."
entries.text: It looks similar to the vase Wilhelmina Blake holds in her portrait in the atrium.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I have no idea, Sir. I've never see..."
entries.text: I have no idea, Sir. I've never seen the actual thing. Likely it is lost.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Where is that vase now?"
entries.text: Where is that vase now?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley

entries.label: Varley: "Yes, well, we provide a laundry ser..."
entries.text: Yes, well, we provide a laundry service, should he wish to avail of it.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Tense body language - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Erickson seems to be on edge..."
entries.text: Missus Erickson seems to be on edge.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Perhaps the lady might benefit from..."
entries.text: Perhaps the lady might benefit from a visit to the bathhouse, or a drink.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I noticed a Miss Deane's name signi..."
entries.text: I noticed a Miss Deane's name signing in, does that happen to be Evelyn Deane?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "...It is. Rather, it was. I'm afrai..."
entries.text: ...It is. Rather, it was. I'm afraid she's not staying with us any longer.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Were you hoping to meet her?"
entries.text: Were you hoping to meet her?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I see you are busy for somewhere so..."
entries.text: I see you are busy for somewhere so remote. Though it seems quiet around here.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "The séance has brought a great many..."
entries.text: The séance has brought a great many visitors, it's true. Most have retired early to be ready for the weekend ahead.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I was. She's left already?"
entries.text: I was. She's left already?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Can I help with anything else?"
entries.text: Can I help with anything else?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Ah yes. The séance."
entries.text: Ah yes. The séance.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Indeed. The, eh, séance..."
entries.text: Indeed. The, eh, séance...

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "She has, yes."
entries.text: She has, yes.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of chapter one

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Your room is ready."
entries.text: Your room is ready.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "If you'd care to follow me..."
entries.text: If you'd care to follow me...

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Mister Doyle has taken your luggage..."
entries.text: Mister Doyle has taken your luggage ahead.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Mister Ward?"
entries.text: Mister Ward?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "The porter shall meet us there."
entries.text: The porter shall meet us there.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Taking you to your room

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Right this way, Sir."
entries.text: Right this way, Sir.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "If you head up the stairs, the port..."
entries.text: If you head up the stairs, the porter will show you to your room.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I can't believe it. I'd hoped it re..."
entries.text: I can't believe it. I'd hoped it really existed, of course, but...

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I owe you a great debt, Mister Ward..."
entries.text: I owe you a great debt, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I wouldn't want to put another on y..."
entries.text: I wouldn't want to put another on you, I think you've already had your fair share.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I believe you've been given the ble..."
entries.text: I believe you've been given the blessings of the woman who hid the money, too. I think now you just need to put it to good use.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I most certainly will. Thank you. S..."
entries.text: I most certainly will. Thank you. Sincerely.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "And Mister Varley?"
entries.text: And Mister Varley?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Sir?"
entries.text: Sir?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Never risk another guest's life. No..."
entries.text: Never risk another guest's life. Not for any reason. I will find out, and I will have this place shut down.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "...Understood."
entries.text: ...Understood.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/Ward in room - Varley

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Mr. Ward, this is a private office...."
entries.text: Mr. Ward, this is a private office. I must ask you to leave.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "I don't recall inviting you here Mr..."
entries.text: I don't recall inviting you here Mr Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Mister Ward! Guests are not permitt..."
entries.text: Mister Ward! Guests are not permitted in the manager's office. Kindly remove yourself.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Mister Ward, this is still my priva..."
entries.text: Mister Ward, this is still my private quarters. I would kindly ask you not to enter this room.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/come to the office quest dialogue

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Varley, it appears you were..."
entries.text: Mister Varley, it appears you were right about that lost... cache.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Hmmm. Let's discuss this further in..."
entries.text: Hmmm. Let's discuss this further in my office.

title: Cast/Vincent Varley/after quest dialogue

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "Now, if you would excuse me. I have..."
entries.text: Now, if you would excuse me. I have plans to make. Perhaps I'd best work while the séance happens, to take advantage of the Marquess being distracted. Everything should be in order already, anyway.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, hello there! I don't recognis..."
entries.text: Well, hello there! I don't recognise you... We haven't met before, have we?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "We haven't. I'm Declan Ward, Miss....."
entries.text: We haven't. I'm Declan Ward, Miss...?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Missus. Missus Erickson. Hazel, if..."
entries.text: Missus. Missus Erickson. Hazel, if ever we should get so friendly.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "And who are you, then? Are you new..."
entries.text: And who are you, then? Are you new blood?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I suppose I am. Declan Ward, Missus..."
entries.text: I suppose I am. Declan Ward, Missus Erickson, at your service.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Very pleased to meet you, Mister Wa..."
entries.text: Very pleased to meet you, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Mister Ward. What troubles you?"
entries.text: Mister Ward. What troubles you?

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I won't bother you anymore, Missus..."
entries.text: I won't bother you anymore, Missus Erickson.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Goodbye, now."
entries.text: Goodbye, now.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I... how could you possibly..."
entries.text: I... how could you possibly...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Can you... read minds? Or did you l..."
entries.text: Can you... read minds? Or did you let yourself into my room to rifle through my belongings?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, I won't. I'll have my heart,..."
entries.text: Well, I won't. I'll have my heart, my powers, my soul, and all you'll get by saying something is a nasty dealing with when I have them.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Bad news for both of us, then. You..."
entries.text: Bad news for both of us, then. You can't say anything without giving yourself up as a thief. And who would believe you?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Whatever it is, you're no mystic, s..."
entries.text: Whatever it is, you're no mystic, so there is no way you can understand. To know such secrets exist, such wonders to see.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "And to be kept from it by some... a..."
entries.text: And to be kept from it by some... abnormality! What's the reason? I've put the work in, and nothing! Am I a soulless freak? Is that why?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Am I to be punished in this life an..."
entries.text: Am I to be punished in this life and then again for eternity? Would you sit by and do nothing?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Stay out of this, Mister Ward, if y..."
entries.text: Stay out of this, Mister Ward, if you have any sense.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I'm a medium by trade, so naturally..."
entries.text: I'm a medium by trade, so naturally I had to come to this gathering. I'm hoping to pick up some new skills before the end.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Again? What else could you possibly..."
entries.text: Again? What else could you possibly want with me?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Mister Ward - surely we have nothin..."
entries.text: Mister Ward - surely we have nothing left to discuss?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/OnQuestCompleted

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Now. I would really like to be left..."
entries.text: Now. I would really like to be left alone. I have a lot to think about.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hiring telegram - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "What's this?"
entries.text: What's this?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I'm sorry, do you mean to tell me a..."
entries.text: I'm sorry, do you mean to tell me a woman has gone missing at this thing?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Then what are we all doing here? Do..."
entries.text: Then what are we all doing here? Doesn't anyone care?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Money - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Come on, now, Mister Ward. What rea..."
entries.text: Come on, now, Mister Ward. What reason have you to give me that?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Photograph of Deane - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this woman?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this woman?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "That's... I know her face, let's se..."
entries.text: That's... I know her face, let's see...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Annabelle... No, Evelyn. Evelyn Dea..."
entries.text: Annabelle... No, Evelyn. Evelyn Deane, isn't it? I think we've met, though I don't know her well.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Bottle of alcohol - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I've no need just now, Mister Ward,..."
entries.text: I've no need just now, Mister Ward, but thank you.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Since you are versed in the subject..."
entries.text: Since you are versed in the subject - can you explain what makes this séance different to any others?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Of course! Traditionally, a séance..."
entries.text: Of course! Traditionally, a séance has a host, a medium. That medium acts as a vessel for the spirits to commune through.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "What brings her to the Grand Séance..."
entries.text: What brings her to the Grand Séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Most of the people I've met here se..."
entries.text: Most of the people I've met here seem to have a particular interest in the supernatural. Would you be one of them?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Ah-hah! I do. My poison is Spiritua..."
entries.text: Ah-hah! I do. My poison is Spiritualism, Sir. Communing with the dead. Humanity has always been fascinated with the whole idea of what lies beyond death.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "But there are some lucky few of us,..."
entries.text: But there are some lucky few of us, with the right gifts and mentorship, that mean it is not impossible, as people would have you think. Not at all.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It's said it will have more reach t..."
entries.text: It's said it will have more reach than one magician could ever dream of. And so, perhaps, more answers. Or so we hope.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I do love events like this... to be..."
entries.text: I do love events like this... to be among like-minded company. Do keep an open mind, won't you?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "But... so often that only provides..."
entries.text: But... so often that only provides more questions. And this séance promises to be quite the landmark in the field!

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "Is she here for the Séance?"
entries.text: Is she here for the Séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you attending the Séance?"
entries.text: Are you attending the Séance?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "How could I not be? I wouldn't take..."
entries.text: How could I not be? I wouldn't take myself to the middle of nowhere for just anything.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "And the Séance! I've been looking f..."
entries.text: And the Séance! I've been looking forward to this for weeks. What an event!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I've been to many a séance before,..."
entries.text: I've been to many a séance before, of course, but not one hosted by Miss Mantovani. And I hear there are some other interesting people here, too.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "So yes, I'm here for the Séance. Ho..."
entries.text: So yes, I'm here for the Séance. How could I miss a thing like that?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems this event is a lot more w..."
entries.text: It seems this event is a lot more welcoming than some other social events.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Not to put too fine a point on it....."
entries.text: Not to put too fine a point on it... But the headline act wouldn't even be here if this were one of those 'Gentlemen's' events. Imagine!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Guests ask the ghost, and it commun..."
entries.text: Guests ask the ghost, and it communicates back through the medium - hence the name.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Here, Miss Mantovani intends to try..."
entries.text: Here, Miss Mantovani intends to try a new technique that will allow us to talk to the ghost - and they to us - directly.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "This is notable as it would remove..."
entries.text: This is notable as it would remove any doubt from sceptics and so, could provide answers to some of the fundamental existential questions we humans have!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ines' telegram - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "This isn't for me, Mister Ward. Per..."
entries.text: This isn't for me, Mister Ward. Perhaps you should give it to the woman it's meant for.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Varley's statement - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "According to Mister Varley, Miss De..."
entries.text: According to Mister Varley, Miss Deane left the event suddenly last Tuesday night.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Is that so? I'd be put-out, if I we..."
entries.text: Is that so? I'd be put-out, if I were a friend of hers...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I suppose, perhaps, she had some so..."
entries.text: I suppose, perhaps, she had some sort of family emergency...? Who's to say, really...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hauntings - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A few of the guests seem to believe..."
entries.text: A few of the guests seem to believe this manor is haunted. Have you seen anything for yourself?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Mister Ward - we would not be here..."
entries.text: Mister Ward - we would not be here if it were not haunted!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I, of course, have seen all manner..."
entries.text: I, of course, have seen all manner of ghosts since coming here. I am sure you will soon, too. Don't worry, Mister Ward, they will make themselves known to you!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "You know that I haven't, that I can..."
entries.text: You know that I haven't, that I cannot.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Séance's Purpose - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you suppose the séance will be s..."
entries.text: Do you suppose the séance will be successful?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "In getting answers from someone sin..."
entries.text: In getting answers from someone since passed? I hope so, or what's it all for?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Leaving letter - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Deane left a letter, it turns..."
entries.text: Miss Deane left a letter, it turns out, as her way of leaving.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It's very abrupt... I suppose she h..."
entries.text: It's very abrupt... I suppose she had something to see to.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Soiled telegram - Ines

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Ah, this isn't for me. ...And thank..."
entries.text: Ah, this isn't for me. ...And thankfully so, the state it's in.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Who is it for? ...Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Who is it for? ...Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I would give it to her, then."
entries.text: I would give it to her, then.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Freemasons - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know anything abou..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about the Freemasons, Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "No, which is exactly how they like..."
entries.text: No, which is exactly how they like it.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I have nothing against a little sec..."
entries.text: I have nothing against a little secrecy in these matters... but to only accept men in their ranks? Ugh...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Second Sight - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you know anything a..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you know anything about this tradition of the Second Sight?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Ah, one of the guests is supposed t..."
entries.text: Ah, one of the guests is supposed to possess it. What's her name, the Scottish girl?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Miss McLeod, I think. I've heard he..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod, I think. I've heard her name in London, though I understand she doesn't perform. Quite the gift, if what they say is true.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ritual markings - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There seems to be evidence of a rit..."
entries.text: There seems to be evidence of a ritual upstairs.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Upstairs? Why come all this way to..."
entries.text: Upstairs? Why come all this way to an event like this, then hide away?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Skeleton key - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Why the- why the Hell do you have t..."
entries.text: Why the- why the Hell do you have that?!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Strange occurences - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, I..."
entries.text: Well, I...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've had a few... strange things ha..."
entries.text: I've had a few... strange things happen around me in this house. I don't suppose you've noticed anything of the sort?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Sometimes I see the windows fogging..."
entries.text: Sometimes I see the windows fogging up, but only in the one place, as if someone's breathing on them from the other side.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "There's never anyone there."
entries.text: There's never anyone there.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Mister Doyle's statement - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Doyle tells me he overheard..."
entries.text: Mister Doyle tells me he overheard an argument Miss Deane had with someone.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "There is usually an argument over s..."
entries.text: There is usually an argument over something or other at these things...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I wouldn't say it's necessarily a c..."
entries.text: I wouldn't say it's necessarily a cause for concern.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Mysterious figure - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Coming back from the gardens, I cou..."
entries.text: Coming back from the gardens, I could have sworn I saw a figure in the window. I was wondering if you'd seen him too?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I think so. A child of the family,..."
entries.text: I think so. A child of the family, perhaps?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Tuatha Dé Danann -Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know anything abou..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about the Tuatha Dé Danann, Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I do indeed. They were the old gods..."
entries.text: I do indeed. They were the old gods of Ireland, thought once to live in the country itself.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Although these days, it's said, the..."
entries.text: Although these days, it's said, they're no longer walking this place, and are instead in their "other" world.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "And it seems, at that, they have be..."
entries.text: And it seems, at that, they have been forgotten.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Dead End - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems that, when Miss Deane left..."
entries.text: It seems that, when Miss Deane left on Tuesday, she simply walked into the hedge maze... and after that, there's no sign of her.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "But that... that doesn't make any s..."
entries.text: But that... that doesn't make any sense! How can that be so?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I hope she's alright, wherever she..."
entries.text: I hope she's alright, wherever she is...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hermetic Order - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about the Herm..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn, Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Do I! I would sure hope so."
entries.text: Do I! I would sure hope so.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Let's see, what can I tell you... W..."
entries.text: Let's see, what can I tell you... We're a society of those interested in magic, especially the divine - what you'll hear called high magic.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Right now, the Egyptian style is in..."
entries.text: Right now, the Egyptian style is in fashion.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "The society is based in London. You..."
entries.text: The society is based in London. You should see about it, you know, if ever you find yourself over there.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Bridge Game - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Were you at the bridge game on Tues..."
entries.text: Were you at the bridge game on Tuesday?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "No. My parents were obsessed with t..."
entries.text: No. My parents were obsessed with the game, so, naturally, I grew to despise it.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Entertainment schedule - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I understand there's quite the numb..."
entries.text: I understand there's quite the number of events planned for the week.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "None of them are half as exciting a..."
entries.text: None of them are half as exciting as an actual séance, but I suppose they haven't been half bad, considering.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Nothing on that list is half as exc..."
entries.text: Nothing on that list is half as exciting as an actual séance, but I suppose they had to kill the time until tomorrow evening somehow.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I sense there is a particular event..."
entries.text: I sense there is a particular event, a time, that you are interested perhaps?

entries.text: Missus Joyce, it seems, has an interest in the gossip columns.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson

entries.text: Not just the gossip columns, but a certain someone...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson

entries.text: Mister Ward, do you disguise your true intentions out of distrust, or for the sheer thrill?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "You could have said! Surely, you do..."
entries.text: You could have said! Surely, you don't think I did anything to hurt Miss Deane? I have no cause to at all. That poor girl.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Telegram draft - Hazel

entries.text: It seems Missus Joyce had the mind to send for a detective on Miss Deane's behalf.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I suppose something really has happ..."
entries.text: I suppose something really has happened to Miss Deane, then? She hasn't just fled in some flight of fancy?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, I hope she's alright. But, he..."
entries.text: Well, I hope she's alright. But, here... Missus Joyce addressed it to a Detective Ward?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Why, is that you? Why the runaround..."
entries.text: Why, is that you? Why the runaround, my good man? You could have said.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Locked doors - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems all the guest rooms are ke..."
entries.text: It seems all the guest rooms are kept locked.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well... yes. But what on earth poss..."
entries.text: Well... yes. But what on earth possessed you to check? Have you no shame at all?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Written complaint - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems the housekeeper has upset..."
entries.text: It seems the housekeeper has upset some people with her prying...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Someone finally said something abou..."
entries.text: Someone finally said something about it? Thank God!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Talks schedule - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you think you'll attend any of t..."
entries.text: Do you think you'll attend any of these talks that are being put on?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I expect so. Not the historical one..."
entries.text: I expect so. Not the historical ones, I have no head for that. But the ones about magic, I will indeed be making time for.

entries.text: What will you do after this?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "If you must discuss it... Now that..."
entries.text: If you must discuss it... Now that I know I am forever doomed, I think I am done with this life.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I will return to New York and my hu..."
entries.text: I will return to New York and my husband and try to find some way to enjoy this joyless experience.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "He will be happy, I am sure. It wil..."
entries.text: He will be happy, I am sure. It will free some storage space for his golf trophies.
