title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well! I do think I shall be spendin..."
entries.text: Well! I do think I shall be spending my afternoon in the Drawing Room.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Such an opportunity to commune with..."
entries.text: Such an opportunity to commune with our fellows, don’t you think? Between the talks.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "If you ask me, though, Miss Mantova..."
entries.text: If you ask me, though, Miss Mantovani’s talk at five is the only one worth attending - and so will be the only one I do attend!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I’m entirely skipping the one at th..."
entries.text: I’m entirely skipping the one at three by… I've already forgotten what it is. I think I’ll take an afternoon nap then, instead.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, well, who can be bothered with..."
entries.text: Oh, well, who can be bothered with plans when we’re conducting a séance this evening, Mister Ward? But yes...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "...I suppose I’ll be in church at e..."
entries.text: ...I suppose I’ll be in church at eleven and lunch at one. The Doctor's talk at three might be a tad silly but... he's easy on the eye and I love the Irish accent!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Otherwise… I’ll waste the day in th..."
entries.text: Otherwise… I’ll waste the day in the gardens and maze, I think, calming my nerves before the big event.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I hear that’s where they’re holding..."
entries.text: I hear that’s where they’re holding it, you know? The séance. I can hardly wait!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have any plans for the weeke..."
entries.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have any plans for today?"
entries.text: Do you have any plans for today?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I want to get some rest in before t..."
entries.text: I want to get some rest in before the ball later!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "And as for Sunday? Ah yes..."
entries.text: And as for Sunday? Ah yes...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I don't think I'd have another talk..."
entries.text: I don't think I'd have another talk in me after that, so I'll nap at 5, instead.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I'll be in my room at 9pm, too, whe..."
entries.text: I'll be in my room at 9pm, too, when the séance takes place. I'm done with all that.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Faith - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There are quite the number of faith..."
entries.text: There are quite the number of faiths practised among the guests, it seems.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, I’m sure. All are welcome, it s..."
entries.text: Oh, I’m sure. All are welcome, it seems, so long as they believe in ghosts.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Catholic Faith - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about Catholicism?"
entries.text: What do you know about Catholicism?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "That is not a question I expected t..."
entries.text: That is not a question I expected to be asked by an Irishman, Mister Ward!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Where I am from, a great many of th..."
entries.text: Where I am from, a great many of the people who call themselves Catholic are Irish.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Besides, I don’t believe I’ll give..."
entries.text: Besides, I don’t believe I’ll give you any sort of decent answer. The details of religion are not my forté.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Protestant Faith - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know, Missus Erickson,..."
entries.text: What do you know, Missus Erickson, about Protestantism?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I know it’s hard to speak on the to..."
entries.text: I know it’s hard to speak on the topic as a whole.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "There are so many denominations und..."
entries.text: There are so many denominations under that label, I would hardly know where to start!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ettiene's Influence - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I’ve gathered that Mister Toussaint..."
entries.text: I’ve gathered that Mister Toussaint is quite influential in these circles.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "He’s published several papers on th..."
entries.text: He’s published several papers on the mechanisms charlatans use to ply their trade and taken down a number of very successful people in the process.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "He is, I think, admired for it."
entries.text: He is, I think, admired for it.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Strange Dreams - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I had such a strange dream the nigh..."
entries.text: I had such a strange dream the night I got here. I was trapped in a corridor somewhere in the manor. Have you experienced similar?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh well... of course, I have... But..."
entries.text: Oh well... of course, I have... But I... could not discuss something so... personal. I'm sorry. When you are as deeply attuned as I am, these things take their toll.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sylized ring - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does this look familiar to you, Mis..."
entries.text: Does this look familiar to you, Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, of course. It's the symbol of..."
entries.text: Well, of course. It's the symbol of the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn. But you are not a member, so whose is it, Sir?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That is what I am trying to ascerta..."
entries.text: That is what I am trying to ascertain. Is there any way to tell the owner from the item itself?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, they are not stamped if that'..."
entries.text: Well, they are not stamped if that's what you mean? The crest is stylised, perhaps you can use that to find the owner?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I don't know much about these thing..."
entries.text: I don't know much about these things. I like to wear jewellery, Mister Ward, not make it.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Grand Séance - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of the goals of th..."
entries.text: What do you make of the goals of this séance?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "What do I make of it? Why, Mister W..."
entries.text: What do I make of it? Why, Mister Ward, I can hardly contain myself!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "The secrets to the universe are mer..."
entries.text: The secrets to the universe are mere hours away from us!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hedonistic Gala - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't say I was expecting a ball..."
entries.text: I can't say I was expecting a ball of that sort.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, these people, they're not all s..."
entries.text: Oh, these people, they're not all so dour as they let on, are they? But what a surprising way for you to find out!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "The drugs had an impact on me, of c..."
entries.text: The drugs had an impact on me, of course, but I presume it was stronger, stranger in this place, at this time of year for anyone who can... see what I cannot.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Such parties are less unusual than..."
entries.text: Such parties are less unusual than you might imagine. There's quite a number in London and New York... but they are always some sort of surprise.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've been seeing this symbol about..."
entries.text: I've been seeing this symbol about the place. I made a sketch. Does it mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I don't believe this is anything fr..."
entries.text: I don't believe this is anything from my traditions. Why don't you ask one of these Irishmen?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Unknown Sigil - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've been seeing this sigil - a spi..."
entries.text: I've been seeing this sigil - a spiral with four lines intersecting it. Would you happen to know what it is?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Some sort of folk magic? I don't kn..."
entries.text: Some sort of folk magic? I don't know.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Deane's Room - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know which room Miss Deane w..."
entries.text: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "No. I've been trying to find her fo..."
entries.text: No. I've been trying to find her for a few days. She's a slippery one. If you find her or her room, do let me know...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hazel's notes from her room

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't think it's wise to discuss..."
entries.text: I don't think it's wise to discuss this.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian magic

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about Enochian mag..."
entries.text: What do you know about Enochian magic?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, it's not my area of expertise..."
entries.text: Well, it's not my area of expertise by any means, but I just refuse to disappoint.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It's a method of communing with ang..."
entries.text: It's a method of communing with angels. Invented in, oh, 15-something or other.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It mostly involves summoning angels..."
entries.text: It mostly involves summoning angels or the like through ritual. I believe we have an expert among us, as it happens, in the form of Mister O'Meara.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "That's what they say. I've heard he..."
entries.text: That's what they say. I've heard he gets up to all that danger just to speak with his angel again. What a romantic idea.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I haven't asked him if that's true..."
entries.text: I haven't asked him if that's true myself, yet, but that's the word about it. He's quite the thrill-seeker, whatever the reason, I know that.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is it true that Mr O'Meara gets up..."
entries.text: Is it true that Mr O'Meara gets up to dangerous pastimes?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Confession

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Surely you can't actually mean to k..."
entries.text: Surely you can't actually mean to kill-

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Lower your voice, and say nothing m..."
entries.text: Lower your voice, and say nothing more about it, do you hear me?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian Magic - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about Enochian mag..."
entries.text: What do you know about Enochian magic?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, it's not my area of expertise..."
entries.text: Well, it's not my area of expertise by any means, but I just refuse to disappoint.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It's a method of communing with ang..."
entries.text: It's a method of communing with angels. Invented - or, discovered, I guess - in, oh, 15-something or other.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It mostly involves summoning angels..."
entries.text: It mostly involves summoning angels or the like through ritual. I believe we have an expert among us, as it happens, in the form of Mister O'Meara.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I've heard he gets up to all that d..."
entries.text: I've heard he gets up to all that danger just to speak with his angel again. What a romantic idea.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I haven't asked him if that's true..."
entries.text: I haven't asked him if that's true myself, yet, but that's the word about it. He's quite the thrill-seeker, whatever the reason, I know that.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Investigating Hazel's room - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't think it's wise to discuss..."
entries.text: I don't think it's wise to discuss this.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Eavesdropping on O'Finn -Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Studying the crash site?"
entries.text: Studying the crash site?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Hmmm? Oh yes! The poor bird."
entries.text: Hmmm? Oh yes! The poor bird.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "As was mentioned, it is an omen. I..."
entries.text: As was mentioned, it is an omen. I thought perhaps it was best to see if anything could be learned in what remained of the incident.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Sadly the staff beat me to it, so t..."
entries.text: Sadly the staff beat me to it, so there is not much to be seen here, I am afraid!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Suspicious lockbox - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I heard the staff mention you had a..."
entries.text: I heard the staff mention you had a lockbox brought with you. It must be important to have brought a thing like that so far.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh. Well, you know. There are secre..."
entries.text: Oh. Well, you know. There are secret... documents to be kept safe.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "What is it to you, anyway?"
entries.text: What is it to you, anyway?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Talk down Hazel - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Please, Missus Erickson, I beg you..."
entries.text: Please, Missus Erickson, I beg you to come to your senses.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Stay out of this, Mister Ward, it d..."
entries.text: Stay out of this, Mister Ward, it does not concern you.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Stay out of this, Mister Ward, it d..."
entries.text: Stay out of this, Mister Ward, it does not concern you.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Burnt paper - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've heard it said that some people..."
entries.text: I've heard it said that some people are simply devoid of magic. Have you heard of such a thing?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Pariahs... Yes, I have... heard of..."
entries.text: Pariahs... Yes, I have... heard of this. People for whom no amount of training will open the third eye.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It's dreadful. Unfair, even. What d..."
entries.text: It's dreadful. Unfair, even. What did they do to be cursed so?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ritual pages - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you think there could be a ritua..."
entries.text: Do you think there could be a ritual that would allow a person to steal magic from another practitioner?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "How could you...?"
entries.text: How could you...?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "...No, of course not."
entries.text: ...No, of course not.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I wouldn't know, Mister Ward. I com..."
entries.text: I wouldn't know, Mister Ward. I communicate with ghosts. I would have no business with such rituals.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/List of names - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There's quite the turnout at this e..."
entries.text: There's quite the turnout at this event. Any number of people skilled in the magical arts...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are there any you would recommend t..."
entries.text: Are there any you would recommend talking with, people who's skill you particularly admire?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh well. Miss Mantovani, of course...."
entries.text: Oh well. Miss Mantovani, of course. But she is so busy, she is hard to talk to.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Miss Deane is also a skilled practi..."
entries.text: Miss Deane is also a skilled practitioner, though I have not seen her in a few days.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So Miss Deane was one of these peop..."
entries.text: So Miss Deane was one of these people who believed they could use magic?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Perhaps you should talk with the Ca..."
entries.text: Perhaps you should talk with the Callaghans?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Or, of course, me!"
entries.text: Or, of course, me!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What would you make of these cards..."
entries.text: What would you make of these cards as a reading? 'The Hanged Man', the 'Ten of Pentacles', and the 'Death' cards.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, that depends - who is the rea..."
entries.text: Well, that depends - who is the reading for and what is their question? You?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It is not for me. It is for Mister..."
entries.text: It is not for me. It is for Mister Skerritt.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Ah! Well, in that case - the Hanged..."
entries.text: Ah! Well, in that case - the Hanged Man and Death could be an awareness of being in his final years.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "With the Ten of Pentacles relating..."
entries.text: With the Ten of Pentacles relating to what he'll leave behind. It is not reversed, so it suggests he will leave something behind, something of worth.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "But that is in his future, or a pos..."
entries.text: But that is in his future, or a possible future. If he were in front of me, I would tell him he needs to make a change or sacrifice to reach this outcome.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What kind of sacrifice?"
entries.text: What kind of sacrifice?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I'm not certain. An acknowledgement..."
entries.text: I'm not certain. An acknowledgement of sin, an end to indulgence, or the taking of a life. I am sure he would know which...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "...Although, knowing him, it's almo..."
entries.text: ...Although, knowing him, it's almost certainly not the first two.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/gauge - hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of the strange dev..."
entries.text: What do you make of the strange device in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, the measuring device? It's very..."
entries.text: Oh, the measuring device? It's very impressive, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I think it bodes well for the séanc..."
entries.text: I think it bodes well for the séance!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ivy - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She's an interesting sort. I've nev..."
entries.text: She's an interesting sort. I've never met anyone with her ability before.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Not exactly, anyway - not from some..."
entries.text: Not exactly, anyway - not from some spontaneous effect of her bloodline.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She seemed too tired to talk about..."
entries.text: She seemed too tired to talk about it. Imagine! Seeing into the future, and finding it tiresome!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Miss McLeod?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Varley - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Mister Varley? I tried asking him a..."
entries.text: Mister Varley? I tried asking him about the manor's history and hauntings but he sent me to the library instead.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the manager at a..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to the manager at all?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Too busy for guests, it seems..."
entries.text: Too busy for guests, it seems...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Doesn't he know who I am, what I do..."
entries.text: Doesn't he know who I am, what I do?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Lan Fen - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I have to wonder what someone who s..."
entries.text: I have to wonder what someone who studies science wants with an event like this, but I suppose that's her prerogative...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I only wish she would stop looking..."
entries.text: I only wish she would stop looking at me the way she does...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Skerritt - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Skerritt?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, yes. He introduced himself to m..."
entries.text: Oh, yes. He introduced himself to me. He was very interested to hear about my work, of course.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "We've actually met before, but he d..."
entries.text: We've actually met before, but he doesn't seem to recall.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Corentine - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've met Miss Qui..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've met Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Once, before, in London. But she se..."
entries.text: Once, before, in London. But she seems to like to keep to herself much of the time... and even more so, recently.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Grimoire magicians do like to study..."
entries.text: Grimoire magicians do like to study... Unlike us spiritualists, they find much of what they need in books.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Though I hear she does formulate he..."
entries.text: Though I hear she does formulate her own magic these days.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Either way, I'm leaving her to it."
entries.text: Either way, I'm leaving her to it.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Caitlin - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the housekeeper?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well... yes, though she mostly spok..."
entries.text: Well... yes, though she mostly spoke to me.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Why the housekeeper wants to know w..."
entries.text: Why the housekeeper wants to know where I'm visiting from, and why I'm visiting, is beyond me.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She seems convinced that, aside fro..."
entries.text: She seems convinced that, aside from not being "proper", my jewellery makes me a walking noise complaint.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Truth be told, I think myself and t..."
entries.text: Truth be told, I think myself and this whole event are simply beyond her understanding.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Darragh - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the groundskeeper?"
entries.text: Have you met the groundskeeper?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "We talked a little on the way up he..."
entries.text: We talked a little on the way up here, but nothing besides the most inconsequential small talk.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I couldn't say much else. He's rath..."
entries.text: I couldn't say much else. He's rather too handsome for a married woman to be making idle conversation with. What would my husband say?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Seamus - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the porter?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the porter?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, Mister Ward... Do you really ex..."
entries.text: Oh, Mister Ward... Do you really expect the porter to show an interest in mysticism? Just from a glance, the complexities of it all would probably go right over his head!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ines - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I have. She's quite unafraid to spe..."
entries.text: I have. She's quite unafraid to speak her mind. That's always refreshing at these high-society events.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It makes for trouble, but that's re..."
entries.text: It makes for trouble, but that's refreshing, too.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ettiene - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Toussaint?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Even before this event, I knew who..."
entries.text: Even before this event, I knew who he was. His reputation precedes him. To meet him is...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Ah, I don't know. Good riddance to..."
entries.text: Ah, I don't know. Good riddance to the fakes he's found, but the man's too sceptical for his own good.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "The supernatural exists. Not everyo..."
entries.text: The supernatural exists. Not everyone is lying. What does he gain from fixating on the people that do?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Cathal - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister O'Meara?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, that boy. He's absolutely fasci..."
entries.text: Oh, that boy. He's absolutely fascinating. It's not often I get to talk to someone who has dealings with angels... He might even be the first.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I wonder if he might consider joini..."
entries.text: I wonder if he might consider joining the Golden Dawn... They'd be more than happy to have him.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Even with his reputation for being..."
entries.text: Even with his reputation for being a bit of a daredevil! Now that I say it aloud, I wonder if there is a link between his gift and his recklessness?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Dupré - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "We've talked a little. He'd all sor..."
entries.text: We've talked a little. He'd all sorts of questions about what I do - claims to be particularly interested in the spiritualism of the dead.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I think he said he runs a funeral h..."
entries.text: I think he said he runs a funeral home, or something like that?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I wouldn't have thought that's a ve..."
entries.text: I wouldn't have thought that's a very lucrative job, but he seems to be doing quite well for himself, so I guess I would be wrong.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on D'Arcy - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus D'Arcy?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Not before this party - I haven't s..."
entries.text: Not before this party - I haven't seen her in our circles before.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She's an author, as it turns out. W..."
entries.text: She's an author, as it turns out. Writes those dark and dramatic sorts of novels. I might even have read one at some point...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She seems surprisingly grounded, co..."
entries.text: She seems surprisingly grounded, considering. Even a little sceptical. I wouldn't have expected that.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Coventry  - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Coventry?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Yes but we didn't speak for long -..."
entries.text: Yes but we didn't speak for long - I came here to talk to my peers, not potential punters.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Hazel - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me about yourself, Missus Eric..."
entries.text: Tell me about yourself, Missus Erickson.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Why, what do you want to know?"
entries.text: Why, what do you want to know?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I mean, let's see... I'm a spiritua..."
entries.text: I mean, let's see... I'm a spiritualist. You know that, don't you? Which is to say I communicate with the spirits of the dead.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I started off in the practice back..."
entries.text: I started off in the practice back home - New York has its own scene, you know - but I prefer London for its societies.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I'm still based in New York, of cou..."
entries.text: I'm still based in New York, of course - there's to be no moving with my husband's job - but I do spend quite some time on this side of the pond.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "How's that for you?"
entries.text: How's that for you?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ruairí - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Doctor Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, yes. It's not so often that you..."
entries.text: Oh, yes. It's not so often that you meet a doctor at one of these things, but he said something about practising old magic, too.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I'm looking forward to speaking wit..."
entries.text: I'm looking forward to speaking with him more.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Carmela - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Met, oh no, not really. Well yes, b..."
entries.text: Met, oh no, not really. Well yes, but...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I've attended talks of hers before,..."
entries.text: I've attended talks of hers before, but I'm too starstruck to really talk with her.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She's an inspiration and the reason..."
entries.text: She's an inspiration and the reason I've come here.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "But will I talk with her? I'm not s..."
entries.text: But will I talk with her? I'm not sure I could bring myself to...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Blake - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the Marquess?"
entries.text: Have you met the Marquess?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I have, though I can't say he seems..."
entries.text: I have, though I can't say he seems much for conversation.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "After all this effort, you'd think..."
entries.text: After all this effort, you'd think he might be a little more interested in his guests.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ó Finn - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "How could I not? I'm still not sure..."
entries.text: How could I not? I'm still not sure what compelled him to show up in ritual garb, but at least it's a talking point.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Fiadh - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you made Miss Callaghan's acqu..."
entries.text: Have you made Miss Callaghan's acquaintance?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She's much too invested in everyone..."
entries.text: She's much too invested in everyone's business, I'm almost embarrassed for her.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It's not the sort of interest that..."
entries.text: It's not the sort of interest that makes friends, you know?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Sinnott - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Father Sinnott?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I have - but you know, I can't say..."
entries.text: I have - but you know, I can't say I learned much at all.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "He's enigmatic, which doesn't surpr..."
entries.text: He's enigmatic, which doesn't surprise me - a man of the cloth here? Ha!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Is he here to cast fire and brimsto..."
entries.text: Is he here to cast fire and brimstone down on us for our sins?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Could he... Can he do that - actual..."
entries.text: Could he... Can he do that - actually, not metaphorically?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh God..."
entries.text: Oh God...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Arwa - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Hisham?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I was so excited to learn more of E..."
entries.text: I was so excited to learn more of Egyptian mysticism and the scene there, but she's much more a historian than a mystic.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Honestly I think I confounded her w..."
entries.text: Honestly I think I confounded her with my esoteric knowledge.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Saoirse - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with the cook, Miss..."
entries.text: Have you spoken with the cook, Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I don't believe I have. I'm not sur..."
entries.text: I don't believe I have. I'm not sure anyone has? Well, that's not true - I saw Miss Deane speaking with her, but I assume that was to ask the poor child to pour poison into somebody's meal!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Em, not really, of course..."
entries.text: Em, not really, of course...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've met Miss Dea..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Did you know, Mister Ward, that cer..."
entries.text: Did you know, Mister Ward, that certain animals have brightly-coloured patterns to warn off other creatures? That's what they're saying these days.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It's too bad Miss Deane's not a fro..."
entries.text: It's too bad Miss Deane's not a frog.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "He was?"
entries.text: He was?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Mister Ward, the poor boy asked her..."
entries.text: Mister Ward, the poor boy asked her to marry him!

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She said no, of course - and so pub..."
entries.text: She said no, of course - and so publically too. What's a wolf to do with a lovesick puppy?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "No, I said she should be a frog. Pr..."
entries.text: No, I said she should be a frog. Presently, she's just a harlot.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Maybe it'd stop the likes of Mister..."
entries.text: Maybe it'd stop the likes of Mister O'Meara from chasing after her tail...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A wolf, then? Not a frog?"
entries.text: A wolf, then? Not a frog?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Only this week - but her reputation..."
entries.text: Only this week - but her reputation precedes her.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Walter Blake - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've met the Marq..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've met the Marquess' son?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "His son? I didn't know he had one!..."
entries.text: His son? I didn't know he had one! He can't be the social sort.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/White heather hairpin - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm almost impressed that Miss McLe..."
entries.text: I'm almost impressed that Miss McLeod is wearing flowers in October.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I suppose they'll be preserved. And..."
entries.text: I suppose they'll be preserved. And maybe some sort of charm...?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Or maybe she just really likes flow..."
entries.text: Or maybe she just really likes flowers. Who's to say? Her, I suppose.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Mourning Cameo - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of the cameo Missu..."
entries.text: What do you make of the cameo Missus Lau is wearing?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "What's to suppose? The poor woman's..."
entries.text: What's to suppose? The poor woman's lost someone. A husband, I'd imagine.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Perhaps that's why she would want t..."
entries.text: Perhaps that's why she would want to attend a séance...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Watchful expression - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Lau seems to have a careful..."
entries.text: Missus Lau seems to have a careful eye on the proceedings...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She's got eyes that'll cut right th..."
entries.text: She's got eyes that'll cut right through you, that's for sure. I can't say I find the experience pleasant.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Mysterious crest on necktie - Skerritt

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know what the cres..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know what the crest Mister Skerritt is wearing is?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Why, yes. He's a Freemason."
entries.text: Why, yes. He's a Freemason.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Though he might not like you knowin..."
entries.text: Though he might not like you knowing that.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Open, eager pose - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Joyce - the housekeeper - do..."
entries.text: Missus Joyce - the housekeeper - does seem interested in what's going on, even if she's not a part of it.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Rather too interested, perhaps."
entries.text: Rather too interested, perhaps.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Sly, knowing smile - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you get the impression that the..."
entries.text: Do you get the impression that the housekeeper might have some interest in the goings on amongst the guests?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "She would do well to mind her own b..."
entries.text: She would do well to mind her own business. Have a little respect, maybe.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Dreamy Eyes - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does Mister O'Meara seem distracted..."
entries.text: Does Mister O'Meara seem distracted to you?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "You can't blame a man for having hi..."
entries.text: You can't blame a man for having his head in the clouds at an event like this of all things, now, can you?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Shaky hands - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed Mister Doyle's han..."
entries.text: Have you noticed Mister Doyle's hands shaking at all?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "You know, Mister Ward, if I have, I..."
entries.text: You know, Mister Ward, if I have, I'm sure it wouldn't do anything for me to comment on it. It seems his own business, hm?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Society of Psychical Research symbol - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you recognise the s..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you recognise the symbol Mister Toussaint is wearing?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Ah... He's a member of the Society..."
entries.text: Ah... He's a member of the Society of Psychical Research. Some of them are just fine by me...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "But I'm not sure I like the society..."
entries.text: But I'm not sure I like the society as a whole. Still, it's not like you can stop them from being here.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Notebook in pocket - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Toussaint seems to always ha..."
entries.text: Mister Toussaint seems to always have that notebook of his on hand.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "He couldn't put it down for just a..."
entries.text: He couldn't put it down for just a moment, could he? Heaven forbid he let us all relax a little...

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Discerning gaze - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Toussaint seems to have quit..."
entries.text: Mister Toussaint seems to have quite the eye on things.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "He has to keep an eye out for his w..."
entries.text: He has to keep an eye out for his work, I know, but for Heaven's sake - who acts normally when they're being watched like that?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Friendly expression - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Dupré seems friendly."
entries.text: Mister Dupré seems friendly.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, he's a good sort. I'd be put ou..."
entries.text: Oh, he's a good sort. I'd be put out if the only other American here wasn't up for conversation, so I'm lucky that he is.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Curious tattoo - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you know the meanin..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you know the meaning of Mister Dupré's tattoo?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "That's, well..."
entries.text: That's, well...

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "That is his place to tell you, Mist..."
entries.text: That is his place to tell you, Mister Ward, not mine.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Large brooch - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know the crest Missus D'Arcy..."
entries.text: Do you know the crest Missus D'Arcy is wearing?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I do, of course! She's a fellow mem..."
entries.text: I do, of course! She's a fellow member of the Golden Order.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Though I don't recognise her face....."
entries.text: Though I don't recognise her face... She must only have joined recently.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Scent of antiseptic - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I do seem to catch the scent of ant..."
entries.text: I do seem to catch the scent of antiseptic around Doctor Callaghan.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "That's what it is! I couldn't place..."
entries.text: That's what it is! I couldn't place it... and I could do without it, honestly.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Tense body language - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you alright, Missus Erickson? Y..."
entries.text: Are you alright, Missus Erickson? You seem uncomfortable.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "As if to comment on it will make me..."
entries.text: As if to comment on it will make me more comfortable? I'm fine, Mister Ward, thank you.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Necklace crest - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can I ask what the crest you're wea..."
entries.text: Can I ask what the crest you're wearing symbolises?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I'm a member of the Hermetic Order..."
entries.text: I'm a member of the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn. It's just a little way to let fellow members know they're among kin, you know?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Spiritual jewellery - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does your jewellery have a particul..."
entries.text: Does your jewellery have a particular meaning at all?

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Oh, not in that there are symbols,..."
entries.text: Oh, not in that there are symbols, or anything of that sort - but different colours and stones are thought to have magical correspondences.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "It's almost standard as the mystic'..."
entries.text: It's almost standard as the mystic's attire. It lets people know exactly why I'm here and what I do.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Protestant Vestments - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I take it the Reverend’s only here..."
entries.text: I take it the Reverend’s only here for business, with how he’s dressed.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "I don’t imagine he approves of all..."
entries.text: I don’t imagine he approves of all this. Outside these walls, it’s really quite controversial.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "But we know better, don’t we?"
entries.text: But we know better, don’t we?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Proud stature - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Marquess Blake carries himself with..."
entries.text: Marquess Blake carries himself with a lot of dignity.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Well, so he should!"
entries.text: Well, so he should!

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Ward in room - Hazel

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "...Mister Ward?"
entries.text: ...Mister Ward?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...Hello, Missus Erickson."
entries.text: ...Hello, Missus Erickson.

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "Mister Varley? MISTER VARLEY! MIS-T..."
entries.text: Mister Varley? MISTER VARLEY! MIS-TER VAR-

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "No, don't-"
entries.text: No, don't-

entries.speaker: Missus Erickson
entries.label: Hazel: "...Sir?"
entries.text: ...Sir?

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/ward post hazel confrontation

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Good Lord. The woman is insane, des..."
entries.text: Good Lord. The woman is insane, desperate, or both. She must be stopped. Maybe Mister Toussaint will have some idea.

title: Cast/Hazel Erickson/PostQuest - Hazel

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "If this séance has attracted the li..."
entries.text: If this séance has attracted the likes of Missus Erickson, then Miss Deane may be in even more danger than I realised...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I was able to make her see sense bu..."
entries.text: I was able to make her see sense but I doubt that’s enough to spare her from eternal damnation.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "She’s a fraud, an unrepentant sinne..."
entries.text: She’s a fraud, an unrepentant sinner, with no regard for the harm caused by her pursuit of power. How many desperate people has she cheated to get this far?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can she atone for what she’s alread..."
entries.text: Can she atone for what she’s already done? That is, if she even realises she needs to?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Regardless, she’s no longer my conc..."
entries.text: Regardless, she’s no longer my concern.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Good day."
entries.text: Good day.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Hello, Sir. Anything I can do for y..."
entries.text: Hello, Sir. Anything I can do for you?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Hello. Declan Ward, Miss. Pleased t..."
entries.text: Hello. Declan Ward, Miss. Pleased to meet you.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh! God bless you, Sir, it isn't of..."
entries.text: Oh! God bless you, Sir, it isn't often someone introduces themselves to the help.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Caitlin Joyce. I'm the housekeeper..."
entries.text: Caitlin Joyce. I'm the housekeeper here.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "If there's anything you need, just..."
entries.text: If there's anything you need, just come right to me.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll be off, Missus Joyce."
entries.text: I'll be off, Missus Joyce.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "God bless you, Sir."
entries.text: God bless you, Sir.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Nonsense! Lord knows, we could use..."
entries.text: Nonsense! Lord knows, we could use someone normal at this damnable séance...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Thank you, Missus Joyce. I'll try n..."
entries.text: Thank you, Missus Joyce. I'll try not to be a bother.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "... Oh Lord. Oh, my sweet Lord, wha..."
entries.text: ... Oh Lord. Oh, my sweet Lord, what is wrong with me?! Every moment the witch lives, I sin!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Even Abraham could kill his son for..."
entries.text: Even Abraham could kill his son for God, Sir! Why... why is it so hard to kill a damn witch?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Could you forgive yourself if it we..."
entries.text: Could you forgive yourself if it were easy? Is this truly what God intends? Think, Missus Joyce!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Y-You don't understand! She's just..."
entries.text: Y-You don't understand! She's just been so... kind. And I keep seeing her face.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Except there's wet red down her sku..."
entries.text: Except there's wet red down her skull, and the squelch of bone mixed with the scent of iron, so thick you can taste it - and her hair is matted, she's crying and I just--

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "But none of it happened! None of it..."
entries.text: But none of it happened! None of it has to!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "No - we are godly. But not everyone..."
entries.text: No - we are godly. But not everyone needs to be godly to be good. Just because somebody is a mystic, that doesn't also mean they are monsters.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I-I want to believe that! But every..."
entries.text: I-I want to believe that! But every time I try, it feels like I'm... questioning Him.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So try again. God is steadfast enou..."
entries.text: So try again. God is steadfast enough for questions, Missus Joyce - and He's good enough to love you when you seek answers. I have faith.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I... Oh, Sir. Oh, you're right, are..."
entries.text: I... Oh, Sir. Oh, you're right, aren't you? I can't do it. I almost... How could I... Oh sweet Lord, forgive me!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Please, take this. It's Saint Brigi..."
entries.text: Please, take this. It's Saint Brigid's cloth - a brat bhride for your protection. I pray the Lord keep you safe.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Then you're not...?"
entries.text: Then you're not...?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I-I mean it, Sir. I'll find a way t..."
entries.text: I-I mean it, Sir. I'll find a way to repent. I don't know how yet, but something will come up - I have faith that it will.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "... Doesn't it?"
entries.text: ... Doesn't it?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "M-maybe... maybe He sent me an ange..."
entries.text: M-maybe... maybe He sent me an angel? To show me these people aren't savages.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Why the Marquess saw fit to risk ou..."
entries.text: Why the Marquess saw fit to risk our immortal souls, bringing that Satanism here, is beyond me! Why, I've half a mind to...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, don't mind me Sir - just gettin..."
entries.text: Oh, don't mind me Sir - just getting crotchety in my old age!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Good. I know this is a lot. I'll be..."
entries.text: Good. I know this is a lot. I'll be back to check on you, Missus Joyce.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Hiring telegram - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Someone hired me to see about this..."
entries.text: Someone hired me to see about this young woman... Would you know anything about her?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Me? No, no, I wouldn't, Sir. That's..."
entries.text: Me? No, no, I wouldn't, Sir. That's not... I'm just the housekeeper.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "All this magic, these strange faith..."
entries.text: All this magic, these strange faiths and secret societies - it's all still very new to me. I don't think I'll ever come around to accepting it all.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How are you feeling now?"
entries.text: How are you feeling now?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But, I can see now that it's not al..."
entries.text: But, I can see now that it's not all wicked. Some are just another way of looking at the world.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I don't understand or trust this ma..."
entries.text: I don't understand or trust this magic, but my cousin in Dublin talks the same way about electricity...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...and I know that's just something..."
entries.text: ...and I know that's just something that happens, and people with more schooling than I can make use of for all sorts.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "So if magic is just another part of..."
entries.text: So if magic is just another part of nature, then God must have put it there. And I won't be scared of anything the good Lord provides us.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...and I know that's just our world..."
entries.text: ...and I know that's just our world changing, and people with more schooling than I can make better sense of it all.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "You know, something came over me wh..."
entries.text: You know, something came over me when you threw that torch, Sir. In that moment, I...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...Well, I just knew that being the..."
entries.text: ...Well, I just knew that being there with you and Mister Dupré, helping that poor girl, was the right thing - the godly thing - to do.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photo of Deane - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know this woman?"
entries.text: Do you happen to know this woman?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Her? Oh, that's Miss Deane. She was..."
entries.text: Her? Oh, that's Miss Deane. She was staying with us just until recently.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Was she a frequent visitor?"
entries.text: Was she a frequent visitor?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh no, this was her first time."
entries.text: Oh no, this was her first time.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Luggage - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Mister Doyle will be along to colle..."
entries.text: Mister Doyle will be along to collect that for you in just a moment, don't you worry, Sir.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the region - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about the surr..."
entries.text: What can you tell me about the surrounding area?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "There's not much, Sir, 'cept for th..."
entries.text: There's not much, Sir, 'cept for the town you would've came through. Mister Hunter used to get supplies there.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Other than that, it's all windswept..."
entries.text: Other than that, it's all windswept plains and the wild Atlantic. Would be romantic if it weren't so cold.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Now they do deliveries right to the..."
entries.text: Now they do deliveries right to the stables! We're getting a big one this Sunday at twelve.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sherry - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, that's very kind of you, Sir!"
entries.text: Well, that's very kind of you, Sir!

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ OFFER ALCOHOL ]"
entries.text: [ OFFER ALCOHOL ]

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ KEEP ALCOHOL ]"
entries.text: [ KEEP ALCOHOL ]

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll hold onto this for now."
entries.text: I'll hold onto this for now.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Séance Flyer - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I take it you're not very pleased a..."
entries.text: I take it you're not very pleased about this séance, Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Not very plea- Sir! I've worked her..."
entries.text: Not very plea- Sir! I've worked here nearly my whole life, and this is the first time I've ever thought to leave.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "There's no good to come of disturbi..."
entries.text: There's no good to come of disturbing those in Heaven. That's ungodly work.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I'd be gone, if it didn't mean leav..."
entries.text: I'd be gone, if it didn't mean leaving poor Mister Varley and young Saoirse in the hands of these wretches.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane's signature - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I saw Miss Deane had signed in abou..."
entries.text: I saw Miss Deane had signed in about a week ago.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh yes, I believe she got here a fe..."
entries.text: Oh yes, I believe she got here a few days before this whole event started. Lovely girl.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Supposed to be something of a socia..."
entries.text: Supposed to be something of a social butterfly, from what I've gathered!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Marriage talk - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I couldn't help but overhear a conv..."
entries.text: I couldn't help but overhear a conversation back in the library. Something about looking a suitable marriage candidates?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I had no idea there'd be such a thi..."
entries.text: I had no idea there'd be such a thing at an event like this! Don't suppose you caught who it was having the conversation?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It was the young lady from Scotland..."
entries.text: It was the young lady from Scotland, I believe.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, I know the girl you mean. I won..."
entries.text: Oh, I know the girl you mean. I wonder which of the gentlemen she's likely to take a fancy to...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Morse code book - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "We use that to write telegrams. Or,..."
entries.text: We use that to write telegrams. Or, Mister Varley and Mister Hunter do, anyway. I don't often use it.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Telegram machine - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "If you want a telegram sent, you'd..."
entries.text: If you want a telegram sent, you'd best ask one of the gentlemen on our staff, Sir. They use the machine more often.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ines' telegram - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "What's that - did the young Brazili..."
entries.text: What's that - did the young Brazilian lady get that reply she was waiting for?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I don't know what it's about, but s..."
entries.text: I don't know what it's about, but she's been fretting over it for the last day.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Regional research - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Would you know anything about all t..."
entries.text: Would you know anything about all the research out in the library?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Not a thing. I did see, when I was..."
entries.text: Not a thing. I did see, when I was going past, that it's all about the local region.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But what that young woman wants wit..."
entries.text: But what that young woman wants with it, I've no idea.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locked door - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I notice the guest rooms are locked..."
entries.text: I notice the guest rooms are locked.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, yes, Sir. If a room is occupi..."
entries.text: Well, yes, Sir. If a room is occupied, then the guest is provided a key, and we keep the empty ones shut up.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You would have a master key, wouldn..."
entries.text: You would have a master key, wouldn't you, for the sake of cleaning? Could I borrow it? I'm curious to see more of the house.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...No. No, Sir, I don't think I can..."
entries.text: ...No. No, Sir, I don't think I can allow that. It might be one thing if the rooms were empty, but...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That's alright, I understand."
entries.text: That's alright, I understand.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ritual markings - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found evidence of a ritual upstai..."
entries.text: I found evidence of a ritual upstairs. Would you happen to know anything about that?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "These people... Nothing about that,..."
entries.text: These people... Nothing about that, Sir, other than now I have to go and see about cleaning it up!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Cathal saw Deane - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister O'Meara says he saw Miss Dea..."
entries.text: Mister O'Meara says he saw Miss Deane late on Tuesday night... and that he had the impression she'd been drinking.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "There's no shortage of that sort of..."
entries.text: There's no shortage of that sort of thing here... but Miss Deane? I didn't think she was the sort!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Just goes to show how people can su..."
entries.text: Just goes to show how people can surprise you!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Waiting on message - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you think there's a chance Miste..."
entries.text: Do you think there's a chance Mister Doyle has mislaid a telegram? Miss Barbosa is still waiting on one, apparently.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, it wouldn't surprise me. I'll r..."
entries.text: Oh, it wouldn't surprise me. I'll remind him next I see him.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Skeleton key - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "What on Earth - is that mine? Miste..."
entries.text: What on Earth - is that mine? Mister Ward, give that back!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Strange occurences - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've noticed some strange happening..."
entries.text: I've noticed some strange happenings about this place...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I knew it, Sir. I warned the Marque..."
entries.text: I knew it, Sir. I warned the Marquess.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "This is what happens when you invit..."
entries.text: This is what happens when you invite a gathering of the dark arts!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "We're turning our home into a snake..."
entries.text: We're turning our home into a snake pit? And for what reason, I ask?

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Leaving letter - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Were you aware that Miss Deane sign..."
entries.text: Were you aware that Miss Deane signed out by means of a letter?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...Yes. Some sort of urgent busines..."
entries.text: ...Yes. Some sort of urgent business to attend to, if I remember right - but no word on what it was...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Suppose she didn't fancy telling th..."
entries.text: Suppose she didn't fancy telling the specifics to just anybody.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane left - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've been told Miss Deane left a li..."
entries.text: I've been told Miss Deane left a little while ago.

entries.text: You know, I think she's always been there for me. I never feel more at peace than when I feel her near.

entries.text: Miss Deane is simply a butterfly caught in her web.

entries.text: Truly, Sir? I think I'm still trying to understand that for myself - even now.

entries.text: How much of her nature is hers? How much of it is the devil's whispers in her ears? How... How do I know if a woman deserves to die, Detective?

entries.text: It's not my money I hired you with - it's what Miss Deane left behind in her room - but I don't imagine she'd mind.

entries.text: Without it, I wouldn't have been able to do anything for her. I hope that you can do more, Sir, now that you're here.

entries.text: It should be that the others will help you, now, if you ask. Now that they know I brought you here.

entries.text: Oh, he hasn't been himself since Marchioness Blake passed away, poor man...

entries.text: The manor can't keep a cat, though - the things always run away!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Horses sick - Caitlin

entries.text: The horses have all taken ill.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: All of them? Mister Hunter said as much, but I thought I'd misheard him! Poor creatures.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Front gates barred - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The front gates will no longer open..."
entries.text: The front gates will no longer open. It's as if they've been barred.

entries.text: It'll be that a tree has fallen down - Mister Hunter will see to it soon enough.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ms Callaghan's Perspective

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Ms Callaghan is concerned that the..."
entries.text: Ms Callaghan is concerned that the doctor's interest in the magic of high society is going to lead him astray from the heart of their practice.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "What Ms Callaghan does, it's been a..."
entries.text: What Ms Callaghan does, it's been around a long time. And she's a good, honest woman. I think, if I might say so, the doctor ought to mind her word.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Callaghan Dynamic - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of how Ms Callagha..."
entries.text: What do you make of how Ms Callaghan and Doctor Callaghan get on?

entries.text: Nothing good comes of stifling a man's pride, you know. Miss Callaghan's a good woman, but she might allow him a longer leash.

entries.text: Or no leash at all, come to think of it! He's a doctor, for Heaven's sake. If he can't make his own decisions, then who of us can?

entries.text: What do you make of Doctor Callaghan's goal of joining the high-society magicians?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Quite frankly, I don't think there'..."
entries.text: Quite frankly, I don't think there's any good to come of it. You can't blame a man for his ambition...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But I don't think there's anything..."
entries.text: But I don't think there's anything worth finding among that sort of practice!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Secret Rendevous - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It appears that while the bridge ga..."
entries.text: It appears that while the bridge game was being held, Miss McLeod and Mister O'Meara were talking in the gardens.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, now - they ought to know bett..."
entries.text: Well, now - they ought to know better, the both of them! There's no good to come of sneaking around. People will talk!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It sounds like Missus Lau isn't doi..."
entries.text: It sounds like Missus Lau isn't doing her job, if you ask me.

entries.text: Thankfully, it's only a few of us to juggle. Once a week usually does the trick. Last Tuesday, we got it in while the bridge was on.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I gather Mister Varley leans on you..."
entries.text: I gather Mister Varley leans on you to help with the rotas?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh aye. He's very good with a lot o..."
entries.text: Oh aye. He's very good with a lot of the job, but remembering people's personals? Not so good.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghost of Edward Blake - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Among the other apparitions here......"
entries.text: Among the other apparitions here... I saw what I think must have been the ghost of Edward Blake.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It doesn't do to dwell on these thi..."
entries.text: It doesn't do to dwell on these things, Mister Ward, and I...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, let's just hope that he didn'..."
entries.text: Well, let's just hope that he didn't take any notice of you.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Catacombs - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Joyce, did you know there ar..."
entries.text: Missus Joyce, did you know there are catacombs under the manor?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It's a spooky old house, Mister War..."
entries.text: It's a spooky old house, Mister Ward! Can't say I'm surprised to hear it's even worse than I thought.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missing Door - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "How the master can leave a portrait..."
entries.text: How the master can leave a portrait out of that man after what he did to those two...

entries.label: Caitlin: "I won't go near the East Tower less..."
entries.text: I won't go near the East Tower less'n I have to!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Even thinking about it gives me the chills. Please, can we speak of something else, Sir?

entries.text: The door to Room 15, it's... missing? As if it's been walled up?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "What? No, Sir. It's on my rota, sur..."
entries.text: What? No, Sir. It's on my rota, sure!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Reminds me of... Oh, Sir - I wish y..."
entries.text: Reminds me of... Oh, Sir - I wish you'd said nothing. You've brought back a terrible, sad story for me.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sketches of strange symbol - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've been seeing this symbol around..."
entries.text: I've been seeing this symbol around the place - you don't happen to know anything about it, do you?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Can't say I do, Sir. I don't - and..."
entries.text: Can't say I do, Sir. I don't - and I won't! - have anything to do with this witchcraft.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Séance's purpose - Caitlin

entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of the intent of t..."
entries.text: What do you make of the intent of this Grand Séance?

entries.text: I can't see any good coming from it, Sir. If the good Lord wanted us to have the answers they're after, he'd have given us them from the start.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Parcel of money - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you take this parcel of money f..."
entries.text: Did you take this parcel of money from Miss Deane's belongings?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, Sir - I hardly had the money..."
entries.text: Well, Sir - I hardly had the money to pay you out of my own pocket, now did I?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "And Miss Deane was very well off, d..."
entries.text: And Miss Deane was very well off, do you know. I can't imagine she'll mind the cost.

entries.label: Ward: "I suppose... You went to a lot of t..."
entries.text: I suppose... You went to a lot of trouble to get this, didn't you? But you didn't even sign your name on my hiring letter.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, this event is very important fo..."
entries.text: Oh, this event is very important for the hotel, Sir. If Mister Varley knew there were a detective snooping about the guests!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "He's just going to have to put up w..."
entries.text: He's just going to have to put up with it now, anyway.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Key - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, this key will get me into the p..."
entries.text: So, this key will get me into the private wing of the manor?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It will indeed, Sir. ...Maybe best..."
entries.text: It will indeed, Sir. ...Maybe best not to let anyone see you with it, eh?

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Hedonistic Gala - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
