entries.text: I can't imagine you host many parties like that masked ball here.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "How Marquess Blake allowed it, I'm..."
entries.text: How Marquess Blake allowed it, I'm sure I don't know!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I'll speak no more of it, Sir, plea..."
entries.text: I'll speak no more of it, Sir, please. Shameful behaviour...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mary Blake - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about Marchion..."
entries.text: What can you tell me about Marchioness Blake?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, God rest her soul. She was a go..."
entries.text: Oh, God rest her soul. She was a good woman, Mister Ward - gone from us too soon.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "The Marquess just hasn't been the s..."
entries.text: The Marquess just hasn't been the same since her passing. He idolised that woman.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "And poor young Walter..."
entries.text: And poor young Walter...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Unknown Sigil - Caitlin

entries.label: Ward: "I've... seen this sigil, somewhere..."
entries.text: I've... seen this sigil, somewhere around here. A spiral, with a line at the twelve o'clock mark, and three more at five, six, and seven.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen anything of the sort..."
entries.text: Have you seen anything of the sort anywhere?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Can't say I have, Sir. Not somethin..."
entries.text: Can't say I have, Sir. Not something I'd know about, anyhow, sigils and the like!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/crib - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is there a particular reason there'..."
entries.text: Is there a particular reason there's a crib in the servant's quarters?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "What-? How do you know about that?..."
entries.text: What-? How do you know about that? You have no business being in the servant's quarters!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Oh, that's a sad story, there, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Varley
entries.label: ...: "STOLEN?"
entries.text: STOLEN?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It was meant for Miss Murphy's chil..."
entries.text: It was meant for Miss Murphy's child, but she never did get to use it before the girl was taken from her.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It's an awful business."
entries.text: It's an awful business.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "What-? How do you know about that?"
entries.text: What-? How do you know about that?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Please, Sir, leave it be. It's comp..."
entries.text: Please, Sir, leave it be. It's complicated enough as it is.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/hotel finances - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I understand the hotel's in some fi..."
entries.text: I understand the hotel's in some financial difficulty.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It takes more money than you'd thin..."
entries.text: It takes more money than you'd think to keep a place like this running. Certainly, it's no easy task!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "And, as it turns out, séances are e..."
entries.text: And, as it turns out, séances are expensive things to host. I don't know what Marquess Blake was thinking.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "All that stress on poor Mister Varl..."
entries.text: All that stress on poor Mister Varley... Sure, they paid that Mantovani a fortune too!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane's Room - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know which room Mi..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Yes, of course, it was room... How..."
entries.text: Yes, of course, it was room... How odd. I can't remember now, but I was there just the other day. F-for cleaning, I mean.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "This place, this event - it's all p..."
entries.text: This place, this event - it's all playing tricks with me...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Room... Oh... How odd. I was there..."
entries.text: Room... Oh... How odd. I was there the other day. Cleaning.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/strange dreams - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you experienced any strange dr..."
entries.text: Have you experienced any strange dreams while sleeping here?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Please, Sir. I'd rather not..."
entries.text: Please, Sir. I'd rather not...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, sometimes I think I'm walking..."
entries.text: Well, sometimes I think I'm walking through the gardens - truly believing it. Then, I have this urge to look back at the manor...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...and oh, Sir. I know not to look,..."
entries.text: ...and oh, Sir. I know not to look, but I can't fight it and I wish, how I wish that I could.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "The windows - they're all black, sa..."
entries.text: The windows - they're all black, save for those red eyes looking down on me. Every window, hiding a horrific figure...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Then, thank the Lord, I snap awake..."
entries.text: Then, thank the Lord, I snap awake in tangled sheets.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Shadowy Figure - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever heard tell of a large..."
entries.text: Have you ever heard tell of a large, shadowy figure stalking the grounds?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, Sir, I couldn't really say. Sur..."
entries.text: Oh, Sir, I couldn't really say. Sure, this place makes you see things, but you won't catch me looking harder 'n I need to!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Best bet might be to check the libr..."
entries.text: Best bet might be to check the library?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "What? It's a cruel thing, Sir, teas..."
entries.text: What? It's a cruel thing, Sir, teasing a poor old housekeeper!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, don't say that! Please, Sir, if..."
entries.text: Oh, don't say that! Please, Sir, if it's children's tales you're after, go hang about in the library.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Unfortunately, I'm... quite serious..."
entries.text: Unfortunately, I'm... quite serious, Missus Joyce.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You know, maybe I should... Thank y..."
entries.text: You know, maybe I should... Thank you Missus Joyce.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/12 Luggage Ticket - Caitlin

entries.label: Ward: "Do you give out tickets for the lug..."
entries.text: Do you give out tickets for the luggage bays, Missus Joyce?

entries.text: We do, Sir! With all the mix-ups, we had to start numbering the bays to help folks keep track.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mysterious Object - Caitlin

entries.text: It's strange, but I believe there's something lodged inside the luggage room vent?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Oh, for goodness-!

entries.text: ...Honestly, Sir, I wish some of these guests had half your consideration.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: And it's no accident, mind! Mister Hunter's fighting fit, but even he can't pry it off without one of his tools.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Miss Deane's Invitation - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: I heard Miss Deane was personally invited to the séance. She must be very well-respected.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Goodness! If she were, Marquess Blake never mentioned it.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Between you and me, Sir, I hope he'..."
entries.text: Between you and me, Sir, I hope he's ashamed of himself. Can you imagine? Inviting people into a cult...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Treasure Map - Caitlin

entries.text: A few of us are playing a game, Missus Joyce, and I fear this riddle has me beat. Does it mean anything to you?

entries.text: Well, how exciting! Let's see here...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Hmm, very clever. It's just an idea, but I would keep an eye out for statues, Sir.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Statues, you say..."
entries.text: Statues, you say...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Witchcraft components - Caitlin

entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of these? They loo..."
entries.text: What do you make of these? They look like components for a charm of some sort to me.

entries.text: Hm. I'd say those look a lot like the materials Mister Hunter uses to make his little good luck charms. Perhaps you could ask him about it?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of these? They loo..."
entries.text: What do you make of these? They look like components for a charm of some sort.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Oh, good Lord, don't bring those near me, Sir! Who knows what darkness they hold?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "If it's important, ask Mister Hunte..."
entries.text: If it's important, ask Mister Hunter. He's thicker-skinned about these things. Otherwise, burn them, Sir, please!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Chimney Charm - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this on the grounds. What d..."
entries.text: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: One of Mister Hunter's little charms. Maybe he dropped it, eh?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: D-Don't just wave it around, Sir! It could be dangerous!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Mister Hunter's the man you want. Always studying up on this sort of thing, he is.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: "Know thy enemy" - that's what he says.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mister Varley's Statement - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Varley mentioned he was in a..."
entries.text: Mister Varley mentioned he was in a staff meeting during the bridge game.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Well, yes, Sir - I was there too. Better that than serving drinks to blasphemers...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Angels - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you believe in angels, Missus Jo..."
entries.text: Do you believe in angels, Missus Joyce?

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Silent Dinner - Caitlin

entries.text: I'd be grateful if you'd attend, though. Lord knows we need someone to keep an eye on these sinners and their rituals...

entries.text: Oh, that-!

entries.text: Don't you worry, Sir, I'll set him straight. He's a good boy at heart, I promise you. Just needs a little guidance.

entries.text: At least he has Father Sinnott to help him along. Always together recently, them two - I'm sure it'll do Seamus some good.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Their Relationship - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: It's like he's a doting father with his blinkers on...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missus Joyce's Bible - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me, Missus Joyce, do you have..."
entries.text: Tell me, Missus Joyce, do you have a... favourite bible verse?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh! Well, if you must know, Sir, I'..."
entries.text: Oh! Well, if you must know, Sir, I'm quite partial to Leviticus. Good wisdom in any of his verses.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I know the New Testament gets all t..."
entries.text: I know the New Testament gets all the attention these days, but sometimes there's nothing like good old-fashioned justice...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Caitlin V Mantovani - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Am I correct in thinking you harbou..."
entries.text: Am I correct in thinking you harbour a serious hatred for Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Hatre-! Sir, if there were a strong..."
entries.text: Hatre-! Sir, if there were a stronger word, I'd advise you to use it.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Without her, none of this would be..."
entries.text: Without her, none of this would be happening. She's a spider! Drawing everyone here into her web!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "At the end of the day, our guests a..."
entries.text: At the end of the day, our guests are but poor lost sheep. She's the accursed shepherd leading them astray.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Handcarved Rattle - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You wouldn't happen to know anyone..."
entries.text: You wouldn't happen to know anyone who's missing a hand-carved rattle, Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Missing a... Oh Sir. That might be..."
entries.text: Missing a... Oh Sir. That might be Miss Murphy's. Bring it to me and I'll return it. I wouldn't want you upsetting the young girl needlessly.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photograph of the Murphy Child - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Murphy has been confiding in m..."
entries.text: Miss Murphy has been confiding in me about her child, Missus Joyce. Do you know anything that could help her?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "P-please, Sir, keep your voice down..."
entries.text: P-please, Sir, keep your voice down!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...Oh, that poor girl has been besi..."
entries.text: ...Oh, that poor girl has been beside herself.  The Lord certainly works in mysterious ways, gifting her a child with a father like that.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But look, these things happen. I'll..."
entries.text: But look, these things happen. I'll not condemn a girl simply for chasing her heart the wrong way.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Especially not one as kind and brig..."
entries.text: Especially not one as kind and bright as our Saoirse.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Not that you'd call him a father. G..."
entries.text: Not that you'd call him a father. Good riddance, I say! Why our Saoirse took a shining to him--

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Badly Written Note - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this note, Missus Joyce, bu..."
entries.text: I found this note, Missus Joyce, but I can't make head nor tail of it.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Is that a note from... It's her han..."
entries.text: Is that a note from... It's her handwriting, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...O-oh, I - Goodness, Sir, I haven..."
entries.text: ...O-oh, I - Goodness, Sir, I haven't a clue what it says! The scrawl is too messy! Far too messy, yes.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trying to speak to priest - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems Miss Murphy is rather eage..."
entries.text: It seems Miss Murphy is rather eager to discuss something with Father Sinnott.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I... Do you know, I haven't a clue..."
entries.text: I... Do you know, I haven't a clue about that, Sir? But he is a priest. A spiritual teacher of sorts, no?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "P-perfectly normal for us to ask hi..."
entries.text: P-perfectly normal for us to ask him all manner of things, I'm sure.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Of course... You've sought guidance..."
entries.text: Of course... You've sought guidance from him as well, then?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...That's between me and the Lord,..."
entries.text: ...That's between me and the Lord, Sir.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Manor - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How long have you been working at t..."
entries.text: How long have you been working at the manor, Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh! Well - really, most of my life,..."
entries.text: Oh! Well - really, most of my life, Sir. Though I only moved in here five years ago or so, after my dear husband passed.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I wasn't sure about it at first. I..."
entries.text: I wasn't sure about it at first. I was all but shaking with nerves on my first day - we used to tell awful stories about this place as children, you know.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "And coming up the road to see the p..."
entries.text: And coming up the road to see the place didn't help, I'll tell you that!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But I've worked here a long old tim..."
entries.text: But I've worked here a long old time, now, and they haven't got me yet!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Thick fog, black windows and you'd..."
entries.text: Thick fog, black windows and you'd swear there were living things in all the shadows...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the Catacombs - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this old map, but I am not..."
entries.text: I found this old map, but I am not sure which areas it covers.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "There's supposed to be a hidden tro..."
entries.text: There's supposed to be a hidden trove of gold down there, didn't you know?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Honestly, the things people come up..."
entries.text: Honestly, the things people come up with...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this old map of the catacom..."
entries.text: I found this old map of the catacombs...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Might be the old catacombs, Sir? I'..."
entries.text: Might be the old catacombs, Sir? I've always heard stories about those.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Research on Deane - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems Mister Varley has taken qu..."
entries.text: It seems Mister Varley has taken quite an interest in Miss Deane.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, only professionally, Sir, of..."
entries.text: Well, only professionally, Sir, of course! It's his job to know about the guests.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I didn't mean-"
entries.text: I didn't mean-

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "You should be ashamed of yourself,..."
entries.text: You should be ashamed of yourself, Sir! He's old enough to be her father.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "No, what I meant to say is... Oh, a..."
entries.text: No, what I meant to say is... Oh, alright.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brat Bhride - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Forgive me, Missus Joyce, but what..."
entries.text: Forgive me, Missus Joyce, but what exactly is a Brat Bhride?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh - it's a special cloth, Sir. It'..."
entries.text: Oh - it's a special cloth, Sir. It's laid out at sunset on Saint Brigid's Feast Day, and brought back in before sunrise.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Saint Brigid blesses it as she trav..."
entries.text: Saint Brigid blesses it as she travels the land that night, and sends the morning dew to fill it with healing and protection.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It's kept me safe all these years,..."
entries.text: It's kept me safe all these years, Sir. I truly hope it does the same for you.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh! Well..."
entries.text: Oh! Well...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Let's see..."
entries.text: Let's see...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What does this weekend look like fo..."
entries.text: What does this weekend look like for you, Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Any plans for today, Missus Joyce?"
entries.text: Any plans for today, Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I'll be cleaning around the atrium..."
entries.text: I'll be cleaning around the atrium and bedroom corridors for most of the day.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "If I'm not there, I'll almost certa..."
entries.text: If I'm not there, I'll almost certainly be in the dining room! Lunch at one and dinner at seven, don't you forget.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "With so many guests about the place..."
entries.text: With so many guests about the place, I'll need to be there an hour before each, just to set the tables!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "And then, of course, at eight, I'll..."
entries.text: And then, of course, at eight, I'll be preparing for that wretched masked ball in the ballroom. As for tomorrow...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Other than that, oh, and helping Sa..."
entries.text: Other than that, oh, and helping Saoirse with the dinner, I'll be in the ballroom much of the day, cleaning up after you lot...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I've mass in the drawing room at no..."
entries.text: I've mass in the drawing room at noon, of course, and lunch at one.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...and then I'll be joining Mister..."
entries.text: ...and then I'll be joining Mister Dupré at the séance. Along with the spirit of his friend, Laura. Ha, now that's not a sentence I expected to hear myself say!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...before being forced to attend th..."
entries.text: ...before being forced to attend this awful séance. Oh, Lord, I hope this doesn't stop me getting into Heaven!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa drawing of Vase - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I do! Strange looking thing..."
entries.text: I do! Strange looking thing...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Apparently, it was around here some..."
entries.text: Apparently, it was around here somewhere, years ago. One of the Blake family - not living here now - it was hers.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Got it all the way over in Egypt if..."
entries.text: Got it all the way over in Egypt if you'd believe that! We've a painting in the atrium of her holding it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you recognise this..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you recognise this vase?

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa's Melody - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Can't say I recognise the tune, Sir..."
entries.text: Can't say I recognise the tune, Sir.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But if you're looking for somewhere..."
entries.text: But if you're looking for somewhere to play it, there are a few pianos in the manor.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Of course, the finest piano we had..."
entries.text: Of course, the finest piano we had was Lady Wilhelmina's, but that's down in storage with the rest of her things.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've had this melody stuck in my he..."
entries.text: I've had this melody stuck in my head for hours, and I don't know where it came from. Do you recognise it?

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Lady Wilhelmina - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Goodness, no - she was before my ti..."
entries.text: Goodness, no - she was before my time! A kind Lady, quite the musician too. Spent all day playing the piano, from what I hear.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Anyway, an odd story that one, Sir...."
entries.text: Anyway, an odd story that one, Sir. Up and left one day - no explanation, no letter, and left all her things behind.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "They've been stored down in the bas..."
entries.text: They've been stored down in the basement ever since. A shame - such a lovely piano gathering dust in there with all the old boxes...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you ever meet Lady Wilhelmina B..."
entries.text: Did you ever meet Lady Wilhelmina Blake?

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I hear Mister Dupré is mourning the..."
entries.text: I hear Mister Dupré is mourning the loss of his friend.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I... Goodness. I suppose grief trul..."
entries.text: I... Goodness. I suppose grief truly finds us all, doesn't it?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "And what comfort is there in death..."
entries.text: And what comfort is there in death for any of these people? A godless man can't pray for a loved one's soul.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "A tragedy, that's what it is, Sir."
entries.text: A tragedy, that's what it is, Sir.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Third Aspect - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Joyce... You told me before..."
entries.text: Missus Joyce... You told me before that you wished to repent for your actions. Is that still true?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh yes, Mister Ward. It is."
entries.text: Oh yes, Mister Ward. It is.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "In that case... Mister Dupré is in..."
entries.text: In that case... Mister Dupré is in desperate need of your help.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The spirit of his dearest friend ha..."
entries.text: The spirit of his dearest friend has been trapped inside the manor, and only a worshipper of Saint Brigid can set her free.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Saint Brigid? But she..."
entries.text: Saint Brigid? But she...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I had no idea she cared for people..."
entries.text: I had no idea she cared for people such as them. The Lord truly does have a lot to teach me these days, doesn't He?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Yes, Mister Ward. Tell him I'm read..."
entries.text: Yes, Mister Ward. Tell him I'm ready and willing to help. Whatever it takes, I'll be there.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brid - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever heard of the Goddess..."
entries.text: Have you ever heard of the Goddess Bríd?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Not that much, Mister Ward. I know..."
entries.text: Not that much, Mister Ward. I know she is what the pagan folk think of Saint Brigid of Kildare.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Now her, I know. The Mother Saint o..."
entries.text: Now her, I know. The Mother Saint of Ireland. She's the saint of a good many things, from poetry and learning to blacksmithing and livestock.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "She could lay her hand to anything..."
entries.text: She could lay her hand to anything and master it. What a woman.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Have you noticed her crosses around..."
entries.text: Have you noticed her crosses around the house, Sir? The rushes - that's to protect you... the, eh, guest, I mean, from fire and other harm.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Saint Brigid's Cross - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've noticed someone's been putting..."
entries.text: I've noticed someone's been putting Saint Brigid's crosses around the manor.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, that'd be myself, Sir!"
entries.text: Oh, that'd be myself, Sir!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "You know, they protect against flam..."
entries.text: You know, they protect against flames. I thought...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, I thought we could all use so..."
entries.text: Well, I thought we could all use some protection, I suppose.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Vandalised flyer - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this lying about the atrium..."
entries.text: I found this lying about the atrium. Do you know anything about it?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Wouldn't know a thing about that, n..."
entries.text: Wouldn't know a thing about that, now, Sir...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...But they're not wrong, are they?..."
entries.text: ...But they're not wrong, are they? There’s some fierce evil to some of that magic, I tell you.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Stone cross - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I accidentally stumbled into the br..."
entries.text: I accidentally stumbled into the broom closet recently and noticed a stone cross on the cleaning trolley.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "O-oh yes, Sir! That'd be mine, of c..."
entries.text: O-oh yes, Sir! That'd be mine, of course. It'd broken off an old statue that was being tossed out and... w-well, I thought it shouldn't go to waste.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Of course. It is a shame about thos..."
entries.text: Of course. It is a shame about those red stains though, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Ah that's only rust, Sir. I quite l..."
entries.text: Ah that's only rust, Sir. I quite like it, to be honest with you.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "After all, Jesus must've bled when..."
entries.text: After all, Jesus must've bled when he died for our sins.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Detailed drawings - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise the vase drawn her..."
entries.text: Do you recognise the vase drawn here?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, I'm not really one for that s..."
entries.text: Well, I'm not really one for that sort of... Wait.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Come to think of it, it looks a lot..."
entries.text: Come to think of it, it looks a lot like the one Lady Wilhelmina is painted with. You can see her portrait in the atrium.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/washer woman - caitlin

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "What!? Mister Ward, if you are sugg..."
entries.text: What!? Mister Ward, if you are suggesting that the laundry work ain't quality, then I refute it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did I see you washing clothes last..."
entries.text: Did I see you washing clothes last night in the fountain?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did I see you washing clothes in th..."
entries.text: Did I see you washing clothes in the fountain on Friday night?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Miss Murphy and I wash our knuckles..."
entries.text: Miss Murphy and I wash our knuckles to the bone cleaning and bleaching this place - and its linens!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "In the fountain? God, give me stren..."
entries.text: In the fountain? God, give me strength...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Skerritt - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt,..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt, Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...So many of these people, Sir - t..."
entries.text: ...So many of these people, Sir - they're just victims of Mantovani's dark whispers.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But that one, I think he came in ro..."
entries.text: But that one, I think he came in rotten. Too much money, some people. The Lord was clear on moneylenders, was he not?

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Corentine - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Miss Quinn?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, all that time in the library..."
entries.text: Well, all that time in the library can't be any good for her, Sir.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "The poor girl can't possibly unders..."
entries.text: The poor girl can't possibly understand what dangers she's filling her head with. And why doesn't she have a chaperone?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It's only proper for a young lady o..."
entries.text: It's only proper for a young lady of her station, and I don't see any wedding ring... You have to wonder! It spells trouble, if you ask me...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ivy - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I assume you've met Miss McLeod?"
entries.text: I assume you've met Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Apparently, she's the daughter of a..."
entries.text: Apparently, she's the daughter of a laird - which is the Scottish way of saying a lord, as I understand.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I wouldn't have thought you'd see p..."
entries.text: I wouldn't have thought you'd see proper girl like that among such devilish company as this. Just think of it!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Lan Fen - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you happen to have spoken with..."
entries.text: Did you happen to have spoken with Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Thank goodness for her, Sir. It doe..."
entries.text: Thank goodness for her, Sir. It does us good to have at least one guest with a solid head on her shoulders.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "One less person to keep an eye on!"
entries.text: One less person to keep an eye on!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "From what I can tell, there's not a..."
entries.text: From what I can tell, there's not a magical bone in that girl's body.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Darragh - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you speak much with Mister Hunte..."
entries.text: Do you speak much with Mister Hunter?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "When I can. I think it'd be gloomie..."
entries.text: When I can. I think it'd be gloomier around here without him.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Not that he gets to spend much time..."
entries.text: Not that he gets to spend much time indoors with us. I've no idea what keeps him out there so much, certainly it's not keeping the place pretty.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Hedges and gorse don't quite need m..."
entries.text: Hedges and gorse don't quite need much tending.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, but I don't envy him in the win..."
entries.text: Oh, but I don't envy him in the wintertime!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Varley - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you find working with Mister..."
entries.text: How do you find working with Mister Varley?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "He keeps us right, that's for certa..."
entries.text: He keeps us right, that's for certain.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Believe you me, Mister Ward, it's a..."
entries.text: Believe you me, Mister Ward, it's a rare day when you get a smile from that man.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But I won't speak ill - he might be..."
entries.text: But I won't speak ill - he might be dour, but he's a good man.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Seamus - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you find working with Mister..."
entries.text: How do you find working with Mister Doyle?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "That boy... Between you and me, Sir..."
entries.text: That boy... Between you and me, Sir, he could do with half a mind more on his work.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Always has that look about him, too..."
entries.text: Always has that look about him, too, like it's paining him to talk to you. Even more so with Miss Deane - I swear he was sweet on her.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "He's a good lad though - good with..."
entries.text: He's a good lad though - good with Saoirse too. The poor girl's a nervous wreck now, but you should have seen her a year ago.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I think he's coaxing her out of her..."
entries.text: I think he's coaxing her out of her shell - slowly, mind. It'd be a dear thing if he weren't teaching her how to bicker too...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Caitlin - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, tell me about yourself, Missus..."
entries.text: So, tell me about yourself, Missus Joyce.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, I don't know what's to say, Sir..."
entries.text: Oh, I don't know what's to say, Sir.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I came to work here not long after..."
entries.text: I came to work here not long after it opened as a hotel.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "The good Lord never saw fit to grac..."
entries.text: The good Lord never saw fit to grace me with a husband or children, so the most of my life's in this place.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I've got a roof over my head, a war..."
entries.text: I've got a roof over my head, a warm bed in the women's dormitory, and food in my belly. Could be doing a lot worse for myself, I'd say!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "My dear husband passed away some ti..."
entries.text: My dear husband passed away some time ago, and the good Lord never saw fit to grace us with children, so most of my life's in this place.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ines - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've had a moment..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've had a moment to speak with Miss Barbosa, have you?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "That woman is hiding something, Sir..."
entries.text: That woman is hiding something, Sir - mark my words. Barely a word she has for me!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "And why come all the way here from..."
entries.text: And why come all the way here from so far away?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But at least that Mantovani hasn't..."
entries.text: But at least that Mantovani hasn't gotten her claws into her yet. Or at least, it looks that way...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Cathal - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister O'Meara?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Such a handsome lad! I can't believ..."
entries.text: Such a handsome lad! I can't believe he's mixed up in all this.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Either way, that poor thing is tota..."
entries.text: Either way, that poor thing is totally out of his depth - I'm sure of it.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I do hope that witch doesn't drag h..."
entries.text: I do hope that witch doesn't drag him any deeper into her snake pit.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "And by witch you mean...?"
entries.text: And by witch you mean...?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Mantovani, Sir, of course! That acc..."
entries.text: Mantovani, Sir, of course! That accursed Mantovani...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I've heard he speaks with angels, S..."
entries.text: I've heard he speaks with angels, Sir. I just hope they've been sent to him by God, and not the devil.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ettiene - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Toussaint?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Yes, of course! A scholar, he is -..."
entries.text: Yes, of course! A scholar, he is - not steeped in the dark arts like the rest of this lot.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Had all sorts of questions for me t..."
entries.text: Had all sorts of questions for me too, bless his soul. It's nice to have people like you and he appreciate my thoughts.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Evelyn - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Deane?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Me? Oh, well, she..."
entries.text: Me? Oh, well, she...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "She's just a good girl who fell in..."
entries.text: She's just a good girl who fell in with the wrong crowd, Sir - mark my words. I've got a smell for these things.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...Maybe that would make her think..."
entries.text: ...Maybe that would make her think twice about going into Mister Coventry's room every other day.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "A little quiet time with God is all..."
entries.text: A little quiet time with God is all she needs.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But she seems like such a sweet gir..."
entries.text: But she seems like such a sweet girl. It's a sin we've allowed her to be at this ungodly thing.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I don't know her, of course - it's..."
entries.text: I don't know her, of course - it's her first time coming to the hotel.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Dupré?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "That man! He's here all the way fro..."
entries.text: That man! He's here all the way from America, isn't he? Such a haunting figure he cuts...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "What madness could have possessed h..."
entries.text: What madness could have possessed him to travel so far, I wonder?

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on D'Arcy - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus D'Arcy?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, yes. Her."
entries.text: Oh, yes. Her.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I don't know if she's a witch - but..."
entries.text: I don't know if she's a witch - but I suspect she couldn't be any more ungodly if she were.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "She's only recently widowed, I hear..."
entries.text: She's only recently widowed, I hear! And yet she spends all her time with that Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It's hardly proper, Sir..."
entries.text: It's hardly proper, Sir...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Coventry - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well, perhaps I would have gotten t..."
entries.text: Well, perhaps I would have gotten the chance were he not so busy luring Miss Deane to his quarters...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Well. At least he has the decency t..."
entries.text: Well. At least he has the decency to look ordinary. I can't understand what he wants with this séance, really!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I hope he comes to his senses and l..."
entries.text: I hope he comes to his senses and leaves.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Hazel - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I don't know about her, Sir. You ca..."
entries.text: I don't know about her, Sir. You can't trust a woman in that much jewellery.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, she thinks she's big fish among..."
entries.text: Oh, she thinks she's big fish among all these heathens but it's just talk, Sir, trust me.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Mantovani's the real one to worry a..."
entries.text: Mantovani's the real one to worry about...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ruairí - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Doctor Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It's good to have such a distinguis..."
entries.text: It's good to have such a distinguished, local gentleman among the guests, Sir.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "He seems like a smart boy. I'm sure..."
entries.text: He seems like a smart boy. I'm sure he'll come to his senses and drop all this dark business his aunt's gotten him into.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "As much as the help can meet a gues..."
entries.text: As much as the help can meet a guest, Sir. She's quite a woman, though for better or worse, I don't know...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Has all the airs of a decent woman,..."
entries.text: Has all the airs of a decent woman, though, at least.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Miss... Hah. Have I met- Hah!"
entries.text: Miss... Hah. Have I met- Hah!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...Missus Joyce? Are you alright?"
entries.text: ...Missus Joyce? Are you alright?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "...Oh. O-oh, goodness, I am so sorr..."
entries.text: ...Oh. O-oh, goodness, I am so sorry, Sir.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I..."

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Did you need something?"
entries.text: Did you need something?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "No, that's quite alright, Missus Jo..."
entries.text: No, that's quite alright, Missus Joyce...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh. Oh yes, Sir, you just steer cle..."
entries.text: Oh. Oh yes, Sir, you just steer clear of that woman, Sir! That wretched, wretched woman, who... Sir, she...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Saoirse - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you find working with Miss M..."
entries.text: How do you find working with Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, such a sweet girl. So much sadn..."
entries.text: Oh, such a sweet girl. So much sadness in her short life.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Too curious for her own good, thoug..."
entries.text: Too curious for her own good, though. I worry, seeing her wandering around with these heathens and her eager to fill a hole in her heart.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Arwa - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you made Miss Hisham's acquain..."
entries.text: Have you made Miss Hisham's acquaintance?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "That woman... I trust her less than..."
entries.text: That woman... I trust her less than I'd trust the devil.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I've come into rooms - places you w..."
entries.text: I've come into rooms - places you wouldn't expect a guest to be - to find her there! But she's not after the silverware or anything like that!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I'm telling you, Sir, she's after s..."
entries.text: I'm telling you, Sir, she's after something dark. Coming here from so far away - and for what?

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of Father Sinnott?"
entries.text: What do you make of Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Ah, Sir, it is good to have a man o..."
entries.text: Ah, Sir, it is good to have a man of the cloth here during all this.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I've got my crosses up but they can..."
entries.text: I've got my crosses up but they can only do so much!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I feel so much safer with him here."
entries.text: I feel so much safer with him here.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It's like God himself sent him to k..."
entries.text: It's like God himself sent him to keep my soul during all this!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Fiadh - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It's a crying shame, Sir. She shoul..."
entries.text: It's a crying shame, Sir. She should be looking out for that nephew of hers!

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Instead, she's guiding him down tha..."
entries.text: Instead, she's guiding him down that dark path of witchcraft and blood offerings!

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ó Finn - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "He keeps his room tidy. Almost unsl..."
entries.text: He keeps his room tidy. Almost unslept in. Don't know what to make of him, really - but at least it's handy for me.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinon on Campbell - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know the Reverend, Missus Jo..."
entries.text: Do you know the Reverend, Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Not any more than making him tea when he stops by to talk to the Marquess. He seems fine enough.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Higgins - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed someone around the..."
entries.text: Have you noticed someone around the grounds? A large man, not a guest or staff...?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Can't say I have. Has there been so..."
entries.text: Can't say I have. Has there been someone around?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, I don't like that one bit..."
entries.text: Oh, I don't like that one bit...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Blake - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you find working for Marques..."
entries.text: How do you find working for Marquess Blake?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, Sir, I'd like it a lot better i..."
entries.text: Oh, Sir, I'd like it a lot better if he hadn't decided to host this wretched séance.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I know he misses his wife, but this..."
entries.text: I know he misses his wife, but this just doesn't seem like the right way to honour her memory.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Walter Blake - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Am I correct in thinking that the M..."
entries.text: Am I correct in thinking that the Marquess has a son?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Yes, Sir. But he's a quiet boy. Kee..."
entries.text: Yes, Sir. But he's a quiet boy. Keeps to his room when there's guests in the manor.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But he's a sweet boy. Sometimes you..."
entries.text: But he's a sweet boy. Sometimes you forget he's the young master and not family of your own.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Been that way since the accident. P..."
entries.text: Been that way since the accident. Probably the same before, but that was a while back and he was younger then.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I assume he was hiding then too, ju..."
entries.text: I assume he was hiding then too, just in his mother's petticoat. I don't really recall. He missed her something awful, the poor lad.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/UPDATED Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How are you and Mister Dupré gettin..."
entries.text: How are you and Mister Dupré getting on?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, Sir, it just isn't right. The m..."
entries.text: Oh, Sir, it just isn't right. The man is stricken with grief! From all he's told me of Laura, I've never seen a friendship quite so special as that.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "I've offered what comfort I can, th..."
entries.text: I've offered what comfort I can, the poor lamb. But I know from my Colm it'll be a lifelong ache.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "And how I spent all those days avoi..."
entries.text: And how I spent all those days avoiding him when he first arrived, when all this time... Oh, Sir.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "It's just nice to have someone who..."
entries.text: It's just nice to have someone who understands.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/Open, eager pose - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: It's good to see a friendly face among all these strangers, Missus Joyce.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh! Well, I'm glad you think so, Si..."
entries.text: Oh! Well, I'm glad you think so, Sir. Folks like you and me need to stick together around this lot.

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/Sly, knowing smile - Caitlin

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I have the impression, Missus Joyce..."
entries.text: I have the impression, Missus Joyce, that little gets past you around here.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Oh, no more than any housekeeper, S..."
entries.text: Oh, no more than any housekeeper, Sir. We get all sorts of little insights into the guests, you know...

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/brigit's Cross - Caitlin

entries.text: Your necklace - at a distance, I assumed it was a resurrectix, but now I see it's a Saint Brigid's cross.

entries.label: Caitlin: "Yes, Sir. All my love to God, Jesus..."
entries.text: Yes, Sir. All my love to God, Jesus, and Mary - but I have a special place in my heart for Saint Brigid.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: I keep her close to me as she protects us, Sir. From evil - and from fire too.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "..."

title: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin womens dorm conversation

entries.text: I'm glad my faith in you wasn't misplaced, Sir.

entries.text: Without the means to look into what happened to the girl myself, there's not much I can do.

entries.text: But it's not right, Sir, for no one to do anything at all. I can't do much myself, you know, but I can get the staff to help you.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "They're a bit strange, in their own..."
entries.text: They're a bit strange, in their own ways, but none of them would do a thing like this.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: Come with me, Sir. We'll talk to them.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You're the one who hired me?"
entries.text: You're the one who hired me?

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Mantovani and her wretched séance w..."
entries.text: Mantovani and her wretched séance were bound to get someone hurt sooner or later.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: This wretched séance was bound to get someone hurt sooner or later.

entries.text: It was Missus Joyce who vandalised the flyer! But why?

entries.text: Ora, who is this man? You are late to this event... but you have not missed the heart of it!

entries.text: I'm sorry if I startled you, Ma'am. I'm Declan Ward. Who might you be?

entries.text: My name? My name, Signor... is Carmela Mantovani.

entries.text: Signor Ward. We meet again.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I am the mystic who will conduct th..."
entries.text: I am the mystic who will conduct this Grand Séance, who will channel the forces from the other side while the veil is lowered...

entries.label: Carmela: "...and allow you all to speak with..."
entries.text: ...and allow you all to speak with the dead.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward

entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.text: LEAVE

entries.text: Of course. *cough* Take care.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That's all."
entries.text: That's all.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani

entries.text: It is not just those of us speaking to ghosts who are uncovering secrets, is it, Signor?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani

entries.text: I have had time... to consider. To decide. This is not where I wanted to spend my last days...

entries.text: But at least, this way, my death will have use. The last I have spent on this Grand Séance...

entries.text: It will be something to be remembered. And this contract will serve my family well.

entries.text: Signor Ward, I have a favour I must ask of you.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani

entries.text: *cough* *cough*

entries.text: My name? My name, Signor... is Carmela Mantovani.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani

entries.text: You do not recognise me or my name. I would wager good money that no others came this far west without some idea of those details.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "..."

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Come. Allow me to read your cards...."
entries.text: Come. Allow me to read your cards. Perhaps we can discover your real reason for attending. Maybe you will find a little direction along the way...

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ ACCEPT THE READING ]"
entries.text: [ ACCEPT THE READING ]

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ REFUSE THE READING ]"
entries.text: [ REFUSE THE READING ]

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Thank you madam, but no. I think pe..."
entries.text: Thank you madam, but no. I think perhaps I am more wary of your cards than I expected to be.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "After that display, how could I ref..."
entries.text: After that display, how could I refuse?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Very wise, Signor. Perhaps a more t..."
entries.text: Very wise, Signor. Perhaps a more traditional conversation instead, then?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Come closer then, Signor."
entries.text: Come closer then, Signor.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "A three card spread, Signor."
entries.text: A three card spread, Signor.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "You see? I was not wrong. There is..."
entries.text: You see? I was not wrong. There is more for you here than a mere séance.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "One card for your past, one for you..."
entries.text: One card for your past, one for your present, and one for your future.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Let us begin."
entries.text: Let us begin.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "The Three of Swords."
entries.text: The Three of Swords.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "The Tower."
entries.text: The Tower.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh! Oh, the wind!"
entries.text: Oh! Oh, the wind!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...Indeed. Though I am unsure what..."
entries.text: ...Indeed. Though I am unsure what all this means.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And now...Perhaps a more traditiona..."
entries.text: And now...Perhaps a more traditional conversation, sì?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Swords cover the intellectual realm..."
entries.text: Swords cover the intellectual realm. And this one in particular deals with heartbreak.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Major Arcana. These cards deal with..."
entries.text: Major Arcana. These cards deal with big, life-changing affairs.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "As you can see, lightning, fire, de..."
entries.text: As you can see, lightning, fire, destruction, and chaos are the purview of this card.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Love, perhaps? But also grief, sorr..."
entries.text: Love, perhaps? But also grief, sorrow. Perhaps even betrayal.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Surely your cards can tell you whic..."
entries.text: Surely your cards can tell you which?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "They're pieces of paper, Signor! Th..."
entries.text: They're pieces of paper, Signor! They can't answer anything. They put you in front of questions that you may choose to ask yourself - or not.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "If this card, if these cards, are t..."
entries.text: If this card, if these cards, are to mean anything, only you will know it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That sounds... bad?"
entries.text: That sounds... bad?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "What is 'bad'? This card would sugg..."
entries.text: What is 'bad'? This card would suggest that you are - or soon will be - in the middle of something significant and unavoidable.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "'Bad' is not the right word. But ne..."
entries.text: 'Bad' is not the right word. But neither is it 'good'...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What does that mean?"
entries.text: What does that mean?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Everything means something, Signor...."
entries.text: Everything means something, Signor. Normally a card is upright, or reversed.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "When upright, this card - the Wheel..."
entries.text: When upright, this card - the Wheel of Fortune - means good luck, prosperity.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Reversed it means, as you may suspe..."
entries.text: Reversed it means, as you may suspect, bad luck and misfortune.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "On its side? I believe it means bot..."
entries.text: On its side? I believe it means both are possible. I think your future - perhaps all of our futures - are very much in your hands.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "However you resolve your Tower - th..."
entries.text: However you resolve your Tower - this here and now, your own reason for attending - it seems likely to affect us all...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It means, Signor, tread carefully b..."
entries.text: It means, Signor, tread carefully but act decisively. So much hangs in the balance.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Signor Ward. You have come for a ca..."
entries.text: Signor Ward. You have come for a card reading, then?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "If you'd be so kind."
entries.text: If you'd be so kind.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It is a kindness to give me an excu..."
entries.text: It is a kindness to give me an excuse to do so. I miss my old ways, sometimes.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Come. Shall I read your cards?"
entries.text: Come. Shall I read your cards?

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I wish there was more I could do."
entries.text: I wish there was more I could do.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "As do I, Signor."
entries.text: As do I, Signor.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But this is how it is. I have pushe..."
entries.text: But this is how it is. I have pushed myself for so long.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I was young when I left my family f..."
entries.text: I was young when I left my family for a better life - and I found it. I enjoyed the finest things with the finest company.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But for all my fame, I have little..."
entries.text: But for all my fame, I have little to show.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And faced with the end, I finally r..."
entries.text: And faced with the end, I finally realise what wealth I had at home.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Like everyone in my position, I tho..."
entries.text: Like everyone in my position, I thought I would have more time. I thought I could go back, fix that which I broke.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "What a cliché I have become!"
entries.text: What a cliché I have become!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Maybe this is what the ghosts are t..."
entries.text: Maybe this is what the ghosts are trying to tell us? That our time is limited and we would do well to be more precious with it.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "One way or the other, I am soon to..."
entries.text: One way or the other, I am soon to find out...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Photograph of Deane - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this woman?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this woman?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I do. She is... Ah... Oh, Signorina..."
entries.text: I do. She is... Ah... Oh, Signorina Deane! We have spoken a little. She's somewhere around here.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/A Map of the Region - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of this?"
entries.text: What do you make of this?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Who here has need of this? Well, I..."
entries.text: Who here has need of this? Well, I suppose it might be useful if you wanted to go walking...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "If they could brave this weather, a..."
entries.text: If they could brave this weather, also.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Séance advert - Carmela

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "True, I am. Though how a hotel so f..."
entries.text: True, I am. Though how a hotel so far from the civilised world heard of me, I do not know...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Carmella Mantovani? So you are the..."
entries.text: Carmella Mantovani? So you are the person leading the séance?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I have some fame, yes, but this muc..."
entries.text: I have some fame, yes, but this much? A surprise to me.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Alcohol - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I thought you might like this."
entries.text: I thought you might like this.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah? Oh, no, I don't need it - but t..."
entries.text: Ah? Oh, no, I don't need it - but thank you for the offer.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Blake Family - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems the Blake family have quit..."
entries.text: It seems the Blake family have quite the lineage.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Well... If they don't want to speak..."
entries.text: Well... If they don't want to speak to me themselves, alive or dead, then it's not my business to know.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I'm not going to pry into my employ..."
entries.text: I'm not going to pry into my employer's private life... That wouldn't make me any friends.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Statement Mister Varley - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Varley said Miss Deane check..."
entries.text: Mister Varley said Miss Deane checked out some time ago.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Did she? Hm. I suppose she had some..."
entries.text: Did she? Hm. I suppose she had something to see to somewhere else.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hauntings - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you think there are ghosts aroun..."
entries.text: Do you think there are ghosts around this place?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "You don't have a sense for them, th..."
entries.text: You don't have a sense for them, then? There are more ghosts here than there are guests!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Even in my sleep, I hear them... *c..."
entries.text: Even in my sleep, I hear them... *cough*

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "There is a reason this is the place..."
entries.text: There is a reason this is the place we gather - so many years of tragedy and misery to trap so many souls.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "The Blakes have not always been goo..."
entries.text: The Blakes have not always been good people, I think. But this generation, they are different, sì?

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Séance's Purpose - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I take it you've been to a great de..."
entries.text: I take it you've been to a great deal of séances.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Plenty. For loved ones that have pa..."
entries.text: Plenty. For loved ones that have passed, to speak to legends, just to speak with what is behind the veil...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But I've never before tried to bind..."
entries.text: But I've never before tried to bind a ghost to this side. I will have my work cut out for me.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Leaving letter - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Deane left a letter excusing h..."
entries.text: Miss Deane left a letter excusing herself from the event.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "She did? Well, Signorina Deane is a..."
entries.text: She did? Well, Signorina Deane is always up to something or other...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Though... I am surprised she would..."
entries.text: Though... I am surprised she would miss such a thing as this.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/entertainment schedule - Carmela

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "An entertaining week, certainly."
entries.text: An entertaining week, certainly.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But I think that perhaps you do not..."
entries.text: But I think that perhaps you do not really care for my experiences? If you are seeking answers, you should consult the cards, Signor Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Consult the cards? I see a bridge g..."
entries.text: Consult the cards? I see a bridge game happened on Tuesday night. Yes, perhaps that is useful. Is that... is that what you meant?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "If you found that useful, let's say..."
entries.text: If you found that useful, let's say... yes?

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Second Sight - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about Miss McL..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about Miss McLeod's Second Sight?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Mm... I do not know it by the name...."
entries.text: Mm... I do not know it by the name. But she sees the future, doesn't she? Has visions.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It wouldn't be something I'd want....."
entries.text: It wouldn't be something I'd want... Sometimes it is better not to know.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Mister O'Meara Statement - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister O'Meara said he saw Miss Dea..."
entries.text: Mister O'Meara said he saw Miss Deane late on Tuesday night, and that she seemed to have been drinking.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah, well, that's not my business, S..."
entries.text: Ah, well, that's not my business, Signor.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Bedroom skeleton key - Carmela

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Caro Dio! Put that back exactly whe..."
entries.text: Caro Dio! Put that back exactly where you found it, if you have any sense at all!

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Doyle's Statement - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Apparently, Mister Doyle overheard..."
entries.text: Apparently, Mister Doyle overheard Miss Deane arguing with a man on Tuesday evening.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Someone always argues with someone..."
entries.text: Someone always argues with someone at these things... Especially when Signorina Deane is involved.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Thankfully, I have no concerns with..."
entries.text: Thankfully, I have no concerns with her... but that is not common, I do not think.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Mysterious figure in window - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Walking back from the gardens, I co..."
entries.text: Walking back from the gardens, I could have sworn I saw someone watching me from an upstairs window.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Is that so? It might be that it's a..."
entries.text: Is that so? It might be that it's another member of the family... Or perhaps it's just another ghost.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Dead End - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems that Miss Deane walked int..."
entries.text: It seems that Miss Deane walked into the hedge maze on Tuesday night, but there's no sign of her from there.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "So - you mean to say she did not si..."
entries.text: So - you mean to say she did not sign out? But then, where could she be? Someone must look!

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hermetic Order - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know anything abou..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about the Hermetic Order Of The Golden Dawn?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh, they're one of the magical soci..."
entries.text: Oh, they're one of the magical societies you'll find around London.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "They and I have never been interest..."
entries.text: They and I have never been interested in the same sort of magic, though, so I did not want to join.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Bridge game - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Were you at the bridge game the oth..."
entries.text: Were you at the bridge game the other night?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Me? Ah, no - the only cards that in..."
entries.text: Me? Ah, no - the only cards that interest me are the tarot. It was those I was reading while they played their game.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Statement, Dupré - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Dupré tells me you were kind..."
entries.text: Mister Dupré tells me you were kind enough to give him a reading on Tuesday.
