entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I do not know if it was a kindness,..."
entries.text: I do not know if it was a kindness, more... an excuse to practise something familiar.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But he is right - I read his cards..."
entries.text: But he is right - I read his cards for him.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I hope the reading helps him find t..."
entries.text: I hope the reading helps him find the spirit he is seeking.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Exorcism - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Would you know anything about exorc..."
entries.text: Would you know anything about exorcisms, Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Exorcism? Oh, no, Signor. I talk wi..."
entries.text: Exorcism? Oh, no, Signor. I talk with the dead. If I *cough* were to chase them away, I would be out of work!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But there are many magicians here...."
entries.text: But there are many magicians here. Someone more versed in death is certain to know anything you could ask.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Dreams - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had any strange dreams sin..."
entries.text: Have you had any strange dreams since arriving here?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "In a place like this? How could one..."
entries.text: In a place like this? How could one not?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "There is a... force at work in the..."
entries.text: There is a... force at work in the dreams here. You can feel, it, no? It is not another practitioner - it does not have that focus.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "What it is and what it wants, I do..."
entries.text: What it is and what it wants, I do not know. *cough* Perhaps it will be our guest at the séance? Aha!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But the recurring one. The maze of..."
entries.text: But the recurring one. The maze of corridors luring me to the séance? That is enticing.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Sigil - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does this symbol look familiar to y..."
entries.text: Does this symbol look familiar to you, Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I don't believe so!"
entries.text: I don't believe so!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But I must admit it doesn't feel li..."
entries.text: But I must admit it doesn't feel like the kind of symbol I'd want to look at, Signor Ward.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Photo of a child - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This is a photo of Miss Murphy's ch..."
entries.text: This is a photo of Miss Murphy's child, who has been taken from her. Do you know of any magical means through which she might see her?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Mio Dio! Taken from her? This is mo..."
entries.text: Mio Dio! Taken from her? This is monstrous behaviour!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But I know of no way to help the po..."
entries.text: But I know of no way to help the poor girl...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah! Signorina Callaghan, she can do..."
entries.text: Ah! Signorina Callaghan, she can do the scrying! You must go see her. At once!

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Grand Séance - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You're to be our guide for the séan..."
entries.text: You're to be our guide for the séance, I understand? That's an impressive undertaking.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah, it is but one among many, Signo..."
entries.text: Ah, it is but one among many, Signor Ward! Every party wants a cartomancer.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Though I must tell you... there is..."
entries.text: Though I must tell you... there is something about the shadows. Too long, too many in the wrong place.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I am sure it is just the amount of..."
entries.text: I am sure it is just the amount of ghosts lining up to speak with us and not... something else.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ha! Do not worry, this is good - wh..."
entries.text: Ha! Do not worry, this is good - what a night we will have to remember!

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Talks schedule - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I hear you're one of the speakers f..."
entries.text: I hear you're one of the speakers for this event.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh yes, yes! I am speaking on the g..."
entries.text: Oh yes, yes! I am speaking on the ghost, you see.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The one you'll summon?"
entries.text: The one you'll summon?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Nono, more the nature of the ghost...."
entries.text: Nono, more the nature of the ghost. I must educate, I must be...barriera. I must not dazzle without shielding from the glare, no?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Sprits are but the echoes of a hear..."
entries.text: Sprits are but the echoes of a heart, Signor Ward. I should not wish to see them break.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hedonistic Gala - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Marquess Blake seems to have spared..."
entries.text: Marquess Blake seems to have spared no expense on this event.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I think I am worth the money, no?"
entries.text: I think I am worth the money, no?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I meant the ball last night."
entries.text: I meant the ball last night.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah yes. The ball. I worry we might..."
entries.text: Ah yes. The ball. I worry we might have provoked some spirits, but the Marquess insisted on the drugs.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Part of attuning ourselves to this..."
entries.text: Part of attuning ourselves to this place and its frequency.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And the others, they seemed happy w..."
entries.text: And the others, they seemed happy with the experience, no?

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Occurrences - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed anything out of pl..."
entries.text: Have you noticed anything out of place here, Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh, yes, Signor. The spiders, for o..."
entries.text: Oh, yes, Signor. The spiders, for one thing.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I saw a bird last Thursday. Little,..."
entries.text: I saw a bird last Thursday. Little, little. All caught up in their webs.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I made a small grave for it beside..."
entries.text: I made a small grave for it beside the stables. But you know what I found the next day?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Don't tell me it was empty?"
entries.text: Don't tell me it was empty?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I found spiders. Littered across th..."
entries.text: I found spiders. Littered across the grave, feathers through their bellies. Like, eh, offerings.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I never knew why people were scared..."
entries.text: I never knew why people were scared of spiders. Never knew. There are worse things that chase them.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Ritual Markings - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I stumbled upon the evidence of a r..."
entries.text: I stumbled upon the evidence of a ritual being performed upstairs.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "You did? Hah! It's good to know tha..."
entries.text: You did? Hah! It's good to know that I'm not the one doing all the work around here.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Fetters - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about fetters,..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about fetters, Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "These are what binds us to this wor..."
entries.text: These are what binds us to this world after death. Their "unfinished business". Only for the dead, they say - sciocchezze! It starts with the living.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Always business. Always unfinished...."
entries.text: Always business. Always unfinished. Always something to do. Or what would be the point?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Why some can leave it behind and ot..."
entries.text: Why some can leave it behind and others not? That is down to the person's personality and the situation.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Sketches of strange symbol - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do these sketches strike any chords..."
entries.text: Do these sketches strike any chords with you?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "...Yes. Perhaps a D minor. Oh, a cl..."
entries.text: ...Yes. Perhaps a D minor. Oh, a clear D Minor could dredge up visions of my darkest moments, Signor Ward.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I suspect this symbol does the same..."
entries.text: I suspect this symbol does the same. I cannot say why. It is simply how it feels to look at it.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/well scrying - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I gather Miss Callaghan has learned..."
entries.text: I gather Miss Callaghan has learned a way to use well water to see over great distances?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Hmph. Yes, and she makes it look ea..."
entries.text: Hmph. Yes, and she makes it look easy, does she not?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "To think, she has to keep such a wo..."
entries.text: To think, she has to keep such a wonderful secret so men in frocks do not take her to the flames!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "So many of your people have lost lo..."
entries.text: So many of your people have lost loved ones to the Americas because of your famine. Imagine they could stay in touch!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "With only an intention, she was abl..."
entries.text: With only an intention, she was able to guide me to see my famiglia.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Deane's room - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know where Miss Deane was st..."
entries.text: Do you know where Miss Deane was staying when she was at the manor?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Past tense? She has left? Now you s..."
entries.text: Past tense? She has left? Now you say it, I have *cough* not seen her much lately. I had almost forgotten she was here...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "As to her room... I have forgotten..."
entries.text: As to her room... I have forgotten that, too. La Vita e Cosi.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Magical Grimoire - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this book, Miss Ma..."
entries.text: Do you recognise this book, Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "The book? No. But its...feeling? To..."
entries.text: The book? No. But its...feeling? Too familiar for my liking.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "There is powerful magic in those pa..."
entries.text: There is powerful magic in those pages, Signor Ward. Fate-choosing magic.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I do not know it fully, but my card..."
entries.text: I do not know it fully, but my cards don't like it, absolutely. They don't know which way to turn.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Miss Deane's Invitation - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Someone told me Miss Deane was spec..."
entries.text: Someone told me Miss Deane was specially invited to the séance.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh... like me? They invited others?..."
entries.text: Oh... like me? They invited others? Oh, Signor Ward. Will I never be enough for these rich people?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Oh. I do not think..."
entries.text: Oh. I do not think...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh... Signor Ward, please. Of cours..."
entries.text: Oh... Signor Ward, please. Of course, others were asked.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I wonder who else?"
entries.text: I wonder who else?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Myself, Signor Ó Finn, and now Sign..."
entries.text: Myself, Signor Ó Finn, and now Signorina Deane.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh... Signor Ward, please. I am mak..."
entries.text: Oh... Signor Ward, please. I am making fun. What do I care who has been invited alongside me? I am still numero uno!

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Coded Papers - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this page covered in strang..."
entries.text: I found this page covered in strange dots. I was wondering if they might mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Hmm...I don't play much with this k..."
entries.text: Hmm...I don't play much with this kind of magic, but it seems to me like a hidden message.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Whatever is beneath that pattern is..."
entries.text: Whatever is beneath that pattern is something the caster would not want you to see, Signor...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Threatening Flier - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Someone mentioned you've been recei..."
entries.text: Someone mentioned you've been receiving threats. I'm so sorry to hear that.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah! You mean my fans?"
entries.text: Ah! You mean my fans?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Fans?"
entries.text: Fans?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "A fan is just a heart-obsessed, no?..."
entries.text: A fan is just a heart-obsessed, no? I treat all my fans with love.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And also wear pointy shoes, in case..."
entries.text: And also wear pointy shoes, in case they love me back wrong.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Conductor of the Séance - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So you are the mystic leading us in..."
entries.text: So you are the mystic leading us in the Grand Séance?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Sì. While I began my career with th..."
entries.text: Sì. While I began my career with the tarot - and I love it dearly - it does not provide the same show as a séance!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "There is nothing like it. To press..."
entries.text: There is nothing like it. To press your hand to the veil, and feel another on the other side... *cough* the spirits calling back...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And this one! Where the veil will f..."
entries.text: And this one! Where the veil will fall down like stage curtains! There will be nothing to compare, Signor, I assure you!

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Family - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have family back home, Miss..."
entries.text: Do you have family back home, Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Yes, a big one! More uncles, aunts,..."
entries.text: Yes, a big one! More uncles, aunts, cousins, nieces, and nephews than you could count!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "All in one another's pockets, knowi..."
entries.text: All in one another's pockets, knowing business and having opinions.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Labouring on the same farmlands, da..."
entries.text: Labouring on the same farmlands, day in and out, with no hope for a better life.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I miss them. When I was young, it w..."
entries.text: I miss them. When I was young, it was a terrible life for me. But now, as I age?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I had hoped..."
entries.text: I had hoped...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "..."

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah, do not mind me, Signor Ward."
entries.text: Ah, do not mind me, Signor Ward.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Health - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you feeling alright, Miss Manto..."
entries.text: Are you feeling alright, Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh, why do you...? *cough* *cough*"
entries.text: Oh, why do you...? *cough* *cough*

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I'm alright. I'm fine! It is just a..."
entries.text: I'm alright. I'm fine! It is just a cough.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Perhaps a cold from the weather. Lo..."
entries.text: Perhaps a cold from the weather. London is foggy, but here - it is just damp. To the bone.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Chiave del sigillo - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you remind me what this is for?"
entries.text: Can you remind me what this is for?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "The lockbox in my room, Signor Ward..."
entries.text: The lockbox in my room, Signor Ward, the one that contains the money for my family - it can only be unlocked with a sigil. This sigil.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "You... are up to the task, sì?"
entries.text: You... are up to the task, sì?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll see it done, Miss Mantovani."
entries.text: I'll see it done, Miss Mantovani.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Good. I do not want to think the ca..."
entries.text: Good. I do not want to think the cards led me astray, not so close to the end...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Séance contract - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Forgive me if it's impolite to ask,..."
entries.text: Forgive me if it's impolite to ask, but... am I right in thinking an event, such as this one, must pay quite well for you?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Is it impolite? I suppose it may be..."
entries.text: Is it impolite? I suppose it may be, so you and I, Signor, we will keep it a secret.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It does pay well, very well. Better..."
entries.text: It does pay well, very well. Better than any I have hosted *cough* before, in fact! I did not come here for the weather alone!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I think Marquess Blake was very anx..."
entries.text: I think Marquess Blake was very anxious for it to happen, you see.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are your plans for the weekend..."
entries.text: What are your plans for the weekend?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh, but I plan to spend much of my..."
entries.text: Oh, but I plan to spend much of my weekend giving readings in the hedge maze. When I am free, of course...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And of course... I *cough* *cough*..."
entries.text: And of course... I *cough* *cough* - excuse me - have my talk today at five.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But mostly, my energies will be foc..."
entries.text: But mostly, my energies will be focused on preparing for the Silent Dinner and Grand Séance in the evening.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "After this, I am to meet Signorina..."
entries.text: After this, I am to meet Signorina Callaghan for dinner at seven. I think she intends to, how you say, chew my ear off about this whole weekend.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And there is the ball this evening...."
entries.text: And there is the ball this evening. That will be quite the event, I'm sure!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are your plans for today?"
entries.text: What are your plans for today?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "And tomorrow?"
entries.text: And tomorrow?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Again tomorrow I will spend some ti..."
entries.text: Again tomorrow I will spend some time giving readings in the maze.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What would you make of a reading ma..."
entries.text: What would you make of a reading made up of 'The Hanged Man', the 'Ten of Pentacles', and the 'Death' cards?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "So... Let me see... Two Major Arcan..."
entries.text: So... Let me see... Two Major Arcana in one spread - there is a lot going on, perhaps... turmoil in the recipient. First, the cards themselves:

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "The Hanged Man, he represents sacri..."
entries.text: The Hanged Man, he represents sacrifice, new perspectives, higher learnings - this kind of thing. It is a card of great wisdom and personal growth.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Death - now this can, of course, me..."
entries.text: Death - now this can, of course, mean death. But, rarely is this the case. It symbolises more of a... transformation or transition in life. A fork in the road of life, sì?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "The Ten of Pentacles is for legacy..."
entries.text: The Ten of Pentacles is for legacy and prosperity being passed down through generations.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It is hard to comment on a spread n..."
entries.text: It is hard to comment on a spread not knowing the recipient, their question, all this.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "And are there other ways to read th..."
entries.text: And are there other ways to read this?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Of course! There are many ways to i..."
entries.text: Of course! There are many ways to interpret the cards! Take an extreme, for example.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Mind you, this is a shallow reading..."
entries.text: Mind you, this is a shallow reading and only takes the face value of the cards into account, but shows how wide a range of interpretations there are, sì?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But a cold reading of this? I could..."
entries.text: But a cold reading of this? I could take it to mean that somebody needs to make a sacrifice and undergo a transition to gain a new perspective. They do this, and they may find something they seek - a form of enduring happiness, perhaps?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "In a literal way, these cards could..."
entries.text: In a literal way, these cards could mean a person must undertake the ultimate sacrifice - death. A legacy might be created, then, through the nature of the death itself. Or maybe the Hanged Man returns here, and new learning is left in their wake, which forms the legacy.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever seen a woman's ghost..."
entries.text: Have you ever seen a woman's ghost by the firepit?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I have felt a presence, but no, I h..."
entries.text: I have felt a presence, but no, I have not seen her.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "She does look like her. I felt like..."
entries.text: She does look like her. I felt like she was trying to share something, something important with me.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Could you find a way to communicate..."
entries.text: Could you find a way to communicate with her, perhaps? She has manifested to you. Perhaps you have a better chance of understanding her.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How am I meant to reach her if you..."
entries.text: How am I meant to reach her if you cannot?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "You think about this all wrong. Bec..."
entries.text: You think about this all wrong. Because I cannot do it does not mean you cannot. Find something, a spirit board perhaps? Then see what she is trying to tell us.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Tell me, Signor - is this her?"
entries.text: Tell me, Signor - is this her?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I... I think, yes?"
entries.text: I... I think, yes?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Signor Dupré left this with me the..."
entries.text: Signor Dupré left this with me the other day. He is seeking a spirit - perhaps the one you have found?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "At first, I thought this was Signor..."
entries.text: At first, I thought this was Signorina Deane, but he assures me she is not...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Take the picture. Maybe it will hel..."
entries.text: Take the picture. Maybe it will help you keep her in your mind.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Could you find a way to communicate..."
entries.text: Could you find a way to communicate with her, perhaps? She has manifested to you. Perhaps you have a better chance of understanding her.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/gauge - carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know what the strange device..."
entries.text: Do you know what the strange device in the atrium is for?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Certo! Is it not a measure of how s..."
entries.text: Certo! Is it not a measure of how successful we will be?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "This is what the Marquess tells me...."
entries.text: This is what the Marquess tells me. I cannot recall what it measures. Ghosts or the veil or such? Ah, maledetta memoria, I do not know. Sorry.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/washer woman - carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "When I arrived here... I saw a woma..."
entries.text: When I arrived here... I saw a woman washing what appeared to be your shawl in the fountain out front.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh? Are you sure - mine is dry, in..."
entries.text: Oh? Are you sure - mine is dry, in my room?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I think it was an omen."
entries.text: I think it was an omen.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah. A spectre of death, perhaps? Sh..."
entries.text: Ah. A spectre of death, perhaps? She knows, then, that my end is near.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh, do not look at me this way. It..."
entries.text: Oh, do not look at me this way. It is of my own doing. I pushed myself too hard all these years.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "This is my last séance. My last......"
entries.text: This is my last séance. My last... anything. I have made peace with that.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The flyer you found on your door......"
entries.text: The flyer you found on your door... Are you okay?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ha! Signor! This is not the first t..."
entries.text: Ha! Signor! This is not the first time that such a thing has happened!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But I will give them marks for thea..."
entries.text: But I will give them marks for theatrics! Right through the eye, they stuck it!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So you are not worried?"
entries.text: So you are not worried?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "*cough* *cough*"
entries.text: *cough* *cough*

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I am... not scared of death, Signor..."
entries.text: I am... not scared of death, Signor.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And this is but a scare tactic. The..."
entries.text: And this is but a scare tactic. They hope only to chase me off.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Anyone willing to go further would..."
entries.text: Anyone willing to go further would have gone there to begin with.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "They would not have given a warning..."
entries.text: They would not have given a warning, surely...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Worn tarot - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You must be very fond of that tarot..."
entries.text: You must be very fond of that tarot deck.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It shows in the wear, does it? Howe..."
entries.text: It shows in the wear, does it? However precious something is, however much you love it, time will change it.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It has served me well and has given..."
entries.text: It has served me well and has given me some very *cough*  interesting readings over the years.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "You can have a reading yourself, if..."
entries.text: You can have a reading yourself, if you so wish, Signor! You need only meet me when I am doing readings in the hedge maze.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "For such a special occasion, I wish..."
entries.text: For such a special occasion, I wish to put the cards to good use, and it will be, as they say, on the house.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I will be offering readings all wee..."
entries.text: I will be offering readings all weekend in the hedge maze.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "This is a Visconti-Sforza deck, giv..."
entries.text: This is a Visconti-Sforza deck, given to me by the woman who trained me as a child.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Shadows under eyes - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You look tired, Miss Mantovani..."
entries.text: You look tired, Miss Mantovani...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah, oh... No, that's... *cough*"
entries.text: Ah, oh... No, that's... *cough*

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "There is a lot of... strange energy..."
entries.text: There is a lot of... strange energy in this place. It is difficult to sleep in a place so... beset with spirits...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Shaking hands - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you cold Miss? Your hands are s..."
entries.text: Are you cold Miss? Your hands are shaking.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh, I wouldn't... Don't worry about..."
entries.text: Oh, I wouldn't... Don't worry about that. I have been... *cough* *cough*

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "You are right, of course, I should..."
entries.text: You are right, of course, I should be wearing my shawl.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Skerritt - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Skerritt?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "He introduced himself to me, sì."
entries.text: He introduced himself to me, sì.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "He was very excited. Giddy, almost,..."
entries.text: He was very excited. Giddy, almost, about his involvement, even though he has but a small role in the séance. It was not a fruitful conversation.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Corentine - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Quinn?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Briefly. If it were not for the dea..."
entries.text: Briefly. If it were not for the death following her... I could like her.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But with the heavy veil she carries..."
entries.text: But with the heavy veil she carries about her? I cannot help but feel sorrow for her and hers.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ivy - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Miss McLeod?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Sì. She also reads the cards so we..."
entries.text: Sì. She also reads the cards so we found much to discuss over tea. Wonderful - a talented young woman.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I gave her a reading. She is at the..."
entries.text: I gave her a reading. She is at the crossroads of living a true life, or not. I hope she finds a way to pick correctly.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Lan Fen - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus Lau?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Signora Lau, sì! Signorina McLeod i..."
entries.text: Signora Lau, sì! Signorina McLeod introduced her to me. Her chaperone, I am told. She did not talk as much as Signorina McLeod did.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Still, she was very polite. I think..."
entries.text: Still, she was very polite. I think, talk of magic is not so interesting to her - though she did pay some attention to her charge's cards.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Varley - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Varley?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Varley?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But of course! He is my main point..."
entries.text: But of course! He is my main point of contact for this event. Everything I ask for, he gets me.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "We would have no séance without him..."
entries.text: We would have no séance without him. People say he is cold, but I see how much work he has to do behind the scenes.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Caitlin - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the housekeeper?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I... do not think she likes me."
entries.text: I... do not think she likes me.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I have done many events like this...."
entries.text: I have done many events like this. Often, I meet a family member who is against my presence.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Why do you say that?"
entries.text: Why do you say that?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But I think, to her, I am just a wi..."
entries.text: But I think, to her, I am just a witch.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Some cannot hide this. Signora Joyc..."
entries.text: Some cannot hide this. Signora Joyce, she hides it well enough.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Darragh - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the stable maste..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to the stable master?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "The grounds and maze are his domain..."
entries.text: The grounds and maze are his domain, so of course we spoke!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I imagine there is no nook or crann..."
entries.text: I imagine there is no nook or cranny that he does not know secret ways in out of.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Doyle - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the porter?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the porter?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "He is not so talkative, I find."
entries.text: He is not so talkative, I find.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I should not have done so without h..."
entries.text: I should not have done so without his permission, but one day I did a reading about him - it was very... confused.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It was as if his past and present w..."
entries.text: It was as if his past and present were unrelated. I wish I could ask him, but of course, I cannot.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Maybe this is the reason he does no..."
entries.text: Maybe this is the reason he does not talk so much?

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ines - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "She is the girl from Brazil, sì? Sh..."
entries.text: She is the girl from Brazil, sì? She is not here for the magic, so we talked about life in our countries.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Both our homes have been going thro..."
entries.text: Both our homes have been going through big changes these last few years. She has fled hers, I would return to mine, if only...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ettiene - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Touissant?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Touissant?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh, yes! And meeting him here was n..."
entries.text: Oh, yes! And meeting him here was not for the first time.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "He has... investigated me, you know..."
entries.text: He has... investigated me, you know? He was very polite about it, and it did not take long to conclude.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "After he... what would you call it,..."
entries.text: After he... what would you call it, approved me? After that, my demand shot up!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I know some people do not like him..."
entries.text: I know some people do not like him - but I have never minded him. I like his company.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Cathal - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister O'Meara?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I have. We spoke briefly - he seems..."
entries.text: I have. We spoke briefly - he seems an... interesting young man.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "There is something... beautiful abo..."
entries.text: There is something... beautiful about him. Around him. Some... pale, shining haze.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I pulled a card for it - the Seven..."
entries.text: I pulled a card for it - the Seven of Swords. Trickery and cunning. I hope Signor O'Meara will be... okay...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Dupré - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Dupré?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Ah, the man from America."
entries.text: Ah, the man from America.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Yes, we have spoken. I didn't know..."
entries.text: Yes, we have spoken. I didn't know his face, so I wanted - well, most of the new faces are from near here, are they not?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "A funeral director. What a thing to..."
entries.text: A funeral director. What a thing to find here. And at this time. The universe, she is a wily one.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on D'Arcy - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Missus D'Arcy?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I have not seen her before, but I k..."
entries.text: I have not seen her before, but I know her name - I have a friend in London who adores her books.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I am surprised to learn she is a me..."
entries.text: I am surprised to learn she is a member of the Golden Dawn. She does not seem very versed in all this. Perhaps she is new to the society?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I wonder if there will be a séance..."
entries.text: I wonder if there will be a séance in her next book?

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Coventry - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I gave him a reading. He is lost, o..."
entries.text: I gave him a reading. He is lost, or was at least. Now he is, perhaps, found again. His future was more open than I expected for a man of his age. Bene per lui!

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Hazel - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Here? Sì. It was not for the first..."
entries.text: Here? Sì. It was not for the first time. We have crossed paths before, in London.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "There and here she avoids me. Maybe..."
entries.text: There and here she avoids me. Maybe I am stealing business from her?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Though, I think maybe she avoids me..."
entries.text: Though, I think maybe she avoids me for another reason? I do not know, she does not show up in my cards.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ruairi - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I have! I have never met him before..."
entries.text: I have! I have never met him before this event, but I am so pleased to have done so here.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I think that we understand each oth..."
entries.text: I think that we understand each other. I think, perhaps, I have made a friend. That is always a welcome surprise.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "His attempts to modernise certain p..."
entries.text: His attempts to modernise certain practices are intriguing! What wonders this age brings with it!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I wish I could be around when he cr..."
entries.text: I wish I could be around when he cracks it, so I could see and congratulate him on the achievement...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Evelyn - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've met Miss Dea..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've met Miss Deane, have you?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "We have met. Not here, before in Lo..."
entries.text: We have met. Not here, before in London - many times.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "She flutters from person to person..."
entries.text: She flutters from person to person to suit her own agenda; I have seen the damage she has caused, so I stay away.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "She cannot poison the flower she ca..."
entries.text: She cannot poison the flower she cannot land on.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Carmela - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, tell me about yourself, Miss Ma..."
entries.text: So, tell me about yourself, Miss Mantovani.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Hah! Oh, I always hate this. Ah......"
entries.text: Hah! Oh, I always hate this. Ah... I am from the north of Italy, a farming community.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It was clear from a young age, I wa..."
entries.text: It was clear from a young age, I was... gifted. *cough* I would predict things, find lost items. This was cute...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "My nonna, she took me to see a stre..."
entries.text: My nonna, she took me to see a strega - a witch.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I was taught the tarot and *cough*..."
entries.text: I was taught the tarot and *cough* our folk magic. Italy has its own magic, of course.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Soon I was good enough that I made..."
entries.text: Soon I was good enough that I made a name for myself...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Money and fame came not long after...."
entries.text: Money and fame came not long after. Which is how I came to be here, sì?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "...but once I heard the dead, the p..."
entries.text: ...but once I heard the dead, the people of my town grew cold. Even some in mia famiglia grew distant.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You have dealt with Marquess Blake,..."
entries.text: You have dealt with Marquess Blake, yes?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh yes, from the very beginning. It..."
entries.text: Oh yes, from the very beginning. It was he who reached out to me to come and host this event.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...You think he regrets inviting yo..."
entries.text: ...You think he regrets inviting you?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "No, no. Nothing like that. I'm just..."
entries.text: No, no. Nothing like that. I'm just not sure it was entirely him behind those eyes...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "He has been very welcoming. Ah, but..."
entries.text: He has been very welcoming. Ah, but...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "But?"
entries.text: But?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It is his eyes, Signor. They scare..."
entries.text: It is his eyes, Signor. They scare me. Their intensity. I'm not always sure what is behind those eyes...

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Though how he had heard of me, I do..."
entries.text: Though how he had heard of me, I do not know!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Is it just grief that drives him? S..."
entries.text: Is it just grief that drives him? Something more?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "There is a part of me that worries..."
entries.text: There is a part of me that worries I am enabling something in him...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Fiadh - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you feel about Miss Callagha..."
entries.text: How do you feel about Miss Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "We do not 'share eyes' on the matte..."
entries.text: We do not 'share eyes' on the matter of this event, but she is a good woman and skilled practitioner.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I think elsewhere we could get on l..."
entries.text: I think elsewhere we could get on like a building on fire. Here, we are at odds.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Sinnott - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the Father yet?"
entries.text: Have you met the Father yet?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "That man needs some sun!"
entries.text: That man needs some sun!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I am a good Catholic girl; of cours..."
entries.text: I am a good Catholic girl; of course, I have met with him! How fortunate for us that, if the séance does not go well, at least we still have one way to gaze upon the dead!

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Saoirse - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen Miss Murphy about the..."
entries.text: Have you seen Miss Murphy about the manor?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Such a shy little thing. I think sh..."
entries.text: Such a shy little thing. I think she wanted to ask me something, but could not work up the nerve.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "If she is not careful, she will bli..."
entries.text: If she is not careful, she will blink and end up replacing Signora Joyce in no time.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "A life wasted washing sheets for st..."
entries.text: A life wasted washing sheets for strangers.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Arwa - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Miss Hisham?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I tried, but did not get so far. Sh..."
entries.text: I tried, but did not get so far. She seems very driven by... something.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "She asked if I could divine the loc..."
entries.text: She asked if I could divine the location of things, which, normally I can. But here, there is too much energy surrounding this place.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "It comes from every direction; It i..."
entries.text: It comes from every direction; It is overwhelming! I could not focus on any one person or thing in it all.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Since then, I wish I had asked what..."
entries.text: Since then, I wish I had asked what the 'thing' had been, at least.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ó Finn - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Oh, I like him! Warm, solid type. F..."
entries.text: Oh, I like him! Warm, solid type. Feet on the ground, laughs with the chest.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Speaks his mind even when it's not..."
entries.text: Speaks his mind even when it's not welcome - perhaps especially then.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I can see why he was invited!"
entries.text: I can see why he was invited!

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Walter Blake - Carmela

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you like the Young Master?"
entries.text: How do you like the Young Master?

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I have not met him. The Marquess wa..."
entries.text: I have not met him. The Marquess wants him kept from all this business.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "No, best he is saved from the whole..."
entries.text: No, best he is saved from the whole thing until a later age.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Though he would not say it, I suspe..."
entries.text: Though he would not say it, I suspect there is a hope that the Marchioness' ghost would appear.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "That may be too much for the boy at..."
entries.text: That may be too much for the boy at this age. And if she did not appear, that would be too much in another way.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Ward in room - Carmela

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And what is the meaning of this?"
entries.text: And what is the meaning of this?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Mantovani-"
entries.text: Miss Mantovani-

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "You may save your words. I do not n..."
entries.text: You may save your words. I do not need cards to know what to do with you.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 1

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Signor Ward... I believe you to be..."
entries.text: Signor Ward... I believe you to be a good man.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I will not survive this séance. Eve..."
entries.text: I will not survive this séance. Even if I hadn't already known it for myself... I have seen it in my cards.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I have resigned myself to this. I h..."
entries.text: I have resigned myself to this. I have reason for seeing this séance through.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And what a life it has given me! I..."
entries.text: And what a life it has given me! I have performed in the old world and the new. Every kind of party I have been to.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I even read for Queen Victoria, and..."
entries.text: I even read for Queen Victoria, and through her granddaughter, I performed a séance for the Tsar.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I could not have asked for more!"
entries.text: I could not have asked for more!

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "My family... I left when I was youn..."
entries.text: My family... I left when I was young. When I realised this gift gave me a way out.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 2

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But I do not have much left. All I..."
entries.text: But I do not have much left. All I earned, I spent. I could always earn more.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But the time for that is at its end..."
entries.text: But the time for that is at its end.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "I want to give something, some frac..."
entries.text: I want to give something, some fraction of the comfort I have had.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "This event. It pays well. Too much,..."
entries.text: This event. It pays well. Too much, even. But at a time when I needed much.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "But now I fear I will be gone befor..."
entries.text: But now I fear I will be gone before I can get this money to them. Please, Signor, I will give you the secret to the lockbox in my room.

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 3

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Of course."
entries.text: Of course.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Per favore, you must go to my room..."
entries.text: Per favore, you must go to my room and get my earnings.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "And let them know I am sorry that I..."
entries.text: And let them know I am sorry that I left but that I loved them, always.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Take this symbol, it will open my l..."
entries.text: Take this symbol, it will open my lockbox. A key to my room, I suspect you already have.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "When the séance is done, please ens..."
entries.text: When the séance is done, please ensure my family gets the full amount.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "When the séance is done, when I am..."
entries.text: When the séance is done, when I am done - please, go to my room and ensure my family gets the full amount.

entries.speaker: Miss Mantovani
entries.label: Carmela: "Grazie... Now, go..."
entries.text: Grazie... Now, go...

title: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela Post Quest Reflection

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can hardly imagine how the other..."
entries.text: I can hardly imagine how the other guests are going to react.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Would they go through with the séan..."
entries.text: Would they go through with the séance if they found out what it would do to Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I pray the Lord shows them compassi..."
entries.text: I pray the Lord shows them compassion; they don’t own their complicity.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "At least Miss Mantovani has chosen..."
entries.text: At least Miss Mantovani has chosen to die on her own terms. It’s a luxury too few of us are afforded…

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Am I so easily read? Oh, dear. I'm..."
entries.text: Am I so easily read? Oh, dear. I'm not much for secrets, but I'd rather have some mystique.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "That's a disgrace, isn't it? I'm Ca..."
entries.text: That's a disgrace, isn't it? I'm Cathal O'Meara.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Ah, you again. Did I introduce myse..."
entries.text: Ah, you again. Did I introduce myself? No?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "You again?"
entries.text: You again?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Declan Ward."
entries.text: Declan Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Well, I suppose it is good to meet..."
entries.text: Well, I suppose it is good to meet you. What do you need?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Another stranger, is it? They must..."
entries.text: Another stranger, is it? They must have dredged the barrel to find so many unknowns.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Declan Ward. It's a pleasure. What..."
entries.text: Declan Ward. It's a pleasure. What brings you to the event?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Beyond the séance? If you must know..."
entries.text: Beyond the séance? If you must know, I guess I'm hoping the techniques used here can be repurposed to speak to... other things...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Cathal O'Meara, Sir. You?"
entries.text: Cathal O'Meara, Sir. You?

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll be off, Mister O'Meara."
entries.text: I'll be off, Mister O'Meara.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Don't let me keep you."
entries.text: Don't let me keep you.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Apparently that's not at all the ca..."
entries.text: Apparently that's not at all the case, as you've got me pinned. Ah, well.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It's true, after all. There's an an..."
entries.text: It's true, after all. There's an angel somewhere about me, I know it, but I can only ever see it when I am - well, close to death.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "But, I can't continue on like this...."

entries.label: Ward: "...Sometimes, I do."
entries.text: ...Sometimes, I do.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Séance purpose - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you think of this séance? I..."
entries.text: What do you think of this séance? I mean, do you think they'll manage to capture a ghost?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I've never been to a séance before,..."
entries.text: I've never been to a séance before, I don't know how a normal one goes.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "But if Miss Mantovani is as good as..."
entries.text: But if Miss Mantovani is as good as they say, and we have so many powerful people here, I think they'll manage it.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Second Sight

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you heard about Miss McLeod's..."
entries.text: Have you heard about Miss McLeod's ability? The Second Sight, she called it.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I have. She explained it to me hers..."
entries.text: I have. She explained it to me herself. I think... while it must be difficult sometimes, I think it's amazing.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Ritual markings - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You know, I found what looks like t..."
entries.text: You know, I found what looks like the remains of a ritual upstairs.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...You did? What sort?"
entries.text: ...You did? What sort?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm afraid I wouldn't know, myself."
entries.text: I'm afraid I wouldn't know, myself.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Hmm..."
entries.text: Hmm...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cathal saw Deane - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is there anything else you can tell..."
entries.text: Is there anything else you can tell me about when you saw Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Let me think..."
entries.text: Let me think...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "No, I think I told you everything...."
entries.text: No, I think I told you everything. I do hope she's alright...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She must be... right?"
entries.text: She must be... right?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Bedroom skeleton key - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "What... wait, why do you have that?"
entries.text: What... wait, why do you have that?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange occurences - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed any... strange eve..."
entries.text: Have you noticed any... strange events around this place?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I would say so... And I don't think..."
entries.text: I would say so... And I don't think I'm the only one. I've heard people talking about it.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "But as for me? I had a glass of wat..."
entries.text: But as for me? I had a glass of water by my bedside the other night, and I woke up in the night to find it boiling.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "The next day I thought I'd dreamed..."
entries.text: The next day I thought I'd dreamed it - except, when I woke up that next morning, I found the glass empty, cracked, and blackened.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I sat and watched the entire thing..."
entries.text: I sat and watched the entire thing evaporate. I didn't feel... scared or any of that. Not with my guardian there. When it was done, I went back to sleep.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Deane has left - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The staff tell me that Miss Deane l..."
entries.text: The staff tell me that Miss Deane left on Tuesday night.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I suppose, maybe she had something..."
entries.text: I suppose, maybe she had something else to attend to...?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Statement, Mister Doyle - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Doyle tells me he overheard..."
entries.text: Mister Doyle tells me he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Oh? But what about?"
entries.text: Oh? But what about?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Do you think that has something to..."
entries.text: Do you think that has something to do with where she might be...? I hope not.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Mysterious figure - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed... someone watchin..."
entries.text: Have you noticed... someone watching from the upstairs windows?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Should I have? I'm sure there's all..."
entries.text: Should I have? I'm sure there's all sorts about the place...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "There's more than just us here. I k..."
entries.text: There's more than just us here. I know that, even if I don't often see them for myself.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Goibniu - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about Goibniu,..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about Goibniu, Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I might have heard the name somewhe..."
entries.text: I might have heard the name somewhere before... but if I have, I don't recall anything about them. Sorry, Sir.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about the fae?"
entries.text: What do you know about the fae?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I don't believe in all that."
entries.text: I don't believe in all that.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "But..."
entries.text: But...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "One night I was walking home throug..."
entries.text: One night I was walking home through some fields - a way I often took before and knew well.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I found myself trapped. I could see..."
entries.text: I found myself trapped. I could see the way out but no matter how far I walked, I could get no closer.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "And I swear to you, I could hear la..."
entries.text: And I swear to you, I could hear laughter. Even felt a small hand touch me.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I offered up what was left of my hi..."
entries.text: I offered up what was left of my hipflask by way of tribute and ran.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "They must have taken it, because I..."
entries.text: They must have taken it, because I was finally out.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Maybe they were fae, maybe somethin..."
entries.text: Maybe they were fae, maybe something else. Regardless, I no longer walk home that way.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about the Tuat..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about the Tuatha Dé Danann?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I've definitely heard the name... T..."
entries.text: I've definitely heard the name... They were the old Irish gods, weren't they?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I don't remember where I... hm..."
entries.text: I don't remember where I... hm...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I don't think I remember very much...."
entries.text: I don't think I remember very much. Maybe there's a book in the library that might help...?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Goddess Bridget - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about the godd..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about the goddess Bríd?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I don't know much about any goddess..."
entries.text: I don't know much about any goddess at all, but I do know of Saint Brigid.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She's a patron saint of Ireland, al..."
entries.text: She's a patron saint of Ireland, along with all sorts of other things. Healing, protection, blacksmithing...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "They used to keep a fire burning in..."
entries.text: They used to keep a fire burning in her honour, they say, over in Kildare.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Dead End - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems that Miss Deane never left..."
entries.text: It seems that Miss Deane never left the grounds... instead, she wandered into the hedge maze after you saw her.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Where she went afterwards, though,..."
entries.text: Where she went afterwards, though, I don't know. I intend to find out.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "So you're trying to find her? Good...."
entries.text: So you're trying to find her? Good. I'm so glad someone is. I don't know what I could do to help... but if I can, I will.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/resolution - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Not yet. Something physical, I know..."
entries.text: Not yet. Something physical, I know that.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Whatever it wants of me, I need to..."
entries.text: Whatever it wants of me, I need to be healed.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have much understanding of w..."
entries.text: Do you have much understanding of what your angel wants of you?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I can feel my body recovering at an..."
entries.text: I can feel my body recovering at an accelerated rate since pledging myself to it.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I assume its intentions will become..."
entries.text: I assume its intentions will become clear to me soon enough. But first the séance. Then a visit to my mother.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I have put her to worry for all too..."
entries.text: I have put her to worry for all too long. I need to assure her that what comes next is a divine quest and so, safe.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It's silly but that will put her at..."
entries.text: It's silly but that will put her at ease. The only challenge will be getting her to believe me. It is, admittedly, something of a change of character.

entries.text: Did you attend the bridge game, the other night?

entries.text: The bridge game? That was - Tuesday? I... did not.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara

entries.text: No, I was elsewhere. In my room, praying, I imagine. Yes, that would have been it.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Second chance - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister O'Meara, I have reason to be..."
entries.text: Mister O'Meara, I have reason to believe Miss Deane might be in trouble, and if you know anything that would help, I need to hear it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "If you did not help her when you sa..."
entries.text: If you did not help her when you saw her on Tuesday, perhaps you could help now. Where were you during the bridge game?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I - I didn't -"
entries.text: I - I didn't -

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I was with Miss McLeod, in the gard..."
entries.text: I was with Miss McLeod, in the gardens. We went for a walk. I'm not - I don't know anything more about Miss Deane.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "And Miss McLeod - I suggested mysel..."
entries.text: And Miss McLeod - I suggested myself she bring Missus Lau, but she said she couldn't. I don't remember why, but -

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "But that's where I was. I just, I d..."
entries.text: But that's where I was. I just, I didn't want to say, it looks badly for Miss McLeod. But there was nothing unseemly to it, I swear!

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Bridge statement - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You must remember where you were du..."
entries.text: You must remember where you were during the bridge game. It sounds like it was early Tuesday evening?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I suppose it - can't have been anyt..."
entries.text: I suppose it - can't have been anything very important. I tend to forget things, you know? I've just... forgotten.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Secret rendevouz - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, you were with Miss McLeod durin..."
entries.text: So, you were with Miss McLeod during the bridge game?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Yes. ...It was nice. We just walked..."
entries.text: Yes. ...It was nice. We just walked around the grounds and talked. The rain even held off for a bit.

entries.text: There's quite the array of events going on, this week.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara

entries.text: Isn't there? More than I could ever attend, really.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Anything in particular catch your e..."
entries.text: Anything in particular catch your eye?

entries.text: What do you make of these?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Hm. It looks like someone's got an..."
entries.text: Hm. It looks like someone's got an admirer. Can't say I've ever heard of a Detective Ward, though...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Unless... unless... I think I've ju..."
entries.text: Unless... unless... I think I've just figured it out, haven't I?

entries.label: Cathal: "That looks like it'd get you into a..."
entries.text: That looks like it'd get you into almost anywhere here, probably.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Drafted telegram - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It appears Missus Joyce has always..."
entries.text: It appears Missus Joyce has always been concerned about Miss Deane's disappearance.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "So concerned she hired a detective?..."
entries.text: So concerned she hired a detective? Not just any detective, either. A famous detective.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Well, famous isn't..."
entries.text: Well, famous isn't...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It's you! That's why you cared so m..."
entries.text: It's you! That's why you cared so much all this time. You have to find her, Mister Ward.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Talks schedule - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you going to attend any of the..."
entries.text: Are you going to attend any of the talks going on?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "There's a few I think I'd like to g..."
entries.text: There's a few I think I'd like to go to...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Doctor and Miss Callaghan's respect..."
entries.text: Doctor and Miss Callaghan's respectively, and maybe Miss Quinn's.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I've never really had much to do wi..."
entries.text: I've never really had much to do with ghosts, but I'd like to hear what she knows about them.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Fetters - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about the conc..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about the concept of fetters?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Well, not as much as some of the ot..."
entries.text: Well, not as much as some of the others might. I'm not much for that discipline. But I believe they're the things that hold ghosts in this world.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I suppose that's why they call them..."
entries.text: I suppose that's why they call them fetters, named for the old shackles used to transport prisoners.

entries.text: Are you about to tell me you're a doctor? You're not my doctor. My doctor is sick of me.

entries.text: I, ah... It's a bad habit, I know. But I'm not here to be cross-examined. I have some dangerous past-times. Injury is to be expected.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
