entries.text: Well, the bar only opens in the evening, so I suppose I need other ways to entertain myself ‘til then.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I do hear the housekeeper serves dr..."
entries.text: I do hear the housekeeper serves drinks on the patio. Perhaps I’ll spend the morning there.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "When I get bored of that… Oh, there..."
entries.text: When I get bored of that… Oh, there's lunch at one. Starving is less interesting than you'd think.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "And Miss Callaghan’s talk at three..."
entries.text: And Miss Callaghan’s talk at three seems liveable, so I’ll drop in on that. What else…

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Oh! Yes, I’ve promised Missus D’Arc..."
entries.text: Oh! Yes, I’ve promised Missus D’Arcy a rematch of pool in the bar at six. Now she makes a dull game fun.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I didn’t know you could misfire a b..."
entries.text: I didn’t know you could misfire a ball that badly, but she certainly managed it.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I should go to the mass at 12 and t..."
entries.text: I should go to the mass at 12 and try absolve myself of some my sins. Not all of them, mind you, I don't want to be there all day.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Actually, I might visit the graveya..."
entries.text: Actually, I might visit the graveyard after that. Come to think of it, isn’t every graveyard visit a “near-death” experience? Yes? No? Oh, you could smile, at least...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I suppose I’ll be in the bar in the..."
entries.text: I suppose I’ll be in the bar in the evening. Though I’ve already run two circles around the drinks menu.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Then it’s lunch at one, dinner at e..."
entries.text: Then it’s lunch at one, dinner at eight. God, it really is all circles, isn’t it?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Breakfast, lunch, dinner, drink…"
entries.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, drink…

entries.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have any plans for today?"
entries.text: Do you have any plans for today?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "As for tomorrow..."
entries.text: As for tomorrow...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Of course, I won't be missing the b..."
entries.text: Of course, I won't be missing the ball. Maybe a bit of real fun in this place for once.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Still, not long until the main even..."
entries.text: Still, not long until the main event, eh? Even I should try to be sober for that...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Still, not long until the main even..."
entries.text: Still, not long until the main event, eh? I'm nervous now. I'm not sure what Suibne wants from me. I hope not to let it down!

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/shadowy figure - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It doesn't mean much to me. Angelic..."
entries.text: It doesn't mean much to me. Angelic beings are creatures of light - radiant and pure. I suppose the natural conclusion would be that you have something less Heavenly on your hands.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I saw a shadowy figure stalking the..."
entries.text: I saw a shadowy figure stalking the grounds, twice the height of a man. Would that description mean anything to you?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Artefacts - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "That's interesting... I'd like to t..."
entries.text: That's interesting... I'd like to take a look at that, if you don't mind.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ OFFER ARTEFACT ]"
entries.text: [ OFFER ARTEFACT ]

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ KEEP ARTEFACT ]"
entries.text: [ KEEP ARTEFACT ]

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll hold onto this for now."
entries.text: I'll hold onto this for now.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Be my guest."
entries.text: Be my guest.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Protestant Faith - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about Protestantis..."
entries.text: What do you know about Protestantism?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Not as much as some of the others w..."
entries.text: Not as much as some of the others will do, I'm certain enough about that.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I know they don't have saints the s..."
entries.text: I know they don't have saints the same way that we do, though.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Faith - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't say I was expecting to see..."
entries.text: I can't say I was expecting to see such a range of faiths among the guests.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I suppose that's what happens when..."
entries.text: I suppose that's what happens when you have people coming from all over the world.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "People don't always agree within th..."
entries.text: People don't always agree within the one church, after all. You can't expect everyone from all across the world to agree on one to start with.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Catholic Faith - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about Catholicism,..."
entries.text: What do you know about Catholicism, Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Enough, I should hope! I'd not be a..."
entries.text: Enough, I should hope! I'd not be a good Catholic if I didn't know anything about it.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Ettiene's Influence - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I understand Mister Toussaint is qu..."
entries.text: I understand Mister Toussaint is quite influential.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I don't know much about it myself,..."
entries.text: I don't know much about it myself, but I've heard it said. It's strange... he seems to make Miss McLeod nervous, but he's very kind.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She says its because if she is misu..."
entries.text: She says its because if she is misunderstood, being the real thing held up as a fake would be awful. I can understand that.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Come to think of it, I suppose the..."
entries.text: Come to think of it, I suppose the same could happen to me... but I can't find it in myself to worry about it.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Surreptitious meeting - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It turns out that while Sunday serv..."
entries.text: It turns out that while Sunday services was being held, Miss McLeod was in the gardens talking with Mister Hunter.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She was? Well, perhaps they didn't..."
entries.text: She was? Well, perhaps they didn't hold a service she would have attended.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "What do you want? I don't think the..."
entries.text: What do you want? I don't think there's any great scandal there. And if there was, I don't think I would tell anyone.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She was probably just asking after..."
entries.text: She was probably just asking after the horses. She was quite the equestrian as a child, I think she mentioned...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange dream - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I could swear this place is giving..."
entries.text: I could swear this place is giving me the strangest dreams.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Really? I haven't noticed anything..."
entries.text: Really? I haven't noticed anything like that... I don't... think so, anyway. What's a strange dream when your dreams are always strange?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "But... I can see how this place cou..."
entries.text: But... I can see how this place could inspire them. It's just that... something doesn't feel quite right here. Or... maybe I'm just hungover...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hedonistic Gala - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't say I was expecting anythin..."
entries.text: I can't say I was expecting anything like that ball.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "New to it, are you? I could think o..."
entries.text: New to it, are you? I could think of people I'd rather have attended with, but it wasn't bad.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I did like the costumes; they were..."
entries.text: I did like the costumes; they were a nice touch. Although, the people who wore glitter ought to pay for the laundry. It gets everywhere.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I'm amazed with the... treats... pr..."
entries.text: I'm amazed with the... treats... provided. They were quite effecting.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I was able to see my... companion,..."
entries.text: I was able to see my... companion, but only in the distance.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Unknown Sigil - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about sigils?..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about sigils? There's one I've been trying to identify: a spiral with four lines drawn into it.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Well, I know some... but none that..."
entries.text: Well, I know some... but none that look like that. None with any spirals at all, I don't think.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've been finding sketches of this..."
entries.text: I've been finding sketches of this symbol around. Does it mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "No... Should it? I don't think I've..."
entries.text: No... Should it? I don't think I've seen anything like that before.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angels - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about angels, Mist..."
entries.text: What do you know about angels, Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "What a question! Plenty, if you mus..."
entries.text: What a question! Plenty, if you must know. The Lord's servants, sent now and then to intervene and minister in our earthly matters.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Messengers of the higher power, not..."
entries.text: Messengers of the higher power, not existing as we do, but as incorporeal beings just beyond understanding...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "They're beings of light and the ver..."
entries.text: They're beings of light and the very essence of all that's good... And very seldom seen. Maybe for that reason. Hah!

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "If only I could say otherwise... I..."
entries.text: If only I could say otherwise... I could swear there's one with me, but I can so seldom reach it...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/meeting with Ivy - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Please, Sir. Have some decorum, wil..."
entries.text: Please, Sir. Have some decorum, will you?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It was an innocent conversation tha..."
entries.text: It was an innocent conversation that you would do well to forget, lest you drag the poor girl's reputation through the mud.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your meeting with Miss McLeod in th..."
entries.text: Your meeting with Miss McLeod in the changing roo--

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/cathal's journal - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Where... where did you get this?"
entries.text: Where... where did you get this?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't think it would be wise to d..."
entries.text: I don't think it would be wise to discuss this.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Deane's room - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to recall which room..."
entries.text: Do you happen to recall which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Oh, she's... she's... she's beside..."
entries.text: Oh, she's... she's... she's beside mine. How did I forget that?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I had... sort of forgotten she was..."
entries.text: I had... sort of forgotten she was here... How did that happen?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Aeon - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever heard of an Aeon?"
entries.text: Have you ever heard of an Aeon?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "A what? A... Oh, yeah, it rings a b..."
entries.text: A what? A... Oh, yeah, it rings a bell.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Something... Gnostic? Sorry, can't..."
entries.text: Something... Gnostic? Sorry, can't help more than that - you need to talk to an expert, my man.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel's name - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I think your Angel's name is Suibne..."
entries.text: I think your Angel's name is Suibne.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Suibne? Alright, I'll try it. You'l..."
entries.text: Suibne? Alright, I'll try it. You'll come with me? See this to the end?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Suibne? Alright, I'll try it. You'l..."
entries.text: Suibne? Alright, I'll try it. You'll stay, right? You couldn't possibly leave at this stage?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Séance general - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of this séance?"
entries.text: What do you make of this séance?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Supposing they manage it, you mean."
entries.text: Supposing they manage it, you mean.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Well, it seems as worthy an endeavo..."
entries.text: Well, it seems as worthy an endeavour as any. Asking questions of the dead... why not?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "They're not being shy about who the..."
entries.text: They're not being shy about who they recruit for it either, I'll give them that. Have you ever seen a turnout such as this one?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Who knows, it might even be just a..."
entries.text: Who knows, it might even be just a little fun. Though... I won't bank on it.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had any strange experience..."
entries.text: Have you had any strange experiences around the manor, Mister O'Meara? I could swear I have.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "You're not the first person to ask..."
entries.text: You're not the first person to ask me that, actually. It seems like everyone's seeing things in this place.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I haven't seen much... but I have t..."
entries.text: I haven't seen much... but I have this feeling that there are other people here. More than us guests. Don't you?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Ah... you mean ghosts?"
entries.text: Ah... you mean ghosts?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed any... strange eve..."
entries.text: Have you noticed any... strange events around this place?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I've heard people talking about gho..."
entries.text: I've heard people talking about ghosts. I don't believe I've seen any ghosts, but there was something.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I had a glass of water by my bedsid..."
entries.text: I had a glass of water by my bedside last night, and I woke up in the night to find it boiling.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I thought I'd dreamed it, but in th..."
entries.text: I thought I'd dreamed it, but in the morning I found the glass empty and blackened.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "What sort of ghost does that? There..."
entries.text: What sort of ghost does that? There's something about this place, I tell you.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel sketches - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you believe in the concept of gu..."
entries.text: Do you believe in the concept of guardian angels?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Very much so! And I'll tell you why..."
entries.text: Very much so! And I'll tell you why - I have seen mine!

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "When I had the accident that gave m..."
entries.text: When I had the accident that gave me this cane, I witnessed it in the peripheries of my vision! My own guardian angel!

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "And I've seen it since. I even know..."
entries.text: And I've seen it since. I even know its name. Well, sort of...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I found allusions to it in dreams -..."
entries.text: I found allusions to it in dreams - old symbols, burnt into my mind.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Surely the angel put them there? Wh..."
entries.text: Surely the angel put them there? Who else, after all?  Just... if I could translate it, I could call it here...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I know it all sounds a bit... well,..."
entries.text: I know it all sounds a bit... well, crazy, doesn't it? Haha! That's faith for you.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Enochian magic - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about Enochian mag..."
entries.text: What do you know about Enochian magic, Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Hm? Oh, you've been talking to peop..."
entries.text: Hm? Oh, you've been talking to people, have you? Did they send you to me? Mm... Well, I'm no lecturer, but the gist of it is something like...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It's its own magical discipline, us..."
entries.text: It's its own magical discipline, using rituals and ceremonies, to speak to angels or their like.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It was all developed some time ago...."
entries.text: It was all developed some time ago... and it does work. Not so often as I would like but... you make do.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Angels don't speak our language, ex..."
entries.text: Angels don't speak our language, exactly, which is entirely another thing... but there are ways to work around that.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It is almost enough just to have th..."
entries.text: It is almost enough just to have them answer.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Almost. But they don't stay for ver..."
entries.text: Almost. But they don't stay for very long. I would know.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Thrill seeker - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You have quite the reputation, you..."
entries.text: You have quite the reputation, you know.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Mm... I've heard mention. I didn't..."
entries.text: Mm... I've heard mention. I didn't think that was actually the case.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is it true you've had a number of n..."
entries.text: Is it true you've had a number of near-death experiences?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "So it is true. I didn't know. It's..."
entries.text: So it is true. I didn't know. It's nothing so grand, you know... Bad luck, and then... knowing that there's an angel waiting at the veil.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "If you saw such a thing, you would..."
entries.text: If you saw such a thing, you would understand. A being made of nothing but light, so much that to gaze upon it is to feel it light you up...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "You would understand, I think, if y..."
entries.text: You would understand, I think, if you felt it. It is almost worth the risk, meeting death, if I might find what it is that it wants. Almost, but... There must be another way...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Soul Jars - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about soul jar..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about soul jars?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Practical magic and artefacts isn't..."
entries.text: Practical magic and artefacts isn't really my sort of thing... but actually, as it happens, yes.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "They're used for holding - well, so..."
entries.text: They're used for holding - well, souls. Life essence, and what have you.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Damned hard to find. Or, so I am to..."
entries.text: Damned hard to find. Or, so I am told...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Coded Papers - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this dotted paper lying abo..."
entries.text: I found this dotted paper lying about, but I've no idea what it could mean.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...Have you ever sent a love letter..."
entries.text: ...Have you ever sent a love letter, Mister Ward?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...Pardon?"
entries.text: ...Pardon?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Wrote one in lemon juice once. Hold..."
entries.text: Wrote one in lemon juice once. Hold it above a flame and the words appear like magic.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "This paper of yours sounds like tha..."
entries.text: This paper of yours sounds like that. Except, actually magic.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...I never told Margaret I'd used l..."
entries.text: ...I never told Margaret I'd used lemon juice, did I? Oh well.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Drugged water - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have any reason to think Mis..."
entries.text: Do you have any reason to think Miss McLeod's water might have been tampered with?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Tampered with? How'd you mean? As i..."
entries.text: Tampered with? How'd you mean? As in, someone's put something in it? Ugh, who would do something like that?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I don't know how you know that, but..."
entries.text: I don't know how you know that, but you'd best make use of knowing and tell her about it.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/drugs in room - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Can't say that I have. Is it any go..."
entries.text: Can't say that I have. Is it any good? Do you have any?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever heard of Quinine powd..."
entries.text: Have you ever heard of Quinine powder?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Memento Mori - cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about the Quin..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about the Quinn family having... an unusual number of deaths?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Ah. So she is one of those Quinns,..."
entries.text: Ah. So she is one of those Quinns, is she? I didn't think there were any left to meet.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Yeah, so I've heard that they bear..."
entries.text: Yeah, so I've heard that they bear a curse, one that's supposedly about a century old, now.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It's done most of them in. I guess..."
entries.text: It's done most of them in. I guess that explains her scars. She's very serious for one who's cards are marked. I'd be enjoying my final days.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister O'Meara, did you fight with..."
entries.text: Mister O'Meara, did you fight with Miss Deane on Tuesday? In the hedge maze?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Right, okay. Yes. Yes, we fought."
entries.text: Right, okay. Yes. Yes, we fought.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This is important."
entries.text: This is important.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is that why you didn't go after her..."
entries.text: Is that why you didn't go after her later that evening?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Yes. I thought she had drank hersel..."
entries.text: Yes. I thought she had drank herself stupid, that she'd wake up in a hedge the next day and regret everything.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What did you fight over?"
entries.text: What did you fight over?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She... well, lots of things. She wa..."
entries.text: She... well, lots of things. She was drunk, when I met her. She'd been drinking all day.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She came to me, and said something..."
entries.text: She came to me, and said something or somebody was after her.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Not physically. Maybe... spirituall..."
entries.text: Not physically. Maybe... spiritually? Astrally? As I say, she was drunk and unclear. She couldn't see their face, she said, but that they had a "Christian aura" or something. She was specific on that point.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Why did she come to you?"
entries.text: Why did she come to you?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "We... were engaged. Or rather I wan..."
entries.text: We... were engaged. Or rather I wanted us to be. I asked her to marry me. We'd been courting... I wanted to make it official.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She didn't want to be caged down. D..."
entries.text: She didn't want to be caged down. Didn't need a man to protect her. All of that.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I chalked it up to overindulgence...."
entries.text: I chalked it up to overindulgence. Told her to go sober up in her room. She did not like that.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "So, naturally when she came to me f..."
entries.text: So, naturally when she came to me for help I threw it in her face and left.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "On seeing her later, I called out a..."
entries.text: On seeing her later, I called out and she ignored me - still furious, I assumed - so I left her be.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Of course, I didn't expect to not s..."
entries.text: Of course, I didn't expect to not see her the following day. I took some food up to her room, but, well... I forgot where she was staying.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Then I forgot that I forgot... Unti..."
entries.text: Then I forgot that I forgot... Until I saw you at her door.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It all came back. And I panicked. I..."
entries.text: It all came back. And I panicked. I thought maybe I was responsible for her disappearance.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Then I thought maybe you would thin..."
entries.text: Then I thought maybe you would think that, but...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...I love her, Mister Ward. You sho..."
entries.text: ...I love her, Mister Ward. You should know that. I just want her safe.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll see to it that she is. Thank y..."
entries.text: I'll see to it that she is. Thank you, this has been helpful.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/gauge - cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you see that odd contraption in..."
entries.text: Did you see that odd contraption in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "The what? I can't say I have given..."
entries.text: The what? I can't say I have given much notice to anything in that room.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ivy - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can I presume you've met Miss McLeo..."
entries.text: Can I presume you've met Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Presume? Why would... I mean, ah, I..."
entries.text: Presume? Why would... I mean, ah, I have.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "They are quite the pair, aren't the..."
entries.text: They are quite the pair, aren't they?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "What a man wouldn't give..."
entries.text: What a man wouldn't give...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I have, her and Missus Lau."
entries.text: I have, her and Missus Lau.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She's been telling me about spiritu..."
entries.text: She's been telling me about spiritualism and séances and that sort of thing. The parts I don't know myself.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It's kind of her to take the time....."
entries.text: It's kind of her to take the time...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Hm? Miss McLeod? Well, it would hav..."
entries.text: Hm? Miss McLeod? Well, it would have been impolite not to introduce myself. She's a lady, after all...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Varley - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken much to the manager..."
entries.text: Have you spoken much to the manager?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Hmm? Oh no, I haven’t spoken with h..."
entries.text: Hmm? Oh no, I haven’t spoken with him much since I arrived. He gave me all the necessary details and went about his own affairs.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Whenever I pass by him, he looks a..."
entries.text: Whenever I pass by him, he looks a touch sour, but I gather he’s fretting over the cost of throwing this whole event together.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "God, can you image having to worry..."
entries.text: God, can you image having to worry about that kind of thing!?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Lan Fen - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you been introduced to Missus..."
entries.text: Have you been introduced to Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Yes. Or, I might have been the one..."
entries.text: Yes. Or, I might have been the one to introduce myself, I can't remember.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Anyway, I've met her. Being that sh..."
entries.text: Anyway, I've met her. Being that she chaperones Miss McLeod, she's always around if I'm to talk to her.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "An absolute bore. Of course she pre..."
entries.text: An absolute bore. Of course she prefers the sciences - of which I care little.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Miss McLeod speaks very fondly of h..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod speaks very fondly of her, though, and I am sure I can adjust.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Skerritt - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Briefly. He introduced himself to m..."
entries.text: Briefly. He introduced himself to me. Seems to know some family of mine. Seemed to know me too, but I don't recall him.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Yes. Well, he introduced himself to..."
entries.text: Yes. Well, he introduced himself to me... but we haven't spoken very much.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I just haven't got it in me. My min..."
entries.text: I just haven't got it in me. My mind falls right off the conversation.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "And for his part... I think he find..."
entries.text: And for his part... I think he finds me distasteful. Let him, I suppose...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I've tried to place him - I asked a..."
entries.text: I've tried to place him - I asked about his family, but it seems he has none. He went a bit quiet then, so I left. I didn't come here to see an old man reflect on his wasted life.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Corentine - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Quinn?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Met her, yes, but I haven't spoken..."
entries.text: Met her, yes, but I haven't spoken with her much. It seems like she's very caught up in... whatever it is she's doing.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I suppose when one's days are numbe..."
entries.text: I suppose when one's days are numbered, there is a drive to get the most our of them.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Numbered?"
entries.text: Numbered?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "The family is cursed. Or so they sa..."
entries.text: The family is cursed. Or so they say. Certainly their numbers are dwindling at an alarming rate.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I think Miss Quinn is one of only a..."
entries.text: I think Miss Quinn is one of only a handful left.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you happen to have spoken to th..."
entries.text: Did you happen to have spoken to the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I have, a little. She asked where I..."
entries.text: I have, a little. She asked where I was visiting from, and when I told her, she asked me about a woman that works a few doors down from me.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She wanted to know how she was gett..."
entries.text: She wanted to know how she was getting on, after... I don't remember. The woman she asked about is doing fine as best as I know, at least.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Missus Joyce said she was a friend..."
entries.text: Missus Joyce said she was a friend of a friend, or something like that. A friend of a cousin?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Oh, yes. She asked where I was visi..."
entries.text: Oh, yes. She asked where I was visiting from, and then who my parents were, and then all other sorts of things...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Seems to want to know just about ev..."
entries.text: Seems to want to know just about everything there is. And then, unfortunately for her, she got me.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you happen to have spoken to th..."
entries.text: Did you happen to have spoken to the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Oh, yes. She asked where I was visi..."
entries.text: Oh, yes. She asked where I was visiting from, and then who my parents were, and then all other sorts of things...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She seems to think I'm too pretty t..."
entries.text: She seems to think I'm too pretty to be mixed up in all this. Occasionally, I wonder if she's right.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Darragh - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the stable master?"
entries.text: Have you met the stable master?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I may have said hello in passing, b..."
entries.text: I may have said hello in passing, but I haven't much cause to talk to him. I don't go for so many walks or ride often, what with this cane.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Miss McLeod likes him, though. Appa..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod likes him, though. Apparently they're old friends, of a sort, so I hear good things. You'd have to ask her.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Seamus - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the porter?"
entries.text: Have you met the porter?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "That bum, Mister Doyle?"
entries.text: That bum, Mister Doyle?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "This place might run a bit better i..."
entries.text: This place might run a bit better if he spent more time porting and less time flirting with the guests.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I have half a mind to take this can..."
entries.text: I have half a mind to take this cane to him...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinon on Cathal - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Not that I'm old money, Mister Ward..."
entries.text: Not that I'm old money, Mister Ward, or of some ancient, grand heritage.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It just so happens my grandfather w..."
entries.text: It just so happens my grandfather was a very wealthy man, and my father after him.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "And now... here I am. Generally dis..."
entries.text: And now... here I am. Generally disappointing them both, I suppose.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A bit less like myself, then. What'..."
entries.text: A bit less like myself, then. What's a well-to-do kid from the Southside doing here?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Well... I've an interest in this ki..."
entries.text: Well... I've an interest in this kind of affair. And, as you say, the money to attend them.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You're a Dub, like myself."
entries.text: You're a Dub, like myself.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "True enough. I'm from Ballsbridge."
entries.text: True enough. I'm from Ballsbridge.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ettiene - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you happen to have spoken with..."
entries.text: Did you happen to have spoken with Mister Touissant?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "He's some sort of scientist, or ano..."
entries.text: He's some sort of scientist, or another, isn't that the case?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Anyhow, he introduced himself, and..."
entries.text: Anyhow, he introduced himself, and asked what brought me here. I told him, of course.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Well, his reaction! Not only does h..."
entries.text: Well, his reaction! Not only does he not believe in angels but I got the distinct impression that he did not like the church itself!

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I am used to ridicule about what I..."
entries.text: I am used to ridicule about what I have witnessed, but the Church! The Church is infallible! Beyond question!

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ines - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Over breakfast, once. She wanted to..."
entries.text: Over breakfast, once. She wanted to know if I was from nearby - she's interested in the local population records.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I was offended - to take a look at..."
entries.text: I was offended - to take a look at me and think I'd be interested in historical data!

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "But she didn't care - she doesn't s..."
entries.text: But she didn't care - she doesn't seem to give a damn if a person has money behind them or not. I admire that.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to have met Miss Dean..."
entries.text: Do you happen to have met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "We've talked a bit. She was telling..."
entries.text: We've talked a bit. She was telling a few of us about other séances she's been to. The worthwhile ones, she said.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I take it they're common in London...."
entries.text: I take it they're common in London. But, anyway, when we talked it was mostly about that.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Oh, well, we talked a bit. She was..."
entries.text: Oh, well, we talked a bit. She was telling me about other séances she's been to. The worthwhile ones, she said.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Though she also mentioned she'd had..."
entries.text: Though she also mentioned she'd had an argument or two with people at them. I didn't know it was all so... contentious?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Have I! I mightn't have shown my fa..."
entries.text: Have I! I mightn't have shown my face if I knew Evelyn was here... But why should I suffer for her lack of decorum?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Miss Deane turned down a marriage p..."
entries.text: Miss Deane turned down a marriage proposal I made her a year or two ago. And there was not a second thought to it!

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It'd have been one thing if it were..."
entries.text: It'd have been one thing if it were just an offer of convenience, but I thought... No, nevermind. I'm not giving it anymore thought...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...Ha. I was stupid enough to ask i..."
entries.text: ...Ha. I was stupid enough to ask if she'd mind me switching to Room 16, you know. Just to be near her.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...At least I was there to overhear..."
entries.text: ...At least I was there to overhear her and Miss Quinn arguing in the corridor the other evening!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you, by chance, met Miss Deane..."
entries.text: Have you, by chance, met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Have I! I mightn't have shown my fa..."
entries.text: Have I! I mightn't have shown my face if I knew Evelyn was here... But why should I suffer for her lack of decorum?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It'd have been one thing if it were..."
entries.text: It'd have been one thing if it were just an offer of convenience, but I thought...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Miss Deane turned down a marriage p..."
entries.text: Miss Deane turned down a marriage proposal I made her a year or two ago. And there was not a second thought to it!

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Honestly, Corentine needs to let it..."
entries.text: Honestly, Corentine needs to let it go - Evelyn just makes use of people. It's just how she is.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Dupré - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Dupré at..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Dupré at all?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Oh, I have, actually. He was curiou..."
entries.text: Oh, I have, actually. He was curious as to my reason for being here. Everyone wants to know what everyone else is doing, it seems...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Anyway, when I told him, he seemed..."
entries.text: Anyway, when I told him, he seemed quite intrigued by the idea. He said something about matters of life and death being one, and that's what angels are?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Agree to disagree, but... I suppose..."
entries.text: Agree to disagree, but... I suppose those in his line of work tend to associate death with everything good in the world.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on D'Arcy - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus D'Arcy?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She's... oh, she's the authour. Of..."
entries.text: She's... oh, she's the authour. Of all sorts of dark and sordid tales, she said.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "We talked a little at breakfast. Sh..."
entries.text: We talked a little at breakfast. She said I'd suit as a hero in one of her novels, and I don't know what to make of that.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I'm going to hope it's a good thing..."
entries.text: I'm going to hope it's a good thing, for the sake of my pride.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Hazel - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you met Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Yes, I believe so, but we haven't r..."
entries.text: Yes, I believe so, but we haven't really talked.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Funny, I thought a woman who speaks..."
entries.text: Funny, I thought a woman who speaks with the dead might have more time for me. Apparently not...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Too Catholic for her, maybe."
entries.text: Too Catholic for her, maybe.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Coventry - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Once or twice over drinks. He's fas..."
entries.text: Once or twice over drinks. He's fascinated with everything this place has to offer.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Including Miss Deane... Sly old dog..."
entries.text: Including Miss Deane... Sly old dog took a shine to her, I think. Harmless at his age, but Evelyn shouldn't have led him on by going to his room...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ruairí - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Doctor Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I have. Of all the doctors I've met..."
entries.text: I have. Of all the doctors I've met, and there have been a few, he's one of the most pleasant.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...That was probably helped by the..."
entries.text: ...That was probably helped by the fact we were talking about something other than my health, to be fair to the others.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "And who doesn't like a doctor who's..."
entries.text: And who doesn't like a doctor who's worth their salt in the occult? Much more interesting than the usual sort...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Carmela - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Not too self-important for one so f..."
entries.text: Not too self-important for one so famous. I talked to her to learn about the parameters of séances.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "How many are needed, is a medium re..."
entries.text: How many are needed, is a medium required, can something more than ghosts be communed with.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She answered my questions calmly an..."
entries.text: She answered my questions calmly and thoroughly.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Then she drew me a card and warned..."
entries.text: Then she drew me a card and warned me to be careful in dealing with the unknown.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "A real show-woman to the end."
entries.text: A real show-woman to the end.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Fiadh - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I've actually heard her name before..."
entries.text: I've actually heard her name before, you know. Miss Deane spoke of, but I've never met her until now.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "We have spoken some - she's very ki..."
entries.text: We have spoken some - she's very kind. Though she doesn't seem to think much of this séance thing, I'll say that...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She's more the old fashioned sort -..."
entries.text: She's more the old fashioned sort - herbal remedies and well scrying, that sort of thing. I guess someone has to keep that up.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Saoirse - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the young cook,..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to the young cook, Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "No but I've seen her about. She's v..."
entries.text: No but I've seen her about. She's very interested in all this magical guff, isn't she?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I guess that must be what Evelyn sa..."
entries.text: I guess that must be what Evelyn saw in her...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Arwa - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Hisham?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "We've done some business actually."
entries.text: We've done some business actually.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I wanted something from her homelan..."
entries.text: I wanted something from her homeland - nothing fancy or rare, mind you. I don't think she would trade such things.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "She was very sharp on paper but som..."
entries.text: She was very sharp on paper but somewhat distracted in person.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "We didn't talk for very long, but w..."
entries.text: We didn't talk for very long, but we've met. He asked me what brought me here.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "So... I talked with him about angel..."
entries.text: So... I talked with him about angels. He asked me some questions but grew quickly bored by my responses.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...Ah, but there's Sunday mass at t..."
entries.text: ...Ah, but there's Sunday mass at twelve, isn't there? So much for that, I'll see him then.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I've been avoiding him since. Imagi..."
entries.text: I've been avoiding him since. Imagine, boring a priest!

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Campbell - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the Reverend?"
entries.text: Have you met the Reverend?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I haven't. Should I have...? I can'..."
entries.text: I haven't. Should I have...? I can't imagine what we'd talk about.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Higgins - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've seen a man a..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've seen a man around here, not a guest or staff, with a strong build - might have been talking to Father Sinnot?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Can't say I have, no."
entries.text: Can't say I have, no.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ó Finn - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Imagine in this, the year of our Lo..."
entries.text: Imagine in this, the year of our Lord 1897, not believing in angels!

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I suppose I should have expected th..."
entries.text: I suppose I should have expected that kind of backwards thinking from a hermit.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Blake - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about our host, th..."
entries.text: Do you know much about our host, the Marquess?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Certainly, I have heard of him. For..."
entries.text: Certainly, I have heard of him. For a while, he was all anyone would talk about. When his wife died, many ambitious families tried to pawn their daughters off on him.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "He had no interest, it seems. Shame..."
entries.text: He had no interest, it seems. Shame. I can't see the line lasting beyond him and the boy.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Walter Blake - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about Marquess..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about Marquess Blake's son?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Well, I know all this will be his w..."
entries.text: Well, I know all this will be his when his father passes. The last surviving Blake. If you can call his state surviving.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...not that I can comment on anyone..."
entries.text: ...not that I can comment on anyone's physical health.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Analysis Presents - (to) Cathal/Walks leaning on a cane - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your cane, I hope it's nothing too..."
entries.text: Your cane, I hope it's nothing too serious?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Ah, I was showing off while horse r..."
entries.text: Ah, I was showing off while horse riding. What was I going to do when the mare spooked?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Scared the daylights out of everyon..."
entries.text: Scared the daylights out of everyone, but I came out of it alright - aside from this. With luck I'll be shot of it eventually.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Analysis Presents - (to) Cathal/Dreamy look in eyes - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have something on your mind,..."
entries.text: Do you have something on your mind, Mister O'Meara? You seem distracted.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Haha... I always do! Don't take it..."
entries.text: Haha... I always do! Don't take it personally. It's not a comment on the company. Not right now it isn't, anyway, hm?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I just... No, I've always had this..."
entries.text: I just... No, I've always had this look, I think.

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Analysis Presents - (to) Cathal/Dressed well, but not expensively - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I wanted to compliment you on your..."
entries.text: I wanted to compliment you on your clothes. It's fine attire.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Mm. You noticed, did you? You've an..."
entries.text: Mm. You noticed, did you? You've an eye for it, then - it's not nearly so showy as I could get away with.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "But who's to care? Not me - I'm the..."
entries.text: But who's to care? Not me - I'm the one wearing it. Once I like what I'm wearing, I don't see much point in showing it off.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "There are grander things to be conc..."
entries.text: There are grander things to be concerned with...

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Analysis Presents - (to) Cathal/powder - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you aware there is a stain on y..."
entries.text: Are you aware there is a stain on your pocket, Sir?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "Oh... so there is. That must be......"
entries.text: Oh... so there is. That must be... soap?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Ward in room - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "What the- Mister Ward?"
entries.text: What the- Mister Ward?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister O'Meara..."
entries.text: Mister O'Meara...

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...Look, if you're not going to ste..."
entries.text: ...Look, if you're not going to steal anything or kill me, could we at least make this interesting?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I think it'd be fun to see what the..."
entries.text: I think it'd be fun to see what the manager thinks of you having a key to my room. Don't you?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "What the- Sir?"
entries.text: What the- Sir?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/OnQuestCompleted

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "...I... I really... Thank you, Mist..."
entries.text: ...I... I really... Thank you, Mister Ward. From the bottom of my heart.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I knew I could only carry on as I w..."
entries.text: I knew I could only carry on as I was for a short while longer, but I could not stop myself.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "But now... I... I need to sit down...."
entries.text: But now... I... I need to sit down. Would you kindly see yourself out, Mister Ward?

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I don't know whatever journey I hav..."
entries.text: I don't know whatever journey I have just started but, for the first time in a while, I am thrilled by the very prospect of it.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I needed to see. To know. And you h..."
entries.text: I needed to see. To know. And you have helped me truly open my eyes.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "It's hard to explain, such a revela..."
entries.text: It's hard to explain, such a revelation in oneself. I'm a different man to the one I was even thirty minutes ago, that much I know. But who I am now, that's yet unknown to me.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "And, again... Thank you."
entries.text: And, again... Thank you.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "I believe he... it... Suibne wants..."
entries.text: I believe he... it... Suibne wants me to attend the séance still. Suibne wants to witness it, maybe through me? I don't know.

entries.speaker: Mister O'Meara
entries.label: Cathal: "However this works, I get the impre..."
entries.text: However this works, I get the impression that something will happen there. I feel as if I will be safe, so I guess this is a warning for you and the others?

title: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/PostQuest - Cathal

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The lad has a decent heart undernea..."
entries.text: The lad has a decent heart underneath it all, but still, I worry for his future.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That… ‘angel’… is unlike anything I..."
entries.text: That… ‘angel’… is unlike anything I could have imagined.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It was beautiful, divine even… but..."
entries.text: It was beautiful, divine even… but Heavenly? I can’t say for certain…

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What manner of angel lures someone..."
entries.text: What manner of angel lures someone to their own death?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I pray its intentions are pure…"
entries.text: I pray its intentions are pure…

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...perhaps I should try to learn mo..."
entries.text: ...perhaps I should try to learn more of this angel of his, Suibne.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Coventry conversation

entries.text: Good day. I don't believe we've met.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry

entries.text: My name is Simon Coventry. I'm a jeweller from London. Who might you be?

entries.text: Declan Ward, Sir. Pleased to meet you.

entries.text: No, very pleased to meet you, I'm sure. This is my first séance and I must say that everyone is so very interesting.

entries.text: Well, ah... I hope not to disappoint.

entries.text: I'm sure you won't, dear boy. Now - can I help you?

entries.text: Mister Ward, how are you?

entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Good day, Sir."
entries.text: Good day, Sir.

entries.text: And to you.

entries.text: Does this mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry

entries.text: You mean to tell me the poor girl's gone missing? It's the first I've heard of it.

entries.text: I can't accept this, Mister Ward, but you're very kind.

entries.text: Well, yes. Isn't that Miss Deane? She's a guest here, of course, I know her.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this woman?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this woman?

entries.text: Ah, very good. I use the '42 edition myself.

entries.text: You'll have to forgive me. I did a lot of research for the event and my travels to it.

entries.text: What you have is part of the 1829 Ordnance Survey Map. A fine piece of work.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "My house at home is littered with m..."
entries.text: My house at home is littered with maps and books on the area. I felt that grounding myself on the area, the house, its history, then I might feel just a little less out of my depth.

entries.text: [ GIVE HIM THE ALCOHOL. ]

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Séance advert - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "They seem to have spared no expense..."
entries.text: They seem to have spared no expense putting on this event.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I think it's fascinating. I underst..."
entries.text: I think it's fascinating. I understand many people have contacted ghosts before in roundabout ways, but to actually speak directly with one?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "God, what I would give to hear my L..."
entries.text: God, what I would give to hear my Lillian again...

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "What I have given..."
entries.text: What I have given...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of the intentions..."
entries.text: What do you make of the intentions for this séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I think it's fascinating. I underst..."
entries.text: I think it's fascinating. I understand many people have contacted ghosts before... but to get answers about death itself?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I have hope that it will be quite i..."
entries.text: I have hope that it will be quite illuminating.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "Is he here for the séance?"
entries.text: Is he here for the séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you just happen to be visiting,..."
entries.text: Do you just happen to be visiting, or are you here for the Grand Séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "While it's a beautiful place, I'm n..."
entries.text: While it's a beautiful place, I'm not visiting just for the scenery.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Which is probably for the best, con..."
entries.text: Which is probably for the best, considering this weather!

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "No, if this séance will really lowe..."
entries.text: No, if this séance will really lower the veil, as they say it will...

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "...there is someone on the other si..."
entries.text: ...there is someone on the other side I should like to speak with just once more.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I see."
entries.text: I see.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "Where did you hear of the event?"
entries.text: Where did you hear of the event?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How did you learn of the event? Do..."
entries.text: How did you learn of the event? Do you move in such circles?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Me, no? I'm a jeweller, so I often..."
entries.text: Me, no? I'm a jeweller, so I often meet the wealthier types this sort of thing seems to cater to.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "A man was inquiring about having a..."
entries.text: A man was inquiring about having a ring resized. Anyway, he let slip about the event, and my curiosity was piqued.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Once I wrangled the information fro..."
entries.text: Once I wrangled the information from him, I booked myself a space and, well, here I am.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Land Records - Coventry

entries.text: Does this mean anything to you, Sir?

entries.text: Do you happen to know what it is Miss Quinn is working on?

entries.text: Well, I wouldn't want to pry, but from what I've gathered, she's looking into the historical records of the region.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I believe she's looking into her an..."
entries.text: I believe she's looking into her ancestry, for whatever reason she might have.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Blake family - Coventry

entries.text: There's quite a number of portraits in the hallways. All Blakes, it looks like. Do you know anything about them?

entries.text: The Blakes? My dear boy, why would I? That would be the family's business, would it not?

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Edward Blake - Coventry

entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about Edward Blake?

entries.text: Ah, yes. Edward Blake had this manor built after the conquest of Ireland by Cromwell.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "He was a commander under General Cr..."
entries.text: He was a commander under General Cromwell, you see, and oversaw the sacking of the land. Once it was taken, he was gifted a part of it.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Accounts of his character... depend..."
entries.text: Accounts of his character... depend on who is writing the account.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Hauntings - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've heard talk that this manor is..."
entries.text: I've heard talk that this manor is haunted. Have you seen anything of the type?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Ah, well... I wouldn't like to call..."
entries.text: Ah, well... I wouldn't like to call it a haunting until I'm absolutely certain, but...

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Sometimes I hear people talking bef..."
entries.text: Sometimes I hear people talking before I walk into my room. There's no one there, of course... and it seems to be the same conversation each time.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I can't make any of it out, really...."
entries.text: I can't make any of it out, really. Probably just old pipes.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/The Séance's Purpose - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of the intentions..."
entries.text: What do you make of the intentions for this séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I think it's fascinating. I underst..."
entries.text: I think it's fascinating. I understand many people have contacted ghosts before... but to get answers about death itself?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I have hope that it will be quite i..."
entries.text: I have hope that it will be quite illuminating.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/The Freemasons - Coventry

entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about the Freemasons?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry

entries.text: I'm afraid I don't. I don't count myself among their number, you see.

entries.text: I don't suppose you know anything about the Second Sight?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry

entries.text: I wouldn't know anything. I don't know about all that, really...

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Personally, I don't believe in it...."
entries.text: Personally, I don't believe in it. The girl might have talent, but I think in that case, she might just be hysterical.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Ritual markings - Coventry

entries.text: Have you seen markings like this before?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I... No, what are they?"
entries.text: I... No, what are they?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That's what I am trying to figure o..."
entries.text: That's what I am trying to figure out.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Well, if you find out, let me know...."
entries.text: Well, if you find out, let me know. In all my studies, I've never seen anything remotely like them.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Statement O'Meara - Coventry

entries.text: Mister O'Meara says he saw Miss Deane on Tuesday night in something of a state - like she had been drinking.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "It's not polite for the boy to talk..."
entries.text: It's not polite for the boy to talk about a lady like that.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Bedroom skeleton key - Coventry

entries.text: You had best hand that back to the manager immediately.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Strange occurences - Coventry

entries.text: Have you noticed anything... strange happening around the manor?

entries.text: It's probably nothing, you know... but sometimes, I do think that there are more crows around here than there should be.

entries.text: Maybe this is what the Irish countryside is like... but... it feels as if they are watching me. All of them.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry

entries.text: As mundane as it likely is, it is very unsettling.

entries.text: Walking back to the house, I could have sworn I saw someone in the window. A young boy, it looks like.

entries.text: Well, she can't have just vanished. Either she came back, or she's gone.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "And she's not here... So she must h..."
entries.text: And she's not here... So she must have left, somehow, mustn't she?

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Hermetic Order - Coventry

entries.text: Do you know anything about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn?

entries.text: I'm certain I've heard of them... They're some sort of magical order, aren't they?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry

entries.text: Anything other than that, though... I'm afraid you're asking the wrong man.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry

entries.text: A Blake? Nobody comes to mind, I'm afraid to say.
