entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "There was! I had to dust off my ski..."
entries.text: There was! I had to dust off my skills a bit, but it was a fun little game altogether.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I hear there was a game of bridge t..."
entries.text: I hear there was a game of bridge the other night.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Ah, yes. Well - myself, Miss Callag..."
entries.text: Ah, yes. Well - myself, Miss Callaghan, Missus D'Arcy, Miss Barbosa, Miss Quinn, and Missus Lau were there. The Marquess Blake joined, too.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Might I ask who played? I may try t..."
entries.text: Might I ask who played? I may try to round up a game myself, so it would be good to know who plays.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Oh, and the Doctor stepped in for....."
entries.text: Oh, and the Doctor stepped in for... I want to say Mister Skerritt... who dropped out for some reason at the last moment.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/entertainment - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Seems I've missed most of the event..."
entries.text: Seems I've missed most of the events. I had to travel in short bursts, I don't have the stamina for the long haul anymore.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Did you attend anything, Mister War..."
entries.text: Did you attend anything, Mister Ward?

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/talks - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "This has been a very... interesting..."
entries.text: This has been a very... interesting week for me, Mister Ward. I've learned a lot of things I'd never have even considered could be known.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I fear my contribution will be very..."
entries.text: I fear my contribution will be very timid compared to some of the talks I've seen this week...

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "It's not surprising, of course, giv..."
entries.text: It's not surprising, of course, given my surroundings, but I'll confess, I really had no idea what I was signing myself up for when I decided to come here.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I can't even claim to be much of an..."
entries.text: I can't even claim to be much of an expert on this area. I just read a few books to prepare for the journey.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "When I was asked if I wanted to spe..."
entries.text: When I was asked if I wanted to speak, I panicked. I just hope that the little I know is enough to hold some interest for whoever attends.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/sylised ring - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This is an odd question, Mister Cov..."
entries.text: This is an odd question, Mister Coventry, but have you noticed Missus D'Arcy's brooch?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I have, yes. Hard not to spot a pie..."
entries.text: I have, yes. Hard not to spot a piece like that in my trade. But I must say it seemed familiar to me somehow.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "From what you've seen of it, do you..."
entries.text: From what you've seen of it, do you think it matches this ring?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Ah! That's how I know it. It was he..."
entries.text: Ah! That's how I know it. It was her man, Cecil D'Arcy, who told me of this event!

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "He wanted his ring - this ring - re..."
entries.text: He wanted his ring - this ring - resized for a lady's finger.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "He was unsure of the size of the ri..."
entries.text: He was unsure of the size of the ring finger, though, so he didn't get it done at the time.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Imagine a man not knowing his wife'..."
entries.text: Imagine a man not knowing his wife's ring size! In this, the year of our Lord, eighteen-ninety-seven!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You are a jeweller, are you not, Mi..."
entries.text: You are a jeweller, are you not, Mister Coventry? Have you seen a ring like this before?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Not one like that, Mister Ward - th..."
entries.text: Not one like that, Mister Ward - that very one!

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I saw it in London. It belonged to..."
entries.text: I saw it in London. It belonged to a Mister Cecil D'Arcy - the man who told me of this event!

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/large brooch - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This is an odd question, Mister Cov..."
entries.text: This is an odd question, Mister Coventry, but have you noticed Missus D'Arcy's brooch?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I have, yes. Hard not to spot a pie..."
entries.text: I have, yes. Hard not to spot a piece like that in my trade. But I must say it seemed familiar to me somehow.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I can't quite place why, though..."
entries.text: I can't quite place why, though...

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/The Grand Séance - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've heard of séances being perform..."
entries.text: I've heard of séances being performed, but I don't believe I've ever heard of such an event.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "It's supposed to be the first of it..."
entries.text: It's supposed to be the first of its kind! What an exciting thing to be a part of.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Despite the central conceit being r..."
entries.text: Despite the central conceit being rather grim, I can't help but find myself enthralled by it all.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Hedonistic Gala - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What did you think of the masked ba..."
entries.text: What did you think of the masked ball?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I've never been to anything like it..."
entries.text: I've never been to anything like it! When you get to my age, you think you've seen everything.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Evidently, I was wrong - I saw a gr..."
entries.text: Evidently, I was wrong - I saw a great many things. I had conversations with all manner of near-human things.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "It should have been terrifying, but..."
entries.text: It should have been terrifying, but it was all so exhilarating!

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I am left entirely drained by it to..."
entries.text: I am left entirely drained by it today, though.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Strange Dreams - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've found I'm having the strangest..."
entries.text: I've found I'm having the strangest dreams ever since I got here. Have you had anything of the sort?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Dreams? Em... no, nothing interesti..."
entries.text: Dreams? Em... no, nothing interesting, anyway.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've seen this symbol about the pla..."
entries.text: I've seen this symbol about the place - here, does it mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "My dear boy, I don't have the first..."
entries.text: My dear boy, I don't have the first clue about these things. Perhaps you should ask someone else.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Unknown Sigil - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I saw some sort of... rune, in my d..."
entries.text: I saw some sort of... rune, in my dream. A spiral with four lines intersecting it, one at the top, three at the bottom. Do you have any idea what it might be?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Me? No. But perhaps one of the fine..."
entries.text: Me? No. But perhaps one of the fine folks here might be able to help you?

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/painting of deane - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This is a fine location, is it not?..."
entries.text: This is a fine location, is it not? I only wish I knew how to capture it. Do you paint, Sir?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "...In fact, I do! It helps keep my..."
entries.text: ...In fact, I do! It helps keep my hands steady, which is useful for work.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you painted much while here?"
entries.text: Have you painted much while here?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Not as much as I'd hoped. There is..."
entries.text: Not as much as I'd hoped. There is so much happening that I'm not left with the energy.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What have you painted? A landscape?"
entries.text: What have you painted? A landscape?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Ah. I couldn't say, Sir, it is work..."
entries.text: Ah. I couldn't say, Sir, it is work that was done in confidence.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Oh, a commission?"
entries.text: Oh, a commission?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Something of the sort, but I couldn..."
entries.text: Something of the sort, but I couldn't say more. It wouldn't be gentlemanly.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/jeweller  - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You mentioned you are a jeweller?"
entries.text: You mentioned you are a jeweller?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I am, or rather I was."
entries.text: I am, or rather I was.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Eventually I wound up with my own s..."
entries.text: Eventually I wound up with my own shop in London. Did a tidy trade, earned enough to live well. No small feat in that city.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I sold up when my wife passed. It d..."
entries.text: I sold up when my wife passed. It didn't fill me in the same way it did before that.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I still do enough to cover my needs..."
entries.text: I still do enough to cover my needs - select clients and all that - but not a whole lot more.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I ended up in London alone as a you..."
entries.text: I ended up in London alone as a young lad. Nothing to my name. But my mother had loved jewels and so, as a result, did I.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I found work cleaning a shop, at fi..."
entries.text: I found work cleaning a shop, at first. I was a well spoken lad and, as I say, I knew my stuff so in time I was raised to sales.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "One thing led to another and time p..."
entries.text: One thing led to another and time passed by all too quickly.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/dead wife - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You mentioned losing your wife - my..."
entries.text: You mentioned losing your wife - my condolences, Sir.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I did, yes. Lillian. Earlier this y..."
entries.text: I did, yes. Lillian. Earlier this year.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "She turned quickly. We had access t..."
entries.text: She turned quickly. We had access to doctors, but they could do little to ease her suffering.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I'll confess, I am lost without her..."
entries.text: I'll confess, I am lost without her. Which, foolish as it sounds, is how I ended up here.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Her illness took everything from me..."
entries.text: Her illness took everything from me. The little I had left I spent to come here, on the hope that the claims about this séance are true.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "If I could see her, hear her, then..."
entries.text: If I could see her, hear her, then I'd gladly give it all - down to the very shirt on my back.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/locket - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This is a strange one, Mister Coven..."
entries.text: This is a strange one, Mister Coventry, but I found a dropped locket in the southwest corridor - which I believe you are staying in?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Oh - ah! Why, that belonged to my d..."
entries.text: Oh - ah! Why, that belonged to my dear dead wife. From before we married. Dabny, she was. Elaine Dabny.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This is a strange one, Mister Coven..."
entries.text: This is a strange one, Mister Coventry, but I have dropped a locket. It's a gift for my beloved, Elaine Donnelly, and bears her initials - might you have seen it?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I have not, but I shall keep an eye..."
entries.text: I have not, but I shall keep an eye out. Hopefully, these old eyes will be of some use!

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I'm here hoping to speak with her,..."
entries.text: I'm here hoping to speak with her, you see. I'm told something personal can help anchor the ghost. I must have dropped it. Thank you, Mister Ward.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/no mementos - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your wife, would you have a picture..."
entries.text: Your wife, would you have a picture I could see?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Ahhh, those are in my room - I'll r..."
entries.text: Ahhh, those are in my room - I'll remember to take one when I'm next there, to show you later on.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/will - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The young Master, Walter Blake - do..."
entries.text: The young Master, Walter Blake - do you know much of the lad?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Hmm? Well... Not a whole lot. He wa..."
entries.text: Hmm? Well... Not a whole lot. He was in a carriage accident some years back. The one his mother died in.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I gather it left the boy scarred bo..."
entries.text: I gather it left the boy scarred both mentally and physically.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "One couldn't be too lonely, I suppo..."
entries.text: One couldn't be too lonely, I suppose, in a large house surrounded by staff.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "He doesn't come out when the hotel..."
entries.text: He doesn't come out when the hotel has guests.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I... relate to him, in a way. I los..."
entries.text: I... relate to him, in a way. I lost my mother when I was young, too, so at least he is not entirely alone.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/sleep pills - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I find I just cannot sleep well her..."
entries.text: I find I just cannot sleep well here. I hope you are faring better...

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Ah, well, I have pills that help wi..."
entries.text: Ah, well, I have pills that help with that sort of thing. I'd wager I could fall asleep on a battlefield once I've taken them.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Or at least, I certainly don't reca..."
entries.text: Or at least, I certainly don't recall anything in the mornings.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Nothing, not even dreams get throug..."
entries.text: Nothing, not even dreams get through.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spotted anything of note o..."
entries.text: Have you spotted anything of note on today's schedule?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "The talks look interesting! I'm esp..."
entries.text: The talks look interesting! I'm especially interested in hearing the Marquess talk about the building and its history.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "And after a spot of lunch, Miss Cal..."
entries.text: And after a spot of lunch, Miss Callaghan's talk on the Otherworld, I think it's called, might be worth hearing.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Then a spot of dinner at 7 before t..."
entries.text: Then a spot of dinner at 7 before the fancy dress ball this evening.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I must confess, I hope that doesn't..."
entries.text: I must confess, I hope that doesn't run too late. Partying into the wee hours is behind me these days. As for tomorrow...

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "And I am interested in attending th..."
entries.text: And I am interested in attending the silent dinner at 8pm.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Other than that, I'm going to play..."
entries.text: Other than that, I'm going to play against myself in a game of chess. I am exhausted after last night's gathering and need to recover - should anyone need me, I'll be in a nice nook I found in the upper west corridor.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Anything planned for today?"
entries.text: Anything planned for today?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I hope to make the Doctor's talk at..."
entries.text: I hope to make the Doctor's talk at 3pm. And, of course, I am giving my own talk at 5pm - "History of the Region".

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Deane's room - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know which room Miss Deane w..."
entries.text: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Hmmm, why? Do you have business wit..."
entries.text: Hmmm, why? Do you have business with her?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Anyway, I cannot help you. It would..."
entries.text: Anyway, I cannot help you. It wouldn't be right to share that sort of information.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/gauge - coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The device in the atrium is a stran..."
entries.text: The device in the atrium is a strange one, no?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Everything here is strange to me! B..."
entries.text: Everything here is strange to me! But yes, that one really stood out.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I'm told it measures our readiness..."
entries.text: I'm told it measures our readiness for the séance. How I do not know.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "But now it is decreasing. I hope th..."
entries.text: But now it is decreasing. I hope that isn't anything to worry about...

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/washer woman - covo

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "You mean... the housekeeper? Missus..."
entries.text: You mean... the housekeeper? Missus Joyce? I assume she does all that work in the basement? Certainly, I've seen none of it anywhere else.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This may sound odd, but have you se..."
entries.text: This may sound odd, but have you seen a woman washing clothes on the grounds?

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/wife name mismatch - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Sorry, what was your wife's name ag..."
entries.text: Sorry, what was your wife's name again?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Eh... Lillian Coventry. Smith, befo..."
entries.text: Eh... Lillian Coventry. Smith, before we married.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Oh, you told me her name was Elaine..."
entries.text: Oh, you told me her name was Elaine Dabny.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Ah. Well, that was my first wife. A..."
entries.text: Ah. Well, that was my first wife. A man my age has history, you see...

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Cigar Burn  - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "One of the armchairs in the library..."
entries.text: One of the armchairs in the library seems to have suffered a few cigar burns.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Nothing to do with me dear boy, I c..."
entries.text: Nothing to do with me dear boy, I can assure you! I abstain from that kind of thing.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ivy - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss McLeod?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "A charming girl, by all accounts. I..."
entries.text: A charming girl, by all accounts. I'm surprised she's allowed to be here, though.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I wonder what her father thinks of..."
entries.text: I wonder what her father thinks of all this... And that dazed look in her eyes - you'd swear she was under the influence.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Varley - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the manager?"
entries.text: Have you met the manager?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Mister Varley? Only in passing. He'..."
entries.text: Mister Varley? Only in passing. He's taken every opportunity to ensure I'm well, but doesn't make much conversation outside of that.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Lan Fen - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Miss McLeod's chaperone? Only throu..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod's chaperone? Only through her companion. She seems as out of place here as myself!

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Skerritt - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "The freemason? Oh, I think I'm not..."
entries.text: The freemason? Oh, I think I'm not meant to let that slip - then again, he told me in no great confidence. I think he wanted to impress me.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "He seems a fine enough chap. I'll m..."
entries.text: He seems a fine enough chap. I'll make sure to get a business card from him; can't hurt to get in with that crowd!

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Corentine - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Quinn?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Not too much, she always seems so e..."
entries.text: Not too much, she always seems so engrossed in her work that I thought it best to leave her be.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "But we did have a brief chat about..."
entries.text: But we did have a brief chat about poetry one evening. I hope she enjoyed the break from her work.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Caitlin - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the housekeeper?"
entries.text: Have you met the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Missus Joyce? Chatty woman, very li..."
entries.text: Missus Joyce? Chatty woman, very likeable.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Missus Joyce? Chatty woman. No love..."
entries.text: Missus Joyce? Chatty woman. No love lost on our resident mystics, certainly.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Word to the wise, don't ask her abo..."
entries.text: Word to the wise, don't ask her about Miss Mantovani. I think it very nearly killed her...

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Darragh - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Hunter?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Hunter?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "He collected me off the train and b..."
entries.text: He collected me off the train and brought me over. Fine fellow. Seems to know a bit about magic himself, which took me by surprise.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Seamus - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the porter?"
entries.text: Have you met the porter?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Doyle is his name, isn't it? I don'..."
entries.text: Doyle is his name, isn't it? I don't want to spread rumours, but I think he might have been drunk or something when he took my bags.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "But, I suppose, we all have our cro..."
entries.text: But, I suppose, we all have our crosses to bear.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ines - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Happily! I caught her for a few mom..."
entries.text: Happily! I caught her for a few moments while out walking on one of the less damp days.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I've never met anyone from Brazil b..."
entries.text: I've never met anyone from Brazil before, so I was rather pleased to.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "She seemed interested in the local..."
entries.text: She seemed interested in the local area and its history, which I happened to have read up on a bit for this trip.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I was no help to her, really, but i..."
entries.text: I was no help to her, really, but it was nice to talk about something... normal while here.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ettiene - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister Touissant?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "We first met at dinner a few evenin..."
entries.text: We first met at dinner a few evenings back. Once he learned I wasn't - what did he call it? - a practitioner, he softened toward me.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Cathal - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you tell me anything on Mister..."
entries.text: Can you tell me anything on Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Oh. Ah- Well, we spoke, but he quic..."
entries.text: Oh. Ah- Well, we spoke, but he quickly grew bored, I'm afraid. I'm not very versed in all this magic stuff, you see.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Dupré - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Dupré?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "He seems like a good man. And doing..."
entries.text: He seems like a good man. And doing quite well for himself, if I do say so. It was nice to talk to another genuine businessman for a while.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "And, well, we discussed our recent..."
entries.text: And, well, we discussed our recent bereavements too - I hope he finds a good resting place for his friend.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on D'Arcy - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had any dealings with Miss..."
entries.text: Have you had any dealings with Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "That one's a firecracker, that's fo..."
entries.text: That one's a firecracker, that's for certain! She seems friendly with Mister Dupré - questionably so, for a married woman. I gather some people expected her husband here, but he couldn't make it in the end.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me about yourself, Mister Cove..."
entries.text: Tell me about yourself, Mister Coventry.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Are you sure? I'm not nearly as int..."
entries.text: Are you sure? I'm not nearly as interesting as the other guests.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I wouldn't say that. I don't find a..."
entries.text: I wouldn't say that. I don't find anyone here uninteresting.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "You're too kind, Mister Ward. I'm n..."
entries.text: You're too kind, Mister Ward. I'm not sure there's much to say about myself; I'm but an ageing jeweller. Making do, but not on par with many other guests here.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I love a good read and, even at my..."
entries.text: I love a good read and, even at my age, I can recall a fair bit of most things I've taken in. It's left me something of an armchair historian.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "If it concerns Britain or Ireland i..."
entries.text: If it concerns Britain or Ireland in the past five hundred years, I can likely tell you something about it.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "In fact, I'm giving a talk tomorrow..."
entries.text: In fact, I'm giving a talk tomorrow on the "History of the Region", at 5pm.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Why, I gave a talk on the "History..."
entries.text: Why, I gave a talk on the "History of the Region" earlier today.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "In fact, I'm giving a talk today on..."
entries.text: In fact, I'm giving a talk today on the "History of the Region", at 5pm.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Hazel - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Missus Erickso..."
entries.text: Have you spoken with Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Not much - I think she's more inter..."
entries.text: Not much - I think she's more interested in speaking with the other magicians.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I don't mind, I can't blame her for..."
entries.text: I don't mind, I can't blame her for it.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ruairí - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I have indeed - a fine fellow. We'v..."
entries.text: I have indeed - a fine fellow. We've had some discussions about the whole idea behind this event. The nature of séances, and such.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I must say, I'm surprised to meet a..."
entries.text: I must say, I'm surprised to meet a doctor who's both that and any sort of magician... but that just goes to show how much I have to learn.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Deane - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Deane?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Not really, no. Every time I see he..."
entries.text: Not really, no. Every time I see her, she is exhausted from her day.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I suppose this is an important even..."
entries.text: I suppose this is an important event for her. Even though I don't know the woman, I can tell she's a big fish in this pond!

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I'm sure she'll find time for me by..."
entries.text: I'm sure she'll find time for me by the time all this is over.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Carmela - Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are your thoughts on Miss Mant..."
entries.text: What are your thoughts on Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I gather she is very well-respected..."
entries.text: I gather she is very well-respected in the field. She's quite the catch for an event as far off as this - indeed, I think she's the sole reason so many have come this far!

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "She gave me a reading. It all sound..."
entries.text: She gave me a reading. It all sounded very impressive, but didn't make all that much sense to me, I'm afraid...

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Arwa - Coventry

entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Miss Hisham?

entries.text: Devastatingly bright, that woman - though she seems to get distracted mid-conversation.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "We were talking about the claiming..."
entries.text: We were talking about the claiming of artefacts from occupied territories and she just... went cold.

entries.text: What do you make of Mister Ó Finn?

entries.text: We've not properly met. An odd fellow to see at a gathering like this.

entries.label: Coventry: "But then, what do I know about gath..."
entries.text: But then, what do I know about gatherings like this?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Quite the character though. He's st..."
entries.text: Quite the character though. He's strikes a mighty portrait, wouldn't you say?

entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Miss Callaghan?

entries.text: Not so much. She spends a lot of her time out in the maze, but my knees aren't up for that - not in this weather.

entries.text: Have you spoken to Marquess Blake yet?

entries.text: The things he's suffered - the loss of his wife, injuries to his son...

entries.text: I can see why he'd invest in an event like this so heavily.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "A few times, the poor man..."
entries.text: A few times, the poor man...

entries.text: Have you spoken to the cook, Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "No, no. I don't see a need to distr..."
entries.text: No, no. I don't see a need to distract her from her duties.

title: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Walter Blake - Coventry

entries.text: If I understand correctly, the Marquess has a son living somewhere in the manor.

entries.text: He lives in their private residence off the east wing, I believe.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "Having lost his mother at such a yo..."
entries.text: Having lost his mother at such a young age, that is understandable.

entries.text: I saw him once, being wheeled through the grounds - but that was only from a distance.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "I gave him a wave and he returned i..."
entries.text: I gave him a wave and he returned it, but I'll admit it was lacklustre. Not used to people, a bit of a recluse.

entries.text: Have you met Father Sinnott?

entries.text: He's a curious sort, isn't he? Very... stern. Though, I suppose in some ways this is a rather serious event... so truthfully I can't blame him for it.

entries.speaker: Mister Coventry
entries.label: Coventry: "He spends a lot of time wandering t..."
entries.text: He spends a lot of time wandering the grounds. Blessing it, for what is to come, he tells me.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Oh. A new face? So late in the proc..."
entries.text: Oh. A new face? So late in the proceedings...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Mister Ward... You need to talk to..."
entries.text: Mister Ward... You need to talk to me?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Then who are you, Sir, that would p..."
entries.text: Then who are you, Sir, that would peer into a house with the veil halfway lifted?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Scoundrel, or scholar?"
entries.text: Scoundrel, or scholar?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Neither, I confess. I'm more of an..."
entries.text: Neither, I confess. I'm more of an interested party than anything else, Miss...?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Arwa. My name is Arwa Hisham. I am..."
entries.text: Arwa. My name is Arwa Hisham. I am a scholar. An archaeologist from Cairo. And you, what is your name?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm Declan Ward, Miss Hisham. Pleas..."
entries.text: I'm Declan Ward, Miss Hisham. Pleased to meet you.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll leave you be."
entries.text: I'll leave you be.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "May Allah guide you."
entries.text: May Allah guide you.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "If you find the artefact, Mister Wa..."
entries.text: If you find the artefact, Mister Ward, you must break it. Leave nothing but powder and dust.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Cursed? If you're trying to dissuad..."
entries.text: Cursed? If you're trying to dissuade me, you will need to choose more than the hysteria of...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "...you are serious."
entries.text: ...you are serious.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm afraid so."
entries.text: I'm afraid so.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "The thing hasn't left my mind since..."
entries.text: The thing hasn't left my mind since I first discovered its existence...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Every moment I am awake... even whe..."
entries.text: Every moment I am awake... even when I am not - I think of that vase. If I am very still, I feel it pulling me away from myself.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Not just obsession, then.... I will..."
entries.text: Not just obsession, then.... I will not be subject to such a thing. Will you help me? Will you find and destroy it?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Normally, I would not condone the d..."
entries.text: Normally, I would not condone the destruction of something so ancient... But such a thing should never have survived this long.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "And always, always... I hear a song..."
entries.text: And always, always... I hear a song, in the back of my head, I have never heard before. I wrote it down, though I do not know what for.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Here. Do you see? I am not myself...."
entries.text: Here. Do you see? I am not myself. And yet it seems so important...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "And take the music, too, in case it..."
entries.text: And take the music, too, in case it helps you.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "You found your way down here, too,..."
entries.text: You found your way down here, too, then?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "This is... not what it looks like!"
entries.text: This is... not what it looks like!

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I was hoping to find more of intere..."
entries.text: I was hoping to find more of interest down here, but it seems long abandoned. You?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "..."

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Wait, you are also not meant to be..."
entries.text: Wait, you are also not meant to be here.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The same, looking for something of..."
entries.text: The same, looking for something of interest. I think, in my case, I found it. You would be?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The same, Miss Hisham. Though I thi..."
entries.text: The same, Miss Hisham. Though I think I, too, am hitting a dead end.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "It seems our path is one. Maybe we..."
entries.text: It seems our path is one. Maybe we can keep one another's discretion?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What brought you down here?"
entries.text: What brought you down here?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I... am seeking a vase. This vase."
entries.text: I... am seeking a vase. This vase.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "It was stolen from my people and I..."
entries.text: It was stolen from my people and I want to bring it home. You?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I am... searching for somebody."
entries.text: I am... searching for somebody.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Who? Is it Evelyn Deane?"
entries.text: Who? Is it Evelyn Deane?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your friend, Evelyn Deane."
entries.text: Your friend, Evelyn Deane.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me, Miss, did you hire me to s..."
entries.text: Tell me, Miss, did you hire me to search for her?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "No, but I am glad somebody did. I a..."
entries.text: No, but I am glad somebody did. I am also looking for her, while I search for my vase. If I find anything, you will be the first to know.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I was hired to find her."
entries.text: I was hired to find her.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Music? I wonder if I can find somew..."
entries.text: Music? I wonder if I can find somewhere to play this...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...How did you know?"
entries.text: ...How did you know?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I am glad to hear that. I am also l..."
entries.text: I am glad to hear that. I am also looking for her, while I search for my vase. If I find anything, you will be the first to know.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "She is missing, is she not? I have..."
entries.text: She is missing, is she not? I have not seen her in days! She is my friend.

entries.text: And as is true of so much of our history in Egypt, it was taken from its rightful home and kept as a souvenir.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Supposedly, it's stored somewhere a..."
entries.text: Supposedly, it's stored somewhere among the Blakes' possessions.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I would be interested in... seeing..."
entries.text: I would be interested in... seeing it...

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Melody - Arwa

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I keep hearing these notes in my mi..."
entries.text: I keep hearing these notes in my mind. Over and over, clear like the blue sky.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I have some idea that they are conn..."
entries.text: I have some idea that they are connected to the vase I am looking for, but I am not sure how.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What is this melody?"
entries.text: What is this melody?

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Manor Maps - Arwa

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Some but I'm keen to see it all. No..."
entries.text: Some but I'm keen to see it all. Not all of it is open to the public.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you explored much of the Manor..."
entries.text: Have you explored much of the Manor?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I wonder how upset they would reall..."
entries.text: I wonder how upset they would really be to find me outside of those bounds? What harm could come from curiosity?

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Lady W Blake - Arwa

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Hah, say "owner" if you like. But d..."
entries.text: Hah, say "owner" if you like. But don't expect me to call a thief by any other name.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems that Lady Wilhelmina Blake..."
entries.text: It seems that Lady Wilhelmina Blake was not the finder, but the last known owner of the vase.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "But if she was the last to have it...."
entries.text: But if she was the last to have it... Maybe she stored it somewhere in this place.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "That could be so, Mister Ward, but..."
entries.text: That could be so, Mister Ward, but I haven't been able to find any written documentation that confirms it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The vase you're looking for, I thin..."
entries.text: The vase you're looking for, I think it may be similar to the one Lady Wilhelmina Blake seems to be holding in her portrait in the atrium.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "In any case, she is long gone. Perh..."
entries.text: In any case, she is long gone. Perhaps it has been stored somewhere in her absence...

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Timetable - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are your plans for Saturday?"
entries.text: What are your plans for Saturday?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Well, I do not think I can miss the..."
entries.text: Well, I do not think I can miss the Ball this evening. I want to know what is considered to be a party over here.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Until then, I am interested in the..."
entries.text: Until then, I am interested in the history of this manor, so I will attend the Marquess' talk at eleven.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "And I'm meeting Mister O'Meara for..."
entries.text: And I'm meeting Mister O'Meara for lunch at one. As for tomorrow...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are your plans for today?"
entries.text: What are your plans for today?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Social obligations aside, I intend..."
entries.text: Social obligations aside, I intend to explore the Manor. Quite an interesting building, and so large. I'm sure it holds many secrets...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I hear the graveyard is opening up,..."
entries.text: I hear the graveyard is opening up, too. I may pay it a visit around eleven.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "And of course, I do not think I can..."
entries.text: And of course, I do not think I can miss the séance...

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Soul jars - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does the term "soul jar" mean anyth..."
entries.text: Does the term "soul jar" mean anything to you, Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Well, it's not technically my field..."
entries.text: Well, it's not technically my field of expertise, but they are jars used to capture the essence of living beings.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Not all of them, of course. Soul ja..."
entries.text: Not all of them, of course. Soul jars were part of funeral rites in the East, and no, um, real-world effect. But I suspect, here, you are asking about the magical type I outlined.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/catacomb map - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen this map of the catac..."
entries.text: Have you seen this map of the catacombs underneath the manor?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I have not, but I would like to."
entries.text: I have not, but I would like to.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "It seems I have not missed anything..."
entries.text: It seems I have not missed anything. Mafawetesh No'ta.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Shukran, Mister Ward. Rayaht bali...."
entries.text: Shukran, Mister Ward. Rayaht bali. You've... put my mind at ease.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "..."

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "It doesn't look like there is anywh..."
entries.text: It doesn't look like there is anywhere to hide items of value, but it might not hurt to check.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/gauge - arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed the strange device..."
entries.text: Have you noticed the strange device in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Eventually. I didn't notice it unde..."
entries.text: Eventually. I didn't notice it under the stairs until one day I saw a few guests gathered around it.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "They had noticed its gauge increasi..."
entries.text: They had noticed its gauge increasing and were wondering why. I did not care, so I left them to it.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/reflection - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How are you feeling now?"
entries.text: How are you feeling now?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I feel... like myself again. Like w..."
entries.text: I feel... like myself again. Like when a cold has passed by. I am restored.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "But the vase - what magic was that?..."
entries.text: But the vase - what magic was that? How does something like that work?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "What did "Wilhelmina" get up to whe..."
entries.text: What did "Wilhelmina" get up to when she left here?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Was it Nectanebo who had taken hold..."
entries.text: Was it Nectanebo who had taken hold of her body at the time, or some Jinn? - and what damage have they done?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I feel like these things may become..."
entries.text: I feel like these things may become my next obsession...

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Skerritt - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to spe..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "The opportunity? That is not what I..."
entries.text: The opportunity? That is not what I would call it. But no, I haven't spoken to him beyond a cursory 'hello'. I don't believe he is interested in talking with a person like me.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Corentine - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to spe..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "The poet... Yes. She seemed tired s..."
entries.text: The poet... Yes. She seemed tired so I brought her a coffee.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "We sat and talked a while. We have..."
entries.text: We sat and talked a while. We have both studied this area. Me, the house, and her, the region.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I cannot say we pushed along each o..."
entries.text: I cannot say we pushed along each other's agendas, but it was nice to find overlaps nonetheless.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ivy - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss McLeod?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "A strange girl with two faces!"
entries.text: A strange girl with two faces!

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "She needs to decide which to wear,..."
entries.text: She needs to decide which to wear, before she's left with nothing between her ears.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "We spoke only once, and it was nons..."
entries.text: We spoke only once, and it was nonsense she spoke - but there was enough between the lines.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Lan Fen - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to spe..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Yes. She walks more comfortably in..."
entries.text: Yes. She walks more comfortably in this world than I, but it's still not home to her.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "We got on well, until I told her I..."
entries.text: We got on well, until I told her I was friends with Miss Deane.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "She kept her composure, but she pre..."
entries.text: She kept her composure, but she pretended to get cold and quickly left.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Why she has such issue with Evelyn..."
entries.text: Why she has such issue with Evelyn I do not know, but I could tell her blood was boiling just under that cold surface.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I gather that my friend has that ef..."
entries.text: I gather that my friend has that effect on people...

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Varley - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Mister Varley?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with Mister Varley?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "The poor man. I have him hounded wi..."
entries.text: The poor man. I have him hounded with questions about the place. He is good to entertain me, but more tight-lipped in his answers than I want.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I was hoping for a tour of the more..."
entries.text: I was hoping for a tour of the more private sections of the house, but the man is a stone wall!

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Really, what do they have to hide!"
entries.text: Really, what do they have to hide!

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Caitlin - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the housekeeper?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "It seems we have a mutual disintere..."
entries.text: It seems we have a mutual disinterest in conversation. Except for once when she demanded to know why I was here, but...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I wonder, why does she care?"
entries.text: I wonder, why does she care?

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Darragh - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the groundsman?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the groundsman?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Not much... but we spoke when he br..."
entries.text: Not much... but we spoke when he brought the carriage to the station for me.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "He's a friendly face. More than som..."
entries.text: He's a friendly face. More than some people here, that's for sure.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I'd love to know what is in his saf..."
entries.text: I'd love to know what is in his safe. I saw him hurriedly deposit something there one evening last week. I wonder if it's a key?

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Seamus - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the porter?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the porter?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "He talks more than my old Auntie! I..."
entries.text: He talks more than my old Auntie! I asked him a bit about the ground, and could have written a book with what he shared.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "He even offered to lend me his keys..."
entries.text: He even offered to lend me his keys so I could see more of the grounds for myself, but then realised he had lost them.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Such a shame."
entries.text: Such a shame.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ines - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Ah, the only woman who has out-trav..."
entries.text: Ah, the only woman who has out-travelled me.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I confess, I like her. No formal ed..."
entries.text: I confess, I like her. No formal education in such things as we scholars study here...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "How do you say... Betgeeb mel-akher..."
entries.text: How do you say... Betgeeb mel-akher? - she gets right to the point. It's very refreshing.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Like me, she is more interested in..."
entries.text: Like me, she is more interested in this area than the séance.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I suppose you need a stronger reaso..."
entries.text: I suppose you need a stronger reason to come so far.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ettiene - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've spoken with..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've spoken with Mister Toussaint?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "As it happens, I have. A scholar of..."
entries.text: As it happens, I have. A scholar of magic and religious ritual, he said, and their misuse.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "An intriguing topic. And a startlin..."
entries.text: An intriguing topic. And a startlingly pleasant man. Which is why it pains me to see him so concerned.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Cathal - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Mister O'Meara..."
entries.text: Have you spoken with Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Yes. In fact, we corresponded befor..."
entries.text: Yes. In fact, we corresponded before the event. His father deals in antiques, and I have found myself working as a go-between.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "That has put me in touch with some..."
entries.text: That has put me in touch with some members of the Golden Dawn who seek more... mystical wares...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Many of them are satisfied with any..."
entries.text: Many of them are satisfied with any pot if it's old enough, and the merchants in Cairo are always happy to relieve them of their gold.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I... am rambling. Mister O'Meara re..."
entries.text: I... am rambling. Mister O'Meara reached out through a previous client and wanted something more interesting.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "An interesting challenge that I hap..."
entries.text: An interesting challenge that I happily overcame.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Dupré - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Dupré?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Yes. We have spoken. He is a perfec..."
entries.text: Yes. We have spoken. He is a perfect gentleman.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "And yet, he had the strangest look..."
entries.text: And yet, he had the strangest look on his face... and the questions he asked... I could not answer.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on D'Arcy - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I might even consider her a friend..."
entries.text: I might even consider her a friend of sorts, provided she wouldn't be put out by the familiarity.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I see something of myself in her, a..."
entries.text: I see something of myself in her, and I think the feeling is mutual. We're two halves of the same bean.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Besides, she makes me laugh."
entries.text: Besides, she makes me laugh.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Coventry - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I have. He is also a student of the..."
entries.text: I have. He is also a student of the past. He is fascinated with his British Empire and we did not see eye to eye when it came to stolen goods.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "He had a 'might makes right' attitu..."
entries.text: He had a 'might makes right' attitude. If something can be taken, then take it - by any means.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Hazel - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Yes. I have, yes. A show-woman to h..."
entries.text: Yes. I have, yes. A show-woman to her core. She was trying to impress me with her knowledge of the seven elements, the eye of Horus, the concept of Ma'at, and other things she no doubt learned skimming through a book.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "It would be like me trying to impre..."
entries.text: It would be like me trying to impress you by listing the ten commandments and your three most popular Saints.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I do not think I would break salt a..."
entries.text: I do not think I would break salt and bread with this woman.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ruairí - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've spoken to Do..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've spoken to Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "He introduced himself to me, and it..."
entries.text: He introduced himself to me, and it became clear that we have almost nothing in common.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Almost. Once we moved past magic an..."
entries.text: Almost. Once we moved past magic and mysticism and got into politics, then the conversation flowed.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "In Egypt, we have been under Britis..."
entries.text: In Egypt, we have been under British occupation for fifteen years. Not that they would admit it.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Yes, a drop in the ocean compared t..."
entries.text: Yes, a drop in the ocean compared to what you have suffered but it is good to hear after all this time and all these tragedies, you have not lost your fight.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Doctor Callaghan assures me there a..."
entries.text: Doctor Callaghan assures me there are movements forming - who knows, perhaps in your lifetime you will know freedom!

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I only hope my people see it soon,..."
entries.text: I only hope my people see it soon, too.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "True, it is not a formal occupation..."
entries.text: True, it is not a formal occupation, but they've put enough money and troops into my country to start their own nation, so I'm not too concerned with what they want to call it.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Arwa - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about yourself..."
entries.text: What can you tell me about yourself, Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I am a historian and Egyptologist,..."
entries.text: I am a historian and Egyptologist, and I am here to see how the adoption of ancient Egyptian culture and symbology is being used in... 'magic'.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I think there are arguments to be h..."
entries.text: I think there are arguments to be had about the nature of this magic, but I would not invite myself to those arguments.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Otherwise... otherwise, I am the el..."
entries.text: Otherwise... otherwise, I am the eldest of three daughters, and I would very much like to see my sisters soon before they run off and marry the first pretty poet boy they meet.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Hopefully, I will not be kept too l..."
entries.text: Hopefully, I will not be kept too long in this part of the world. It is lovely but my bones were not made for this cold.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Deane - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Deane?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "She is... an acquaintance. No, a fr..."
entries.text: She is... an acquaintance. No, a friend. We have been writing to her for some time.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "She is the reason I came here; she..."
entries.text: She is the reason I came here; she invited me. Based on my work, my... research.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "But I have not seen her in a day or..."
entries.text: But I have not seen her in a day or two. At first, I actually forgot she was here. My friend, who brought me here - It's like forgetting to eat or drink!

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Then I found some of our correspond..."
entries.text: Then I found some of our correspondence and it reminded me she was here. But I can not find her now.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I am worried for her."
entries.text: I am worried for her.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Carmela - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "She seems... like a good woman. She..."
entries.text: She seems... like a good woman. She has quite the skill in showmanship. Seems that she fills people's eyes more than any other guest.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "After all, if you believe in all th..."
entries.text: After all, if you believe in all this magic, then why are none of these other magicians hosting? Surely one among them might match her.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I'm sure she's talented, but she ha..."
entries.text: I'm sure she's talented, but she has a way of speaking that makes you want to listen to her, and that, I think, is the heart of it.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Fiadh - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "She looks at me as if there is a ge..."
entries.text: She looks at me as if there is a gecko on my head.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "It makes me uncomfortable, and so I..."
entries.text: It makes me uncomfortable, and so I avoid her.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Sinnott - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Father Sinnott?"
entries.text: Have you met Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Christians have been coming to my l..."
entries.text: Christians have been coming to my land for as long as there have been Christians.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "But it has been getting worse recen..."
entries.text: But it has been getting worse recently. Since the British occupation, more and more missionaries have come.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Father Sinnott, however, did not se..."
entries.text: Father Sinnott, however, did not seem to care about my faith. He asked, shrugged, and then talked about lost tombs and buried sites.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I do not trust him, of course, but..."
entries.text: I do not trust him, of course, but I appreciated the conversation and the lack of religious interest.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Saoirse - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Murphy?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "...The resident cook? We've run int..."
entries.text: ...The resident cook? We've run into each other a few times.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "She always looks worried about some..."
entries.text: She always looks worried about something, but I can never tell what for all her stammering.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ó Finn - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "People will stare at me less, now,..."
entries.text: People will stare at me less, now, so long as he is around to fill their eyes.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "We have not spoken yet, not properl..."
entries.text: We have not spoken yet, not properly. I will try make time later on, once... well, when I am freed up.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
