entries.text: Have you spoken to the Reverend?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Why would I? I am not looking for r..."
entries.text: Why would I? I am not looking for religion; I have my own.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Higgins - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of the man you saw..."
entries.text: What do you make of the man you saw Father Sinnott talking to?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "What do you expect me to make of hi..."
entries.text: What do you expect me to make of him? I only saw him from a distance.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "He looked strong, like a labourer,..."
entries.text: He looked strong, like a labourer, but he was not very remarkable, otherwise, and I heard nothing from him, so I cannot form an opinion on his manner.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "All I can do is wonder why he was h..."
entries.text: All I can do is wonder why he was here at all.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Blake - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the chance to speak wi..."
entries.text: Have you had the chance to speak with the Marquess?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Not so much as I would like - I hav..."
entries.text: Not so much as I would like - I have a lot to say to that man about his ancestors and their sticky fingers.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I'd say half the things in this hou..."
entries.text: I'd say half the things in this house have been stolen from overseas.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "With the other half, of course, hav..."
entries.text: With the other half, of course, having been stolen from the natives here.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Walter Blake - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the Young Master at al..."
entries.text: Have you met the Young Master at all?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "No, nor have I seen him. But then,..."
entries.text: No, nor have I seen him. But then, why would I?

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/Tired eyes - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had trouble sleeping of la..."
entries.text: Have you had trouble sleeping of late, Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "And... if I have? It is a strange p..."
entries.text: And... if I have? It is a strange place where up is down, down is left, and God-only-knows where right is. Is that not to be expected?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I have not slept properly in... som..."
entries.text: I have not slept properly in... some time, now. Maybe even before I came here...

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/Restless hands - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you been drawing?"
entries.text: Have you been drawing?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Ah, the charcoal... yes, it gets ev..."
entries.text: Ah, the charcoal... yes, it gets everywhere. It is useful for sketches of artefacts, shading...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "To manipulate the values of light a..."
entries.text: To manipulate the values of light and dark and bring life to a still image... But still, to never match the real thing.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/headdress - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your headdress, Miss Hisham - does..."
entries.text: Your headdress, Miss Hisham - does it carry any significance?

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "It is a tarha. Headdresses are a sy..."
entries.text: It is a tarha. Headdresses are a symbol of my faith and devotion as a Sunni Muslim. I am thinking, perhaps, you do not get so many of us over here?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I must confess, you would be the fi..."
entries.text: I must confess, you would be the first I met of that ilk.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/necklace - Arwa

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your necklace, it is an unusual des..."
entries.text: Your necklace, it is an unusual design...

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "It is made from pottery I have exca..."
entries.text: It is made from pottery I have excavated. The pottery was not actually old or valuable, a modern pot covered in countless sandstorms.

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "I wear it to remind me to stay in t..."
entries.text: I wear it to remind me to stay in the present - there is beauty to be found here, as much as in the past. Something I find myself struggling with these days.

title: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Ward in room - Arwa

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "What do you think you're-? Get out!"
entries.text: What do you think you're-? Get out!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Hisham-"
entries.text: Miss Hisham-

entries.speaker: Miss Hisham
entries.label: Arwa: "Bara! In fact, let's get out togeth..."
entries.text: Bara! In fact, let's get out together - and we can see what the manager thinks of this behaviour.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Mister Ward. You've come back to me..."
entries.text: Mister Ward. You've come back to me.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "And you are?"
entries.text: And you are?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "My name is Declan Ward."
entries.text: My name is Declan Ward.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Recently arrived?"
entries.text: Recently arrived?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Yes, Miss...?"
entries.text: Yes, Miss...?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "What brings you here?"
entries.text: What brings you here?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm interested to see this Grand Sé..."
entries.text: I'm interested to see this Grand Séance... I saw the advert, and I have to admit, it intrigued me.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Ah, then you're among company. Ever..."
entries.text: Ah, then you're among company. Everyone is here for the séance, I believe.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Why would you be sorry about that?..."
entries.text: Why would you be sorry about that? I haven't told you.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name..."
entries.text: I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Don't look so concerned! My name is..."
entries.text: Don't look so concerned! My name is Olivia D'Arcy, Mister Ward. A pleasure, I'm sure.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "A fair point."
entries.text: A fair point.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That was all. Good day, Missus D'Ar..."
entries.text: That was all. Good day, Missus D'Arcy.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Good day, Mister Ward."
entries.text: Good day, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I... what a dark horse you are, Mis..."
entries.text: I... what a dark horse you are, Mister Ward. But for what purpose? Why go to all this trouble? Would you mock me?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "...Or do you mean something worthwh..."
entries.text: ...Or do you mean something worthwhile by it? I - I confess, I killed my husband. I did. It seemed to me there was nothing else I could do.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Everything he put me through... I s..."
entries.text: Everything he put me through... I saw nothing but red until he was cold in the ground. And then I thought, it wasn't only him who wronged me...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "There was the woman, too, who had c..."
entries.text: There was the woman, too, who had caught his attention. She must have known. Our Evelyn Deane.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "So yes, I came here under his name,..."
entries.text: So yes, I came here under his name, intent on finding her. To this forsaken backwater on the west coast of nowhere. To... to do something terrible to her. But now... Well, now, I don't think I wish as much vengeance as I thought.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "But since I've been here... I didn'..."
entries.text: But since I've been here... I didn't really believe in ghosts and magic before all this, you know. But I'll tell you this; I do now. My husband is haunting me.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I don't want vengeance, but I do wa..."
entries.text: I don't want vengeance, but I do want to be rid of him. And maybe he'll be content if he has her for company. If that is what it takes...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There's no need to resort to such t..."
entries.text: There's no need to resort to such things, Missus D'Arcy. Let me see if I can do something about your husband.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Chance would be a damn fine thing."
entries.text: Chance would be a damn fine thing.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "You might well recognise my name fr..."
entries.text: You might well recognise my name from my work? I'm a known writer of  thriller novels.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hiring telegram - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of this, Missus?"
entries.text: What do you make of this, Missus?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Is this some sort of joke?"
entries.text: Is this some sort of joke?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "You're here to look for Miss Deane,..."
entries.text: You're here to look for Miss Deane, because she's missing? Then why is no one talking about this?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Do you mean to report me then? For..."
entries.text: Do you mean to report me then? For murdering my husband?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I am not a police officer. I have n..."
entries.text: I am not a police officer. I have no legal obligation to do so.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "What about a moral one?"
entries.text: What about a moral one?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I... know what happened. Between yo..."
entries.text: I... know what happened. Between you. To you. I can see how you ended up where you did.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Mister Ward, it would have taken a..."
entries.text: Mister Ward, it would have taken a mystic to see where I was to end up.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "If there is any consolation in it,..."
entries.text: If there is any consolation in it, it is not something I would do again.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "A haunting changes one's perspectiv..."
entries.text: A haunting changes one's perspective on such things.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How about this, then - a second cha..."
entries.text: How about this, then - a second chance.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I will monitor the news where you l..."
entries.text: I will monitor the news where you live and only intervene if any husbands go mysteriously missing. Does that sound fair?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I don't know, Sir... Mister Baker f..."
entries.text: I don't know, Sir... Mister Baker from number 11 is an awful bore. If I need to listen to him talk about his bay trees one more time...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I shouldn't joke, I know. It is fai..."
entries.text: I shouldn't joke, I know. It is fair, Sir. Thank you for your kindness to me through all this.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Photograph of Deane - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this woman?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this woman?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Mm. Oh, that's Miss Deane, isn't it..."
entries.text: Mm. Oh, that's Miss Deane, isn't it? She was around here just a little while ago...

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance advert - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you suppose the séance will be s..."
entries.text: Do you suppose the séance will be successful?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I would hope so. It's a long way to..."
entries.text: I would hope so. It's a long way to come for a failure.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "But I'm sure all these experts - ho..."
entries.text: But I'm sure all these experts - how hard can it be?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I'm still struggling to understand..."
entries.text: I'm still struggling to understand the significance between asking a medium to tell me a ghost's name, and asking the ghost itself?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "What is the difference, really, bet..."
entries.text: What is the difference, really, between asking a ghost their name and asking one to stay a while?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "It's all the same to me as long as..."
entries.text: It's all the same to me as long as the ghost leaves afterwards. That's the part I am interested in.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Marriage talk - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I hear that one of the young women..."
entries.text: I hear that one of the young women in attendance is looking for a suitor.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Really? Poor darling, she should sp..."
entries.text: Really? Poor darling, she should spare herself the trouble.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Statement Mister Varley - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The manager says that Miss Deane ch..."
entries.text: The manager says that Miss Deane checked out by means of a letter on Tuesday night.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "And she's gone, just like that? Who..."
entries.text: And she's gone, just like that? Who leaves without a word of goodbye? For God's sake...

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hauntings - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've been hearing talk that this ma..."
entries.text: I've been hearing talk that this manor is haunted. Have you seen anything like that yourself?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I... If you had said that to me not..."
entries.text: I... If you had said that to me not two weeks ago, I'd have rolled my eyes at you, Sir.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "But this place... has changed my mi..."
entries.text: But this place... has changed my mind on ghosts...

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance's purpose - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you suppose the séance will be s..."
entries.text: Do you suppose the séance will be successful?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "They've been conducted before, why..."
entries.text: They've been conducted before, why not this one?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "What is the difference, really, bet..."
entries.text: What is the difference, really, between asking a ghost their name and asking a ghost to stay a while?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Leaving letter - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Deane left a letter excusing h..."
entries.text: Miss Deane left a letter excusing herself from the event, it seems.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "So she's really gone, then? So much..."
entries.text: So she's really gone, then? So much for goodbyes.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/The Freemasons - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "How could I? I am, after all, a wom..."
entries.text: How could I? I am, after all, a woman.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about the Free..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about the Freemasons?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Second Sight - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you heard anything about Miss..."
entries.text: Have you heard anything about Miss McLeod's Second Sight?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "It would make for a compelling stor..."
entries.text: It would make for a compelling story...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "But a compelling truth? I would say..."
entries.text: But a compelling truth? I would say less so.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Ritual markings - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've found evidence of a ritual bei..."
entries.text: I've found evidence of a ritual being conducted upstairs.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Well, what's the point in that? Com..."
entries.text: Well, what's the point in that? Coming all this way just to be secretive about it?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I don't understand some of these pe..."
entries.text: I don't understand some of these people...

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Skeleton key - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "What in God's name - get away from..."
entries.text: What in God's name - get away from me, will you?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Strange occurences - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't help but feel like strange..."
entries.text: I can't help but feel like strange things happen in this place.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Tricks of the light and imagination..."
entries.text: Tricks of the light and imagination, Mister Ward, most certainly.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I mean... aren't they?"
entries.text: I mean... aren't they?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Statement, Mister Doyle - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss..."
entries.text: Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone late on Tuesday.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I cannot say I'm thrilled at the id..."
entries.text: I cannot say I'm thrilled at the idea that the staff are talking about our business.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I mean, of course, they are, but th..."
entries.text: I mean, of course, they are, but they could have the decency to pretend that they're not.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mysterious figure - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've noticed a figure in the upper..."
entries.text: I've noticed a figure in the upper windows when I'm outside... I don't suppose you've seen it too?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I... I have. And I wish I hadn't. W..."
entries.text: I... I have. And I wish I hadn't. What is watching us?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Dead End - DArcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems that when Miss Deane left..."
entries.text: It seems that when Miss Deane left on Tuesday, she never actually left the grounds. Her trail ends in the gardens.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "This is beginning to sound uncomfor..."
entries.text: This is beginning to sound uncomfortably like a murder mystery.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I..."

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hermetic Order - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about the Herm..."
entries.text: What can you tell me about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Oh. Well, Mister Ward, I'm not sure..."
entries.text: Oh. Well, Mister Ward, I'm not sure I should say anything at all. I wouldn't want to betray their trust in me, you understand.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Bridge game - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Were you at the bridge game on Tues..."
entries.text: Were you at the bridge game on Tuesday?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Indeed, I was. And I got roundly th..."
entries.text: Indeed, I was. And I got roundly thrashed, so I don't want to speak anymore about it.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "...I suppose I will say that we eve..."
entries.text: ...I suppose I will say that we eventually managed to convince the Doctor to play, after no small amount of badgering.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "He was a good sport about it - and..."
entries.text: He was a good sport about it - and surprisingly good at the game itself, come to think of it.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "His aunt was there too, of course,..."
entries.text: His aunt was there too, of course, as was Miss Quinn, Miss Barbosa, Missus Lau, Mister Coventry and, of course, the Marquess.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm sorry, but I must ask - did man..."
entries.text: I'm sorry, but I must ask - did many attend?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Locked doors - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems they keep even the unused..."
entries.text: It seems they keep even the unused guest bedrooms locked.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Why wouldn't they?"
entries.text: Why wouldn't they?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Written complaint - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you submit a complaint about Mi..."
entries.text: Did you submit a complaint about Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I did. I mean, it was ridiculous! I..."
entries.text: I did. I mean, it was ridiculous! I know we're all terribly interesting, but I felt like I was the suspect in some awful penny dreadful.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Talks schedule - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you think of these talks th..."
entries.text: What do you think of these talks that are going on?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I suppose I'll go to one or two - t..."
entries.text: I suppose I'll go to one or two - they'll do for inspiration, if nothing else.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/entertainment schedule - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Quite the range of events. All very..."
entries.text: Quite the range of events. All very pedestrian, mind you. I suppose I'll go to one or two - they'll do for inspiration, if nothing else.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Did you have an interest in any par..."
entries.text: Did you have an interest in any particular event or time, Mister Ward?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/cigar burn - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I noticed there are cigar burns on..."
entries.text: I noticed there are cigar burns on one of the library armchairs.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Oh, that oaf, Skerritt, fell asleep..."

entries.text: *ahem*

entries.text: Now and then, something will turn up. But it's never had that sort of gravitas before.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: Perhaps I should agree to broach the veil of life and death more often. Or find out what they put in the wine.

entries.text: Well... No, nothing comes to mind.

entries.text: Oh, do I! My Cecil was quite the wordsmith; it was what had me fall for him in the first place...

entries.label: DArcy: "Now, if only he'd had the decency t..."
entries.text: Now, if only he'd had the decency to save those love letters for me...

entries.text: Oh goodness, no! The odd time I would need to include something like that, it's off to the library for me. Or I might pester my cousin, who has, himself, become a doctor.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Possessed Ring - D'Arcy

entries.text: What do you think you'll do with that ring, now?

entries.text: I wish I was vicious enough to say that I will wear it... but I'm not.

entries.text: No, if this is Cecil's fate, then I will hide it away somewhere, out of sight. Or perhaps I will throw it into the sea on my way home.

entries.text: I... No, I... it's not something I think I...

entries.text: ...frankly, Sir, given how the topic is dealt with in the real world, I do not think publishers or an audience would care for it.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I shall ask around and try to find..."
entries.text: I shall ask around and try to find a way to exorcise your husband's ghost from you.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "...please. I like ghost stories in..."
entries.text: ...please. I like ghost stories in books. In reality... less so.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "About the exorcism..."
entries.text: About the exorcism...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "After that ritual, it should be tha..."
entries.text: After that ritual, it should be that you've seen the last of your husband.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "You actually... My God, you both ac..."
entries.text: You actually... My God, you both actually went to all that trouble on my behalf.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Yours, and Miss Deane's."
entries.text: Yours, and Miss Deane's.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Miss Deane's, of course..."
entries.text: Miss Deane's, of course...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I'll forget it all, Mister Ward. Fo..."
entries.text: I'll forget it all, Mister Ward. For whatever it is worth, you have my word on that. It's done. I am free of my late husband, and that's all I need.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Thank you. Sincerely."
entries.text: Thank you. Sincerely.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "This place is positively crawling w..."
entries.text: This place is positively crawling with experts on death, so hopefully...

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mistress - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus D'Arcy, I'm sorry to ask - b..."
entries.text: Missus D'Arcy, I'm sorry to ask - but was your husband unfaithful to you?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Marriage vows don't mean an awful l..."
entries.text: Marriage vows don't mean an awful lot to some people, as it turns out.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "He doesn't even have the decency to..."
entries.text: He doesn't even have the decency to honour the bit about death parting us.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "He didn't even have the decency to..."
entries.text: He didn't even have the decency to honour the bit about death parting us, after all.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever used an affair or inf..."
entries.text: Have you ever used an affair or infidelity as a plot point in a book?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "You know, if you just read my books..."
entries.text: You know, if you just read my books...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "But yes. I did once. A woman's husb..."
entries.text: But yes. I did once. A woman's husband cheated on her, and their... reconciliation night was his alibi for a murder.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "In hindsight, I do not think I did..."
entries.text: In hindsight, I do not think I did justice to how devastating it can be... If I were to revisit that story now, he would need another alibi.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Deane's Room - D'Arcy

entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to recall which room..."
entries.text: Do you happen to recall which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Near me, I know that. I overheard h..."
entries.text: Near me, I know that. I overheard her and Miss Quinn arguing the other night. Not sure of the actual room. I don't recall seeing her coming or going from any room in particular.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/timetable - Darcy

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I suppose to work hard and play har..."
entries.text: I suppose to work hard and play hard, Mister Ward, so after all that I shall pay the bar a visit in the evenings too. Then, on Sunday...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I'll keep things light, I think. Ch..."
entries.text: I'll keep things light, I think. Church at eleven, for my sins. Then back to my room for some writing before and after lunch at one.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are your plans while you're he..."
entries.text: What are your plans while you're here, Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have any plans for today?"
entries.text: Do you have any plans for today?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I'll be in attendance for Mister Bl..."
entries.text: I'll be in attendance for Mister Blake's talk at eleven and Miss Mantovani's at five, certainly.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I suppose I'll have to make time fo..."
entries.text: I suppose I'll have to make time for lunch at one, and I plan to retire to my bedroom for some writing at three.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "And, of course, I don't know if I c..."
entries.text: And, of course, I don't know if I can face the séance without some liquid courage first...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "And since I am not going to the séa..."
entries.text: And since I am not going to the séance anymore, I might as well have a few glasses of wine before I turn in early.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Drawings of a young woman - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you recognise the w..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you recognise the woman Mister Dupré has been drawing?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I... Is that... Evelyn Deane? Why w..."
entries.text: I... Is that... Evelyn Deane? Why would he be...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "No, no, I am sure it must be his La..."
entries.text: No, no, I am sure it must be his Laura. It must be.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "He has recently lost a friend, you..."
entries.text: He has recently lost a friend, you see. She was some sort of pagan fire priestess. I think that is why he is so fond of the fire pit in the maze.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "...but really, that is not my story..."
entries.text: ...but really, that is not my story to tell.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Their relationship - D'Arcy

entries.label: Ward: "Were you aware that Miss McLeod and..."
entries.text: Were you aware that Miss McLeod and Mister Hunter know each other? It seems they're quite close.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Do I seem to you like some common g..."
entries.text: Do I seem to you like some common gossip monger?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I'm not. Which means I didn't know,..."
entries.text: I'm not. Which means I didn't know, and I'm quite upset about that. How darling!

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Oh, but you could start trouble wit..."
entries.text: Oh, but you could start trouble with that. I'll bet Miss McLeod's lord father wouldn't like competition in the way of a stable master of all things.

entries.text: What do you make of that strange contraption in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: The garish green tube? You can tell this place lacks a woman's touch.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: Have you been witness to anyone washing clothes in an odd place, like the fountain?

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ivy - D'Arcy

entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss McLeod?

entries.text: I'm not entirely sure what she's doing here, but girls like her have a tendency to find the strangest places for themselves.

entries.text: Couldn't stop talking about this book she has either. What was it about? Lucent dreams?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Honestly. As if there aren't enough..."
entries.text: Honestly. As if there aren't enough problems in the world without dreaming up new ones.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Varley - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the manager?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the manager?

entries.text: As much as I can, but he is very tight-lipped. I think he suspects I may use anything he says in a story.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "And he is right! He seems like a pe..."
entries.text: And he is right! He seems like a perfect villain for a story, don't you think?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Silent as he may be, I've been watc..."
entries.text: Silent as he may be, I've been watching him. He has an old key he caresses from time to time.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "It is probably just a master key to..."
entries.text: It is probably just a master key to the place, but I will embellish on that point when I make use of him as inspiration.

entries.text: I wish I'd had a chaperone like her before I was married. A friend - rather than an uptight, old aunt of mine.

entries.text: She might have steered me better, in the end. Or perhaps not.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: For all the thought we put in, flights of fancy do have a way of seizing a girl.

entries.text: And then there's the fact that she's supposed to be a noble of some sort, but she turns herself out in that fashion? It's just delightful.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: He reminds me of a gravedigger podding around in his large boot, with a shovel over his shoulder. Though I can't imagine he is doing much planting at this time of year.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: I mean, it is his main function. He should be good at it.

entries.text: Certainly, if I robbed it for a tale, I think I would have a hard time selling a reader on it.

entries.text: To think all that action and travel only to spend her days here waiting by a telegraph machine!

entries.text: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

entries.text: ...And I can't yet tell which our Mister Toussaint is.

entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister O'Meara?

entries.text: A little. Good God, have you ever seen a boy look more like he's stepped out of a painting? He's practically cherubic.

entries.text: I hope, for his sake, he never follows the trend of all this and goes to London.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: Oh, he may not agree, but I'm sure they would eat him alive.

entries.text: Have you been speaking much with Mister Dupré?

entries.text: Have I indeed - I've been spending the most of my time here with him.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: He's a good man. And unlike most people, he's usually able to tell when I'm joking.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on D'Arcy - D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me about yourself, Missus D'Ar..."
entries.text: Tell me about yourself, Missus D'Arcy.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Well now, have I not made introduct..."
entries.text: Well now, have I not made introductions? Or is this an attempt to charm me? Let's see...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "My name is Olivia D'Arcy, as you kn..."
entries.text: My name is Olivia D'Arcy, as you know, and I am visiting from London. Moreover, I am sorely missing the city.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I am best known for my novels, whic..."
entries.text: I am best known for my novels, which have been described alternately as "breathtaking", "whip-smart"...

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "...and "horrendously macabre", whic..."
entries.text: ...and "horrendously macabre", which I must say, I was quite pleased with.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "It is very... clean... here. Quiet..."
entries.text: It is very... clean... here. Quiet too. I am going to appreciate the city so much more when I get home.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Coventry - D'Arcy

entries.text: Have you spoken with Mister Coventry?

entries.text: I didn't find him all that interesting until I learned he was a jeweller. That piqued my interest!

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I have arranged to go see him when..."
entries.text: I have arranged to go see him when all this is over. I have a number of men's items to pass on.

entries.text: Have you met Missus Erickson?

entries.text: I have. She's alright... In brief doses. She can be a bit much.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "A bit too eager to showcase her tal..."
entries.text: A bit too eager to showcase her talents for my liking.

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ruairí - D'Arcy

entries.text: Have you spoken to Doctor Callaghan?

entries.text: I have indeed. It will be the guests that save this whole event for me, you know, Mister Ward - with Doctor Callaghan among them.

entries.text: You don't know - or perhaps you do - what time without decent conversation can do to a person.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: I was expecting it least of all from some local doctor, but it turns out he could give my Londonite sort a run for their money.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "They will be furious if they meet h..."
entries.text: They will be furious if they meet him. How wonderful!

entries.text: Miss Deane is...?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "Oh, her. I know of her, but I can't..."
entries.text: Oh, her. I know of her, but I can't say I know her personally - but she did make herself known the other day, arguing with Miss Quinn outside my door.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy
entries.label: DArcy: "I might have minded more, but hones..."
entries.text: I might have minded more, but honestly, it was quite the story.

entries.text: Have you spoken with Miss Mantovani?

entries.text: She asked me a lot of questions, as if I am to know more than her?

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: She's the one paid to be here, I'm the one paying. Honestly.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: His contraption is interesting - not that I'll be going near it.

entries.text: Thankfully, her cooking has more personality than her.

entries.text: What do you make of Miss Hisham?

entries.text: But there's something wrong with her, there's no other way to say it.

entries.text: It's like she's possessed by something. I wonder if one of the ghosts has got to her early.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: I'm only joking! ... I mean, I think so...

title: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Sinnott - D'Arcy

entries.text: Why would I listen to him? I'm not here looking for religion, and I'm certainly not here to confess my sins.

entries.text: I know his type - the quiet, stoic nobleman. Not exactly the type to host a large event such as this.

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.speaker: Missus D'Arcy

entries.text: You seem unimpressed with something, Missus D'Arcy?

entries.text: Well, you can rest easy. Since coming here, I have a great many things on my mind, and none of them are to do with a man I just met.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Ah, there you are now."
entries.text: Ah, there you are now.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "And you're back. What can I do you..."
entries.text: And you're back. What can I do you for?

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I take it that you have come for th..."
entries.text: I take it that you have come for the séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I should go."
entries.text: I should go.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Only do something if you want, not..."
entries.text: Only do something if you want, not because you "should".

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...I'm sorry, Sir, but do I know yo..."
entries.text: ...I'm sorry, Sir, but do I know you?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Haha, no no, but I ne'er said such...."
entries.text: Haha, no no, but I ne'er said such. Just plainly, there you are. And, you are.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You have me there, Sir."
entries.text: You have me there, Sir.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Sir? I'm no knight. I'm Domhnall Ó..."
entries.text: Sir? I'm no knight. I'm Domhnall Ó Finn, and you can call me such. I'm a proud Traveller and protector of these lands.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Noted. I am Declan Ward. Also, not..."
entries.text: Noted. I am Declan Ward. Also, not a knight.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Haha! Good to meet you, lad."
entries.text: Haha! Good to meet you, lad.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Ahhh... Yes and no. I am here becau..."
entries.text: Ahhh... Yes and no. I am here because of the séance but not for it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I have no urge to speak to the dead..."
entries.text: I have no urge to speak to the dead, I doubt they have much comfort to offer up.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "What interests me is those people w..."
entries.text: What interests me is those people who do want to speak with the dead. How they intend to do it, and more, what they will be doing afterwards to clean up their mess.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "These rich people! They think becau..."
entries.text: These rich people! They think because they forced themselves on these lands, they can do what they want to them. It won't stand! The land won't let it, and neither will I.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Bridge Game  - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn

entries.text: Nah, I wasn't here then. Wouldn't have played even if I had been. I don't like bridge - gimme a game of Twenty-five or Irish Don anytime, though.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you play the bridge game that w..."
entries.text: Did you play the bridge game that was on last Tuesday evening?

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/The Grand Séance - O'Finn

entries.text: Oh, very exciting to talk to a ghost. I'm sure the dead have lots to say. "Oh no, my god isn't real", "I wasted my life", "so and so didn't show up for my funeral". Riveting.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I'm more interested in the mad fell..."
entries.text: I'm more interested in the mad fellas who think death is more interesting than life. And the stupid things they'll do to prove it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are your thoughts on the séanc..."
entries.text: What are your thoughts on the séance?

entries.text: What's this? Some kinda glyph? A sigil? What does it mean - one in, three out? Can't say for sure, but it feels old and Irish.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I can't say much beyond that."
entries.text: I can't say much beyond that.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Reminds me of an evil eye curse. No..."
entries.text: Reminds me of an evil eye curse. Not that it is one, but it looks to be focusing someone or something on, well, whoever it's cast on.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen markings like these b..."
entries.text: Have you seen markings like these before?

entries.text: Hmmm, there's whispering coming from my fireplace - that strange enough for you?

entries.label: OFinn: "Probably just the old chimneys, but..."
entries.text: Probably just the old chimneys, but it sounds like it's asking "home?".

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you witnessed any strange occu..."
entries.text: Have you witnessed any strange occurrences since you got here?

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Strange Dreams - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Strange dreams? Funny, you say that..."
entries.text: Strange dreams? Funny, you say that. I don't recall the dream, but I woke this morning with both a wanting to stay and a wanting to get the hell out of this place.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had any odd dreams since g..."
entries.text: Have you had any odd dreams since getting here?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Sure, how am I meant to do both?"
entries.text: Sure, how am I meant to do both?

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Map of the Region - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "What's this? A local map with nothi..."
entries.text: What's this? A local map with nothing useful or interesting marked on it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "You try to leave here with that and..."
entries.text: You try to leave here with that and you'll be found dead - if you're found at all!

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Why do you even have this? Hahaha!"
entries.text: Why do you even have this? Hahaha!

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Hauntings - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen any ghosts since comi..."
entries.text: Have you seen any ghosts since coming here?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "...have you not?"
entries.text: ...have you not?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "My least favourite was a woman who..."
entries.text: My least favourite was a woman who crawled in through a window last night.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Thankfully, a flash of thunder and..."
entries.text: Thankfully, a flash of thunder and she was gone.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Damn near soiled myself."
entries.text: Damn near soiled myself.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Fetters - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know of fetters?"
entries.text: What do you know of fetters?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Oh, right. This I know. Some folk b..."
entries.text: Oh, right. This I know. Some folk believe that ghosts are anchored to this world.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Either by a feeling, an incomplete..."
entries.text: Either by a feeling, an incomplete task, or an object. Usually an object of importance to the ghost, but often times something powerful.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "There are some who believe a place..."
entries.text: There are some who believe a place like this, with more ghosts than seems right might, itself, be a fetter

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "A load of old horse apples. There a..."
entries.text: A load of old horse apples. There are more ghosts here because more bad things happened here.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Such as?"
entries.text: Such as?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Battles, blood spilt, massacres, an..."
entries.text: Battles, blood spilt, massacres, and a nest of Blakes for 250 years.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Enough misery to raise a graveyard."
entries.text: Enough misery to raise a graveyard.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Druid  - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You say you're a druid?"
entries.text: You say you're a druid?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Ah, as much as anyone can be. The C..."
entries.text: Ah, as much as anyone can be. The Catholics didn't leave much trace of the old ways, but I've pieced together a tradition that feels alright to me and called it 'druidism'. No more made up than anything else, mind.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "For the most part, I just treat all..."
entries.text: For the most part, I just treat all natural things as equal in value - people, plants, animals, and places. Real places - the wild and such. Not manmade intrusions like this manor. Bloody eyesore!

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Code - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What is the code you live by?"
entries.text: What is the code you live by?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "It's nothing fancy. I try to treat..."
entries.text: It's nothing fancy. I try to treat all people, creatures, plants, and places as equal. I leave no trace, I burn safely, and I leave my share for the Other Folks.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Shadowy Figure - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I... think I have seen something......"
entries.text: I... think I have seen something... something stalking the manor grounds... a large, ghostly figure?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Oh, lad, if you've seen the Tuatha..."
entries.text: Oh, lad, if you've seen the Tuatha Dé Danann, then you're a lucky man!

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "The old Gods... Get an education in..."
entries.text: The old Gods... Get an education in your heritage, lad. They walked this land a long time ago, before disappearing into the Otherworld.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "But fragments still exist. Like the..."
entries.text: But fragments still exist. Like the way you say it - large, ghostly forms.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Apparently, Miss Deane is the desce..."
entries.text: Apparently, Miss Deane is the descendant of a powerful Milesian ancestor.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Is she now? She and I ought to have..."
entries.text: Is she now? She and I ought to have a chat, in that case.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Magical Grimoire - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of this book, Mist..."
entries.text: What do you make of this book, Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Now, where'd you find a thing like..."
entries.text: Now, where'd you find a thing like that, lad?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I can't read the words - never lear..."
entries.text: I can't read the words - never learned letters - but those markings in the columns? That is Ogham, and that I can read.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "It's of the meaning of gateway or d..."
entries.text: It's of the meaning of gateway or door - but not quite. It's something akin to both, but less mundane than either.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Chimney Charm - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this on a walk about the gr..."
entries.text: I found this on a walk about the grounds. What do you make of it?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "No need to be so vague, lad. You fo..."
entries.text: No need to be so vague, lad. You found it in someone's room. Don't worry, I'll pry no further.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "It's a binding charm, stops the tar..."
entries.text: It's a binding charm, stops the target from having any magical effect on someone else. It only works if it stays close to the person it's targeting, though.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Witchcraft components - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of these? They loo..."
entries.text: What do you make of these? They look like the components of some sort of charm to me.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I'd say that's about right. Couldn'..."
entries.text: I'd say that's about right. Couldn't say what kind of charm, though, without seeing it assembled. A lot of the magic's in the making of the thing.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Goibniu - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever heard of Goibniu?"
entries.text: Have you ever heard of Goibniu?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Anyway, Goibniu is not only a smith..."
entries.text: Anyway, Goibniu is not only a smith - he was the hospitaller of the Tuatha de Danann.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I wouldn't mind some of that protec..."
entries.text: I wouldn't mind some of that protection going into winter, ha!

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I have, aye. Mincéir - Travellers,..."
entries.text: I have, aye. Mincéir - Travellers, that is, call him Galyōn. Or we call our god Galyōn, anyway.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "We believe the world was forged out..."
entries.text: We believe the world was forged out of metal.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "And since Goibniu is a smith god, w..."
entries.text: And since Goibniu is a smith god, well, there is a natural comparison gets made there.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "You could drink at his feast and no..."
entries.text: You could drink at his feast and not get a hangover, and the food you'd eat -  it'd protect a man from both sickness and decay.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/fae - O Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about the fae?"
entries.text: What can you tell me about the fae?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Surely you know this yourself?"
entries.text: Surely you know this yourself?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Right, well, in basic terms, they'r..."
entries.text: Right, well, in basic terms, they're spirits of the land. Or, they are the land.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "People say they can't be trusted or..."
entries.text: People say they can't be trusted or they're tricksy, but that's applying human thinking to them. And you don't want to do that.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Tuatha Dé Danann - ofinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you tell me much about the Tuat..."
entries.text: Can you tell me much about the Tuatha Dé Danann?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Nothing you won't find in a book. T..."
entries.text: Nothing you won't find in a book. They are the old gods of this land, gone underground after being tricked by us mortals.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "What they think of us now, I can't..."
entries.text: What they think of us now, I can't say - and even as a man who walks their path, I'm not always sure why I do.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Do they hear us, talk to us like th..."
entries.text: Do they hear us, talk to us like the Christians think their god does?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I can't say. They connect me to thi..."
entries.text: I can't say. They connect me to this land, and my heritage is all I know. Just feels right to light a fire for them from time to time. They've never asked for more than that.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Brid - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know the Goddess Bríd?"
entries.text: Do you know the Goddess Bríd?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Aye. Her father was the chieftain o..."
entries.text: Aye. Her father was the chieftain of the Tuatha Dé Danann. She's a powerful and versatile god.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Her realm is up in Faughart by Dund..."
entries.text: Her realm is up in Faughart by Dundalk. A modest shrine but, then, I think that's how she'd like it.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/morrigan - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Could you tell me anything about Th..."
entries.text: Could you tell me anything about The Morrigan?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I couldn't. Not with all these crow..."
entries.text: I couldn't. Not with all these crows about to report it back to her.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Cailleach - OFInn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you tell me much about the Cail..."
entries.text: Can you tell me much about the Cailleach?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "An Cailleach? Fiadh'd know more on..."
entries.text: An Cailleach? Fiadh'd know more on that, now. Did you know Cailleach means hag? Sort of a thing we both respect and revile.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know of Tír na nÓg?"
entries.text: What do you know of Tír na nÓg?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Nothing that you shouldn't. One of..."
entries.text: Nothing that you shouldn't. One of the many Tíortha, or lands, of our Otherworld.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "There's many Tíortha - like Tír fo..."
entries.text: There's many Tíortha - like Tír fo Thuinn, the lands under the wave; Mag Mell, the plain of delight; and Emain Ablach, the isle of apple trees.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "They say that on a clear day you ca..."
entries.text: They say that on a clear day you can see it, past the plain of honey, on the horizon where the sun settles.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Mind you, I've never seen a clear d..."
entries.text: Mind you, I've never seen a clear day on this blasted rock we call home.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "You can get there underground too -..."
entries.text: You can get there underground too - like the Tuatha de Danann eventually did. There's plenty of old passageways in the dark corners of places of power.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "None of them is safe. Guarded by fa..."
entries.text: None of them is safe. Guarded by fae things. Or worse - not guarded and you can get in.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I know a woman once who got near, s..."
entries.text: I know a woman once who got near, saw her own death, and only because she had kids, was let leave.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I have no kids - none I know of - s..."
entries.text: I have no kids - none I know of - so I won't be risking it, thanks.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Tír na nÓg means lands of the young..."
entries.text: Tír na nÓg means lands of the young.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Milesians - OFINN

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does the term Milesians mean anythi..."
entries.text: Does the term Milesians mean anything to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Humans, lad. They're humans. Our an..."
entries.text: Humans, lad. They're humans. Our ancestors.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Legend is that they came here over..."
entries.text: Legend is that they came here over nine waves and battled the gods so they could settle here.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Didn't end well for either group bu..."
entries.text: Didn't end well for either group but you could say we came out on top.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "That's a good joke on account of us..."
entries.text: That's a good joke on account of us dividing the land and them getting the bottom half.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "You'd have appreciated that if you..."
entries.text: You'd have appreciated that if you knew your history.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Any plans for this weekend, Mister..."
entries.text: Any plans for this weekend, Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I'm told there's a big party on lat..."
entries.text: I'm told there's a big party on later. I'll go to that, I guess. Fancy dress - I reckon that means they'll dress like me and I'd dress like them, no?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I'm told there's proper history - g..."
entries.text: I'm told there's proper history - good history in the gardens, so I'll go there while it's bright, then head off to the bar when it's dark.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Not sure what else there is to do...."
entries.text: Not sure what else there is to do. I'm told there are talks, but talking - to me - is a two-way thing. Not sitting down so somebody can tell you about their hobbies.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Ah, who knows? Tomorrow's too far a..."
entries.text: Ah, who knows? Tomorrow's too far away to be worth thinking about today. There's the séance, anyway.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Hah - and for Sunday?"
entries.text: Hah - and for Sunday?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Could spend some time getting on Fi..."
entries.text: Could spend some time getting on Fiadh's nerves, though - that's always fun.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "She said she'd be doing some work w..."
entries.text: She said she'd be doing some work with the well after lunch - might stick my face in and see how she's getting on.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I'll wander the hedge maze after lu..."
entries.text: I'll wander the hedge maze after lunchtime, I think, and go get a gāter in the bar before the dinner bell.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/washer woman - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Last night, as I arrived, I saw a w..."
entries.text: Last night, as I arrived, I saw a woman washing clothes in the fountain.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Ack, I knew there would be death he..."
entries.text: Ack, I knew there would be death here.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm sorry?"
entries.text: I'm sorry?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "You saw a bean nigh, lad. Spells tr..."
entries.text: You saw a bean nigh, lad. Spells trouble. Of the life-ending type.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "She's a portent, you see - an omen...."
entries.text: She's a portent, you see - an omen. One that means death and grief have come to your house.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Somebody will die here this weekend..."
entries.text: Somebody will die here this weekend. Possibly more than one. Certainly no less.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Deane... Am I too late?"
entries.text: Miss Deane... Am I too late?

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/gauge - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen the strange device ke..."
entries.text: Have you seen the strange device kept off to the side in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I have, and I don't like it. It has..."
entries.text: I have, and I don't like it. It has a bad energy off it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Whatever it's measuring, it's part..."
entries.text: Whatever it's measuring, it's part of this séance, and that means I don't trust it.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/deane's room - OF

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know which room Miss Deane w..."
entries.text: Do you know which room Miss Deane was in?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Who? I don't know how to find my ow..."
entries.text: Who? I don't know how to find my own room in this place, ne'er mind whoever that is. Sorry, can't help you.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Pagan Crown- O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That's an unusual crown you wear."
entries.text: That's an unusual crown you wear.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Crown? That's the Pale speaking in..."
entries.text: Crown? That's the Pale speaking in you, lad. It's a circlet.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "It's a sign of my station as a drui..."
entries.text: It's a sign of my station as a druid, a protector of this land and its inhabitants.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "*tsk* Crown..."
entries.text: *tsk* Crown...

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Wild Hair - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You sport an... uncommon look."
entries.text: You sport an... uncommon look.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "A man is only truly free when he is..."
entries.text: A man is only truly free when he is free of the opinion of others.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Staff - O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What does your staff signify?"
entries.text: What does your staff signify?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "It, eh, signifies that I'll bash yo..."
entries.text: It, eh, signifies that I'll bash you if you come near me or mine.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "No, you mind what they say, lad, th..."
entries.text: No, you mind what they say, lad, there are still plenty of snakes in Ireland.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/belt- O'Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You have quite the ornate belt."
entries.text: You have quite the ornate belt.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Do you like it? I killed and skinne..."
entries.text: Do you like it? I killed and skinned the deer myself. My cousin, Conor, helped me shape the tin.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "That man is fierce handy with a bal..."
entries.text: That man is fierce handy with a ball hammer.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Ward in room - OFinn

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Oh lad..."
entries.text: Oh lad...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Ó Finn-"
entries.text: Mister Ó Finn-

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Sorry, now, but I won't hear it."
entries.text: Sorry, now, but I won't hear it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "This is against your ways, I know t..."
entries.text: This is against your ways, I know that, so you're up to something. Come on, let's go see the manager.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Blake

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are your thoughts on the Marqu..."
entries.text: What are your thoughts on the Marquess?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "This isn't his land, and he doesn't..."
entries.text: This isn't his land, and he doesn't belong here. More so, he's not welcome. Him or his.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I've made my views known well enoug..."
entries.text: I've made my views known well enough. I'm surprised I was invited.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Coventry

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Coventry?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Not yet. I keep missing him. As I'm..."
entries.text: Not yet. I keep missing him. As I'm entering a room, he's leaving it! It's almost as if he's avoiding me!

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on O Finn

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "Me? I'm a druid, as much as anyone..."
entries.text: Me? I'm a druid, as much as anyone can be these days. I wander the land, making sure it's not too abused by ye buffers.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I've a special place in my heart fo..."
entries.text: I've a special place in my heart for this part of the land, though. My people are from here, as much as anyone is really from anywhere.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me about yourself, Mister Ó Fi..."
entries.text: Tell me about yourself, Mister Ó Finn.

title: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Mantovanni

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met our hostess, Miss Mant..."
entries.text: Have you met our hostess, Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "She's the madwoman who kept showing..."
entries.text: She's the madwoman who kept showing me that card with a hermit on it?

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "I like her, if not the company she..."
entries.text: I like her, if not the company she keeps.

entries.speaker: Mister Ó Finn
entries.label: OFinn: "She'd do well to stop singing Blake..."

entries.text: I've come here to put the capstone on my legacy, the final feather in my cap, as such. A pleasure to meet you.

entries.label: Skerritt: "People across the globe and the age..."
entries.text: People across the globe and the ages will know this moment, this piercing of the veil, and with it, they will know the name Michael Skerritt!

entries.text: Impressive, eh?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: Frankly, Mister Skerritt, it turns my stomach.

entries.text: Wha... What?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That the best way you can think to..."
entries.text: That the best way you can think to see out your days is by ending them in the hope of impressing... who, exactly?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: The others here at the event? Businessmen back home? Or historians in the future?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Such a pointless sacrifice. And you..."
entries.text: Such a pointless sacrifice. And you don't even know if it will work!?

entries.text: Perhaps she can. And she will get all the accolades for it, too.

entries.speaker: Mister Skerritt

entries.text: I... I believe it will work... Miss Mantovani can pull it off.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: You know Louis Pasteur for his vaccines, or Joseph Lister for his antiseptic sprays, but not the people these were tested on.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Even if this works - a substantial..."
entries.text: Even if this works - a substantial 'if' given the undertaking and the volume of ghosts already present in this God-forsaken manor - then it will be Miss Mantovani who is remembered.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You will be a footnote, subject num..."
entries.text: You will be a footnote, subject number 1, as she continues to perform the ritual, unlocking more secrets from beyond the grave. And have no doubt she will do it again. Perhaps immediately.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You'll be newly dead, unable to ans..."
entries.text: You'll be newly dead, unable to answer a single question beyond "has this worked". You'll be tossed back so they can catch a bigger fish.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: Some legacy.

entries.speaker: Mister Skerritt

entries.text: You answer me that and I shall stand down. You have my word.

entries.text: Yes, I am old. Yes, I have no legacy to speak of. How would you see me change that path if not at the séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "With his resources and connections,..."
entries.text: With his resources and connections, there has to be something more meaningful he can achieve with the time he has left.

entries.speaker: Mister Skerritt

entries.text:
No! That's not fair! I would have given everything, the ultimate sacrifice! 
They have to remember me! Love me!

entries.text: There is nothing about this that anyone will love. Anyone who does dig into your story will only unearth your lifetime of failures.

entries.text: I need to find proof of a person being immortalised through their charitable deeds - perhaps there is a monument or a record of such somewhere here?

entries.text: Well, strange as it sounds, she seems to have gone missing. There's no sign of her beyond the hedge maze.
