title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You didn't happen to attend the bri..."
entries.text: You didn't happen to attend the bridge game on Tuesday evening?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Tuesday evening? No. No, I wasn't...."
entries.text: Tuesday evening? No. No, I wasn't. I was waylaid by Mademoiselle Deane.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you mean by waylaid?"
entries.text: What do you mean by waylaid?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah... I published a paper, half a y..."
entries.text: Ah... I published a paper, half a year ago, you see, on a spiritualist by the name of Marcus H. Watson. He was something of a mentor to Mademoiselle Deane.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "He was also about the most perfect..."
entries.text: He was also about the most perfect master of emotional trickery I've ever met. The paper took two long years. In it, I took his process apart.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I wrote about just how he appeared..."
entries.text: I wrote about just how he appeared to speak to the dead. It was very, very difficult, and I will confess, I am immensely proud of that work.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Despite all Monsieur Watson's work,..."
entries.text: Despite all Monsieur Watson's work, once his manner was laid plain, it was no longer difficult to see. He was disgraced, just as he deserved.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "However, Mademoiselle Deane's assoc..."
entries.text: However, Mademoiselle Deane's association with him... Well, any benefit to her was dashed. She decided to let me hear exactly what she thought of it.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "And so, I did not make the bridge g..."
entries.text: And so, I did not make the bridge game, no, I was fielding that instead. I confess, I was... almost concerned for the woman.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Concerned? How come?"
entries.text: Concerned? How come?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Well, she let me hear exactly what..."
entries.text: Well, she let me hear exactly what she thought, certainly - but she half apologised afterwards. She said she was on edge...

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She seemed convinced of some "male..."
entries.text: She seemed convinced of some "male presence" following her in the house.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I tried to ask, of course, but she..."
entries.text: I tried to ask, of course, but she hadn't forgiven me enough by then to feel like elaborating, and I didn't get anything more.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I did not. I'm not really one for s..."
entries.text: I did not. I'm not really one for socialising.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I suppose you might call it a fight..."
entries.text: I suppose you might call it a fight, though I would say it was more one-sided than that.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Forgive my forwardness, but might I..."
entries.text: Forgive my forwardness, but might I ask as to why?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "So... I published a paper, half a y..."
entries.text: So... I published a paper, half a year ago, you see, on a spiritualist by the name of Marcus H. Watson. He was something of a mentor to Mademoiselle Deane.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "He was also about the most perfect..."
entries.text: He was also about the most perfect master of emotional trickery I've ever met. The paper took two long years. In it, I took his process apart.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I wrote about just how he appeared..."
entries.text: I wrote about just how he appeared to speak to the dead. It was very, very difficult, and I will confess, I am immensely proud of that work.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Despite all Monsieur Watson's work,..."
entries.text: Despite all Monsieur Watson's work, once his manner was laid plain, it was no longer difficult to see. He was disgraced, just as he deserved.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "However, Mademoiselle Deane's assoc..."
entries.text: However, Mademoiselle Deane's association with him... Well, any benefit to her was dashed. She decided to let me hear exactly what she thought of it.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "And so, I did not make the bridge g..."
entries.text: And so, I did not make the bridge game, no, I was fielding that instead. I confess, I was... almost concerned for the woman.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Concerned? How come?"
entries.text: Concerned? How come?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Well, she let me hear exactly what..."
entries.text: Well, she let me hear exactly what she thought, certainly - but she half apologised afterwards. She said she was on edge...

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She seemed convinced that somebody..."
entries.text: She seemed convinced that somebody meant her harm - somebody with a "Christian aura". She was specific on that point. It doesn't seem like her, but maybe she's locked herself away from whatever it was?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I tried to ask, of course, but she..."
entries.text: I tried to ask, of course, but she hadn't forgiven me enough by then to feel like elaborating, and I didn't get anything more.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Am I correct in believing you fough..."
entries.text: Am I correct in believing you fought with Miss Deane last Tuesday?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "This house. It doesn't seem to agre..."
entries.text: This house. It doesn't seem to agree with her. Bad dream, then bouts of no sleep. Thinking back on it, I haven't seen her leave her room since then.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Now that you've drawn my attention..."
entries.text: Now that you've drawn my attention to her absence, maybe I should check in on her...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you find anything more interest..."
entries.text: Did you find anything more interesting to pass your time?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She seemed convinced of some "male..."
entries.text: She seemed convinced of some "male presence" following her in the house. It doesn't seem like her, but maybe she's locked herself away from whatever it was?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah, I see. Now I'm starting to get..."
entries.text: Ah, I see. Now I'm starting to get a sense of your true investigation here now, Detective.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "The cook, Mademoiselle Murphy - I h..."
entries.text: The cook, Mademoiselle Murphy - I had asked her to bring me a sandwich that evening. She can attest to my whereabouts.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "But we are not friends yet, Monsieu..."
entries.text: But we are not friends yet, Monsieur. Come, let us talk on other matters for a while. Specifically, the matter of fraud, oui?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah... I suppose we are friends now..."
entries.text: Ah... I suppose we are friends now that you have done me my favour, yes?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "The answer is a boring one. I sat t..."
entries.text: The answer is a boring one. I sat the event out. I found a pleasant nook in the north east corridor and read.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "But you do not need to trust me, Mo..."
entries.text: But you do not need to trust me, Monsieur, though it is the truth.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "And you did not think to share this..."
entries.text: And you did not think to share this for my investigation?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "And as discussed, there is informat..."
entries.text: And as discussed, there is information I want.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah... You are probing! I have somet..."
entries.text: Ah... You are probing! I have something you want, no? Information, perhaps?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Once you have helped me with Madame..."
entries.text: Once you have helped me with Madame Erickson, I will tell you anything you want...

entries.text: Correct.

entries.text: It seems as if Missus Joyce went to hire a detective when Miss Deane disappeared.

entries.text: Telling anyone, however, is a terrible idea, for someone's responsible for Mademoiselle Deane's appearance, and if you tell them, who knows what they'll do?

entries.label: Ettiene: "I'll have to have a look. Anyway -..."
entries.text: I'll have to have a look. Anyway - thank you, Monsieur Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "That's very kind of you, but I don'..."
entries.text: That's very kind of you, but I don't need them.

entries.text: I'll hold onto this for now.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Hm, this is intriguing. I'll take a..."
entries.text: Hm, this is intriguing. I'll take a look at it. Thank you.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Faith - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems there are many more faiths..."
entries.text: It seems there are many more faiths practised among the guests than just Christianity.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "A great deal of them, certainly - a..."
entries.text: A great deal of them, certainly - and in my case, none at all.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Protestant Faith - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about the Protesta..."
entries.text: What do you know about the Protestant faith?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Not a great deal. I was raised Cath..."
entries.text: Not a great deal. I was raised Catholic, and I am not a theologian.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Catholic Faith - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about Catholicism?"
entries.text: Do you know much about Catholicism?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Rather too much, as it happens. If..."
entries.text: Rather too much, as it happens. If you want any sort of useful answer, however, you might ask someone else.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ettiene's Influence - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I understand you're quite influenti..."
entries.text: I understand you're quite influential in certain circles.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Really, that depends on who you ask..."
entries.text: Really, that depends on who you ask... but I will admit, I have made something of a name for myself.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "That in itself is not special. Plen..."
entries.text: That in itself is not special. Plenty of people here have influence and renown, in their differing forms.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "It just so happens I do something t..."
entries.text: It just so happens I do something that no one else here does.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Surreptitious Meeting - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It appears Miss McLeod didn't atten..."
entries.text: It appears Miss McLeod didn't attend a service on Sunday - she was talking with Mister Hunter, instead.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Hm? Well, that's curious. I suppose..."
entries.text: Hm? Well, that's curious. I suppose they must know each other better than they have initially let on.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "It's not out of the question. Outsi..."
entries.text: It's not out of the question. Outside classicism might pressure them not to interact openly.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I suppose you might call it a fight..."
entries.text: I suppose you might call it a fight, though I would say it was more one-sided than that.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Forgive my forwardness, but might I..."
entries.text: Forgive my forwardness, but might I ask as to why?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "So... I published a paper, half a y..."
entries.text: So... I published a paper, half a year ago, you see, on a spiritualist by the name of Marcus H. Watson. He was something of a mentor to Mademoiselle Deane.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "He was also about the most perfect..."
entries.text: He was also about the most perfect master of emotional trickery I've ever met. The paper took two long years. In it, I took his process apart.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I wrote about just how he appeared..."
entries.text: I wrote about just how he appeared to speak to the dead. It was very, very difficult, and I will confess, I am immensely proud of that work.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Despite all Monsieur Watson's work,..."
entries.text: Despite all Monsieur Watson's work, once his manner was laid plain, it was no longer difficult to see. He was disgraced, just as he deserved.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "However, Mademoiselle Deane's assoc..."
entries.text: However, Mademoiselle Deane's association with him... Well, any benefit to her was dashed. She decided to let me hear exactly what she thought of it.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "And so, I did not make the bridge g..."
entries.text: And so, I did not make the bridge game, no, I was fielding that instead. I confess, I was... almost concerned for the woman.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Concerned? How come?"
entries.text: Concerned? How come?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Well, she let me hear exactly what..."
entries.text: Well, she let me hear exactly what she thought, certainly - but she half apologised afterwards. She said she was on edge...

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She seemed convinced that somebody..."
entries.text: She seemed convinced that somebody meant her harm - somebody with a "Christian aura". She was specific on that point. It doesn't seem like her, but maybe she's locked herself away from whatever it was?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I tried to ask, of course, but she..."
entries.text: I tried to ask, of course, but she hadn't forgiven me enough by then to feel like elaborating, and I didn't get anything more.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Am I correct in believing you fough..."
entries.text: Am I correct in believing you fought with Miss Deane last Tuesday?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "This house. It doesn't seem to agre..."
entries.text: This house. It doesn't seem to agree with her. Bad dream, then bouts of no sleep. Thinking back on it, I haven't seen her leave her room since then.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Now that you've drawn my attention..."
entries.text: Now that you've drawn my attention to her absence, maybe I should check in on her...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "And you did not think to share this..."
entries.text: And you did not think to share this for my investigation?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She seemed convinced of some "male..."
entries.text: She seemed convinced of some "male presence" following her in the house. It doesn't seem like her, but maybe she's locked herself away from whatever it was?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah, I see. Now I'm starting to get..."
entries.text: Ah, I see. Now I'm starting to get a sense of your true investigation here now, Detective.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems Miss Deane was overheard a..."
entries.text: It seems Miss Deane was overheard arguing with someone the other night, while the bridge game was being held.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Am I right in thinking it was you s..."
entries.text: Am I right in thinking it was you she was arguing with?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah, that was overheard? Yes, it was..."
entries.text: Ah, that was overheard? Yes, it was me.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "But I... don't see how that's of yo..."
entries.text: But I... don't see how that's of your concern. Especially as you've chosen not to involve yourself in such matters as those that I'm concerned with.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah... well, I suppose you've done m..."
entries.text: Ah... well, I suppose you've done me a favour, it's only fair.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "If you were to reconsider doing me..."
entries.text: If you were to reconsider doing me that favour... then I might consider talking about it. How about it?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "So... I published a paper six month..."
entries.text: So... I published a paper six months ago on a spiritualist by the name of Marcus H. Watson. He was something of a mentor to Mademoiselle Deane.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "He was also about the most perfect..."
entries.text: He was also about the most perfect master of emotional trickery I've ever met. The paper took two long years to write. In it, I took his process apart.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I wrote about just how he appeared..."
entries.text: I wrote about just how he appeared to speak to the dead. It was very, very difficult, and I will confess, I am immensely proud of that work.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Despite all Monsieur Watson's work,..."
entries.text: Despite all Monsieur Watson's work, once his manner was laid plain, it was no longer difficult to see. He was disgraced, just as he deserved.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "However, Mademoiselle Deane's assoc..."
entries.text: However, Mademoiselle Deane's association with him... Well, any benefit to her was dashed. And I thought that was what our conversation was going to be about.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Instead, it was more like she was t..."
entries.text: Instead, it was more like she was trying to rope me into some new scheme. I still don't understand it, if I'm perfectly honest.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She came to me, telling me she thou..."
entries.text: She came to me, telling me she thought she was being followed by some hoax, and wanted me to disprove it, as I had disproved her mentor.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I don't know... I just couldn't bel..."
entries.text: I don't know... I just couldn't believe it. It felt as if she was trying to set me up for something.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "So I refused her, and she wasn't ha..."
entries.text: So I refused her, and she wasn't happy to hear it at all, she rather let me have it.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "And I suppose that was what was ove..."
entries.text: And I suppose that was what was overheard. Does that help you?

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Memento Mori - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know about any......"
entries.text: Do you happen to know about any... unusual deaths among the Quinn family?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Yes. I've heard it said that the Qu..."
entries.text: Yes. I've heard it said that the Quinn family is cursed, but you've met Mademoiselle Quinn...

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She seldom talks about it, and cert..."
entries.text: She seldom talks about it, and certainly not for any sort of gain, and so I don't consider it my business in any professional sense. However...

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I'll say this; I don't know about a..."
entries.text: I'll say this; I don't know about any sort of magic tied to it, but if the Quinns believe they are cursed, whether they are right or not, it's not without reason.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "From what I've gathered, the family..."
entries.text: From what I've gathered, the family has been the victim of tragedy more times than they can count.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Cigar burns - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know where the cigar burns i..."
entries.text: Do you know where the cigar burns in the library came from?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I can't say I do. And I don't smoke..."
entries.text: I can't say I do. And I don't smoke, so you needn't look at me.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Someone ought to tip the housekeepe..."
entries.text: Someone ought to tip the housekeeper for the trouble, though.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hedonistic Gala - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't say I was expecting a party..."
entries.text: I can't say I was expecting a party of that sort.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah, did it take you off guard? I ca..."
entries.text: Ah, did it take you off guard? I cannot say I am shocked.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "You would be surprised just how unc..."
entries.text: You would be surprised just how uncivilised high society events can get. At least you'll know, now, to brace yourself should you attend another.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've found I have the strangest dre..."
entries.text: I've found I have the strangest dreams staying here.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "My data would suggest you are not a..."
entries.text: My data would suggest you are not alone.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Data?"
entries.text: Data?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Oui. But it's too early to comment...."
entries.text: Oui. But it's too early to comment. I am still gathering data and undertaking experiments. Perhaps when I am done, we can talk.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What data is this? Where would it b..."
entries.text: What data is this? Where would it be kept? His room, perhaps?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I feel my technique is solid. I hav..."
entries.text: I feel my technique is solid. I have suitable music and I keep the dream in the forefront of my thoughts, but still - no luck.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Perhaps I could try this technique..."
entries.text: Perhaps I could try this technique and use the knowledge of the shared dreams as my anchor? I could use Miss Deane's journal to represent that.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Aha. You do not seem to be alone. I..."
entries.text: Aha. You do not seem to be alone. I say you, but I, too, have had recurring dreams since coming here.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I have been trying to induce a waki..."
entries.text: I have been trying to induce a waking dream state in myself to see if I can explore the dreams, but I have had no luck.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I have heard that having an anchor..."
entries.text: I have heard that having an anchor to focus on what you hope to achieve can help. I should try that tonight.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Unknown Sigil - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've been seeing this sigil about....."
entries.text: I've been seeing this sigil about... a spiral intersected by four lines. Do you know anything about that?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I've never come across it, no."
entries.text: I've never come across it, no.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Deane's Room - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know which room Miss Deane w..."
entries.text: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Yes, she is in the room... No, I ha..."
entries.text: Yes, she is in the room... No, I have forgotten.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Hmmm..."
entries.text: Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "How unlike me to forget something l..."
entries.text: How unlike me to forget something like that. Suspicious.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Let me check my notes. Here, Room 1..."
entries.text: Let me check my notes. Here, Room 15.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Missus Erickson has confessed to me..."
entries.text: Missus Erickson has confessed to me quite a gruesome plan.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Well, look at that. That is unfortu..."
entries.text: Well, look at that. That is unfortunate... I almost pity her. Maybe I would if she weren't deceiving innocent people.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "This is excellent, Monsieur Ward. T..."
entries.text: This is excellent, Monsieur Ward. Thank you. Your secret is safe with me, I swear it.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "This... I knew I was right about he..."
entries.text: This... I knew I was right about her being a fraud, but I didn't know about this.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "This will do fine, I'm sure - but t..."
entries.text: This will do fine, I'm sure - but that hardly matters. Someone has to stop her.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "No doubt she won't hear anything fr..."
entries.text: No doubt she won't hear anything from me... but you might have a chance to talk some sense into her, Detective.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "And as for your profession, no one..."
entries.text: And as for your profession, no one will hear about it from me, you have my word.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "These might help you - some proof t..."
entries.text: These might help you - some proof that she's not so subtle as she thinks.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "She is indeed a fraud - she has no..."
entries.text: She is indeed a fraud - she has no magical powers. She seems to be incapable of using magic, in fact.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Something that plagues her to the p..."
entries.text: Something that plagues her to the point where she will perform a ritual to steal the heart and magical prowess from another here.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "What? Non! It cannot be!"
entries.text: What? Non! It cannot be!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "She is in dire need to feel magic,..."
entries.text: She is in dire need to feel magic, to have it, it seems.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "But also, she fears that the reason..."
entries.text: But also, she fears that the reason she cannot use magic is a flaw in her soul.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She is blinded, of course, by her d..."
entries.text: She is blinded, of course, by her desires. Anyone who believes in a soul would also believe that there is no eternal bliss for them after murder.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Especially in a manner so foul. Wha..."
entries.text: Especially in a manner so foul. What's more, now you and I know her plan.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Here, take my notes. Let her know t..."
entries.text: Here, take my notes. Let her know that if she does this, not only would it stain her in her god's eyes for eternity, but also, we will see her hanged and raced to this oblivion she fears so much.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She would be better served getting..."
entries.text: She would be better served getting off this path now and finding more mundane solutions to finding her god's favour.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I am told one can cleanse the soul..."
entries.text: I am told one can cleanse the soul with coin? My records show she's certainly conned enough of that in her time...

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "As for you and me, Monsieur Ward, o..."
entries.text: As for you and me, Monsieur Ward, our business is done. Whatever reason you are really here, your identity is safe with me.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "And as for this place? News of her..."
entries.text: And as for this place? News of her plans has turned my stomach. I've had enough mysticism for this trip. I shall be sitting the séance out.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Now, if you will excuse me, I have..."
entries.text: Now, if you will excuse me, I have notes to make in my quarters. Au revoir, Monsieur.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found a ritual in her room - it t..."
entries.text: I found a ritual in her room - it talks of eating a person's heart to steal their magical abilities.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "That is... ominous. Rather too omin..."
entries.text: That is... ominous. Rather too ominous.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Madame Erickson is a fraud, Monsieu..."
entries.text: Madame Erickson is a fraud, Monsieur, but I have trouble believing her capable of such a deranged act.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "You'll no doubt find many here stud..."
entries.text: You'll no doubt find many here studying strange things. But reading a book on sacrifice is not the same as performing it, correct?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "If we are to know this is her plan,..."
entries.text: If we are to know this is her plan, and not academic in nature, then she would need to confess.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She is unlikely to confess to me..."
entries.text: She is unlikely to confess to me...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Surely this is nonsense, Sir? Such..."
entries.text: Surely this is nonsense, Sir? Such a thing cannot be real. What's more, she cannot intend on doing this?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Certainly, such rituals exist. Do t..."
entries.text: Certainly, such rituals exist. Do they work? I cannot say. Would she do it?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "...but you? Perhaps?"
entries.text: ...but you? Perhaps?

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's letter - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this scrap of paper indicat..."
entries.text: I found this scrap of paper indicating that Missus Erickson is a pariah. I thought it might interest you.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "It does, and if the page were compl..."
entries.text: It does, and if the page were complete and she was named on it, perhaps it would suffice.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "...but, ah, the state of it. I don'..."
entries.text: ...but, ah, the state of it. I don't think I could convince anyone this isn't a forgery, however real it might be.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Then, it will not suffice. I do not..."
entries.text: Then, it will not suffice. I do not think we could convince anyone it isn't a forgery, however real it might be.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "It does. But a scrap, you say? Is t..."
entries.text: It does. But a scrap, you say? Is the page complete? Is she named on it?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found a scrap of paper indicating..."
entries.text: I found a scrap of paper indicating that Missus Erickson is a pariah. I thought it might interest you.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...She is not."
entries.text: ...She is not.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's list - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I discovered a list in her room wit..."
entries.text: I discovered a list in her room with names of guests on it.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Interesting, but it doesn't prove a..."
entries.text: Interesting, but it doesn't prove anything in itself. A list of marks for her fraudulent ways? A list for something more? Who can say off this alone?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Your name was marked off."
entries.text: Your name was marked off.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "How insulting! A list of people she..."
entries.text: How insulting! A list of people she does not like, maybe?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Evelyn Deane's name was circled. At..."
entries.text: Evelyn Deane's name was circled. At the top was written 'Targets'.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Interesting. Speculation, yes, but..."
entries.text: Interesting. Speculation, yes, but perhaps it is that I do not use magic, whereas Mademoiselle Deane - she is rumoured to be a studied woman.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You said you wanted to see Missus E..."
entries.text: You said you wanted to see Missus Erickson in action? But isn't Miss Carmella Mantovani the mystic of honour at this séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah yes. I have heard tales of her w..."
entries.text: Ah yes. I have heard tales of her work from... less than

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "They are not always correct in this..."
entries.text: They are not always correct in this, and unfortunately, any skilled enough liar can make use of that.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I don't believe Madame Erickson tru..."
entries.text: I don't believe Madame Erickson truly is communing with spirits on her clients' behalf. I think she is a practised fake, taking advantage of vulnerable people.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, it's Missus Erickson you're loo..."
entries.text: So, it's Missus Erickson you're looking into?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "The thing about mediums is that the..."
entries.text: The thing about mediums is that their clients must take what they say on faith; they assume that the medium is more capable than them.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "They are not always correct in this..."
entries.text: They are not always correct in this, and unfortunately any skilled enough liar can make use of that.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I don't believe Madame Erickson tru..."
entries.text: I don't believe Madame Erickson truly is communing with spirits on her clients' behalf. I think she is a practised fake, taking advantage of vulnerable people.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "You are correct, Monsieur, but that..."
entries.text: You are correct, Monsieur, but that does not interest me. Mademoiselle Mantovani's talents are known and tested many times over. I am sure she will do a fine job.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What sort of proof would suffice to..."
entries.text: What sort of proof would suffice to show someone to be a fraud?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Any number of things, Monsieur. Cat..."
entries.text: Any number of things, Monsieur. Catching them in the act, of course. But a record of their methods, a letter admitting they are faking it - even a confession would do, if witnessed by somebody of standing.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I'm sure you will know it when you..."
entries.text: I'm sure you will know it when you see it...

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Searching out fraud must be easy wo..."
entries.text: Searching out fraud must be easy work at an event such as this.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Au contraire, Monsieur. Many of the..."
entries.text: Au contraire, Monsieur. Many of the guests are true magical practitioners.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, is that your purpose at all eve..."
entries.text: So, is that your purpose at all events like this, searching out the fraud?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "It's certainly not the company. Wel..."
entries.text: It's certainly not the company. Well, that's unfair. It's not consistently the company.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How did you come into a profession..."
entries.text: How did you come into a profession like that?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Just like you might imagine. A frau..."
entries.text: Just like you might imagine. A fraud decided I would be a perfect specimen on which to prove his abilities. I won't get into the specifics.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "But you can imagine it inspired a c..."
entries.text: But you can imagine it inspired a certain drive to expose such cases, and the people behind them.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, is searching out fraud your pur..."
entries.text: So, is searching out fraud your purpose here?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "At a gathering such as this, there..."
entries.text: At a gathering such as this, there is likely to be somebody looking to take advantage of the more vulnerable attendees.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "In what way, Monsieur?"
entries.text: In what way, Monsieur?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It is a séance. Surely everyone inv..."
entries.text: It is a séance. Surely everyone involved in running it is a charlatan and the rest naive fools.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "But at a gathering such as this, th..."
entries.text: But at a gathering such as this, there is likely to be somebody looking to take advantage of the more vulnerable attendees, those who merely believe.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's key - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How did you get this key?"
entries.text: How did you get this key?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Watching for sleight of hand lends..."
entries.text: Watching for sleight of hand lends a certain capacity for it, I've found.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Notes on Hazel - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you think these notes will be en..."
entries.text: Do you think these notes will be enough?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "To prove her a fraud? With what we'..."
entries.text: To prove her a fraud? With what we've learned now, I believe so. To convince her to stop this madness? I could not say.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraudulent attendees - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you really suppose there are peo..."
entries.text: Do you really suppose there are people here that might be frauds? Other than Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I haven't looked so thoroughly at t..."
entries.text: I haven't looked so thoroughly at the others as I might have if I weren't so interested in Madame Erickson's attendance, honestly.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "But there are few who strike me as..."
entries.text: But there are few who strike me as disingenuous here. Anyone here who claims any magical talent certainly believes it themselves.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "That sort of thing - in the case th..."
entries.text: That sort of thing - in the case they are disingenuous - is more difficult to discern, and... rather sad. I like that sort of work much, much less.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/exorcism - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you learned much about exorcis..."
entries.text: Have you learned much about exorcisms in your work?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I have, and they can be real. But,..."
entries.text: I have, and they can be real. But, Monsieur Ward, they are more often not.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Like any tool of the church, you mu..."
entries.text: Like any tool of the church, you must be very sceptical.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Any undesired behaviour can be deem..."
entries.text: Any undesired behaviour can be deemed to be demonic possession - the discovery of unfavourable sciences, a wilful woman, a child who struggles to conform.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Even those of... different sexual o..."
entries.text: Even those of... different sexual orientations are fair game for a fiery priest and his inhumane methods to chase the 'demon' out.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Like witch burnings before it, it's..."
entries.text: Like witch burnings before it, it's a form of punishment for being different. Be wary of it, Monsieur Ward, and of those who use it.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Buried Messages - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The dream - it contains buried mess..."
entries.text: The dream - it contains buried messages!

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah! That makes sense. What is the m..."
entries.text: Ah! That makes sense. What is the message?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "In short, attend the séance. But, f..."
entries.text: In short, attend the séance. But, for reasons I do not yet understand, it is coded with imagery of home.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Strange, I would have said dreaming..."
entries.text: Strange, I would have said dreaming of home might make me want to return there. But that is not the case.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Perhaps this speaks more to the sou..."
entries.text: Perhaps this speaks more to the source of the dreams - maybe they convey a feeling moreso than a directive?

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Altered Reality - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I... I believe that something about..."
entries.text: I... I believe that something about the dream is reshaping how we see the hotel.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I shook it for only a moment - just..."
entries.text: I shook it for only a moment - just enough to realise it - before the veil dropped again.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I saw pictures of my homelife inste..."
entries.text: I saw pictures of my homelife instead of the manor; people and places I love.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Would that not become obvious? As w..."
entries.text: Would that not become obvious? As we point out aspects that do not align with one another's experiences?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Interesting. As if this place wants..."
entries.text: Interesting. As if this place wants you to feel at home? Or perhaps something is trying to communicate a feeling through this?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I think it is... more subconscious..."
entries.text: I think it is... more subconscious than that. I saw, for a moment, familiar images underneath the art in my room.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I wonder, then, what might anyone w..."
entries.text: I wonder, then, what might anyone who's been under its influence for longer be experiencing?

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Lucid Dreaming - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you tell me more about this luc..."
entries.text: Can you tell me more about this lucid dreaming?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah, Les Rêves Lucide. I have only a..."
entries.text: Ah, Les Rêves Lucide. I have only a passing familiarity with the work of Marquis d’Hervey de Saint-Denys. I had to research what I could in the library here to try it myself and so far, I have had little luck with it.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Perhaps the record I am using isn't..."
entries.text: Perhaps the record I am using isn't suitable, or my technique is otherwise flawed? We shall see.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I am told Madame Lau is a psycholog..."
entries.text: I am told Madame Lau is a psychologist - perhaps she would know more. Or the doctor - this seems up his alley, non?

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Shared Dreams - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I suspect many of the guests are ex..."
entries.text: I suspect many of the guests are experiencing the same dream.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Oui. I am coming to that same concl..."
entries.text: Oui. I am coming to that same conclusion, but as yet I do not know the why of it.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Is it, perhaps, an echo of somethin..."
entries.text: Is it, perhaps, an echo of something from the past? A communication? Are we actually trapped in the one dream? If so, whose?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I am working on a lucid dream, but..."
entries.text: I am working on a lucid dream, but I'm not making the headway I would like. I am missing something, but what?

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Coded Paper - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does this pattern ring any bells fo..."
entries.text: Does this pattern ring any bells for you, Mister Toussaint?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "...Intriguing. I do not recognise i..."
entries.text: ...Intriguing. I do not recognise it exactly, but it certainly seems mystical in nature.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/guests - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You suspect someone, then?"
entries.text: You suspect someone, then?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I believe most attendees are legiti..."
entries.text: I believe most attendees are legitimate practitioners, but yes, I have my suspicions.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "My intent is to gain the proof that..."
entries.text: My intent is to gain the proof that will discredit them.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have any plans for the weeke..."
entries.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Talks?"
entries.text: Talks?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "In the drawing room. One at eleven,..."
entries.text: In the drawing room. One at eleven, one at three, and one more at five if you wish to join me.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I plan to attend the drawing room t..."
entries.text: I plan to attend the drawing room talk at three. Then the bar at five, I think, to unwind from all this.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Other than the ball this evening, I..."
entries.text: Other than the ball this evening, I hope to attend the talks.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I'll want to eat before the séance..."
entries.text: I'll want to eat before the séance at 9, but I have no interest in the silent dinner, so I'll need to corner the staff and make arrangements for beforehand.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you have any plans for today?"
entries.text: Do you have any plans for today?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "And tomorrow, let me see..."
entries.text: And tomorrow, let me see...

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I've no interest in the silent dinn..."
entries.text: I've no interest in the silent dinner or the séance, so I'll need to corner the staff and make arrangements to eat beforehand.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Excuse me but did you say there are..."
entries.text: Excuse me but did you say there are people here who think they can perform magic?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Non."
entries.text: Non.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I said there are people here who ca..."
entries.text: I said there are people here who can perform it.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "You are, I know, not of this scene,..."
entries.text: You are, I know, not of this scene, but believe me when I tell you - magic, rituals, ghosts. It is all real.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "It is hard, of course, and expensiv..."
entries.text: It is hard, of course, and expensive in what it takes. So it is not commonplace.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Easier for some to... fake."
entries.text: Easier for some to... fake.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This is ridiculous!"
entries.text: This is ridiculous!

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "To you right now? Maybe. But you ar..."
entries.text: To you right now? Maybe. But you are here now, and you will soon see many unexplainable things.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "We shall see, then, how "ridiculous..."
entries.text: We shall see, then, how "ridiculous" it all is.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/identity known - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You know me, Sir?"
entries.text: You know me, Sir?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Not quite. I know of you."
entries.text: Not quite. I know of you.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "It remains to be seen if you truly..."
entries.text: It remains to be seen if you truly are the man I have read about.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/gauge - Etienne

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you studied the strange device..."
entries.text: Have you studied the strange device in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I have, and it is strange indeed, b..."
entries.text: I have, and it is strange indeed, but this place has other similar devices. I'm unsure if it means anything or is purely for display.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ivy - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss McLeod?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I have. Quite the ability she claim..."
entries.text: I have. Quite the ability she claims to have. Convenient that her time here has dampened it, non?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Certainly, something has her distra..."
entries.text: Certainly, something has her distracted. What would be of greater importance to her than this event, eh?

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Varley - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the manager?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the manager?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Monsieur Varley? Not extensively."
entries.text: Monsieur Varley? Not extensively.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I don't take him as one for idle co..."
entries.text: I don't take him as one for idle conversation. My kind of man.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you been introduced to Missus..."
entries.text: Have you been introduced to Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah! How pleasant to find a psycholo..."
entries.text: Ah! How pleasant to find a psychologist in our crowd, and one so shrewd.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "And such a watch she keeps on her c..."
entries.text: And such a watch she keeps on her companion! I can see why she was chosen as a chaperone.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Skerritt - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Skerritt?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I have. We did not, how you say, bo..."
entries.text: I have. We did not, how you say, bond...

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "How could I put this? He is not a f..."
entries.text: How could I put this? He is not a fan of Oscar Wilde.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Corentine - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've met Miss Qui..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've met Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Mademoiselle Quinn and I first met..."
entries.text: Mademoiselle Quinn and I first met some time ago, in London. It was a pleasant surprise to see her again.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I haven't wanted to interrupt her w..."
entries.text: I haven't wanted to interrupt her work, whatever it is she's doing, but when there is an opportunity, I enjoy talking to her.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "She has some unique insights into t..."
entries.text: She has some unique insights into this culture of ours. She's also friendlier to me than many.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I understand why people are wary of..."
entries.text: I understand why people are wary of me, but that's not to say it isn't a welcome break to have a proper conversation now and then.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Many people here are, perhaps under..."
entries.text: Many people here are, perhaps understandably, wary of me.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Mademoiselle Quinn, not so. She doe..."
entries.text: Mademoiselle Quinn, not so. She does not care to impress others with her work, so she does not care if I believe in her or not.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "As such, we get on reasonably well...."
entries.text: As such, we get on reasonably well. Sadly for me, she is so preoccupied with her research.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Caitlin - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the housekeeper?"
entries.text: Have you met the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Of course. At a gathering like this..."
entries.text: Of course. At a gathering like this, the staff are a great resource. Overlooked but everywhere!

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I asked her many questions, and she..."
entries.text: I asked her many questions, and she was happy to oblige.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Perhaps both?"
entries.text: Perhaps both?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I'm unsure whether she's intrigued..."
entries.text: I'm unsure whether she's intrigued by the events of this weekend, or horrified at its "godlessness".

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Darragh - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the stable maste..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to the stable master?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "It is well he is such a gentle soul..."
entries.text: It is well he is such a gentle soul - a man of that size would be hard to overpower if it came to that, non?

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Seamus - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've met the port..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've met the porter?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I had a question or two for him, bu..."
entries.text: I had a question or two for him, but I can tell you I didn't learn much.

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, Mister Touissant, tell me about..."
entries.text: So, Mister Touissant, tell me about yourself.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Hm. Shall I presume that no one's t..."
entries.text: Hm. Shall I presume that no one's told you anything of their own accord? I will, I'll be charitable.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I'm an academic with a particular i..."
entries.text: I'm an academic with a particular interest in the supernatural - what of it can be proved or disproved.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Enough people work to prove its exi..."
entries.text: Enough people work to prove its existence, but not so many try to mark where fraud begins.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "What else? I am from Reims, studied..."
entries.text: What else? I am from Reims, studied the classics first, and... if I tell you any more, I'll become very boring.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "Where is he visiting from?"
entries.text: Where is he visiting from?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you come far for this event?"
entries.text: Have you come far for this event?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Some distance, I will confess. I'm..."
entries.text: Some distance, I will confess. I'm accustomed to travelling to England - London especially - and this is significantly farther West.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Where are you visiting from, if not..."
entries.text: Where are you visiting from, if not England?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "France. Reims, more specifically. H..."
entries.text: France. Reims, more specifically. Have you ever been?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've never left Ireland."
entries.text: I've never left Ireland.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Well, I hope someday you have the o..."
entries.text: Well, I hope someday you have the opportunity. In the meantime... your country is quite beautiful, so no harm there.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Some distance, I will confess. I'm..."
entries.text: Some distance, I will confess. I'm accustomed to travelling to England - London especially - but this is significantly farther West.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Where are you visiting from, if not..."
entries.text: Where are you visiting from, if not England?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've... never left Ireland."
entries.text: I've... never left Ireland.

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "I hope someday you have the opportu..."
entries.text: I hope someday you have the opportunity. In the meantime... your country is quite beautiful in its own way.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I take it, from your accent, you ha..."
entries.text: I take it, from your accent, you have travelled far to be here?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "As for my origin - France. Paris, n..."
entries.text: As for my origin - France. Paris, nowadays, though I was born and raised in Reims. Have you ever been?

title: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Cathal - Ettiene

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Mister Toussaint
entries.label: Ettiene: "Ah... that I have. To say I am conc..."
entries.text: Ah... that I have. To say I am concerned for him...

entries.text: ...You should put that back where you found it.

entries.text: Have you noticed anything strange while you've been staying here?

entries.text: It would be the place for that.

entries.text: I keep finding ash on my clothes. I don't have the faintest idea where it's coming from.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: Admittedly, I was afraid that...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: Well, I've brought an urn with me.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: Thankfully, the lid is on tight.

entries.text: Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone on Tuesday night.

entries.text: He did? Did something happen to her? I'd been looking everywhere for her, but...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...But I hope she's alright."
entries.text: ...But I hope she's alright.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Mysterious figure in window - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I couldn't help but notice a figure..."
entries.text: I couldn't help but notice a figure in the window on my way back into the manor.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "That's curious. A child of the hous..."
entries.text: That's curious. A child of the house, or another ghost, perhaps?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Fae - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you tell me anything about the..."
entries.text: Can you tell me anything about the fae?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "You know, every culture has its nam..."
entries.text: You know, every culture has its name for the things that live on the edge of our understanding.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The Japanese call them Yōkai, the P..."
entries.text: The Japanese call them Yōkai, the Persians have Peri, the Russians call theirs Leshy - and so on.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Each one is shaped by their climate..."
entries.text: Each one is shaped by their climates and the reports influenced by the human cultures, but I think perhaps they are all the same thing.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Whatever that ultimately is."
entries.text: Whatever that ultimately is.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Dupré

entries.text: Do you know anything about The Tuatha Dé Danann?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: Ah, yes. They were the old gods of Ireland.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The mythical race that came before..."
entries.text: The mythical race that came before humanity, some say.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The old Anvil - Dupré

entries.text: The anvil outside must have been there for quite some time.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: I was thinking that, myself.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I wonder what's so special about it..."
entries.text: I wonder what's so special about it that it's been left alone for so long?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dead End - Dupré

entries.text: It seems that when Miss Deane left on Tuesday, she wandered into the garden... but there's no sign of her from there.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: How can that be?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I do hope she's safe, wherever she..."
entries.text: I do hope she's safe, wherever she is.

entries.text: I know they're a society interested in magic... but I'm afraid I don't know anything more specific than that.

entries.text: Did you attend Tuesday’s bridge game?

entries.text: Almost. But the lovely Miss Mantovani offered me a reading. How could I refuse? So I skipped the game.

entries.text: But with such conversation to be had, and so little time, I’ve found not a second to spare.

entries.text: Well, I never imagined…you’re quite prolific, aren’t you Mister Ward?

entries.text: If I’m under investigation, I do hope you’d have the decency to say it to my face.

entries.text: Someone hired me to investigate Miss Deane’s disappearance. I think it was the housekeeper.

entries.text: You mean to tell me that in all this, that young woman has been missing?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: I hope you find her, Mister Ward. This hotel has enough ghosts as it is.

entries.text: I do hope you'll find time to stop by for some of them - mine especially, of course. I'm rather proud of it.

entries.text: Missus D'Arcy believes she is being haunted by her late husband, and she seems to be... at her wits' end.

entries.text: I understand you're well-versed in such matters - do you think you'd be able to help her?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: My... I had the impression there was something troubling her, but I didn't know it was... quite that serious.

entries.text: I can help, of course, but I'll need an item of Mister D'Arcy's - something that would have been of considerable emotional value to him.

entries.text: But, when that is not an option, which is often the case with angry spirits, then we trap a soul and take that fetter to a faraway place.

entries.text: The Gulf of Mexico is littered with ghosts. They are harmless to us, there.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Laying a soul to rest is the easier..."
entries.text: Laying a soul to rest is the easier, and kinder, method of being rid of one.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I have been having the strangest dr..."
entries.text: I have been having the strangest dreams of late.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Have you now? I'll confess to some..."
entries.text: Have you now? I'll confess to some strange patterns, yes.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Mine started with classic Celtic ic..."
entries.text: Mine started with classic Celtic iconography around the hotel - standing stones, spirals - all that.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "But the more often I dream it, the..."
entries.text: But the more often I dream it, the more I'm seeing the same elements, but in my funeral parlour at home.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That sounds unnerving."
entries.text: That sounds unnerving.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "At first, I found it quite comforti..."
entries.text: At first, I found it quite comforting - the views of home are crystal clear and helped with my homesickness. But once I realised I could not reach home?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It was all in the manor walls, at f..."
entries.text: It was all in the manor walls, at first.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Then, yes. Unnerving. I could only..."
entries.text: Then, yes. Unnerving. I could only ever find my way to the séance - or, what I took to represent that, at least. It's... given some apprehension about attending, I cannot lie.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I've already been here the longest..."
entries.text: I've already been here the longest - at least from the guests. Any longer, and I fear this place will get its claws in me for good...

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Sigil - Dupre

entries.text: Do you recognise this symbol?

entries.text: Hmm...can't say that I do, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: It looks vaguely Celtic, but beyond that, I couldn't say.

entries.text: Does this mean anything to you, Mister Dupré?

entries.label: Dupré: "Let me see... It looks much like th..."
entries.text: Let me see... It looks much like that brooch Missus D'Arcy wears. Other than that, no, it means nothing to me.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Grand Séance - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are your feelings on this Gran..."
entries.text: What are your feelings on this Grand Séance, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I must tell you, Mister Ward...I am..."
entries.text: I must tell you, Mister Ward...I am no stranger to death. Assuredly no stranger to spirits.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "But never before have I heard one s..."
entries.text: But never before have I heard one speak. And as compelling as that may be, the chill in my bones endures.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You believe there's a risk?"
entries.text: You believe there's a risk?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Oh, I'm sure Miss Mantovani will ta..."
entries.text: Oh, I'm sure Miss Mantovani will take good care of us.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...But I am an undertaker, Mister W..."
entries.text: ...But I am an undertaker, Mister Ward. I have welcomed the rageful dead - those unwanted, those "unclean" or too in between to find their gods.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "And I fear we forget that people af..."
entries.text: And I fear we forget that people after death are simply themselves with nothing left to lose.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Urn - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...Someone mentioned to me that you..."
entries.text: ...Someone mentioned to me that you had an urn with you when you arrived at the manor, Mister Dupré.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...Indeed, I do, Mister Ward. It co..."
entries.text: ...Indeed, I do, Mister Ward. It contains a being of true menace.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I speak, naturally, of my dearest f..."
entries.text: I speak, naturally, of my dearest friend. She'd wanted her ashes scattered in her home country, you see.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I must admit, however, that I'm tak..."
entries.text: I must admit, however, that I'm taking my time. I still have hope that I might see her one last time before laying her to rest.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Really?"
entries.text: Really?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hedonistic Gala - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What did you make of last night's b..."
entries.text: What did you make of last night's ball?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Why, it wasn't dissimilar to Mardi..."
entries.text: Why, it wasn't dissimilar to Mardi Gras back home. Less soulful, but when you are as homesick as I find myself to be, it was a welcome distraction.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Did you spot the quartet? Apparentl..."
entries.text: Did you spot the quartet? Apparently, that four piece were killed here over one-hundred years ago by the Marquess of the time so nobody else would hear how finely they played.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "They just placed some instruments a..."
entries.text: They just placed some instruments and let those lost souls find them - quite macabre but also fascinating.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does this remind you of anything, M..."
entries.text: Does this remind you of anything, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...Strange."
entries.text: ...Strange.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I cannot recall seeing it, and yet..."
entries.text: I cannot recall seeing it, and yet I feel a sense of...nostalgia? No, perhaps a darker shade of remembrance.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "My body knows it, even if my mind d..."
entries.text: My body knows it, even if my mind does not.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Fetters - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about fetters?"
entries.text: What do you know about fetters?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Chains, Mister Ward. Physically, ye..."
entries.text: Chains, Mister Ward. Physically, yes - and spiritually.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "A ghost can no more escape its fett..."
entries.text: A ghost can no more escape its fetters than we can chains in a cell. Unless, of course, there's a key - ha!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Fetters are impermanent, then? Can..."
entries.text: Fetters are impermanent, then? Can they be undone?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Oh, yes! Some spirits need simply r..."
entries.text: Oh, yes! Some spirits need simply release their sorrow. Many need help to do so.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "But some ghosts are chained to worl..."
entries.text: But some ghosts are chained to worldly objects. In those cases, permanence is likely the intent.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You're saying fetters can be made?"
entries.text: You're saying fetters can be made?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I've made them, Mister Ward. Though..."
entries.text: I've made them, Mister Ward. Though only ever as a last resort.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Possessed ring - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I do wonder if keeping this ring on..."
entries.text: I do wonder if keeping this ring on my person is a terribly bright idea.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Worry not, Mister Ward. You have my..."
entries.text: Worry not, Mister Ward. You have my assurance that Mister D'Arcy is firmly confined - poor devil.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Still. I wonder about the others."
entries.text: Still. I wonder about the others.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "A place with this much history...su..."
entries.text: A place with this much history...surely there are spirits trapped within its walls? If one knows where to look.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I doubt many of them deserve it."
entries.text: I doubt many of them deserve it.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Death Certificate - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Barbosa seems to have suffered..."
entries.text: Miss Barbosa seems to have suffered a great loss indeed.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "So she tells me, Mister Ward."
entries.text: So she tells me, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Grief is an old friend in my line o..."
entries.text: Grief is an old friend in my line of work, but it still does me no good to see her visit a warm-hearted soul like that.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Father's Ghost - Dupré

entries.label: Ward: "Miss Barbosa hopes to see her fathe..."
entries.text: Miss Barbosa hopes to see her father at the séance. Do you know anything that could help her find him?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Hmm...This is a large séance, Miste..."
entries.text: Hmm...This is a large séance, Mister Ward. Multiple people, countless desires overlapping like ripples.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Now, Doctor Callaghan - he could he..."
entries.text: Now, Doctor Callaghan - he could help you! I've heard he can work wonders with spirit photography.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I fear that seeking out one specifi..."
entries.text: I fear that seeking out one specific spirit may prove quite a feat.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Drawings of a Young Woman - Dupré

entries.text: ...Were you close with Miss Deane, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: ...Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "No. No, I dare say she looked right..."
entries.text: No. No, I dare say she looked right through me.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She looks uncannily like my dearly..."
entries.text: She looks uncannily like my dearly departed friend, you see. Each time I see her, it's like... Well, the grief feels fresh.

entries.text: I've heard Miss Callaghan is a master in the art of well scrying.

entries.text: So I have heard. In fact, I have made plans to visit her myself.
