entries.label: Dupré: "To be able to show a person their l..."
entries.text: To be able to show a person their loved ones while separated - what a gift.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She is indeed. I had some time with..."
entries.text: She is indeed. I had some time with her and she was able to show me the people back home.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Deane's Room - Dupré

entries.text: Do you happen to know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.text: ...Miss D'Arcy mentioned overhearing a fight between Miss Deane and Miss Quinn outside her room, room 13. I cannot help beyond that.

entries.text: Mister Dupré? Would this work? For Missus D'Arcy's needs?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Come, let us first find Missus D'Ar..."
entries.text: Come, let us first find Missus D'Arcy and then a secluded area to perform the rite.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Let me see... You know, I think it..."
entries.text: Let me see... You know, I think it will.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Shadowy Figure - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you ever heard of, well, ghost..."
entries.text: Have you ever heard of, well, ghosts that are larger than normal?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Hmmm... I've heard of a great many..."
entries.text: Hmmm... I've heard of a great many things, and many cultures claim to have had giants walk their lands in times passed. But no, I've never seen or heard of it, at least nothing that makes me believe.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "But other things? That is possible...."
entries.text: But other things? That is possible. Perhaps not a ghost, but an angelic visitation or other godly figure, maybe?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "This land's old gods, the Tuatha Dé..."
entries.text: This land's old gods, the Tuatha Dé Danann, would have been described as "larger than man", for example, and the mythology here references many giants in that vein.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Magical Grimoire - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does this book mean anything to you..."
entries.text: Does this book mean anything to you, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It does not, Mister Ward, and for t..."
entries.text: It does not, Mister Ward, and for that I am glad.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I would not trifle with the energy..."
entries.text: I would not trifle with the energy it holds - nor the magic those symbols have to offer.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I heard recently that Miss Deane de..."
entries.text: I heard recently that Miss Deane descends from a powerful bloodline of Milesians.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Good for her. I've been told she is..."
entries.text: Good for her. I've been told she is a talented practitioner.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I'm not sure that her bloodline pla..."
entries.text: I'm not sure that her bloodline plays any part in that, but it sounds impressive.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...hopefully not so impressive that..."
entries.text: ...hopefully not so impressive that some lunatic comes looking for her blood.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Don't look at me like that, Mister..."
entries.text: Don't look at me like that, Mister Ward. People have done worse for the promise of less.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Coded Papers - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does this mean anything to you, Mis..."
entries.text: Does this mean anything to you, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Hm. The paper certainly seems to em..."
entries.text: Hm. The paper certainly seems to emanate some sort of energy.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I couldn't tell you what it's hidin..."
entries.text: I couldn't tell you what it's hiding, but hiding is what it seems to be doing.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "That sigil is keeping a secret from..."
entries.text: That sigil is keeping a secret from you, Mister Ward.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Carmela's Health

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Mantovani seems unwell..."
entries.text: Miss Mantovani seems unwell...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Indeed, someone who works so regula..."
entries.text: Indeed, someone who works so regularly with such forces takes a risk.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "But it's not my place to say anythi..."
entries.text: But it's not my place to say anything more.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The way she speaks of it, and write..."
entries.text: The way she speaks of it, and writes of it. It clearly takes a toll.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "We have... made some arrangements,..."
entries.text: We have... made some arrangements, her and I, just in case. I'm hoping it won't come to that.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brat Bhride

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know what a Brat Bhride is,..."
entries.text: Do you know what a Brat Bhride is, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Indeed, I do. In simple terms, it i..."
entries.text: Indeed, I do. In simple terms, it is a powerful cloth, endowed with the blessing of Saint Brigid.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I've known those who make them to b..."
entries.text: I've known those who make them to be among her most devoted and loving followers.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've found the third aspect."
entries.text: I've found the third aspect.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Mister Ward, I could not be more gr..."
entries.text: Mister Ward, I could not be more grateful that Maman has delivered you to me this day. Who is it?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It's... Caitlin Joyce. She gave me..."
entries.text: It's... Caitlin Joyce. She gave me a brat bhride that should hopefully be a suitable demonstration of her devotion.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...The housekeeper? I was given to..."
entries.text: ...The housekeeper? I was given to understand I frighten her.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Truth be told, Mister Dupré, you pr..."
entries.text: Truth be told, Mister Dupré, you probably do. But she's willing to learn, to repent for...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...past misgivings."
entries.text: ...past misgivings.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Then by all means, Mister Ward. Lea..."
entries.text: Then by all means, Mister Ward. Lead the way.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "But I'm certain she'll be willing t..."
entries.text: But I'm certain she'll be willing to help.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm grateful that Laura was seen of..."
entries.text: I'm grateful that Laura was seen off safely.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Not as grateful as I am for you and..."
entries.text: Not as grateful as I am for you and Missus Joyce, Mister Ward.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Forgive me for prying, Mister Dupré..."
entries.text: Forgive me for prying, Mister Dupré, but... I heard tell that you'd lost someone close to you recently.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...Ah."

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You needn't speak to me about it, o..."
entries.text: You needn't speak to me about it, of course. But I wanted to let you know that you could.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Well, she was originally from Irela..."
entries.text: Well, she was originally from Ireland. I'm primarily here to scatter her ashes, in fact. She was a priestess of Bríd, and I a follower of Maman Brigitte.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "W-well, yes, I suppose I have lost..."
entries.text: W-well, yes, I suppose I have lost her - at least to some degree. I don't like to say it out loud, but my best friend is...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Well, she's dead, Mister Ward. But..."
entries.text: Well, she's dead, Mister Ward. But I still have hope this séance will allow us to speak, just one last time.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Two adepts of close beliefs? I can..."
entries.text: Two adepts of close beliefs? I can imagine that was something truly special.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Hah! You talk as if we were profess..."
entries.text: Hah! You talk as if we were professionals - but my favourite thing about her is how phenomenally stupid she made me.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "We met in a bicycle shop, you see...."
entries.text: We met in a bicycle shop, you see. She convinced them to sell to us, and then insisted on racing me down the steepest hill I've ever seen.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "We both wound up with scrapes, and..."
entries.text: We both wound up with scrapes, and a bit less bicycle than we started with - but it made me feel like a child again. That's her.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What was she like?"
entries.text: What was she like?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you think spirit boards have any..."
entries.text: Do you think spirit boards have any practical use, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Oh yes, Mister Ward. Rather too oft..."
entries.text: Oh yes, Mister Ward. Rather too often, they're dismissed as toys. I've even brought one here myself.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is there some communication you wis..."
entries.text: Is there some communication you wish to make beyond the boundary?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...My dearest friend. I brought her..."
entries.text: ...My dearest friend. I brought her ashes here to be scattered in her home country - but also that we might speak once more.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The spirit board will allow us a fe..."
entries.text: The spirit board will allow us a few words, at least. But this séance may actually allow us to speak, to-

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Well. I've not found her, but no do..."
entries.text: Well. I've not found her, but no doubt she's near a place of fire - I've checked everywhere but I cannot find her.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Sometimes I think I have lost her t..."
entries.text: Sometimes I think I have lost her to this place and... other times I wonder if she is not speaking to me.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Knowing her, she's floating in some..."
entries.text: Knowing her, she's floating in some ridiculous twist or turn, like it's a game of hide and seek. Playing through it all, lest she face it head-on...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "But, when she sees what I have plan..."
entries.text: But, when she sees what I have planned is for the best, too good an opportunity to...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Forgive me, Mister Ward, I lost the..."
entries.text: Forgive me, Mister Ward, I lost the run of myself there...

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I... communicated with a ghost in t..."
entries.text: I... communicated with a ghost in the hedge maze using a spirit board.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It said "Help me or I'll be trapped..."
entries.text: It said "Help me or I'll be trapped here forever".

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...How would one go about freeing a..."
entries.text: ...How would one go about freeing a spirit from this manor, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Unfortunately, Mister Ward, I suspe..."
entries.text: Unfortunately, Mister Ward, I suspect it's rather too late for most of them.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "For spirits only recently bound to..."
entries.text: For spirits only recently bound to the manor, however, there may still be a chance.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I used the spirit board to speak wi..."
entries.text: I used the spirit board to speak with your friend's ghost.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "She said "Help me or I'll be trappe..."
entries.text: She said "Help me or I'll be trapped here forever".

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Trapped here? But I thought she wan..."
entries.text: Trapped here? But I thought she wanted to be freed in Ireland. I don't understand, Mister Ward, can you give me more context?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Unfortunately, Mister Ward, I suspe..."
entries.text: Unfortunately, Mister Ward, I suspect it's rather too late for any spirit here...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Unless they were only recently boun..."
entries.text: Unless they were only recently bound to the manor - in which case there may still be a chance for them.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...What do you know about transferr..."
entries.text: ...What do you know about transferring souls, Mister Dupré? Specifically into living bodies.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Wh..."
entries.text: Wh...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...I know it to be an unforgivable..."
entries.text: ...I know it to be an unforgivable act. The erasure of one life to prolong another beyond its natural years.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "P-please may we dwell on it no furt..."
entries.text: P-please may we dwell on it no further?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Maman Brigitte

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I take it you're close with Maman B..."
entries.text: I take it you're close with Maman Brigitte, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Deeply, Mister Ward. When grief is..."
entries.text: Deeply, Mister Ward. When grief is a constant companion, she is there to remind me that both the living and the dead need healers. I am devoted to her and her teachings.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I came across a ghost who seems lik..."
entries.text: I came across a ghost who seems like she has something to say to me, Mister Dupré.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know how I might go about co..."
entries.text: Do you know how I might go about communicating with her?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She must have a powerful soul if sh..."
entries.text: She must have a powerful soul if she can appear before you so, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "For a spirit strong enough to take..."
entries.text: For a spirit strong enough to take visible form, even a spirit board would be enough.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I came across a ghost, Mister Dupré..."
entries.text: I came across a ghost, Mister Dupré. One, I suspect you have ties to...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I don't think I follow, Mister Ward..."
entries.text: I don't think I follow, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...could it be? ...Laura? Come, you..."
entries.text: ...could it be? ...Laura? Come, you must show me right away.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "At the firepit."
entries.text: At the firepit.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How are you faring, Mister Dupré? W..."
entries.text: How are you faring, Mister Dupré? What with Laura...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She'd never encourage my wallowing,..."
entries.text: She'd never encourage my wallowing, Mister Ward. I'm as well as she'd like me to be.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...Perhaps I'll say that again, som..."
entries.text: ...Perhaps I'll say that again, sometime, and believe it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I came across a ghost, Mister Dupré..."
entries.text: I came across a ghost, Mister Dupré. One, I suspect you have ties to...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...I don't think I follow, Mister W..."
entries.text: ...I don't think I follow, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "You... N-no. No, you must be mistak..."
entries.text: You... N-no. No, you must be mistaken.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "At the firepit."
entries.text: At the firepit.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Please, Mister Ward, may we speak o..."
entries.text: Please, Mister Ward, may we speak of something else?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Plenty, Mister Ward! Though I have..."
entries.text: Plenty, Mister Ward! Though I have an especially busy day tomorrow - so I think I'll take today a little easier.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Quite a lot, it would seem!"
entries.text: Quite a lot, it would seem!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Any plans for this weekend, Mister..."
entries.text: Any plans for this weekend, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What are you up to today, Mister Du..."
entries.text: What are you up to today, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "And then we reach the big moment -..."
entries.text: And then we reach the big moment - the Grand Séance! I assume I will see you there?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I'll spend some time wandering the..."
entries.text: I'll spend some time wandering the gardens. I've felt a strange calling to the outdoors since coming here, and I can't help but feel I must answer.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "If I'm not there, I'll likely be in..."
entries.text: If I'm not there, I'll likely be in the drawing room, attending talks or discussing them with other guests.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Before then, a walk in the hedge ma..."
entries.text: Before then, a walk in the hedge maze before attending Miss Callaghan's talk at three, I think.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Then tomorrow..."
entries.text: Then tomorrow...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I also have a scrying session with..."
entries.text: I also have a scrying session with Miss Callaghan at eleven - and I'm attending her nephew's talk at three.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I'll certainly join the silent dinn..."
entries.text: I'll certainly join the silent dinner at eight. There's... Well, I'm hoping a certain spirit might attend.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "There's lunch in the dining room at..."
entries.text: There's lunch in the dining room at one, and I think I'll take a late nap at five. I suspect it will be a long evening!

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I don't want to wear myself out bef..."
entries.text: I don't want to wear myself out before the ball, so I won't do much more than that, today.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Well, first of all - how could resi..."
entries.text: Well, first of all - how could resist a talk from our resident mystic, Miss Mantovani? I will be in attendance at 5pm.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "And then we reach the big moment -..."
entries.text: And then we reach the big moment - the Grand Séance! I will admit, I am happier attending under Laura's watchful eye.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Goibniu - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about the god Goib..."
entries.text: Do you know much about the god Goibniu?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "He's a smithing god, yes? I don't r..."
entries.text: He's a smithing god, yes? I don't recall much about him - perhaps one of the Callaghans or Mister Ó Finn can be of more help?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Tuatha Dé Danann - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you heard of the Tuatha Dé Dan..."
entries.text: Have you heard of the Tuatha Dé Danann?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The old gods of Ireland. Not defeat..."
entries.text: The old gods of Ireland. Not defeated by mankind but tricked by them.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "If you are keen, I believe the libr..."
entries.text: If you are keen, I believe the library stocks a few books on the matter.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I always wondered if they lurk abou..."
entries.text: I always wondered if they lurk about plotting their revenge.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brid - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know of the goddess, Bríd?"
entries.text: Do you know of the goddess, Bríd?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I do. A friend of mine was a priest..."
entries.text: I do. A friend of mine was a priestess of hers. Bríd was not one of the sovereignty goddesses, but in some ways, she should have been.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "When the Catholic church came here,..."
entries.text: When the Catholic church came here, she alone was deemed too powerful to be swept under the rug. And so they canonised her.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Saint Brigid of Kildare, she became..."
entries.text: Saint Brigid of Kildare, she became. A lot of the same domains - husbandry, midwifery, healing. You may have noticed her crosses hung along the walls of the manor?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "My own Loa, Maman Brigitte, is said..."
entries.text: My own Loa, Maman Brigitte, is said to be the part of the old goddess that fled the church and was changed in that journey.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It's interesting, isn't it? Three v..."
entries.text: It's interesting, isn't it? Three versions of the one goddess, all distinct yet so similar, all back together under this roof. So to speak.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/morrigan - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you learned much about the Mor..."
entries.text: Have you learned much about the Morrigan?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "A triple sister goddess associated..."
entries.text: A triple sister goddess associated with war and fate.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Some say she is the bean-nighe, the..."
entries.text: Some say she is the bean-nighe, the washer woman who appears before a tragedy to wash the clothes of the soon to be dead.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It's funny you mention her, one of..."
entries.text: It's funny you mention her, one of her triad is named Babd, which is also the Gaelic word for crow.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Which I find funny given how many o..."
entries.text: Which I find funny given how many of the damned birds are here at the moment. It's a murder, many times over.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Cailleach - dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about the Cailleac..."
entries.text: Do you know much about the Cailleach?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "No, not a lot. I know that she pred..."
entries.text: No, not a lot. I know that she predates the Tuatha Dé Danann, but nothing more than that.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It's scary, isn't it, Mister Ward,..."
entries.text: It's scary, isn't it, Mister Ward, to think that there are things out there older than gods?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/tir na nog - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you heard of Tír na nÓg?"
entries.text: Have you heard of Tír na nÓg?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have. The old Irish Otherworld se..."
entries.text: I have. The old Irish Otherworld serves as home to the gods, realm of the fae, and, sometimes, an afterlife for mortal folk.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It is both geographical and a-geogr..."
entries.text: It is both geographical and a-geographical in that it is said to be under Ireland but also an island off to the southwest.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Many stories exist of heroes sailin..."
entries.text: Many stories exist of heroes sailing there on Immrams - voyages that transcend the physical rules of the sea.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Saint Brigid's Cross - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Someone's been putting Saint Brigid..."
entries.text: Someone's been putting Saint Brigid's crosses around the manor, haven't they?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "So I have seen, but I am not sure w..."
entries.text: So I have seen, but I am not sure who.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I tried to ask the housekeeper, but..."
entries.text: I tried to ask the housekeeper, but she gave me the filthiest glare and rushed off.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I suspect that she'd rather die tha..."
entries.text: I suspect that she'd rather die than have anything to do with magic, ritual, or myself...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Ah, yes. That would be the housekee..."
entries.text: Ah, yes. That would be the housekeeper, Missus Joyce.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I tried to compliment her on them,..."
entries.text: I tried to compliment her on them, but she gave me the filthiest glare and rushed off.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Milesians - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you heard of the Milesians?"
entries.text: Have you heard of the Milesians?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The Irish. Or, what your ancestors..."
entries.text: The Irish. Or, what your ancestors were called. They were said to come from the Iberian Peninsula.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Itself populated thousands of years..."
entries.text: Itself populated thousands of years before when Homo sapiens left Africa.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "See, Mister Ward? We are practicall..."
entries.text: See, Mister Ward? We are practically cousins.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/soul jars - dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know anything about soul jar..."
entries.text: Do you know anything about soul jars, Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Well simply put, Mister Ward, they..."
entries.text: Well simply put, Mister Ward, they are as they sound.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "They're jars for storing souls - an..."
entries.text: They're jars for storing souls - and not something I'd see used beyond the most extreme of circumstances.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/gauge - dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Dupré, have you seen that od..."
entries.text: Mister Dupré, have you seen that odd machine in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Of course! It's a most wondrous thi..."
entries.text: Of course! It's a most wondrous thing. I don't have the faintest idea what it is, but it's very impressive.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/washer woman - dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Not I, but I believe there is a cre..."
entries.text: Not I, but I believe there is a creature here, a variant on the more well-known Beansidhe.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I witnessed a person washing clothe..."
entries.text: I witnessed a person washing clothes in the fountain when I arrived, and I am wondering if you experienced anything like this?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Instead of keening or singing to fo..."
entries.text: Instead of keening or singing to forewarn of death, this other creature washes the clothes of the doomed soul.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I think she is called the bean nigh..."
entries.text: I think she is called the bean nigh, or washer woman. I suspect there are entries on her in the library.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Missing Aspect Ritual

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can you tell me more about this rit..."
entries.text: Can you tell me more about this ritual, Mister Dupre?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "My goddess has three aspects - Mama..."
entries.text: My goddess has three aspects - Maman Brigitte, the goddess Bríd, and the Saint Brigid.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Mister Ward, you represent Bríd. I..."
entries.text: Mister Ward, you represent Bríd. I believe Laura chose you to play that part when she presented herself to you.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I would represent Maman Brigitte, n..."
entries.text: I would represent Maman Brigitte, naturally.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "To help Laura pass we need to bring..."
entries.text: To help Laura pass we need to bring them together, allowing me to combine their powers and release her from this place.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "And so we need one to represent the..."
entries.text: And so we need one to represent the final aspect - Saint Brigid...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "But who? Can you think of anyone wh..."
entries.text: But who? Can you think of anyone who would be willing to help me with this?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ivy - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have. She's a charming woman - re..."
entries.text: I have. She's a charming woman - reminds me of an old friend of mine.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Miss McLeod, I think, steps a littl..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod, I think, steps a little more carefully - but they have... had, I mean, a similar upbeat attitude.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It's been a pleasure to make her ac..."
entries.text: It's been a pleasure to make her acquaintance.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Varley - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken much to the manager..."
entries.text: Have you spoken much to the manager?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I wouldn't say much, but enough tha..."
entries.text: I wouldn't say much, but enough that I can say he seems like a decent fellow.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Lan Fen - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Missus Lau?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "A little. Though, she seems to keep..."
entries.text: A little. Though, she seems to keep company more with the scientific types. I spoke more to her friend, Miss McLeod.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Not that I mind - a lady is entitle..."
entries.text: Not that I mind - a lady is entitled to her choice of company, after all. Miss McLeod speaks very highly of her, too.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Skerritt - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "To him? No."
entries.text: To him? No.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "To men like him? Every day, back ho..."
entries.text: To men like him? Every day, back home.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Some people are so full of self-loa..."
entries.text: Some people are so full of self-loathing they can't keep it to themselves. It spills out and hits everyone around them.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Corentine - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Quinn?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have, but at least initially, I f..."
entries.text: I have, but at least initially, I felt it best to leave her to her own devices. There is... There is an air of death that follows her.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "As far as I can tell, she knows it...."
entries.text: As far as I can tell, she knows it. Indeed, I think that is why she is so preoccupied.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Happily, though, it seems she has m..."
entries.text: Happily, though, it seems she has made time to talk with me, and I'm glad - I do enjoy her company.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the housekeeper?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I certainly tried, my friend! I'm n..."
entries.text: I certainly tried, my friend! I'm not sure I've ever seen someone scurry away from me so fast.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I get the sense that the presence o..."
entries.text: I get the sense that the presence of all these practitioners, myself included, leaves her quite shaken.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Darragh - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the groundskeepe..."
entries.text: Have you spoken to the groundskeeper?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "He even gave me some recommendation..."
entries.text: He even gave me some recommendations as to where I could go if I wanted to do some walking.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The nearby town is too far, of cour..."
entries.text: The nearby town is too far, of course, but there are local forests, a brook, that sort of thing. He mentioned one fairy fort I will not be going near.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I haven't braved the rest, though...."
entries.text: I haven't braved the rest, though. Not in this weather.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have! He helped me find some good..."
entries.text: I have! He helped me find some good places inside and out of the grounds.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Seamus - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the porter, Mister Doy..."
entries.text: Have you met the porter, Mister Doyle?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Of course. He runs the bar in the e..."
entries.text: Of course. He runs the bar in the evenings, and I've enjoyed the odd drink there.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "He's not much company and seems unc..."
entries.text: He's not much company and seems uncomfortable taking tips, but he seems harmless enough.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ines - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Miss Barbosa?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Ah, that I have. She's an interesti..."
entries.text: Ah, that I have. She's an interesting woman. She said she's got some business in the country, apparently.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Though, you'd have to ask her for t..."
entries.text: Though, you'd have to ask her for the details. We ended up talking more about Ireland than our own affairs.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ettiene - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Toussaint?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I heard about him first - after tha..."
entries.text: I heard about him first - after that, meeting him was a little underwhelming.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "He was actually very pleasant when..."
entries.text: He was actually very pleasant when he spoke to me. So, either the rumours are exaggerated, or I got his better side.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Between you and me, I think it migh..."
entries.text: Between you and me, I think it might be the former. I certainly hope so. But my, he's ruffled some feathers.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Cathal - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister O'Meara?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have. I've heard it mentioned tha..."
entries.text: I have. I've heard it mentioned that his particular niche is speaking to angels.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I don't know about that, exactly......"
entries.text: I don't know about that, exactly... but, you know, somehow I get the feeling he's onto something, whatever it is.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Dupré - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Tell me about yourself, Mister Dupr..."
entries.text: Tell me about yourself, Mister Dupré.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Let's see. I run a funeral home bac..."
entries.text: Let's see. I run a funeral home back home in New Orleans, but I have come to Ireland to handle a personal matter.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have an interest in your mytholog..."
entries.text: I have an interest in your mythology and, well, Voodoo. It's not uncommon, back home but I know it scares outsiders.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "So an event that mixes both? How co..."
entries.text: So an event that mixes both? How could I not attend.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I wasn't expecting to end up at a t..."
entries.text: I wasn't expecting to end up at a thing like this while here, but when I learned of the event, it seemed like something I couldn't miss out on.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on D'Arcy - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Missus D'Arcy?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have indeed. She's a wonderfully..."
entries.text: I have indeed. She's a wonderfully sharp and dry woman.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Talking to her is a sparring match..."
entries.text: Talking to her is a sparring match and I enjoy that immensely.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Coventry - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken much to Mister Cove..."
entries.text: Have you spoken much to Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "He approached me with a question or..."
entries.text: He approached me with a question or two about the séance. I answered them as best I could.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "But they were... quite elementary,..."
entries.text: But they were... quite elementary, anyway. I wonder if he has any idea he's getting himself into.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Hazel - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have indeed! She wanted to know w..."
entries.text: I have indeed! She wanted to know what sort of... interest I had in all these supernatural affairs.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "And she had all sorts of questions..."
entries.text: And she had all sorts of questions once I told her.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She's from New York, she tells me,..."
entries.text: She's from New York, she tells me, and they prefer their séances, so we exchanged some notes, so to speak.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ruairí - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to spe..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to speak to Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have. He's quite agreeable, and I..."
entries.text: I have. He's quite agreeable, and I've certainly met my match in him as to the scholarship side of things.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Though my knowledge is purely acade..."
entries.text: Though my knowledge is purely academic, whereas his is lived and learned the hard way.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The poor boy deserves a great deal..."
entries.text: The poor boy deserves a great deal more confidence in himself.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Though with all the comparisons to..."
entries.text: Though with all the comparisons to his aunt, I'm not surprised that his pride has taken some hits.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Deane - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Deane?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I believe I have met everyone here."
entries.text: I believe I have met everyone here.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I don't know her particularly well..."
entries.text: I don't know her particularly well - everyone here is new to me - but I gather she is a powerful practitioner.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "And a woman with... complicated con..."
entries.text: And a woman with... complicated connections to many here. I suppose that is to be expected when one is at the top of one's game.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Carmela - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I made a point to, yes. Her work ha..."
entries.text: I made a point to, yes. Her work has brought her to America - I have not seen her, but I knew her name.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "There is a lot of similarities in w..."
entries.text: There is a lot of similarities in what we do - we each provide guidance to those faced with death - so the conversation was easy.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I'm interested to see her work here..."
entries.text: I'm interested to see her work here this weekend.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I only hope her health holds for it..."
entries.text: I only hope her health holds for it all...

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Miss Hisham?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with Miss Hisham?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have..."
entries.text: I have...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "..."

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...I found her outside my room hold..."
entries.text: ...I found her outside my room holding a friend's urn I have with me.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She was... almost feverish... She t..."
entries.text: She was... almost feverish... She thought it was some vase.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I had to wrestle it from her before..."
entries.text: I had to wrestle it from her before she opened it and spilt the ashes all over the corridor.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She settled once I had it but had n..."
entries.text: She settled once I had it but had no idea where she was or why.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Or how she got the thing from my ot..."
entries.text: Or how she got the thing from my otherwise locked room.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Sometimes I worry this place is goi..."
entries.text: Sometimes I worry this place is going to drive us all insane...

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Sinnott - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Father Sinnott?"
entries.text: Have you met Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I have. Many times in many places...."
entries.text: I have. Many times in many places. Though his face is never the same, his need to control and judge his fellow man is.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Some people are simply disposed to..."
entries.text: Some people are simply disposed to judge. And some of them call it holy.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Saoirse - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken with Miss Murphy?"
entries.text: Have you spoken with Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Oh, yes. She seems like a sweet gir..."
entries.text: Oh, yes. She seems like a sweet girl. Shy, perhaps...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...Though if I'm used to two things..."
entries.text: ...Though if I'm used to two things, Mister Ward, it's grief and distrust.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "That wall of hers smells more of th..."
entries.text: That wall of hers smells more of the former than the latter.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Blake - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met with the owner of the..."
entries.text: Have you met with the owner of the manor?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Marquess Blake? Indeed, I have. He..."
entries.text: Marquess Blake? Indeed, I have. He was perfectly cordial.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "But even so... in my line of work,..."
entries.text: But even so... in my line of work, you get a sense for grief. And that man has it in spades.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Walter Blake - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I hear the Marquess has a son."
entries.text: I hear the Marquess has a son.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "So I gather. He was in a carriage a..."
entries.text: So I gather. He was in a carriage accident, I think?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I don't mean to sound insensitive,..."
entries.text: I don't mean to sound insensitive, but I get a shiver down my spine anytime I realise he's watching me from his room.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It's not just the weather that keep..."
entries.text: It's not just the weather that keeps me from the gardens...

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Fiadh - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How do you feel about Miss Callagha..."
entries.text: How do you feel about Miss Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "A lovely woman! Certainly, it's peo..."
entries.text: A lovely woman! Certainly, it's people like her who make this event feel so worthwhile.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...Rather unfortunate, since I unde..."
entries.text: ...Rather unfortunate, since I understand she's quite against the whole thing.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on O'Finn - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Ó Finn?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "So rarely do you meet people whose..."
entries.text: So rarely do you meet people whose charms are matched by their honesty.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I could spend hours in his company,..."
entries.text: I could spend hours in his company, though I'd be lying if I said I understood every word he said.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/UPDATED Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "How have things been with Missus Jo..."
entries.text: How have things been with Missus Joyce?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Good, I believe! Before, I sensed o..."
entries.text: Good, I believe! Before, I sensed only a dam of fear from her - and now it's as if it's burst.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "There was a wellspring of curiosity..."
entries.text: There was a wellspring of curiosity behind it all, I think. I can barely keep up with her questions! Not that I mind.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I'm grateful, in fact. It is a tumu..."
entries.text: I'm grateful, in fact. It is a tumultuous time for both of us - me without Laura, her with the new uncertainty of her beliefs.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "In times like these, there's no bet..."
entries.text: In times like these, there's no better thing than a friend.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of oats and sugar - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I catch the scent of what I think m..."
entries.text: I catch the scent of what I think might be sugar from the groundsman.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "If it weren't for the clothes, I mi..."
entries.text: If it weren't for the clothes, I might mistake him for a baker.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Proud bearing - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss McLeod has quite a regal pose..."
entries.text: Miss McLeod has quite a regal pose about her.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She reminds me of someone in that....."
entries.text: She reminds me of someone in that... an old friend. Not a gentlewoman, but she held herself the same way.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Mourning cameo - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed the necklace Missu..."
entries.text: Have you noticed the necklace Missus Lau is wearing?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I understand it's a mourning tradit..."
entries.text: I understand it's a mourning tradition over here, is it not?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She must have lost someone..."
entries.text: She must have lost someone...

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Pen in pocket - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I haven't yet seen Miss Quinn witho..."
entries.text: I haven't yet seen Miss Quinn without that pen she keeps with her.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Well, you know how artistic types c..."
entries.text: Well, you know how artistic types can be!

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "While they do have their way about..."
entries.text: While they do have their way about them, I'm really only joking. She seems like a lovely woman. Completely without airs.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Mysterious crest - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know what the cres..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know what the crest Mister Skerritt is wearing is?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I can't say I do, although I think..."
entries.text: I can't say I do, although I think I might have seen it somewhere before...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Or perhaps not?"
entries.text: Or perhaps not?

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of whiskey - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you catch the scent of whiskey a..."
entries.text: Do you catch the scent of whiskey around Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Well, I wouldn't like to comment on..."
entries.text: Well, I wouldn't like to comment on it.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...But I don't believe you're imagi..."
entries.text: ...But I don't believe you're imagining it.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Ornamental cane - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: I cannot trust a man who carries a cane he doesn't need for walking.

entries.text: The housekeeper seems friendly.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: What do you make of Miss Barbosa's brooch?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: It looks like something she's had for a long time, I think. Perhaps even something someone else had before her.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.text: And for her to keep it all this time... it must mean something special to her.

entries.text: Does Mister O'Meara seem distracted to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The question is whether it's to do..."
entries.text: The question is whether it's to do with this séance, or Miss McLeod.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of how Mister O'Me..."
entries.text: What do you make of how Mister O'Meara is dressed?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "What do I make of it? Why, I'd say..."
entries.text: What do I make of it? Why, I'd say he's very well turned out.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "He might not have a lot of money, b..."
entries.text: He might not have a lot of money, but he's got a good eye.
