entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to recognise the cros..."
entries.text: Do you happen to recognise the cross Mister Doyle is wearing?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I'm sure I've seen its type before...."
entries.text: I'm sure I've seen its type before... but where, or what it meant, I can't remember.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Fine clothes and jewellery - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You know, Mister Dupré, I can't hel..."
entries.text: You know, Mister Dupré, I can't help but admire your clothing. It's quite fine.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Haha, why, thank you."
entries.text: Haha, why, thank you.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I run a funeral house back home. It..."
entries.text: I run a funeral house back home. It is not glamorous work, but it's more than worthwhile...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "And I'm lucky enough to do quite we..."
entries.text: And I'm lucky enough to do quite well for myself these days.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Friendly expression - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I must say, of all the guests here,..."
entries.text: I must say, of all the guests here, you're easily one of the most approachable.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Ah, well, there'd be little point i..."
entries.text: Ah, well, there'd be little point in attending this if I weren't going to socialise.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "There are such interesting people h..."
entries.text: There are such interesting people here, after all.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Curious tattoo - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That's an unusual tattoo; might I a..."
entries.text: That's an unusual tattoo; might I ask about it?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Oh, this? It's Maman Brigitte's Vev..."
entries.text: Oh, this? It's Maman Brigitte's Veve - her mark.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Consider it... a devotional symbol...."
entries.text: Consider it... a devotional symbol. I'm an oungan of hers... a priest as such.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She's our Loa of life and death - I..."
entries.text: She's our Loa of life and death - I suppose, your analogy to a Loa would be 'Saint'.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I guess the journey changed her, fo..."
entries.text: I guess the journey changed her, for want of a better way to explain it.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She is... born of your pagan goddes..."
entries.text: She is... born of your pagan goddess Brigid. Her believers... 'took' her with them when they fled to America.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Tan line - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems as if Missus D'Arcy has re..."
entries.text: It seems as if Missus D'Arcy has recently removed a ring...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It does - but it would be improper..."
entries.text: It does - but it would be improper of me to ask about it.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Large Brooch - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise the brooch Missus..."
entries.text: Do you recognise the brooch Missus D'Arcy is wearing?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It's the crest of some society, isn..."
entries.text: It's the crest of some society, isn't it? I haven't asked, and she herself hasn't offered the information, so I don't know for sure.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Ink stains - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know if Missus D'Arcy has be..."
entries.text: Do you know if Missus D'Arcy has been writing much recently?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Haha, I would expect all that ink t..."
entries.text: Haha, I would expect all that ink to be a permanent fixture.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "She tells me she's a writer, after..."
entries.text: She tells me she's a writer, after all.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of antiseptic - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you catch the scent of antisepti..."
entries.text: Do you catch the scent of antiseptic from Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Ah, I do. I know it's a little stra..."
entries.text: Ah, I do. I know it's a little strange, but I like it - it reminds me of my place back home.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Celtic cross - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed Doctor Callaghan's..."
entries.text: Have you noticed Doctor Callaghan's tie pin?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "It's a cross, isn't it? You see a n..."
entries.text: It's a cross, isn't it? You see a number of them, I'm not sure I took particular note of it.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Thoughtful expression - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Coventry seems to have somet..."
entries.text: Mister Coventry seems to have something on his mind.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I got that impression. I suppose it..."
entries.text: I got that impression. I suppose it will have something to do with the séance.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "We're, potentially, about to be fac..."
entries.text: We're, potentially, about to be faced with answers to some very grand questions.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "To be distracted is quite understan..."
entries.text: To be distracted is quite understandable.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Musty scent - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Coventry's cologne is... str..."
entries.text: Mister Coventry's cologne is... strong.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Yes, I find it is best used to... s..."
entries.text: Yes, I find it is best used to... subtler effect.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Tense body language - Dupré

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Does Missus Erickson seem tense to..."
entries.text: Does Missus Erickson seem tense to you?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Yes. Though a house full of ghosts..."
entries.text: Yes. Though a house full of ghosts is not a very relaxing environment to most people, so I can't blame her.

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Ward in room - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "What's this? I don't recall invitin..."
entries.text: What's this? I don't recall inviting you here, Mister Ward...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I think you can tell me why you hav..."
entries.text: I think you can tell me why you have a key to my room on our way to see the manager...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "What's this? I don't recall invitin..."
entries.text: What's this? I don't recall inviting you here, Sir...

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Hello there, friend. I don't believ..."
entries.text: Hello there, friend. I don't believe we've met?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Hello again, my friend."
entries.text: Hello again, my friend.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "We've not. My name is Declan Ward."
entries.text: We've not. My name is Declan Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Lloyd Dupré. I presume you've just..."
entries.text: Lloyd Dupré. I presume you've just arrived, correct? I've been here two weeks now, and I think I've met every other guest a few times over!

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Correct. New Orleans, to be exact,..."
entries.text: Correct. New Orleans, to be exact, where I am a funeral director. And let me tell you, I am in no rush to make the journey again. It took all of eleven weeks with the storms.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Incredible. This séance must truly..."
entries.text: Incredible. This séance must truly be a special affair for you to travel so far.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Yes and no. As interested in the sé..."
entries.text: Yes and no. As interested in the séance as I am, it would have been hard to justify the journey for it alone.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've taken enough of your time."
entries.text: I've taken enough of your time.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Not at all, Mister Ward – but I won..."
entries.text: Not at all, Mister Ward – but I won't keep you.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Indeed, I have. And, if I'm not mis..."
entries.text: Indeed, I have. And, if I'm not mishearing your voice, I take it you're here all the way from America?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "No, I have some personal business t..."
entries.text: No, I have some personal business to attend to here - joyous as it's been to fascinate myself with your mythology and your spirits.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Are you telling me that this blight..."
entries.text: Are you telling me that this blighted place has taken my dearest friend captive!?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "She's not lost yet, Mister Dupré. N..."
entries.text: She's not lost yet, Mister Dupré. Not... entirely.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Oh, sweet... Damnation. This is my..."
entries.text: Oh, sweet... Damnation. This is my fault. All of it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "She communicated a message to me. "..."
entries.text: She communicated a message to me. "Help me or I'll be trapped here forever."

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I was foolish - selfish - enough to..."
entries.text: I was foolish - selfish - enough to want one last adventure together. I should have laid her to rest before coming to this place.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There is still time, Mister Dupré...."
entries.text: There is still time, Mister Dupré. At least, that is what I think she's trying to tell us.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...You are right, of course. I'll h..."
entries.text: ...You are right, of course. I'll have years without her for my self-pity.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "There is a ritual. I do not know if..."
entries.text: There is a ritual. I do not know if it will work, far as we are from Maman's reach, but we must try.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I'm sorry, Laura. I hope you'll for..."
entries.text: I'm sorry, Laura. I hope you'll forgive an old friend his folly...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Are... Are you telling me that you..."
entries.text: Are... Are you telling me that you found her?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It might be, Mister Dupré. I suspec..."
entries.text: It might be, Mister Dupré. I suspect the spirit of your friend is haunting the fire pit in the hedge maze.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...Of course. Of course, it was her..."
entries.text: ...Of course. Of course, it was her in the hedge maze. I knew I felt her presence there. But why couldn't I see her, reach out to her. How did I lose her?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Is that why I couldn't see her in t..."
entries.text: Is that why I couldn't see her in the hedge maze? She is lost to me...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Laura, yes? I believe I met her spi..."
entries.text: Laura, yes? I believe I met her spirit at the fire pit.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I was foolish - selfish - enough to..."
entries.text: I was foolish - selfish - enough to want one last adventure together. I should have laid her to rest before coming to this place.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "There is a ritual. I do not know if..."
entries.text: There is a ritual. I do not know if it will work, far as we are from Maman's reach, but we must try.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I'm sorry, Laura. I hope you'll for..."
entries.text: I'm sorry, Laura. I hope you'll forgive an old friend his folly...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Oh, sweet... Damnation. Maman, how..."
entries.text: Oh, sweet... Damnation. Maman, how could I keep the company of such dark thoughts?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I didn't do it - I could never! It..."
entries.text: I didn't do it - I could never! It goes against everything that I- that we...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Then take heart, Mister Dupré. You..."
entries.text: Then take heart, Mister Dupré. You haven't acted yet. But I must ask you as a matter of urgency - are these thoughts your own?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I- I don't know. I've felt a heavin..."
entries.text: I- I don't know. I've felt a heaviness here these past few days. Something in this place that feeds on grief... drives obsession.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "The moment you spoke, it felt as if..."
entries.text: The moment you spoke, it felt as if you'd broken a spell... But I'm worried - terrified, that it could return just as suddenly.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Then we must act quickly. Have you..."
entries.text: Then we must act quickly. Have you any idea how we might break this hold on you?

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "I... Oh, Mister Ward! I must lay my..."
entries.text: I... Oh, Mister Ward! I must lay my friend to rest! I should never have delayed it to begin with...

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "You... you saw her? I thought I fel..."
entries.text: You... you saw her? I thought I felt something there. And yet - she's been taken from my sight... Ha.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There is still time, Mister Dupré."
entries.text: There is still time, Mister Dupré.

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "...Yes, you are right. Of course, t..."
entries.text: ...Yes, you are right. Of course, there is!

entries.speaker: Mister Dupré
entries.label: Dupré: "Though I didn't expect to find myse..."
entries.text: Though I didn't expect to find myself here for quite so many days...

title: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Post Quest - Dupre

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I would give anything to speak to E..."
entries.text: I would give anything to speak to Eamonn again, to apologise…

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "But to summon his spirit in flames?"
entries.text: But to summon his spirit in flames?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can see the comfort it brought to..."
entries.text: I can see the comfort it brought to Mister Dupré.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It would be so easy to see you agai..."
entries.text: It would be so easy to see you again, but I don’t think I have it in me to call you here this way…

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I’ve dragged you through fire befor..."
entries.text: I’ve dragged you through fire before. Never again.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Could I trouble you for a moment mo..."
entries.text: Could I trouble you for a moment more?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hello, Mister Ward. How's the day t..."
entries.text: Hello, Mister Ward. How's the day treating you?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "You can. Is there something I can d..."
entries.text: You can. Is there something I can do for you?

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "LEAVE"
entries.text: LEAVE

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll leave you be."
entries.text: I'll leave you be.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Farewell."
entries.text: Farewell.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "If you'd hold a moment… I'm just lo..."
entries.text: If you'd hold a moment… I'm just looking for something...

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "You figured that out, did you? Why..."
entries.text: You figured that out, did you? Why I'm nose-deep in all these godforsaken books?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "You're right, of course. I will - w..."
entries.text: You're right, of course. I will - well, you have a look about you that says I don't have to plead the veracity of my case. Is that right...? Thank God.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "That's what all my work is about. I..."
entries.text: That's what all my work is about. I'm trying to lift the curse before it kills the last of us - but, just our luck, I've reached a dead end.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "After everything, all this work, al..."
entries.text: After everything, all this work, all this death, it couldn't just be simple. God forbid! God forbid I actually manage it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I have it, you know, the name of th..."
entries.text: I have it, you know, the name of the woman who cursed my family - 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor. And if I could only speak to her, I might be able to appease her.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But there are too many spirits with..."
entries.text: But there are too many spirits with her name. And without some item from her, I just cannot reach her. And I can't see what else I could do about it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I will keep trying, of course. But..."
entries.text: I will keep trying, of course. But I think my fate is sealed. Mine, and my little sisters'. We'll all die like the rest of my family because of the cruelty of my ancestors.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Bastards, all of them."
entries.text: Bastards, all of them.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "... And that's that. What else is t..."
entries.text: ... And that's that. What else is there to say about it? I just - I don't want to talk about this any longer.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Without it, I - without it, damn it..."
entries.text: Without it, I - without it, damn it, I'm at a dead end.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Fine, fine - just looking for a boo..."
entries.text: Fine, fine - just looking for a book. I know I had it just a few days ago, but now it's nowhere to be found.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you alright, Miss?"
entries.text: Are you alright, Miss?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Would you tell me if you see it? It..."
entries.text: Would you tell me if you see it? It's a book on local land records from late last century. It has to be around here somewhere - unless... another guest has taken it? Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'll see what I can do."
entries.text: I'll see what I can do.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ GIVE THE RECORDS BOOK ]"
entries.text: [ GIVE THE RECORDS BOOK ]

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "[ KEEP THE RECORDS BOOK ]"
entries.text: [ KEEP THE RECORDS BOOK ]

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Fine, fine - just looking for a boo..."
entries.text: Fine, fine - just looking for a book. I thought maybe I left it here when I last had it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But - look, take this. If you find..."
entries.text: But - look, take this. If you find anything to do with it all, tell me, would you? God knows there's nothing else for it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "With the ritual complete, am I to u..."
entries.text: With the ritual complete, am I to understand that the Quinn family is free of their curse?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I've instructed my solicitor to tra..."
entries.text: I've instructed my solicitor to transfer all the deeds to Miss Barbosa. If 'Biddy' O'Connor keeps her word... yes, I think it's done.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Finally. Finally."
entries.text: Finally. Finally.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "If I might ask... will you and your..."
entries.text: If I might ask... will you and your family be alright? Losing that much land and the money from it must mean you're losing most of your assets.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Oh, almost everything - we will be..."
entries.text: Oh, almost everything - we will be significantly poorer, there's no doubt about that. It will not be easy.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But I have some renown as a poet. I..."
entries.text: But I have some renown as a poet. I'll find the money for my sisters' dowries that way, and I will work for my living.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "We are going to be okay. I will see..."
entries.text: We are going to be okay. I will see to it. I got us this far. And I suppose you did too, in the end - so thank you, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "No, none of it will be easy. But it..."
entries.text: No, none of it will be easy. But it will be worth it. After all - for the first time in my life, I have a future.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "How does she feel having lifted the..."
entries.text: How does she feel having lifted the curse?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "What? Listen, Sir, I don't want to...."
entries.text: What? Listen, Sir, I don't want to... Unless you have that book, I am afraid I just don't have time to talk...

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Research book - Corentine

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Wait, you - hah! Look at that, you..."
entries.text: Wait, you - hah! Look at that, you do indeed. Where was it?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But for now... Thank you, sincerely..."
entries.text: But for now... Thank you, sincerely - and do please excuse me. I have work to do.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Page seventy-eight, and... That's w..."
entries.text: Page seventy-eight, and... That's what I was looking for.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Anyhow - I'm pleased to meet you, M..."
entries.text: Anyhow - I'm pleased to meet you, Mister Ward. My name is Corentine Quinn. You can call me Corentine, and I might, now, owe you a favour.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't think... I haven't seen you..."
entries.text: I don't think... I haven't seen you before the incident with the bird. Unless I'm wrong...?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Rest assured, Miss, we haven't met...."
entries.text: Rest assured, Miss, we haven't met. My name's Declan Ward - I've only arrived recently.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Even then, I could still have misse..."
entries.text: Even then, I could still have missed you. If you hadn't come by the library, I mean.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Actually, I believe I might have th..."
entries.text: Actually, I believe I might have the records you are looking for.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Barbosa had it."
entries.text: Miss Barbosa had it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Of course! I loaned it to her durin..."
entries.text: Of course! I loaned it to her during tea and then forgot - too many late nights researching. Speaking of which...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Thank you, Sir, you've helped me a..."
entries.text: Thank you, Sir, you've helped me a lot. I-I don't know why you would, but you have.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "...How did she get it--"
entries.text: ...How did she get it--

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Photograph of Deane - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you recognise this woman, Miss?"
entries.text: Do you recognise this woman, Miss?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "... That's Evelyn Deane."
entries.text: ... That's Evelyn Deane.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She was around here a few days ago,..."
entries.text: She was around here a few days ago, though where she's gone now, I don't know.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know her?"
entries.text: Do you know her?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "We were friends, once... at least w..."
entries.text: We were friends, once... at least while I was useful to her. I am not anymore. We don't talk.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm... sorry to hear that, Miss."
entries.text: I'm... sorry to hear that, Miss.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Well, it's not your fault."
entries.text: Well, it's not your fault.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But that photograph, it is Evelyn D..."
entries.text: But that photograph, it is Evelyn Deane, and it can't be very old.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Map of the Region - Corentine

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It's a local map... Ah, but mostly..."
entries.text: It's a local map... Ah, but mostly geographical.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "This isn't mine, if that's what you..."
entries.text: This isn't mine, if that's what you're getting at. It could be from the library...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "They've quite their fair share."
entries.text: They've quite their fair share.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Séance Flyer -  Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you really come all this way fo..."
entries.text: Did you really come all this way for this event?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Well... It's a touch more complicat..."
entries.text: Well... It's a touch more complicated than that. But, yes, essentially.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are there not séances in London?"
entries.text: Are there not séances in London?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Plenty. The draw of this one is the..."
entries.text: Plenty. The draw of this one is the timing, the location, and the medium.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Halloween is when the veil between..."
entries.text: Halloween is when the veil between the living and the dead is lowered, the manor is already haunted...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "...and Carmela Mantovani is reputed..."
entries.text: ...and Carmela Mantovani is reputed to be among the best of her sort.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you suppose the séance will work..."
entries.text: Do you suppose the séance will work?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Mm. Well, yes and no. Or rather, ye..."
entries.text: Mm. Well, yes and no. Or rather, yes and maybe.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't think they'll have any trou..."
entries.text: I don't think they'll have any trouble finding a ghost to contact. There are plenty. They might even find a coherent one.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But as for getting any sort of real..."
entries.text: But as for getting any sort of real answer from it? I don't know.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "What brings her to the Grand Séance..."
entries.text: What brings her to the Grand Séance?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can I ask what brings you to this s..."
entries.text: Can I ask what brings you to this séance, Miss?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "What is the broaching of the veil o..."
entries.text: What is the broaching of the veil of life and death not enough for you? You expect me to be here for some other reason?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Is it an afterthought to you to spe..."
entries.text: Is it an afterthought to you to speak a question into the great beyond and finally hear something back?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Well, I..."
entries.text: Well, I...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Don't fret, I'm making fun. I'm not..."
entries.text: Don't fret, I'm making fun. I'm not here for the Grand Séance as it is advertised, as it happens...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But that is my concern, and a long..."
entries.text: But that is my concern, and a long story... and one I do not want to subject either of us to.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Besides, the Grand Séance really sh..."
entries.text: Besides, the Grand Séance really should be spectacle enough. I would prepare yourself if you are not already prepared.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Besides. My family are from this ar..."
entries.text: Besides. My family are from this area and we have holdings here. I can do some work while here. Important work.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Deane's Signature - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I noticed Miss Deane signed into th..."
entries.text: I noticed Miss Deane signed into the hotel just before you did. Did you travel together?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'd rather not give Evelyn any more..."
entries.text: I'd rather not give Evelyn any more of my time, if it's all the same to you, Mister Ward.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Marriage talk - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you attend many events like this..."
entries.text: Do you attend many events like this, Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Some. I'm not a stranger to them, a..."
entries.text: Some. I'm not a stranger to them, anyway. How come?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I overheard a conversation about so..."
entries.text: I overheard a conversation about someone looking to find a suitor here. I wonder if she's likely to have any success at an event like this...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "A social event is a social event, I..."
entries.text: A social event is a social event, I suppose. And while I'm supposing... would this be about Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Well, she's got spirit, looking for..."
entries.text: Well, she's got spirit, looking for a suitor in a place like this. I hope she has luck with it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Miss Quinn's research - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can I ask what it is you're working..."
entries.text: Can I ask what it is you're working on, Miss?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Oh. Yes, it's... How would I explai..."
entries.text: Oh. Yes, it's... How would I explain... It's ancestral, I suppose.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'm looking for what I can about th..."
entries.text: I'm looking for what I can about the Quinn family while they were still in Ireland. They lived somewhere around here.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did your family leave Ireland a lon..."
entries.text: Did your family leave Ireland a long time ago?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "No. I'm of the first generation to..."
entries.text: No. I'm of the first generation to be born in England - but it appears my forefathers and mothers buried everything they could.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And that's... that's where the trou..."
entries.text: And that's... that's where the trouble lies. ...So, the Quinn's history in Ireland. The land they owned... That's what I'm researching, more briefly.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Blake Family Portraits - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed the portraits of t..."
entries.text: Have you noticed the portraits of the family?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "There's a lot of them, aren't there..."
entries.text: There's a lot of them, aren't there? And only Jonathan Blake to meet.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I suppose most of the family are de..."
entries.text: I suppose most of the family are dead.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...That's a morbid observation, Mis..."
entries.text: ...That's a morbid observation, Miss.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I suppose it is. But I imagine I'm..."
entries.text: I suppose it is. But I imagine I'm right.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Staff say Miss Deane left - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "According to the staff, Miss Deane..."
entries.text: According to the staff, Miss Deane left some days ago.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Is that so? I thought I hadn't seen..."
entries.text: Is that so? I thought I hadn't seen her.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "That's strange. I wouldn't have exp..."
entries.text: That's strange. I wouldn't have expected it of her.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "...I wonder what invitation she's f..."
entries.text: ...I wonder what invitation she's found for herself.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Ghosts - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "This might sound strange... but I'v..."
entries.text: This might sound strange... but I've had some improbable encounters around the manor.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to have... seen anyth..."
entries.text: Do you happen to have... seen anything unnatural yourself?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "If you mean the ghosts, then yes, I..."
entries.text: If you mean the ghosts, then yes, I've seen them. This whole house has death strewn about it with the same regularity as furniture.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "You're not used to such a tangible..."
entries.text: You're not used to such a tangible supernatural presence, are you?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you?"
entries.text: Are you?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "In my own way. As such, I'll commen..."
entries.text: In my own way. As such, I'll commend you on your bravery. For a first supernatural experience, it's quite the introduction.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "The ghosts are very vivid. Nobody I..."
entries.text: The ghosts are very vivid. Nobody I know, though, not that I've seen. They're probably the poor souls who have died here.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/The Séance's purpose - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you suppose the séance will work..."
entries.text: Do you suppose the séance will work?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Mm. Well, yes and no. Or rather, ye..."
entries.text: Mm. Well, yes and no. Or rather, yes and maybe.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't think they'll have any trou..."
entries.text: I don't think they'll have any trouble finding a ghost to contact. There are plenty. They might even find a coherent one.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But as for getting any sort of real..."
entries.text: But as for getting any sort of real answer from it? I don't know.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Deane's leaving letter - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It appears Miss Deane left a few da..."
entries.text: It appears Miss Deane left a few days ago. She left a letter.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Well, she can go wherever suits her..."
entries.text: Well, she can go wherever suits her.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Although I can't say I'm not a litt..."
entries.text: Although I can't say I'm not a little relieved.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Another Blake - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You've spent time in London, haven'..."
entries.text: You've spent time in London, haven't you, Miss?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "My fair share, yes. Why do you ask?"
entries.text: My fair share, yes. Why do you ask?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I've heard it mentioned that people..."
entries.text: I've heard it mentioned that people have met another Blake during their time in London, I was wondering if you had, too.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Well, it's not an uncommon name. I'..."
entries.text: Well, it's not an uncommon name. I've probably met a Blake.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But no one comes to mind. And if th..."
entries.text: But no one comes to mind. And if they were of this family, they'd probably have been introduced to me. So, no. I don't think so.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/The Freemasons - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you heard of the Freemasons be..."
entries.text: Have you heard of the Freemasons before?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "The Freemasons? In passing. Somethi..."
entries.text: The Freemasons? In passing. Something about the secrets of the universe...?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I get the sense you don't think muc..."
entries.text: I get the sense you don't think much of them.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hah! No, I don't. Take Miss McLeod,..."
entries.text: Hah! No, I don't. Take Miss McLeod, or, if you prefer, Miss Mantovani.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Both of them have astonishing skill..."
entries.text: Both of them have astonishing skill, but the Freemasons wouldn't allow them entry, because they're of the fairer sex.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Now, of course, a supernatural pers..."
entries.text: Now, of course, a supernatural persuasion is not only a woman's game... But why shoot yourself in the foot so?

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Cigar burns beside chair - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You're spending a lot of time in th..."
entries.text: You're spending a lot of time in the library, aren't you?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Don't go and tell me I ought to get..."
entries.text: Don't go and tell me I ought to get some fresh air, Mister Ward. I haven't the time.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Nothing like that. I was just wonde..."
entries.text: Nothing like that. I was just wondering if you knew where the burns came from. On the armchair, I mean.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Ah, I do. Mister Skerritt enjoyed a..."
entries.text: Ah, I do. Mister Skerritt enjoyed a cigar in that chair the other night... He was to join us in a game of bridge, but he fell asleep after a drink too many.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He's lucky it didn't do worse. I to..."
entries.text: He's lucky it didn't do worse. I tossed it in the ashtray before it could catch. I'm not sure he ever noticed.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And then the long-suffering Doctor..."
entries.text: And then the long-suffering Doctor Callaghan was roped in to replace him, though I don't think he actually minded too terribly.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Second Sight - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss McLeod?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I have. I like her, she's got spiri..."
entries.text: I have. I like her, she's got spirit. Charming, too.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Has she spoken to you about her abi..."
entries.text: Has she spoken to you about her ability?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Her Second Sight? She mentioned it."
entries.text: Her Second Sight? She mentioned it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You sound like you know something a..."
entries.text: You sound like you know something about it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Not as much as she would, naturally..."
entries.text: Not as much as she would, naturally, but I've read about it. It's an ability found among Scottish natives - at least as they define it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Other places have their equivalents..."
entries.text: Other places have their equivalents, but whether they're the same... Well, I don't think they are, but there would be those to disagree with me.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Anyhow. It's fascinating, and... un..."
entries.text: Anyhow. It's fascinating, and... unfortunate. I can only wish her luck and strength with the whole thing.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What makes you call it unfortunate?"
entries.text: What makes you call it unfortunate?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "There's a gift, there, Mister Ward,..."
entries.text: There's a gift, there, Mister Ward, and a very heavy burden.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Has Miss McLeod spoken to you about..."
entries.text: Has Miss McLeod spoken to you about her ability?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Her Second Sight? She mentioned it."
entries.text: Her Second Sight? She mentioned it.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You sound like you know something a..."
entries.text: You sound like you know something about it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Not as much as she would, naturally..."
entries.text: Not as much as she would, naturally, but I've read about it. Foreknowledge, or even visions... It's supposed to be passed down in bloodlines.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It's fascinating, and... unfortunat..."
entries.text: It's fascinating, and... unfortunate. I can only wish her luck and strength with the whole thing.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What makes you call it unfortunate?"
entries.text: What makes you call it unfortunate?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "There's a gift, there, Mister Ward,..."
entries.text: There's a gift, there, Mister Ward, and a heavy burden to outweigh it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Regional research - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can I ask you what you're working o..."
entries.text: Can I ask you what you're working on, Miss?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hm? Oh. Right, yes. I'm, ah... rese..."
entries.text: Hm? Oh. Right, yes. I'm, ah... researching my family, I suppose.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "The Quinn family lived around here..."
entries.text: The Quinn family lived around here not that long ago... I am... interested in the land they used to own.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And who lived on it. I did not expe..."
entries.text: And who lived on it. I did not expect it to prove so difficult.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Ritual markings - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found evidence of some sort of ri..."
entries.text: I found evidence of some sort of ritual upstairs.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Mm... Hm? Someone's performing ritu..."
entries.text: Mm... Hm? Someone's performing rituals? And alone, here? Do you know what sort?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I couldn't say, Miss."
entries.text: I couldn't say, Miss.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "That's strange... You'd think, with..."
entries.text: That's strange... You'd think, with half a dozen practitioners in the building, a ritual would be something of a social affair.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I suppose the practitioner didn't w..."
entries.text: I suppose the practitioner didn't want to share the details? Can't blame them, I suppose...

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Cathal saw Deane - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister O'Meara said he saw Miss Dea..."
entries.text: Mister O'Meara said he saw Miss Deane late on Tuesday night, and that she might have been drunk at that.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "While I can't bring myself to wish..."
entries.text: While I can't bring myself to wish her any real harm, and so, I suppose, hope she's alright...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't wish to hear any more about..."
entries.text: I don't wish to hear any more about Evelyn Deane, if it's all the same to yourself.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Bedroom skeleton key  - Corentine

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Christ alive, Ward, what can you wa..."
entries.text: Christ alive, Ward, what can you want with that? Turn it over to the staff!

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Strange occurences

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you noticed anything strange g..."
entries.text: Have you noticed anything strange going on in this place?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "We are in a haunted house, Sir. Of..."
entries.text: We are in a haunted house, Sir. Of course it has strange goings on.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "For example... Last night, when I w..."
entries.text: For example... Last night, when I was dressing for bed, I noticed that a panel of the wallpaper in my room was falling down.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And this morning... it simply wasn'..."
entries.text: And this morning... it simply wasn't, anymore. It was the same wallpaper, but it looked as if someone had fixed it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Not the most spine-chilling of even..."
entries.text: Not the most spine-chilling of events, but inexplicable and something I might have found unsettling a lifetime ago.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Statement, Mister Doyle - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Doyle tells me that he heard..."
entries.text: Mister Doyle tells me that he heard Miss Deane arguing with someone late on Tuesday.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It would not be the first time Evel..."
entries.text: It would not be the first time Evelyn found herself an argument.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I... agh, Mister Ward, I do not wis..."
entries.text: I... agh, Mister Ward, I do not wish to dwell on her disagreements. I know them well enough for myself.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Mysterious figure - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Coming back to the house from the g..."
entries.text: Coming back to the house from the garden, I thought I saw someone in the window. Have you... seen anything like that?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Ah, good. I thought I was starting..."
entries.text: Ah, good. I thought I was starting to see things.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "If you saw it too, then that either..."

entries.text: But, talk or not, I have no cause to give Marquess Blake more opportunity to look like he suffers for my presence, so I will miss his.

entries.text: Miss Mantovani’s, Mister Dupré’s, and Missus and Doctor Callaghan’s, I would all like to attend. I'll see which I can manage.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Journal Entry about Miss Quinn - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I gather you and Miss Deane had a f..."
entries.text: I gather you and Miss Deane had a falling out of sorts?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hmmm."
entries.text: Hmmm.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I do not make friends easily, Miste..."
entries.text: I do not make friends easily, Mister Ward. I have a great deal of responsibilities and I am left with little time for socialising.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Evelyn came to me for help decipher..."
entries.text: Evelyn came to me for help deciphering a grimoire - an ancient tome of spells - that being my speciality.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I suppose that is a way to describe..."
entries.text: I suppose that is a way to describe it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I liked her. She was curious and sh..."
entries.text: I liked her. She was curious and sharp. And she was exciting to be around. Chaotic, which was a nice break from how ordered the rest of my life was.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "We fast became friends."
entries.text: We fast became friends.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Then one of her friends in the orde..."
entries.text: Then one of her friends in the order showed up with a Sufi who had, or claimed to have, an original copy of The Picatrix, with annotations not copied into later editions.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She had to see it, of course. And a..."
entries.text: She had to see it, of course. And all she needed to do was to steal them some of my books as payment.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "To stop me coming after her, I supp..."
entries.text: To stop me coming after her, I suppose. I couldn't, though. I was heartbroken. I washed my hands of it all and returned to my work.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I would have been wiser to stick to..."
entries.text: I would have been wiser to stick to my books in the first place.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And denounce me publically too, tho..."
entries.text: And denounce me publically too, though I still don't understand the why of that.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Fetters - Corentine

entries.text: What do you know about the concept of fetters?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "You mean as in those of ghosts? Of..."
entries.text: You mean as in those of ghosts? Of course, you do - nobody ever comes to me for a reasonable conversation.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And for good reason, because I know..."
entries.text: And for good reason, because I know a fair amount about fetters, naturally.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "They are the ties that bind, if you..."
entries.text: They are the ties that bind, if you will. Something of such emotional significance to a soul, for whatever reason, that they cannot leave it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Thus, their reason for remaining in..."
entries.text: Thus, their reason for remaining in our world, against their will or otherwise.

entries.text: I wonder what the Marquess thinks about that. Or perhaps I won't, and I'll just thank the tolerance required of hospitality.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Catholic Faith - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about Catholicism?"
entries.text: What do you know about Catholicism?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hm? Well, it's an older form of Chr..."
entries.text: Hm? Well, it's an older form of Christianity than its counterpart, one occasionally - and controversially -deemed akin to polytheism.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "What else? There's more ritual - th..."
entries.text: What else? There's more ritual - they believe in transubstantiation, which is quite the concept.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't think it's equivalent mysel..."
entries.text: I don't think it's equivalent myself, mind you. It's just been argued. People do love to argue.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But as you might have gathered, I a..."
entries.text: But as you might have gathered, I am not Catholic, nor especially godly, so I am perhaps not the person to ask if you want a comprehensive answer.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Protestant Faith - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about the Protesta..."
entries.text: What do you know about the Protestant faith?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Oh, you know - the Lord's Prayer, S..."
entries.text: Oh, you know - the Lord's Prayer, Sunday service, a passage of scripture here and there... everything you'd expect a person in the church to know.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But my faith is mostly a matter of..."
entries.text: But my faith is mostly a matter of tradition and culture. I don't put an awful lot of stock in it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It's a curious idea, and perhaps a..."
entries.text: It's a curious idea, and perhaps a nice one, but not something I'd stake all hope in.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Ettiene's Influence - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "If I've gathered correctly, it seem..."
entries.text: If I've gathered correctly, it seems Mister Toussaint is quite influential.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Naturally. He's faced more than one..."
entries.text: Naturally. He's faced more than one charlatan with their lies. And it's always absolutely beautifully worded.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You don't seem even slightly intimi..."
entries.text: You don't seem even slightly intimidated by him.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Well, for one thing, he's a very pl..."
entries.text: Well, for one thing, he's a very pleasant man. And for another, he and I both know I'm genuine.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'm not interested in showmanship a..."
entries.text: I'm not interested in showmanship and splendour. I'm a scholar. If I were a charlatan, I'd be a very poor one.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'm not making any money or finding..."
entries.text: I'm not making any money or finding any glory spending my time in these books, you know.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Strange dream - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I had the strangest dream on coming..."
entries.text: I had the strangest dream on coming here, of a long corridor somewhere in this place, and lots of locked doors.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "The doors at regular increments dow..."
entries.text: The doors at regular increments down it?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You've experienced it then?"
entries.text: You've experienced it then?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I... No. I wouldn't worry too much..."
entries.text: I... No. I wouldn't worry too much about it. I think an unsettling dream or two is about the least of your worries in a place like this.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Ritual complete

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "With the ritual complete, am I to u..."
entries.text: With the ritual complete, am I to understand that the Quinn family is free of their curse?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I've instructed my solicitor to tra..."
entries.text: I've instructed my solicitor to transfer all the deeds to Miss Barbosa. If 'Biddy' O'Connor keeps her word... yes, I think it's done.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Finally. Finally."
entries.text: Finally. Finally.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "If I might ask... will you and your..."
entries.text: If I might ask... will you and your family be alright? Losing that much land and the money from it must mean you're losing most of your assets.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Oh, almost everything - we will be..."
entries.text: Oh, almost everything - we will be significantly poorer, there's no doubt about that. It will not be easy.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But I have some renown as a poet. I..."
entries.text: But I have some renown as a poet. I'll find the money for my sisters' dowries that way, and I will work for my living.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "We are going to be okay. I will see..."
entries.text: We are going to be okay. I will see to it. I got us this far. And after all... For the first time in our lives, we have a future to plan for.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Hedonistic Gala - Corentine
