entries.text: Nor I.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I never expected Marquess Blake wou..."
entries.text: I never expected Marquess Blake would be the sort to allow such a thing.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Maybe I'm not as good a judge of ch..."
entries.text: Maybe I'm not as good a judge of character as I thought...

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Unknown Sigil - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I keep seeing some sort of... sigil..."
entries.text: I keep seeing some sort of... sigil. A spiral with four lines intersecting it. Have you seen anything of the sort?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Nothing with a spiral comes to mind..."
entries.text: Nothing with a spiral comes to mind... which means, if my memory serves me, it won't be alchemical, or Latin.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "So perhaps you could rule those out..."
entries.text: So perhaps you could rule those out of your search.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Memento Mori - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Are you the sort to keep death mome..."
entries.text: Are you the sort to keep death momentos, Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "At a certain point, it's all you ca..."
entries.text: At a certain point, it's all you can do...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I have many. I keep my brother, Ale..."
entries.text: I have many. I keep my brother, Alexander, particularly close. He didn't die long ago. ...I miss him terribly.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Summoning Ritual - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "So, Miss Quinn. A summoning ritual,..."
entries.text: So, Miss Quinn. A summoning ritual, is it?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Accidentally found yourself in the..."
entries.text: Accidentally found yourself in the ladies' bathroom, did you?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hmmm..."
entries.text: Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'm so close, but yet..."
entries.text: I'm so close, but yet...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I should have cleaned up, of course..."
entries.text: I should have cleaned up, of course.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'm just so... bloody frustrated. I..."
entries.text: I'm just so... bloody frustrated. I need a moment.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Anyway, you need not concern yourse..."
entries.text: Anyway, you need not concern yourself. I will clean my components before another... lost soul finds it...

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/O'Connor Crest - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "It seems the O'Connor family crest..."
entries.text: It seems the O'Connor family crest has a tree in the centre.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I think I knew that, but it was nev..."
entries.text: I think I knew that, but it was never very useful to me.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "That does ring a bell, though..."
entries.text: That does ring a bell, though...

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/O'Connor Research - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You've done some quite extensive re..."
entries.text: You've done some quite extensive research on the O'Connors, Miss Quinn.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Well, yes. This is not something I..."
entries.text: Well, yes. This is not something I am doing by halves, after all. There's just about every record I could possibly need in those papers.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Plus a lot of magical notes. You ca..."
entries.text: Plus a lot of magical notes. You can probably ignore those - that bit I have sorted out. They're mostly in a shorthand, anyway.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found drawings of this symbol aro..."
entries.text: I found drawings of this symbol around the place - do you recognise it?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hm. No, if it's magical, it's not m..."
entries.text: Hm. No, if it's magical, it's not my field.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Curse - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I hear tell your family is supposed..."
entries.text: I hear tell your family is supposedly cursed?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'd ask why you'd dwell on such a t..."
entries.text: I'd ask why you'd dwell on such a thing - but terrible things inspire curiosity, I think. Look, I will put it to bed for you, and then we can be done with it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "My ancestors - at least, a crucial..."
entries.text: My ancestors - at least, a crucial few of them - were awful people. People who valued wealth over other people.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "They were Catholic, you see, and so..."
entries.text: They were Catholic, you see, and so knew of many other Catholics in a time when it was outlawed.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "They turned these other families ov..."
entries.text: They turned these other families over to the crown and were rewarded for it. But it's not like it went unnoticed.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "So they were cursed for it in retri..."
entries.text: So they were cursed for it in retribution; cursed with terrible and early fates, with, in general, grave misfortune.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And, as it turns out, it followed t..."
entries.text: And, as it turns out, it followed the bloodline. So, one hundred years removed, I am one of the only three remaining Quinns.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I have lost my parents, my aunts an..."
entries.text: I have lost my parents, my aunts and uncles, my cousins, and my siblings - bar, thank God, two.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I've dedicated myself to learning h..."
entries.text: I've dedicated myself to learning how to break this curse to save us. I became a damned master of my craft to do so.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "My ancestors - at least, a crucial..."
entries.text: My ancestors - at least, a crucial few of them - were awful people. People who valued wealth over others' lives.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And, well, they turned many of thos..."
entries.text: And, well, they turned many of those over to the crown for coin.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "So they were cursed for it; cursed..."
entries.text: So they were cursed for it; cursed with terrible and early fates, along with, in general, grave misfortune.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And, as it turns out, the curse fol..."
entries.text: And, as it turns out, the curse followed the bloodline. So, less than one hundred years removed, I am one of the only three remaining Quinns.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I have lost my parents, my aunts an..."
entries.text: I have lost my parents, my aunts and uncles, my cousins, and my siblings - bar two, thank God.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I've dedicated myself to learning h..."
entries.text: I've dedicated myself to learning how to break this curse and save us - I've become a damned master of my craft-

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And now it's come to this. Learning..."
entries.text: And now it's come to this. Learning the name of the spirit I need to appease, and finding myself unable to reach her.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Is that enough? Have I made the tra..."
entries.text: Is that enough? Have I made the tragedy clear for you?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And in the end - it took you, askin..."
entries.text: And in the end - it took you, asking questions where you probably should not have been.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't know what my life will look..."
entries.text: I don't know what my life will look like now, Mister Ward, or what sort of home I will have for myself...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But if you ever find yourself in my..."
entries.text: But if you ever find yourself in my part of England, and don't mind modest means, you should come by. You've earned a lifetime of warm welcomes.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "What stupid, meaningless deaths."
entries.text: What stupid, meaningless deaths.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "They were Catholic, you see, and kn..."
entries.text: They were Catholic, you see, and knew many other Catholics - including some wanted by the Crown.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But it's not like it went unnoticed..."
entries.text: But it's not like it went unnoticed.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "...and still, it remains."
entries.text: ...and still, it remains.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "What stupid, meaningless deaths."
entries.text: What stupid, meaningless deaths.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "All for some coin and comfort."
entries.text: All for some coin and comfort.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Shay O'Connor - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Miss Barbosa's father was named Sea..."
entries.text: Miss Barbosa's father was named Seamus O'Connor, it turns out.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She found it, then? I am glad for h..."
entries.text: She found it, then? I am glad for her. Good to see my research put to even more positive use.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/well scrying - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know about well scrying..."
entries.text: What do you know about well scrying?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It's an Irish tradition, gazing int..."
entries.text: It's an Irish tradition, gazing into a well and asking for answers.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It doesn't seem to have transferred..."
entries.text: It doesn't seem to have transferred to England like you might expect of a mostly secular spiritual practice.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It might be that it only works, at..."
entries.text: It might be that it only works, at least as it's known, in Ireland. I wonder...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Miss Callaghan was kind enough to l..."
entries.text: Miss Callaghan was kind enough to lead me in a session. I wanted to see that my sisters were well.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I trust they are?"
entries.text: I trust they are?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Yes. When I saw them, they seemed f..."
entries.text: Yes. When I saw them, they seemed fine, thank God.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Can I ask you what has you out here..."
entries.text: Can I ask you what has you out here?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Ah, I thought I heard someone. It w..."
entries.text: Ah, I thought I heard someone. It was you, then?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "We're well scrying. Someone with th..."
entries.text: We're well scrying. Someone with the right aptitude can look into a well and receive visions. Usually even of the sort they request.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "And you are one of these people, wi..."
entries.text: And you are one of these people, with the right sort of aptitude?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "To everyone's astonishment, I'm sur..."
entries.text: To everyone's astonishment, I'm sure.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Forgive me, but I overheard some of..."
entries.text: Forgive me, but I overheard some of your conversation with Miss Callaghan, earlier.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Is that so?"
entries.text: Is that so?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "May I ask you what you were talking..."
entries.text: May I ask you what you were talking about?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I... suppose it's no harm. We were..."
entries.text: I... suppose it's no harm. We were scrying. I wanted to see that my sisters were well.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I trust they are?"
entries.text: I trust they are?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Yes. When I saw them, they seemed f..."
entries.text: Yes. When I saw them, they seemed fine, thank God.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "What is she doing out here?"
entries.text: What is she doing out here?

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Choice: "What was she talking about with Mis..."
entries.text: What was she talking about with Miss Callaghan at the well?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I have arranged a session with Miss..."
entries.text: I have arranged a session with Miss Callaghan. I want to check on family.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/strange paper - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you leave this behind in the li..."
entries.text: Did you leave this behind in the library, Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "That is my handwriting, certainly...."
entries.text: That is my handwriting, certainly. It looks like... Ah, it's one of my notes. Magical theory.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But I'm beyond the theorising part,..."
entries.text: But I'm beyond the theorising part, now...

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/book of crests - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "There's a book of Irish family cres..."
entries.text: There's a book of Irish family crests in the library.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "The Quinn family crest has a pegasu..."
entries.text: The Quinn family crest has a pegasus on it. I was always very proud of that when I was small.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Usually, you can identify crests by..."
entries.text: Usually, you can identify crests by the main imagery. There will be one image or motif that gets used on all sorts of things.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "People used to care more about that..."
entries.text: People used to care more about that sort of thing.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Deane's room - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know which room Miss Deane w..."
entries.text: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Mm, if I did at one point, I don't..."
entries.text: Mm, if I did at one point, I don't recall now. She must have been near me, though. How strange... It doesn't seem likely I would forget that...

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Enochian magic

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know anything abou..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about Enochian magic?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I can't say angels are my forté. If..."
entries.text: I can't say angels are my forté. If anything, I seem to be attended by a distinct lack of them.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But that's not the case for all of..."
entries.text: But that's not the case for all of the guests here... have you been speaking to Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He's something of a known quantity..."
entries.text: He's something of a known quantity when it comes to that sort of thing. I don't know of anyone who's quite so... invested in the discipline.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Better the discipline, though, than..."
entries.text: Better the discipline, though, than his other exploits. Angels only attend the sides of those that need them, after all.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "So he's known to engineer situation..."
entries.text: So he's known to engineer situations for himself in which the angel would appear. Life and death...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "A ridiculous privilege of a venture..."
entries.text: A ridiculous privilege of a venture, to choose to look death in the eyes. But I suppose you can, knowing it's not on your heels.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I've heard it said. Angels only att..."
entries.text: I've heard it said. Angels only attend the sides of those that need them, after all.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "So it's said he will engineer situa..."
entries.text: So it's said he will engineer situations for himself in which the angel would appear. Life and death...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "A ridiculous privilege of a venture..."
entries.text: A ridiculous privilege of a venture, to choose to look death in the eyes. But I suppose you can, knowing it's not on your heels.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Is Mister O'Meara known for his......"
entries.text: Is Mister O'Meara known for his... dangerous exploits?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I hope he thinks better of it."
entries.text: I hope he thinks better of it.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Enochian magic - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know anything abou..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about Enochian magic?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I can't say angels are my forté. If..."
entries.text: I can't say angels are my forté. If anything, I seem to be attended by a distinct lack of them.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But that's not the case for all of..."
entries.text: But that's not the case for all of the guests here... have you been speaking to Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He's something of a known quantity..."
entries.text: He's something of a known quantity when it comes to that sort of thing. I don't know of anyone who's quite so... invested in the discipline.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Better the discipline, though, than..."
entries.text: Better the discipline, though, than his other exploits. Angels only attend the sides of those that need them, after all.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "So he's known to engineer situation..."
entries.text: So he's known to engineer situations for himself in which the angel would appear. Life and death...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "A ridiculous privilege of a venture..."
entries.text: A ridiculous privilege of a venture, to choose to look death in the eyes. But I suppose you can, knowing it's not on your heels.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Magical Grimoire - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to recognise this, Mi..."
entries.text: Do you happen to recognise this, Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "...You know, I'd like to know where..."
entries.text: ...You know, I'd like to know where you found this, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "This is the sort of magic only toye..."
entries.text: This is the sort of magic only toyed with by egotists and fools, and you strike me as neither.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'd forget you saw it before some,..."
entries.text: I'd forget you saw it before some, or all of us, get hurt.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Coded Papers - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do these dots mean anything to you..."
entries.text: Do these dots mean anything to you Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "...It looks to me like a hidden mes..."
entries.text: ...It looks to me like a hidden message. Magically hidden, I mean.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "You'd need some sort of pattern to..."
entries.text: You'd need some sort of pattern to show it up - though I suspect only the caster knows what it is.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It's probably something important t..."
entries.text: It's probably something important to them. Or something they'd be able to remember, anyway.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Chimney Charm - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found this on the grounds. What d..."
entries.text: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It looks like a charm of some sort...."
entries.text: It looks like a charm of some sort. Old, low magic, I'd imagine. But it doesn't look like anything I do, so I couldn't tell you much more than that.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Witchcraft Components- Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of this? Are they..."
entries.text: What do you make of this? Are they components for a charm or ritual of some sort?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hm. It does look to be something li..."
entries.text: Hm. It does look to be something like that. My guess would be it's a traditional charm of some sort. Old magic, you know?

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/timetable - Corentine

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Truthfully, I think anyone would ha..."
entries.text: Truthfully, I think anyone would have a hard time getting me out of the library this weekend, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I wish I could spend another day in..."
entries.text: I wish I could spend another day in the library again, but I cannot.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What's this weekend looking like fo..."
entries.text: What's this weekend looking like for you, Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Anything exciting planned for today..."
entries.text: Anything exciting planned for today?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Otherwise, I've Miss Mantovani's ta..."
entries.text: Otherwise, I've Miss Mantovani's talk at five and dinner at seven. As for tomorrow...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I suppose some variety would be goo..."
entries.text: I suppose some variety would be good for me. I'll be in church for the service at noon and, after some time in the graveyard, I have lunch at one.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'm also seeing Doctor Callaghan's..."
entries.text: I'm also seeing Doctor Callaghan's talk at three. I've yet to decide what I'll do between it and attending the silent dinner at eight.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Which then brings us to the séance..."
entries.text: Which then brings us to the séance at 9pm. I'm eager to see Miss Mantovani work.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'm planning to enjoy the library a..."
entries.text: I'm planning to enjoy the library again all day, and perhaps the graveyard too. Go ahead and marvel at my whimsy.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'll be sitting the séance out in m..."
entries.text: I'll be sitting the séance out in my room.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/End of quest - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "With the ritual complete, am I to u..."
entries.text: With the ritual complete, am I to understand that the Quinn family is free of their curse?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I've instructed my solicitor to tra..."
entries.text: I've instructed my solicitor to transfer all the deeds to Miss Barbosa. If 'Biddy' O'Connor keeps her word... yes, I think it's done.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Finally. Finally."
entries.text: Finally. Finally.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "If I might ask... will you and your..."
entries.text: If I might ask... will you and your family be alright? Losing that much land and the money from it must mean you're losing most of your assets.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Oh, almost everything - we will be..."
entries.text: Oh, almost everything - we will be significantly poorer, there's no doubt about that. It will not be easy.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But I have some renown as a poet. I..."
entries.text: But I have some renown as a poet. I'll find the money for my sisters' dowries that way, and I will work for my living.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "We are going to be okay. I will see..."
entries.text: We are going to be okay. I will see to it. I got us this far. And I suppose you did too, in the end - so thank you, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "No, none of it will be easy. But it..."
entries.text: No, none of it will be easy. But it will be worth it. After all - for the first time in my life, I have a future.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Ivy and Darragh - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Were you aware that Miss McLeod and..."
entries.text: Were you aware that Miss McLeod and Mister Hunter are close?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I can't say I know either of them w..."
entries.text: I can't say I know either of them well enough to be privy to that sort of thing, no. But I suppose I do now.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Funny. We all try so hard to seem g..."
entries.text: Funny. We all try so hard to seem good and proper, and almost no one is. And for good reason. What do we gain, being proper?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Just the denial of things that make..."
entries.text: Just the denial of things that make life bearable. The denial of a dear friendship or a moment's respite...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "The world is ridiculous."
entries.text: The world is ridiculous.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/Blackmail letter - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you make of this?"
entries.text: What do you make of this?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Ugh... Good God, that's low, even f..."
entries.text: Ugh... Good God, that's low, even for Evelyn.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't know what your opinions on..."
entries.text: I don't know what your opinions on these matters are, Mister Ward, but look at it this way.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Of all those involved in this, only..."
entries.text: Of all those involved in this, only Evelyn is doing anyone any harm. I would suggest you keep this to yourself, lest you start a scandal.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Surely Miss McLeod being blackmaile..."
entries.text: Surely Miss McLeod being blackmailed into service is enough for them to contend with just for now... Don't you think?

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/gauge - corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you seen the strange device, t..."
entries.text: Have you seen the strange device, the one with the green jar, in the atrium?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Even I am not distracted enough to..."
entries.text: Even I am not distracted enough to miss that. It looks impressive, but without knowing much about it, that is all I can say.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Evidence Presents - Corentine/washer woman - quinn

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I've seen her, yes. She's a bean ni..."
entries.text: I've seen her, yes. She's a bean nigh. A spirit of warning.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spotted a woman washing cl..."
entries.text: Have you spotted a woman washing clothes in any strange places?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Whoever's clothes she washes is fat..."
entries.text: Whoever's clothes she washes is fated to die. I do not know if it is preventable.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But just in case, I have been tryin..."
entries.text: But just in case, I have been trying to figure out whose clothes I saw her wash.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But I have had no luck. In my defen..."
entries.text: But I have had no luck. In my defence, I have been largely preoccupied with saving my own, first and foremost.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Skerritt - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know Mister Skerritt?"
entries.text: Do you know Mister Skerritt?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I do. He's one of the wealthiest me..."
entries.text: I do. He's one of the wealthiest men in London. The last of an old banking family. In my position, it would be hard not to know him.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He seemed... disinterested, once he..."
entries.text: He seemed... disinterested, once he had the scope of me, though. And I am no worse for it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Lan Fen - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the chance to speak wi..."
entries.text: Have you had the chance to speak with Missus Lau?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She seems canny - though somewhat o..."
entries.text: She seems canny - though somewhat out of place, being a regular academic.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "We had a lively exchange about her..."
entries.text: We had a lively exchange about her work, but her expression shifted as Miss Deane passed us by.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Though I cannot claim to speak for..."
entries.text: Though I cannot claim to speak for Missus Lau, in that moment, her eyes spoke volumes.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I wouldn’t be the least bit surpris..."
entries.text: I wouldn’t be the least bit surprised if she and Miss Deane had some sour dealings in the past.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Something we share, her and I."
entries.text: Something we share, her and I.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Ivy - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I suppose you've met Miss McLeod?"
entries.text: I suppose you've met Miss McLeod?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I have. For all the people I've met..."
entries.text: I have. For all the people I've met who wrongfully claim to see the future... I think I believe her.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She's got spirit. Charming, too. I'..."
entries.text: She's got spirit. Charming, too. I'm inclined to like her.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Varley - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you speak to the manager?"
entries.text: Did you speak to the manager?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Only about getting some more writin..."
entries.text: Only about getting some more writing paper.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He’s not much for small talk, but h..."
entries.text: He’s not much for small talk, but he certainly puts in the effort to accommodate his guests who lean towards the arts.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I heard he placed a Gramophone insi..."
entries.text: I heard he placed a Gramophone inside Mister Toussaint’s room upon request, and the other day I saw him carrying paint supplies to Mister Coventry’s room.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Caitlin - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the housekeeper?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Only a little. She asked me where I..."
entries.text: Only a little. She asked me where I was visiting from.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Though why she wanted to know, I co..."
entries.text: Though why she wanted to know, I couldn't say... There are people here from more interesting places.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the housekeeper?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "... It might be more accurate to sa..."
entries.text: ... It might be more accurate to say that the housekeeper has spoken to me.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She spent ten minutes cautioning me..."
entries.text: She spent ten minutes cautioning me on the health hazards of being near Miss Mantovani - and also in libraries.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't recall that I ever responde..."
entries.text: I don't recall that I ever responded.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Seamus - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you happen to have met the port..."
entries.text: Did you happen to have met the porter?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Of course. He carried my bags in. T..."
entries.text: Of course. He carried my bags in. Thankfully, there was very little that was delicate in them, as he kept dropping them.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He was very sorry about it, but it..."
entries.text: He was very sorry about it, but it was clear he was... wasn't all there.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "One of my cousins died from an over..."
entries.text: One of my cousins died from an overreliance on drugs and, well... Mister Doyle should probably clean up his act...

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Darragh - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met the stable master?"
entries.text: Have you met the stable master?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He's spoken with me whenever I visi..."
entries.text: He's spoken with me whenever I visited the horses. I was there to talk to the actual horses, mind you.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I did hear him mutter something abo..."
entries.text: I did hear him mutter something about Deane, which I took to mean Miss Deane - I have yet to meet a person she hasn't rubbed the wrong way!

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Corentine - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What can you tell me about yourself..."
entries.text: What can you tell me about yourself, Miss Quinn?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Mm. Let's see."
entries.text: Mm. Let's see.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I am a poet by trade, and I have ha..."
entries.text: I am a poet by trade, and I have had some success with it. I am twenty-five, traditionally qualified, and the head of my household.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "That being for lack of anyone more..."
entries.text: That being for lack of anyone more traditionally qualified, you understand.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "...and I am a scholar of grimoire m..."
entries.text: ...and I am a scholar of grimoire magic, which is to say I study it rather than rely on a divine source. How does that do?

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Evelyn - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What do you know of Miss Deane?"
entries.text: What do you know of Miss Deane?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Oh, you know... Irish, of a certain..."
entries.text: Oh, you know... Irish, of a certain class, interested in mysticism... most branches, rather than one in particular.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't know what she does these da..."
entries.text: I don't know what she does these days. I only know it's not grimoire magic, because that was why she first spoke to me.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Sir, I'm really quite busy."
entries.text: Sir, I'm really quite busy.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She learned her lot and decided it..."
entries.text: She learned her lot and decided it wasn't for her. Now I hear she's a member of the Hermetic Order Of The Golden Dawn.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "You'd have to ask another of them t..."
entries.text: You'd have to ask another of them to know for sure, of course.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But frankly, you'd do better asking..."
entries.text: But frankly, you'd do better asking someone else. Evelyn and I haven't been on speaking terms for some time.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't know what she does these da..."
entries.text: I don't know what she does these days, but when we met, she was hunting for ancient secrets in grimoires.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Ettiene - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Touissant?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Touissant?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It's the first opportunity I've had..."
entries.text: It's the first opportunity I've had to put a face to the name - I made time to make my introductions.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You're pleased to see him?"
entries.text: You're pleased to see him?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I respect him, and I respect his wo..."
entries.text: I respect him, and I respect his work. And, as I hear, he's perfectly decent about it. I haven't heard him hurling baseless accusations yet.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He does important work, Mister Ward..."
entries.text: He does important work, Mister Ward. Anyone who tries to tell you there are no charlatans in the field deserves a good, hard look themselves.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Ines - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you have cause to speak with M..."
entries.text: Have you have cause to speak with Miss Barbosa?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Mm... cause? No. But I ended up bes..."
entries.text: Mm... cause? No. But I ended up beside her at tea one day, and she is, dare I say, good fun.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Over here because of an Irish fathe..."
entries.text: Over here because of an Irish father, so she says... Funny, how even after they've passed, your family can take you all sorts of places.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Cathal - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you know Mister O'M..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you know Mister O'Meara?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "No, but I know enough to know his t..."
entries.text: No, but I know enough to know his type. Born rich, never worked for anything, spends daddy's money on new ways to feel alive.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I tried to tell him I'm sure it was..."
entries.text: I tried to tell him I'm sure it was my fault, but he was very apologetic all the same.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Anyhow, we talked, somewhat, after..."
entries.text: Anyhow, we talked, somewhat, after that, so to answer your question, yes.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He is, perhaps, peculiar, but only..."
entries.text: He is, perhaps, peculiar, but only in exactly the way you'd expect of an event like this. I take him to be quite amicable. Quite sweet, actually.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "That man has hardly a thought for t..."
entries.text: That man has hardly a thought for the world around him. I might sympathise, under different circumstances.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But as it is... You know, I think I..."
entries.text: But as it is... You know, I think I would like him quite a lot, were he less hellbent on wasting a perfectly decent life.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It's not perfect, I'm sure, but I h..."
entries.text: It's not perfect, I'm sure, but I have no doubt it's not worth throwing away in some stupid, avoidable accident he'll engineer for himself.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "A waste of a life and a perfectly d..."
entries.text: A waste of a life and a perfectly decent man, frankly. He's quite sweet when you manage to get past it all.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I've heard of his antics, and unles..."
entries.text: I've heard of his antics, and unless he changes his ways, it'll not be long before he's the ghost loved ones are trying to reach...

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Dupré - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Mister Dupré?"
entries.text: Have you met Mister Dupré?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Well, I haven't been much for talki..."
entries.text: Well, I haven't been much for talking, but I've been trying to make the time.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "He's very friendly, which is rare t..."
entries.text: He's very friendly, which is rare to see, and if I'm to be honest with you, I like that about a person.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "The formality demanded by proper ac..."
entries.text: The formality demanded by proper acquaintanceship gets so damn dull.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "So, for what little time I have for..."
entries.text: So, for what little time I have for it, I welcome friendly conversation. And thus, I find I also welcome Mister Dupré.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Besides, I'm too morbid for most, a..."
entries.text: Besides, I'm too morbid for most, and he has a higher tolerance for that sort of thing.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on D'Arcy - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Did you happen to meet Missus D'Arc..."
entries.text: Did you happen to meet Missus D'Arcy?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Why, when I heard Olivia D'Arcy was..."
entries.text: Why, when I heard Olivia D'Arcy was here, I had to make some sort of introduction.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "My younger sister and I so enjoyed..."
entries.text: My younger sister and I so enjoyed her debut novel, she wouldn't have forgiven me if I hadn't said hello.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She's a charming woman. Just as wry..."
entries.text: She's a charming woman. Just as wry as one would expect, and besides - it's always nice to meet another author.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Coventry - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you had the opportunity to mee..."
entries.text: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister Coventry?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I have. I would have assumed we'd n..."
entries.text: I have. I would have assumed we'd not have much to talk about - he's no magician, not gentry, and no writer.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "...Which makes me sound very snobby..."
entries.text: ...Which makes me sound very snobby, but I simply mean I don't have much else I can talk on.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But he knew of my poetry, and we di..."
entries.text: But he knew of my poetry, and we discussed that for a while.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It was very distracting, honestly."
entries.text: It was very distracting, honestly.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Hazel - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Not really. She said hello, but I'm..."
entries.text: Not really. She said hello, but I'm so busy...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I will have to at some point, thoug..."
entries.text: I will have to at some point, though. I keep running into her.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I just... hers is a style of occult..."
entries.text: I just... hers is a style of occultism that I find very... shallow?

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Ruairí - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Doctor Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Ah, yes. I do like it when the scie..."
entries.text: Ah, yes. I do like it when the scientists pitch in - once they accept certain supernatural details, of course. It makes for interesting conversation.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "A shame for me that he is so focuse..."
entries.text: A shame for me that he is so focused on the future - he wasn't able to help me much with my search into the past.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Carmela - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Miss Mantovani?"
entries.text: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I've seen her in London before, tho..."
entries.text: I've seen her in London before, though we didn't speak.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She was quiet when we talked here,..."
entries.text: She was quiet when we talked here, but she didn't stay for long. She had a look in her eyes... a sadness.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't see that often in the eyes..."
entries.text: I don't see that often in the eyes of talented mystics. Usually, they have seen so much that they show nothing.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Blake - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know the Marquess?"
entries.text: Do you know the Marquess?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "No, I do not. Some of my family kne..."
entries.text: No, I do not. Some of my family knew of him, so I had an impression of the man.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Studious, hard working, quiet - a d..."
entries.text: Studious, hard working, quiet - a devout protestant.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I gather his father spent a generou..."
entries.text: I gather his father spent a generous portion of the family fortune on a lavish lifestyle across Europe - all while Ireland struggled through the famine.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And so, he tasked himself with rebu..."
entries.text: And so, he tasked himself with rebuilding the family's funds by turning the place into a hotel.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But the man I met now - the one who..."
entries.text: But the man I met now - the one who opened his doors to this gathering, this event... - well, there is a gulf between the man I heard of and the one I met here.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Ó Finn - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've had the oppo..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've had the opportunity to speak to Mister Ó Finn, have you?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "The master of the lands? I did corn..."
entries.text: The master of the lands? I did corner him for some information on the people of the region, but he seems more focused on the myths - at some moments, I got the impression he couldn't actually distinguish the two.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Fiadh - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I have. She is..."
entries.text: I have. She is...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She means well, but her eyes are fu..."
entries.text: She means well, but her eyes are full of pity - and I cannot abide pity.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I cannot use pity, pity does not se..."
entries.text: I cannot use pity, pity does not set anything right. Only action does.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you met Father Sinnott?"
entries.text: Have you met Father Sinnott?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I haven't been especially compelled..."
entries.text: I haven't been especially compelled to introduce myself. Clergymen often disapprove of me.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "As a rule, they dislike vocal women..."
entries.text: As a rule, they dislike vocal women. Or perhaps women as a whole. I've heard of their Magdalene laundries - asylums for anyone found guilty of the crime of being born female.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "So, as intrigued as I am to what bu..."
entries.text: So, as intrigued as I am to what business he has here, I will be staying clear.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Arwa - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you made Miss Hisham's acquain..."
entries.text: Have you made Miss Hisham's acquaintance?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I mean - insomuch as we spoke brief..."
entries.text: I mean - insomuch as we spoke briefly, but she and I both seem to be occupied, you know?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She is not. Instead, there is somet..."
entries.text: She is not. Instead, there is something... disconcerting about her. Something I cannot put my finger on.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Still, she seems like she might mak..."
entries.text: Still, she seems like she might make interesting company, if she were in the mood, but...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Is that how other people feel when..."
entries.text: Is that how other people feel when they talk to me?

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Saoirse - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to Miss Murphy?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to Miss Murphy?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "That would be... not the housekeepe..."
entries.text: That would be... not the housekeeper... Oh, the cook? I haven't said anything in particular to her.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She seems nervous around all this w..."
entries.text: She seems nervous around all this well-to-do company - why drag her into a conversation she doesn't wish to be a part of?

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Campbell - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Have you spoken to the Reverend?"
entries.text: Have you spoken to the Reverend?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "No, and I don't intend to. The last..."
entries.text: No, and I don't intend to. The last thing I am here for is preaching.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Higgins - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I don't suppose you've seen a man a..."
entries.text: I don't suppose you've seen a man around here - not a guest, but quite a large fellow; he's distinctive.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I can't say I've had eyes for much..."
entries.text: I can't say I've had eyes for much at all but the contents of the library.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "What might he be doing, if he's not..."
entries.text: What might he be doing, if he's not a guest?

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Character Presents - Corentine/Opinion on Walter Blake - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you know much about Walter Blake..."
entries.text: Do you know much about Walter Blake?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Not a lot. I've heard of him and ga..."
entries.text: Not a lot. I've heard of him and gather he is the family's last hope. Frankly, I've been too busy with the survival of my own lot to care too much.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Analysis Presents - (to) Corentine/Well and practically dressed - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "That's quite a striking brooch you..."
entries.text: That's quite a striking brooch you have.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "My sister gave it to me as a keepsa..."
entries.text: My sister gave it to me as a keepsake when I set off. A good luck charm, she called it.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I hope that she is right."
entries.text: I hope that she is right.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Given how everything has played out..."
entries.text: Given how everything has played out, I think she was right.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Forgive me, Miss, but can I ask - h..."
entries.text: Forgive me, Miss, but can I ask - how did you end up with the injuries you've sustained?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Ah... How do I... Is it enough to s..."
entries.text: Ah... How do I... Is it enough to say I have terrible luck?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But there is some luck, I suppose,..."
entries.text: But there is some luck, I suppose, in the fact that I have only been scarred, and it hasn't killed me yet.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You talk like there's something aft..."
entries.text: You talk like there's something after you.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It does look that way, Mister Ward."
entries.text: It does look that way, Mister Ward.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Analysis Presents - (to) Corentine/Pen in pocket - Corentine

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "You've a pen in your pocket, Miss...."
entries.text: You've a pen in your pocket, Miss. Just in case it slipped your mind.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Oh, don't worry, it's clean. I've s..."
entries.text: Oh, don't worry, it's clean. I've stained enough of my clothes not to make that mistake again.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I take it you're not often without..."
entries.text: I take it you're not often without one.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I'm a poet by trade. I prefer to ca..."
entries.text: I'm a poet by trade. I prefer to carry one so I'm never caught with a refrain, or suchlike, and without the means to write it down.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Idiots and ghouls, all of you..."
entries.text: Idiots and ghouls, all of you...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "What did you think would happen? Th..."
entries.text: What did you think would happen? That nobody would mind? That they were not entirely as capable of vengeance as you?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And for what? For sixteen funerals..."
entries.text: And for what? For sixteen funerals in thirty years, but at least - oh, at least the caskets were nice.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And you never even saw the ruin you..."
entries.text: And you never even saw the ruin you caused! It's just me in this godforsaken library! Bastards. What damnable stock we are!

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn

entries.text: Excuse me, would you? I just - I need to think.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Ritual

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And I appreciate it. Alright. Alrig..."
entries.text: And I appreciate it. Alright. Alright, one more time.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hear me, 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor, I ca..."
entries.text: Hear me, 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor, I call you from beyond the grave. Hear me, the child of the family you damned.

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "Santo Cristo! Um fantasma!"
entries.text: Santo Cristo! Um fantasma!

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hear me, so that we may bury all th..."
entries.text: Hear me, so that we may bury all this grief.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Are you 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor?"
entries.text: Are you 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Good. My name is Corentine Quinn. I..."
entries.text: Good. My name is Corentine Quinn. I am of the third generation of the Quinn family since Fiontan Quinn, and now one of the three of us that remain.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It is myself, and my two sisters. T..."
entries.text: It is myself, and my two sisters. The people that wronged you - and they did wrong you, I will not deny it - they're long since dead by your curse.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "My ancestors sinned against you, bu..."
entries.text: My ancestors sinned against you, but we did not. For the sake of my life, for my dear sisters' lives, I implore you to release us from your curse.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Would you consider this, now the ma..."
entries.text: Would you consider this, now the man who hurt you so is dead?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Excellent, alright. Let me think. D..."
entries.text: Excellent, alright. Let me think. Do you require your bones to be laid to rest?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "If too many candles blow out, the r..."
entries.text: If too many candles blow out, the ritual will be over, spent, and I will have lost my chance. My family will be doomed.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Do you have some unfinished busines..."
entries.text: Do you have some unfinished business here that I could see to on your behalf?

entries.speaker: Spirit
entries.label: Spirit: "..."

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "They betrayed their fellow Catholic..."
entries.text: They betrayed their fellow Catholics to the Crown, and then they took the land- Oh. Oh! Maybe...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "'Biddy' O'Connor, you would have me..."
entries.text: 'Biddy' O'Connor, you would have me relinquish my claim on that land, the money from it?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She... Oh, why didn't I see it? - M..."
entries.text: She... Oh, why didn't I see it? - Miss Barbosa - Ines - would you accept the Quinn lands, and the money we made from it?

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "What...?"
entries.text: What...?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "It was ill-got, it shouldn't be our..."
entries.text: It was ill-got, it shouldn't be ours - and if it will satisfy 'Biddy' O'Connor for her descendant to have it... Will you take it? Please?

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "You are serious..."
entries.text: You are serious...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "'Biddy' Eve O'Connor, from the bott..."
entries.text: 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor, from the bottom of my heart, I offer you my deepest apologies for all the wrong done to you, and my promise, the Quinn fortune will go to Ines Barbosa.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "She can do with it as she likes. I..."
entries.text: She can do with it as she likes. I will relinquish every acre and every penny of it immediately. This I swear to you, on my honour and my life.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "And if that's all that need be said..."
entries.text: And if that's all that need be said, then... Then, I bid you goodbye, 'Biddy' O'Connor, and thank you. May you rest in peace.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Come, Miss Barbosa. We'll go to the..."
entries.text: Come, Miss Barbosa. We'll go to the telegraph room and send word to my lawyers so they can get the paperwork in order.

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "Huh. Lead the way, I suppose?"
entries.text: Huh. Lead the way, I suppose?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "You'll be needed too, Mister Ward,..."
entries.text: You'll be needed too, Mister Ward, to witness. Come along, would you?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Thank you, Miss Barbosa - this coul..."
entries.text: Thank you, Miss Barbosa - this could well save the lives of the last people that truly matter to me.

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "I do not understand how being in a..."
entries.text: I do not understand how being in a bathroom with two strangers is helping, but I am eager to learn.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "..."

entries.speaker: Spirit
entries.label: Spirit: "..."

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "The same 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor that..."
entries.text: The same 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor that cursed Fiontan Quinn and his descendants?

entries.speaker: Spirit
entries.label: Spirit: "..."

entries.speaker: Spirit
entries.label: Spirit: "..."

entries.speaker: Spirit
entries.label: Spirit: "..."

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "What does that mean?"
entries.text: What does that mean?

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "Oh..."
entries.text: Oh...

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "How many candles are too many?"
entries.text: How many candles are too many?

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "Tsss... What did your ancestors do..."
entries.text: Tsss... What did your ancestors do to deserve all this?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "I don't know, but I don't like the..."
entries.text: I don't know, but I don't like the chances. The spell is already failing. I don't think it will survive another wrong question, another extinguished candle...

entries.speaker: Spirit
entries.label: Spirit: "..."

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "Yes. I will accept it."
entries.text: Yes. I will accept it.

title: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Post ritual conversation

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "I know this is a séance but I did n..."
entries.text: I know this is a séance but I did not expect to see a ghost quite so... close...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Yes, I am sure it is a lot to take..."
entries.text: Yes, I am sure it is a lot to take in...

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "But look, that hardly matters now;..."
entries.text: But look, that hardly matters now; I'm going to write to my solicitor and have him prepare everything for you. All we will need then is to get the deeds to you.

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "So, you're serious? It was not a li..."
entries.text: So, you're serious? It was not a lie to trick the spirit?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Completely and utterly serious, Mis..."
entries.text: Completely and utterly serious, Miss Barbosa. One does not trick ghosts and come off the better for it.

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "Ines. Just call me Ines. All this....."
entries.text: Ines. Just call me Ines. All this... It's hard to comprehend.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Well, you have the rest of your lif..."
entries.text: Well, you have the rest of your life to get your head around it, Ines. And now, so do I.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "...And if I am to call you that, th..."
entries.text: ...And if I am to call you that, then you must call me Corentine. I've always hated "Miss Quinn".

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "If you say so, Corentine. Plenty of..."
entries.text: If you say so, Corentine. Plenty of time to get familiar now, yes?

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Now. You sign here to prove you acc..."
entries.text: Now. You sign here to prove you accepted them, then you here Mister Ward as witness.

entries.speaker: Miss Quinn
entries.label: Corentine: "Hah! Isn't there just? But you know..."
entries.text: Hah! Isn't there just? But you know, I think I am done with summoning the damned. I am going to skip the séance and do something I've not done for some time - think about the future.

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "As much as I value the lands and we..."
entries.text: As much as I value the lands and wealth, that is the real treasure in all of this.

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "Very good. And I, I now have my fat..."
entries.text: Very good. And I, I now have my father's real name - Seamus O'Connor.

entries.speaker: Miss Barbosa
entries.label: Ines: "And for her to be my grandmother..."
entries.text: And for her to be my grandmother...

entries.text: Hello again, Sir. Uh, need something?

entries.text: I'll leave you be.

entries.label: Doyle: "The name's Doyle, Sir. I'm the port..."

entries.text: I will, thank you Mister Doyle.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "Shove that séance, I'm not going! A..."
entries.text: Shove that séance, I'm not going! And tell Father Sinnott that I'm sorry, but he's on his own.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "Wha... What... Oh God. It... Ah......"
entries.text: Wha... What... Oh God. It... Ah... it's all coming back to me now...

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "I do work for Sinnott! ...Or I did...."
entries.text: I do work for Sinnott! ...Or I did. I came and took the old porter's job when he was let go for misconduct.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "When was that? A year ago? I don't..."
entries.text: When was that? A year ago? I don't really know. The last few months are hazy...

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "I was to map the grounds, find the..."
entries.text: I was to map the grounds, find the Aeon, and bring Sinnott here to free it from its prison.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "I... things are foggy here. I forgo..."
entries.text: I... things are foggy here. I forgot all this. I don't think it was the drink, drugs, or even Miss Deane that did that.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "What now?"
entries.text: What now?

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "Yeah... What now? I don't care abou..."
entries.text: Yeah... What now? I don't care about that old life. It doesn't feel like mine anymore.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "But I don't want this life either...."
entries.text: But I don't want this life either. I was thinking of going away, but something's been stopping me.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "But not anymore. Now I can move on..."
entries.text: But not anymore. Now I can move on from all this. Once I get my pay for this weekend, I'm leaving to see the world!

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle

entries.text: What's taking him so long? Oh, sorry Sir. Can I help you with something?

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle

entries.text: I'm not sure why talking to you has brought it all back, but... I'm glad that it has.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "I was using all that to cover up th..."
entries.text: I was using all that to cover up the confusion, the confusion caused by... this place. This place was protecting itself. From me - from Sinnott!

entries.text: I keep meaning to just ask her, but I... what room was she in? Ah, doesn't matter. She'll talk to me if she wants to.

entries.text: Other people seem to forget that anyone could be in here at all, and when they take their arguments outside, forget they might be heard.

entries.text: Her. Last Tuesday. Work was quiet, so I slipped out here. I overheard her having a fight about... something.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle

entries.text: I don't know.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "Since we're good pals now, I'll tel..."

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "..."

entries.text: I'm Doyle, by the way. The porter. We met, but you didn't bother to say hello.

entries.text: I don't know, but I hope to learn.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "Christ."
entries.text: Christ.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "She didn't care what status you had..."
entries.text: She didn't care what status you had, only what stash. Nice change for one of their lot.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "Was fun for the few days it lasted."
entries.text: Was fun for the few days it lasted.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "Probably some of this magic stuff t..."
entries.text: Probably some of this magic stuff they're all so keen on.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "You'd need to ask him, I guess."
entries.text: You'd need to ask him, I guess.

entries.speaker: Mister Doyle
entries.label: Doyle: "Well, if you're gonna be snooping a..."
entries.text: Well, if you're gonna be snooping about... It was 8pm they fought. I know because the bar was quiet with all the blue bloods playing bridge.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward

entries.text: Thank you.

entries.text: This room's yours, Sir. Number 4.

entries.text: Well... This is your room, Sir.

title: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation

entries.text: A new face. You're a little late, but you haven't missed the main event, at least. Who might you be?

entries.text: Mister Ward. What can I do for you?

entries.text: LEAVE

entries.text: I have to be on my way.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "Be well, Mister Ward."
entries.text: Be well, Mister Ward.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "My name is Declan Ward. Pleased to..."
entries.text: My name is Declan Ward. Pleased to meet you, Mister...?

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan

entries.text: Doctor, as it happens. Doctor Ruairí Callaghan. And very pleased to meet you, too.

entries.speaker: Detective Ward
entries.label: Decision: "CONFRONT!"
entries.text: CONFRONT!

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "Then maybe you can help? There has..."
entries.text: Then maybe you can help? There has to be a way to prove to Fiadh that I am not a child anymore. I've learned her ways - I'm not as good at them as she is, yes, but I've gained new knowledge she does not have! I've forged my own path, and I am her peer.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "No... my older brother - he always..."
entries.text: No... my older brother - he always overshadowed me. I began to take... risks at work. It was an effort to be seen, and in the end, it cost me dearly. It cost him dearly. I understand very well, Doctor.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "If not now, then when?"
entries.text: If not now, then when?

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "Take my research. Maybe she'll list..."
entries.text: Take my research. Maybe she'll listen to you. Maybe there's another way to convince her. I no longer see a way forward - but I haven't entirely given up hope.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "And yes, before you ask, I am relat..."
entries.text: And yes, before you ask, I am related to Fiadh Callaghan. Her nephew and apprentice.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "But I have taken what she has taugh..."
entries.text: But I have taken what she has taught me and improved it through the application of science!

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "And this weekend I will prove the v..."
entries.text: And this weekend I will prove the value of my approach, once and for all!

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I'm glad that you were in attendanc..."
entries.text: I'm glad that you were in attendance, for Miss Barbosa's sake. It was good of you to provide her that photograph.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "What good are such things, if we do..."
entries.text: What good are such things, if we don't use them where they're needed?

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "It only cost me a little time and s..."
entries.text: It only cost me a little time and some development materials. Compared to what it gets Miss Barbosa, it's nothing at all.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "Magic is born from the need for its..."
entries.text: Magic is born from the need for its practical applications, after all. What good is it if it is withheld?

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "A thing that, I would say, really s..."
entries.text: A thing that, I would say, really shouldn't need proving...

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan

entries.text: But I would imagine we stand a decent chance.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "Or, it might be a disaster and unra..."
entries.text: Or, it might be a disaster and unravel the fabric of reality. Either way, I should be here, whatever way it goes.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I can't help but wonder what a man..."
entries.text: I can't help but wonder what a man of science such as yourself would want from an event like this.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "Not that long ago, people mistook c..."
entries.text: Not that long ago, people mistook chemistry for magic. The same with medicine.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "Just because we don't fully underst..."
entries.text: Just because we don't fully understand what magic is, or what ghosts really are, does not make them unscientific.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "If this event can do what they clai..."
entries.text: If this event can do what they claim it will, it could be a massive breakthrough.

title: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Miss Deane's signature - Ruairí

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I saw that Miss Deane signed in som..."
entries.text: I saw that Miss Deane signed in some time ago when I was checking in.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: ""Didn't want to miss a moment of th..."
entries.text: "Didn't want to miss a moment of this thing," were her words, if I recall correctly.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "I do wonder where she's got to..."
entries.text: I do wonder where she's got to...

title: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Marriage talk - Ruairí

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I couldn't help but overhear that o..."
entries.text: I couldn't help but overhear that one of the young women attending is in search of a suitor.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "Here? Well! I wouldn't have thought..."
entries.text: Here? Well! I wouldn't have thought it would be the first choice, but she'll know what she's getting into, I suppose...

title: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Edward Blake - Ruairí

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "I'm no historian... But I believe h..."
entries.text: I'm no historian... But I believe he was an soldier of esteem in the invading force.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Do you happen to know anything abou..."
entries.text: Do you happen to know anything about the man who had the manor built?

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "He was 'gifted' the land by Cromwel..."
entries.text: He was 'gifted' the land by Cromwell. If one can gift something acquired like that.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "And favoured as he was by Cromwell,..."
entries.text: And favoured as he was by Cromwell, I can only imagine he was the sort of man best forgotten.

title: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Statement, Mister Varley - Ruairi

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Mister Varley says that Miss Deane..."
entries.text: Mister Varley says that Miss Deane signed out on Tuesday night by way of a letter.

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "Wait, are you sure? She's gone?"
entries.text: Wait, are you sure? She's gone?

entries.speaker: Doctor Callaghan
entries.label: Ruairí: "I would have thought she might say..."
entries.text: I would have thought she might say something...

title: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Hauntings - Ruairí
