I always knew there'd be a day like this, and yet I was not prepared. I am in the middle of it all, and still not prepared. I'm stuck trying to speak to people that aren't there anymore, or never were.

Power is for the deserving, Evelyn.
Do you deserve it?

"It's apparent I was right.
I had little doubt, of course. But the jump from instinct to confirmation has been beyond imagining. I am the descendent of a Milesian ruler. One among three. My power is not imagined, nor subjective. It is written in the authority of blood. Those curling waves emblemize my blood. Power is for the deserving, it said. I thought it ominous, at first. Even a trap. But it's clear I was paranoid. Perhaps it is simply the truth."

entries.text:
Apprentice Skerritt,
We have been back and forth on this. You have been in the order for many years, and yet you have not grasped its core tenets.
Your obsession with advancement has blinded you to the very ways to advance! Progress is gained through fraternity, charity, and self-sacrifice.
The fact that, despite many requests to stop doing so, you continue to wear your father's badge and claim his rank to impress people just shows how little you respect the order, its rites, and its processes.
Whatever secrets you seek are not for sale. They must be earned. Since you are unwilling to work towards them, it has been decided to evict you from the lodge.
We wish you well, Mister Skerritt, but do not return here. Then, across the letter, the following note is scrawled: "They deny me their magic! What kind of legacy can I forge by mundane means alone!?"

Fiadh,
You're at it again. Dragging my poor boy back from a promising life in that London - oh, don't you think he didn't tell me why he is back. More of your withershins nonsense!
For all his accomplishments he's still a wee pup with you - he'd follow you to the ends of the Earth for the time of day. Which you still won't give him.
You know he just got offered work in that St Bartholomew's - the oldest hospital they have. They don't go giving out those offers, Fiadh. It's all his hard work, impressing their lot. All that to get away form here and you call him back to help fix a broken well! The nerve.
You'd best make certain nothing harms that boy or, God help me, bean draoí or not, you'll have more to worry about than a few white hairs.
I'm serious now, no more of this.

entries.text: It's always been... eerie, around here. I don't like the idea of someone lost about the place.

entries.text: Quite right! Which is why I have us Mister Ward here. Someone at this event must be responsible for whatever's happened to Miss Deane.

entries.text: Mister Ó Finn's kidnapper is likely the same person responsible for Miss Deane's disappearance.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce

entries.text: So, we'd all best be helpful to him.

entries.text: So who else, other than yourselves, would know the grounds that well?

entries.speaker: Mister Varley

entries.text: There can't be many. Only the Marquess and the young Master know the place.

entries.text: But the Master likes to keep to himself.

entries.text: We haven't seen him for a long time.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Thank you, Missus Joyce. I will."
entries.text: Thank you, Missus Joyce. I will.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "You won't be able to get in without..."
entries.text: You won't be able to get in without the proper key, though, and the Marquess has the only copy. Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Fact of the matter is, Sir, and I w..."
entries.text: Fact of the matter is, Sir, and I won't say anything much about it as I don't want to speak ill of the Marquess or the Master...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "But you ought to go and take a look..."
entries.text: But you ought to go and take a look around the private residence, considering it all. It'd be where I'd start.

entries.speaker: Messers Varley, Hunter, & Doyle, Miss Murphy, & Missus Joyce
entries.label: staffFinale_V&D&D&S&C: "And there is nobody else."
entries.text: And there is nobody else.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I... see."
entries.text: I... see.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "...Are they... No, they are not awa..."
entries.text: ...Are they... No, they are not aware that they are speaking as one on this subject...

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "You got the key I sent with your di..."
entries.text: You got the key I sent with your dinner, yes? You ought to go and take a look around, considering it all. It'd be where I'd start.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Thank you, Missus Joyce."
entries.text: Thank you, Missus Joyce.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "The kidnapper is likely the same pe..."
entries.text: The kidnapper is likely the same person responsible for Miss Deane's disappearance.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "Look. At the ball last night, anoth..."
entries.text: Look. At the ball last night, another guest was taken. I gave chase through some catacombs, but I lost them in the hedge maze.

entries.speaker: Mister Varley
entries.label: Varley: "..."

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "He intends to hand it to me before..."
entries.text: He intends to hand it to me before the silent dinner, so I can bring the young Master his meal. Once I've done that, I'll pass it to you.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Go to the silent dinner at 8pm - th..."
entries.text: Go to the silent dinner at 8pm - that's where I'll get it to you. You'll need to act fast to be done by the séance at nine.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "You won't be able to get in without..."
entries.text: You won't be able to get in without the proper key, though. I wasn't expecting you to piece things together this late in the day, so I left the key for you at your seat at the silent dinner.

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I found that, thank you."
entries.text: I found that, thank you.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "Then you'd best get to the Blake Re..."
entries.text: Then you'd best get to the Blake Residence, there's not too much time left before the séance...

entries.speaker: Mister Ward
entries.label: Ward: "I should make my way to the dining..."
entries.text: I should make my way to the dining hall and retrieve it, then. There isn't much time before the séance.

entries.speaker: Missus Joyce
entries.label: Caitlin: "God be with you, Mister Ward."
entries.text: God be with you, Mister Ward.
